==Walkthrough==
===Kidnapping===
{{Needed|recommended=Combat equipment, preferably Ranged or Magic to utilise safespots}}
{{Map|2566,3199|align=left|r=5|height=240|width=240|mtype=square|caption=Location of quest start.}}
[[File:Lady Servil chathead.png|left]]
Head just south-west of the [[Ardougne Monastery]] and talk to [[Lady Servil]] by the north-east corner of the [[Tree Gnome Village (location)|Tree Gnome Village]] maze. She will explain that her family has been kidnapped by [[General Khazard]] and his group of mercenaries and forced to fight in their arena. The player will agree to help rescue them.

{{Map|2613,3190|mtype=pin|align=right|height=220|width=220|caption=The location of the chest containing the [[Khazard armour|armour]].}}
[[File:Fight Arena - Khazard armour chest.png|thumb|220px|The chest containing the [[Khazard armour|armour]].]]
Head east to a group of buildings located south of the [[Ardougne Monastery]]. In the most north-eastern house, search the chest to obtain [[Khazard armour]]. Equip both pieces and head south to the prison, which forms the south and east boundaries of the arena.

'''Note:''' Multiple sets of armour may be obtained using the [[drop trick]].

The guards will only let you into the prison wearing the Khazard armour. Once inside, do not remove it, or the guards will not speak to you. You can wear anything in any of the other slots.

===Staging a breakout===
{{Needed|5 coins}}
[[File:Khazard Guard chathead.png|left]]
[[Sammy Servil]] (the boy in the purple shirt) is located in the northernmost cell of the east wing of the prison. Ask him where the [[Khazard cell keys|cell keys]] are, and he will explain the Head Guard has them.

Head to the south-eastern corner of the jail and talk to the Head Guard by the staircase. He will mention his cravings for [[Khali brew]] and let it slip that last time he had too many, he fell asleep on the job.

Head to the bar found west of the western entrance to the jail, and purchase [[Khali brew]] from the [[Khazard barman]] for five [[coins]]. '''If there is no option to, you must finish the dialogue with the head guard.'''

Return to the head guard and give him the brew, and he will quickly get drunk, handing the player the keys when asked.

Ensure you have your [[combat]] [[equipment]] and prepare for three enemies you must fight in a row (all [[safespottable]]).

Use the keys on Sammy's prison door to free him and a cutscene will begin, in which Sammy enters the main arena in search of his father [[Justin Servil|Justin]], who is being attacked by a [[Khazard ogre]].

===The fights===
{{Instance}}

'''Note''': The [[dwarven multicannon]] cannot be set up in the arena.

'''Note:''' Throughout the fights, you may teleport out if you run into trouble. Speaking to the [[Khazard Guard]] by the door of the prison will take you back into the arena.

[[File:General Khazard chathead.png|left]]
You must kill the level 63 [[Khazard Ogre]] attacking Sammy's father. There is a very easy [[safespot]]
behind a nearby skeleton, whereby you may use [[Magic]], [[Ranged]] or a [[halberd]] for an easy fight. All of the following enemies use melee, so you can alternately use [[Protect from Melee]]. 

'''Note''': If a fight sequence does not initiate, speak to Justin in order to continue, '''but note that if the ogre has already spawned, a second one will appear if you talk to Justin.'''

After defeating the ogre, [[General Khazard]] will appear and order his guards to lock you away after suggesting that if you fight in his arena, he might let the Servils go. 

Talk to your cellmate [[Hengrad]], and after a brief conversation the guard will bring you back to the arena.

The second fight is with a level 44 non poisonous [[Khazard scorpion]]. Note that it will reach you quickly, so you should immediately run to the same safespot or activate [[Protect from Melee]].

[[File:Fight Arena - Fighting General Khazard.png|thumb|right|Fighting [[General Khazard]] with [[Magic]] using the [[safespot]].]]
After defeating the scorpion, Khazard will release [[Bouncer]] the level 137 hellhound. You will need high healing food if not using the safespot or [[Protect from Melee]] at a low level, but otherwise the strategy is the same.

After killing the hellhound, a level 142 [[General Khazard]] will vow to make you pay for killing his puppy, and then attack you. '''This fight is optional''', and the quest progresses the same if you leave now via the door (use its Quick-escape option to avoid needing to confirm you wish to leave). The same strategies as before are effective against the general.

Return to [[Lady Servil]] and she will tell you that her son and husband are safe and recovering at home.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

Castle,2759:3484 }} Head to [[Camelot]], east of [[Seers' Village]]. Ask [[King Arthur]] if you can join the Knights of the Round Table, and he'll suggest you complete a quest first to prove yourself; [[Merlin]] has been found trapped in a crystal. He wants you to ask the other knights for ideas on how to rescue him. {{Clear|left}} ===Gathering information=== [[File:Sir Gawain chathead.png|left|frameless]] Speak to [[Sir Gawain]], found either within the castle or roaming in the courtyard. Ask him how Merlin got trapped, and he will suspect it to be the work of [[Morgan Le Faye]]. However, he does not know how to get into her [[Keep Le Faye|keep]], which is guarded by [[Mordred]] and his group of renegade knights. Next, talk to [[Sir Lancelot]] on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}}. Ask him if he has any ideas on how to get into the keep. He will mention that there is a sea entrance to the keep, and that the knights get all of their deliveries by boat from [[Catherby]]. {{Clear|left}} ===Infiltrating the keep=== {{Needed|recommended=Combat equipment, food}} Now that you have a lead, follow the road south-east to [[Catherby]]. If you do not already have a [[bucket of wax]], pick up the nearby [[insect repellent]] for use later, which can be found on a table in the house containing [[Perdu]] just north of the bank. Ensure you have your combat equipment, then head just north of the dock between the bank and the [[Candle Shop]], where you'll find a few crates against the back of the shop. Click on them to hide inside. There will be a bit of dialogue as workers come to pack you up and put you in the boat. After a while, you'll end up in the [[Keep Le Faye]]; when prompted, choose yes to climb out. ===Defeating Mordred=== [[File:Merlin's Crystal - Fighting Sir Mordred.png|thumb|220px|Fighting Sir Mordred.]] [[File:Sir Mordred chathead.png|left|frameless]] Head up the stairs to the top floor, ignoring the [[renegade knight]]s that are wandering around the castle. You should find [[Sir Mordred]] (level 39); fight him, and just as you are about to defeat him, [[Morgan Le Faye]] will appear and beg for her son's life. '''Do not select the option to kill him or interrupt the conversation, or you'll need to fight Mordred again. Running out of Prayer will interrupt it.''' Agree to spare him in return for information on how to untrap Merlin, and she will tell you that you will need a magic symbol, bat bones, and a black candle, in order to summon a mighty spirit. You'll need to bind the spirit with magic words, and then obtain the sword [[Excalibur]] to finally shatter the crystal. {{Clear|left}} ===Obtaining the items=== {{Needed|[[bread]], [[bat bones]] (obtainable below), [[bucket of wax]] (obtainable below)|recommended=Fast travel method to Taverley, Port Sarim, Varrock and Camelot for subsequent sections}} ====Bat bones==== If you did not bring [[bat bones]], you can obtain some by descending the stairs to the {{FloorNumber|uk=0}} and leaving through the doors, then killing the [[giant bat]]s around the keep. :'''Note:''' Upon leaving the keep, you will only be able to return through the Catherby crates. ====Black candle==== The [[black candle]] can be obtained by bringing a [[bucket of wax]] to the [[candle maker]] in [[Catherby]], located in his house west of the bank. Ask him about black candles, then talk to him again to give him the wax. If you do not yet have a [[bucket of wax]], head to the fenced-in area north of the keep, by the flax field. Pick up a bucket by the gate. If you have [[insect repellent]], use it on one of the beehives, then use the bucket on the beehive to obtain your bucket of wax. If you wear the [[Beekeeper's outfit]], you can simply click the beehive with the bucket in your inventory, without needing to use insect repellant. ====Excalibur==== {{Needed|[[Bread]]}} [[File:Merlin's Crystal - Lady of the Lake.png|thumb|180px|The Lady of the Lake]] [[File:The Lady of the Lake chathead.png|left|frameless|80px]] The sword is kept by [[The Lady of the Lake]], found by the lake within [[Taverley]], in the peninsula just south of the [[Hot Air Balloon]]. Tell her you seek Excalibur, and she will say that she will only give it to one who is worthy and good. She has set a test for you; she wants you to first enter the [[Port Sarim]] [[Grum's Gold Exchange|Jeweller's shop]]. Head to [[Port Sarim]]. If you don't have any bread, you can make [[bread dough]] on the [[cooking range]] just south of the Jeweller's shop. Purchase a [[pot of flour]] from [[Wydin's Food Store]], a bucket from the [[Trader crewmember]]'s on the southernmost dock, fill it at the sink east of the [[magic shop]], then use it on the flour to make [[bread dough]] for cooking. Alternately, if you have completed [[X Marks the Spot]], you can travel via [[Veos]] to [[Port Piscarilius]], and head west to the [[Kourend Castle Baker's Stall.]] to purchase some bread. Open the door to the jeweller's shop and a beggar will approach, asking for food to feed his starving family. Give him the loaf of bread. When you do, he will change into the Lady of the Lake, who gives you [[Excalibur]] for passing the test. '''You must finish this dialogue or you will need another piece of bread to repeat it.''' {{clear|left}} ===Chaos altar inscription=== {{Map|mtype=pin|3258,3381|align=right|caption=Location of the inscription.|width=200|height=200}} [[File:Chaos altar.png|100px|frameless|left]]Finally, you will need the magic words for the spell. Head to the [[Zamorakian chapel]] in the south-east corner of [[Varrock]], containing a [[chaos altar (Prayer)|chaos altar]]. "Check" the altar to find the words needed: ''Snarthon Candtrick Termanto''. '''Finishing this dialogue is required to progress further.''' ===Breaking the Crystal=== {{Needed|[[Excalibur]], [[black candle]], [[tinderbox]], [[bat bones]]}} [[File:Merlin's Crystal - Thrantax the Mighty.png|thumb|left|220px|Summoning Thrantax.]] Now that you have all the required items and the magic words, return to [[Camelot]], where you will find the magical symbol on the north-east side of the castle's garden, just inside the fence. Light your black candle and '''drop''' the bat bones in the circle ('''DO NOT BURY THEM'''). A demonic spirit named [[Thrantax the Mighty]] will appear, and you will be presented with a sequence of words. The correct incantation is "'''Snarthon Candtrick Termanto'''". If you get it right, the spirit will obey you. :'''{{Colour|red|Warning}}:''' If you recite the wrong phrase, the spirit will attack you, and you will have to get a new black candle and try again. Be careful as the spirit is level 92, with a max hit of 10, and can hit rather accurately. Once under your control, the spirit will offer a boon, which the player uses to make the request to free [[Merlin]]. After granting your boon, he will disappear. Head into [[Camelot Castle]], and climb up the south-east ladder to the very top of the south-east tower, where [[Merlin]] is imprisoned in a blue crystal. Use [[Excalibur]] on the crystal, and it will shatter. Head back down and talk to [[King Arthur]], who will dub the player an honorary Knight Of The Round Table. ==Walkthrough==
{{Map|name=Boy|x=2928|y=3456|r=3|align=left|width=240|height=240|mtype=square|caption=The start point of the quest.}}
===Lost ball===
[[File:Witch's House - Boy.png|thumb|220px|Talking to the [[boy]].]]
Head to [[Taverley]] and talk to the [[boy]] near the eastern entrance along the hedges. He will start crying; ask him what's the matter, and he will say that he kicked his [[ball]] over the hedge into the garden, and the [[Nora T. Hagg|witch]] living in the house put it in her shed. The boy wants you to get it back for him.

===Breaking in===
[[File:Witch's House - Breaking in.png|thumb|220px|The location of the [[Door key (Witch's House)|key]].]]
{{Needed|Cheese, gloves, combat equipment}}
Head west then north around the hedge to the front door of the house - it is locked. Look-under the pot north of the door to find a [[Door key (Witch's House)|door key]] and enter the house. Read the entire [[Diary (Witch's House)|diary]] on the table.

Go down the ladder in the northern room to enter the basement. If you don't already have [[leather gloves]], search the [[boxes (witch's house)|boxes]] for a pair, however it may take many attempts to find them. Equip your gloves, go through the [[gate (witch's house)|gate]], and search the [[cupboard (witch's house)|cupboard]] for the [[Magnet (Witch's House)|magnet]]. Go back up the ladder and into the southern room with the door that leads to the garden. Drop your [[cheese]] or use it on the mouse hole. Suddenly, a [[Mouse (Witch's House)|mouse]] will come out; use the magnet on the mouse and it will unlock the door. '''Be quick or the mouse will leave, and you will lose the cheese.''' Enter the door into the garden.
{{Clear|left}}

[[File:Nora T. Hagg.png|60px|left|frameless]]
===Getting past the witch===
Once in the garden, you will see the [[Nora T. Hagg|witch]] walking back and forth in the middle. You cannot walk through the garden, and must walk around it while using the hedges as cover until you reach the [[fountain (witch's house)|fountain]]. If the witch catches you, she will teleport you out of the garden and you will have to repeat most of the previous steps. Search the fountain to obtain a [[Key (Witch's House)|key]].

{{Clear|left}}
===Witch's experiment===
Head to the shed (east of the courtyard) and use the key on the door. Do '''not''' attempt to take the ball otherwise the [[Witch's experiment]] will lower your stats. Attack the Witch's experiment. Each time you kill the experiment's current form it changes to a stronger form. You have to kill the experiment four times before it is defeated - the first stage is a Skavid (level 19), then a spider (level 30), then a bear (level 42), and finally a wolf (level 53). If you flee during the battle you will have to start over.
[[File:Witch's House - Fighting the Witch's experiment.png|thumb|220px|Fighting the [[Witch's experiment]].]]

:'''Note:''' [[Rings of recoil]] may be used - a maximum of 4 will be required, as the experiments combined have a total of 144 hitpoints.

:'''Note:''' You cannot use a [[Dwarf multicannon]] in the shed.

The first and second forms can be [[safespot]]ted with Magic or [[Flinching|flinched]] with Melee by going into the north-east corner and waiting for the experiment to move south of you. Once it is in position, run past it, then walk on top of it. After this, walk west 1 tile so you are positioned diagonally from the Witch's experiment, then you're free to attack.

The third and fourth can also be safespotted by walking to the south wall of the shed between the sacks and the crate with the [[ball]] on it and using [[Ranged]] or [[Magic]] attacks from there.

Once you have killed the Witch's experiment, take the ball and return it to the boy. 

'''Do not let the witch see you''' or she will teleport you outside and '''you will lose the ball'''. You can avoid needing to pass her by teleporting out. If she does catch you, the doors to the shed will need to be unlocked again. Although the creature will respawn, it will not attack you.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

==Walkthrough==
===Sneaking back===
{{Needed|[[gas mask]], two free inventory spaces}}
[[File:Elena chathead.png|left|frameless]]
{{Map|2614,3325|mtype=rectangle|rectX=8|rectY=6|caption=Jerico's house with pigeon cages and bird food.|align=right|width=200|height=200}}
{{Map|mtype=polygon|2559,3267|2561,3267|2561,3262|2557,3262|2557,3264|2559,3264|caption=Omart's location.|align=left|width=200|height=200}}
Talk to [[Elena]] in [[East Ardougne]], directly west of the shortcut log. The mourners have confiscated her [[distillator]], which she needs to test plague samples. She wants you to retrieve it, but the tunnel the player used to enter West Ardougne last time has been filled in. She suggests you talk to her father's friend [[Jerico]], who has a method of communication with [[West Ardougne]].

[[Jerico]] can be found in a house just south of the northern bank, and just north of the [[chapel]]. Talk to him, and he will tell you that he has used messenger pigeons to communicate with two friends who are going to help you with a rope ladder to cross the wall.

Open and search the [[cupboard (Jerico's house)|cupboard]] on the north wall to find some [[bird feed]], then go behind the house to grab a [[pigeon cage]].

Ensure you have your gas mask, then speak to [[Omart]], who can be found by the wall just north of the [[Battlefield]] [[Spirit tree]], near [[Ceril Carnillean]]'s house. He will ask you to create a distraction to occupy the watchtower guards before his assistant [[Kilron]] can help you over the wall.

[[File:Biohazard - Releasing the pigeons.png|thumb|200px|Creating a distraction.]]
Head to the small watchtower along the wall, directly north of [[Omart]]. Stand in the corner where the two spiked fences meet, put the [[bird feed]] on either fence, then click the cage in your inventory to create the distraction.

Go back and talk to [[Omart]], who will call out to [[Kilron]] to throw over the rope ladder. With the [[gas mask]] equipped, climb over the ladder into [[West Ardougne]].
{{Clear|left}}

===Infiltrating the Mourner HQ===
{{Needed|Combat equipment to kill the level 13 Mourner, four free inventory spaces}}
{{Map|mtype=polygon|2542,3328|2542,3324|2547,3324|2547,3321|2556,3321|2556,3328|caption=Mourners' headquarters|align=left|width=200|height=200}}
{{Map|2517,3274|mtype=rectangle|rectX=4|rectY=8|caption=Nurse Sarah's house.|align=right|width=200|height=200}}
Head to the [[Mourner Headquarters|Mourners' headquarters]] located in the north-eastern corner of the city. If you tried to enter you would not be allowed in; instead, head to the western side and squeeze through a [[fence (Biohazard)|gap in the fence]] into the backyard. Pick up the [[rotten apple]] laying on the ground just to the west of the fence hole, and right click to use it on the stew that is brewing in the cauldron for the mourners. If you tried to enter the headquarters again, they would complain that several mourners have been taken ill with food poisoning, and are in need of a nurse.

Head to [[nurse Sarah]]'s house - the large building south-west of the [[West Ardougne]] church. Search the [[cupboard (Nurse Sarah's house)|cupboard]] in the northern part of her house to obtain a [[medical gown]]. Equip the gown, and go back to the headquarters. The professional attire will easily fool the mourners into letting you into their base. For all subsequent visits to the headquarters during the quest, the gown must be worn at all times.

Go upstairs and kill a mourner. A [[Key (Biohazard)|key]] will automatically be placed in the player's inventory. Use the key on the [[gate (Biohazard)|gate]] to get inside the caged room. Search the [[crate (Biohazard)|crate]] third from the left on the northern wall to find [[Elena]]'s [[distillator]].

'''Note''': [[Rings of recoil]] work against the mourner, after talking to him he will attack you and the key will still drop.

Go back to [[Elena]] by climbing down the [[manhole (West Ardougne)|manhole]] in the middle of the city and climbing the mud pile. Alternatively, [[Kilron]] at the south-eastern corner of [[West Ardougne]] will help the player get back over into [[East Ardougne]].

Speak to [[Elena]] and the player will give her the distillator. After running the tests, she will be confused to find that the touch paper hasn't changed colour at all. She will give you a [[plague sample]], [[liquid honey]], [[ethenea]], and [[sulphuric broline]], and ask you to visit her old mentor [[Guidor]] in [[Varrock]] for guidance. First, you will need to visit the [[Chemist]] in [[Rimmington]] to obtain more [[touch paper]] and to find a way to smuggle the three vials into [[Varrock]].

===Smuggling goods===
{{Needed| [[Liquid honey]], [[ethenea]], [[sulphuric broline]], the [[plague sample]], and one free inventory space}}
{{Map|2933,3210|mtype=rectangle|rectX=16|rectY=8|caption=The chemist's location.|align=right|width=200|height=200}}
[[File:Chemist chathead.png|left|80px|frameless]]
Make your way to the [[Chemist]] in western [[Rimmington]], who will give you the [[touch paper]]; you need to have the [[plague sample]] in your inventory to talk to him about the quest.

'''Note''': You may fast travel to [[Rimmington]]; the vials used to break when doing so, but this is no longer the case. For a list of transportation options to Rimmington [[Rimmington#Transportation|see here]].

The chemist will advise you to use his errand boys to deliver the goods, but warns you that they have a habit of stealing, and that you must give them each something they have no reason to steal.

{|class="wikitable"
|-
!Helper
!Sample Vial

|[[Da Vinci]]
|[[File:Ethenea.png]][[Ethenea]]
|Da Vinci cannot use the ethenea to create a "work of art".

|[[File:Liquid honey.png]][[Liquid honey]]
|Owing to its low value, Chancy cannot wager the liquid honey in a gamble.

Chancy the gambler, Da Vinci the artist, and Hops the drinker are located right outside the chemist's house crowding around a fire. Talk to each of them to give them their respective vials. If you give the wrong vial to someone, give the remaining vials to the others, speak to them all in Varrock, then return to Elena to get new vials before repeating this step.

===So far, so good===
{{Needed|A [[priest gown]] top and bottom, the [[plague sample]] and [[touch paper]], and three free inventory spaces}}
{{Map|3271,3392|mtype=rectangle|rectX=10|rectY=8|caption=The Dancing Donkey Inn's location.|align=right|width=220|height=220}}
[[File:Guidor.png|left|frameless|80px]]
Head to the fenced-in enclosure in south-eastern Varrock. The guard will search you when you try and pass through the gate, but will not find the plague sample; he will however confiscate the vials if you forgot to give them to the errand boys, and you will need to repeat the step.

The errand boys can be found in the [[Dancing Donkey Inn]] inside this area. With the plague sample in your inventory and '''three free inventory slots''', talk to Hops, Da Vinci, and Chancy to get the vials back. If your inventory is full when you talk to them, you will need to obtain a new set from the chemist.

{{Colour|red|Warning:}} Now that you have the vials, '''do not leave the fenced area''', or they will be confiscated on return. If you forgot your plague sample or touch paper, you can drop the vials at the gate, quickly retrieve your items from the [[Varrock east bank]] and then pick up the vials again.

Guidor is ill, and his wife [[Julie]] will not let anyone visit him, though she wishes for him to see a priest. If you didn't bring a [[priest gown]], you can obtain one for free by talking to [[Asyff]] in the [[Fancy Clothes Store]] in this area. Equip your [[priest gown]] and then talk to [[Guidor]] in his house in the south-eastern corner of the gated area. Give him the vials and sample, and tell him that [[Elena]] has sent a sample that needs to be processed. After analysing it, he will come to the conclusion that there is no plague - someone has been lying about it.

===Exposing the lie===
[[File:King Lathas chathead.png|left|frameless]]
Return to [[Ardougne]], and talk to Elena. When you tell her that [[Guidor]] found nothing in his results, she suggests that the plague must be a hoax and that you should speak to the person on top of this - [[King Lathas]] of [[East Ardougne]]. King Lathas is located just south of Elena's house, in his throne-room on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} of the East [[Ardougne Castle]].

When told that the plague is in fact a hoax, the King replies that he did it for the best of his people, and that it protects them from a "far greater danger". He then tells the player about the journey of [[King Tyras]] - the king of [[West Ardougne]] and King Lathas's brother - towards the west and that he has been corrupted by the [[Dark Lord]] after drinking from the Chalice of Eternity. Hence, the wall has been erected between the cities to protect [[East Ardougne]] and in turn, all of [[Gielinor]].

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

It is possible to avoid the trade interface by '''using''' the key and certificate halves obtained during the quest on your partner, allowing the quest to be completed by [[ironmen]] and players with new account [[Account#New account trade restrictions|trade restrictions]]. ===Choosing a gang=== [[File:Reldo chathead.png|left]] Talk to [[Reldo]] in the [[Varrock Palace library]], the northernmost room on the ground floor. ==Walkthrough==
===Arrows for the hunt===
[[File:Rantz chathead.png|left]]
{{Needed|[[chisel]], [[axe]], [[knife]], 100 [[feathers]], 4 [[wolf bones]] (or combat equipment to kill level 64 wolves)|recommended=[[food]] for low levels if killing the wolves for the bones|skills={{SCP|Fletching|5}} {{Boostable|yes}} to create [[ogre arrows]]}}
{{Map|name=Rantz|x=2630|y=2981|r=4|width=240|height=240|align=right|mtype=square|caption=The start point of the quest.|group=other}}
Talk to [[Rantz]]; he is located south-east of [[Gu'Tanoth]]. Some ways to get to him include using the [[Gnome glider]] (after completing [[One Small Favour]]), [[Feldip Hills]] [[Feldip hills teleport|teleport]], or the [[fairy ring|Fairy rings]] system ({{Fairycode|AKS}}).

Rantz is hungry and wants you to help him make arrows for his unusually large bow, so he can hunt the [[chompy bird]]. The quest '''must be started by talking to Rantz first''', otherwise you will be unable to make the arrowtips. '''Rantz will not accept the arrows unless you make them yourself.'''

If you didn't bring [[wolf bones]], kill 4 level 64 [[wolves]] in the crater to the south-west of [[Rantz]] and pick up the bones. They may be [[safespotted]] by standing near the roots in the north-east of the swamp.

{{Checklist|
*Use a [[chisel]] on the wolf bones to produce [[wolfbone arrowtips]], and you will receive between 2-6 per bone at random ({{SCP|Fletching|5}}).
*Chop down 4 [[Achey Tree]]s nearby for [[Achey tree logs]].
*Use a [[knife]] on the logs to produce some [[ogre arrow shaft]]s ({{SCP|Fletching|5}}).
*Use [[feather]]s on the [[Ogre arrow shaft|shafts]] to produce [[flighted ogre arrow]]s ({{SCP|Fletching|5}}).
*Use the [[Flighted ogre arrow|arrows]] with the [[wolfbone arrowtips|arrowtips]] ({{SCP|Fletching|5}}).
}}

===The cave===
*Return to [[Rantz]], and give him at least 6 [[Ogre arrow|arrows]]. He then tells you about the [[Swamp Toad|swamp toads]] that his children like to play with.
*Ask Rantz all of the questions that are listed, or else, you won't be able to open the [[Locked Ogre chest|chest]] later.
*Enter the [[Rantz's cave|cave entrance]] north of Rantz.
*Attempt to unlock the  [[Unlocked Ogre chest|chest]]. Unsuccessful attempts will reduce your [[Strength]] by 1.
[[File:Big Chompy Bird Hunting - Opening the Ogre Chest.png|thumb|220px|Opening the chest.]]
*Search the chest to retrieve the bellows (make sure to search it right away, or it may lock again).

===The inflatable toads===
[[File:Big Chompy Bird Hunting - Bloating the toad.png|thumb|220px|Filling the bellows and using it on the toads.]]
*Head to the swamp south-west of [[Rantz]] near the [[wolves]].
*Use the [[bellows]] on the [[swamp bubbles]] in the swamp, at the southern end of the swamp pond. You get three shots with the gas filled bellows before it needs to be filled again. (Swamp bubbles may also be found at [[Yanille Agility dungeon]] near [[poison spider]]s.)
*Use the bellows on a toad again to get a [[bloated toad]], and you will catch it and put it in your inventory. Get three toads. You can only carry a maximum of three bloated toads; inflating more will simply replace one toad in your inventory.

===The chompy and the hunt===
{{Needed|skills={{SCP|Ranged|30}} {{Boostable|no}} to equip the [[ogre bow]]}}
*Return to [[Rantz]] and talk to him. He will show you where you need to place the toads to lure the [[chompy bird]]s out.

*'''Drop''' some toads on the spot (a yellow flashing arrow will mark it), then walk closer to Rantz. Don't stay too close to the bait, but make sure it is in visible range. On a successful lure, a chompy bird will appear. Occasionally, the lure will be unsuccessful and the bait will disappear; if this happens, drop another toad. Rantz will take a shot at it, but he will miss. He will complain that the arrows don't fly straight.
*Talk to Rantz and offer to help shoot for him. He will agree and give you his [[ogre bow]]. (If you're quick getting the bow, the already spawned chompy bird can be killed. The ogre bow or [[comp ogre bow]] are used during Recipe for Disaster, so be sure to hold on to either if planning to do that quest too).
*Head back down to the clearing and place another toad (it doesn't have to be on the exact tile indicated at first).
*Wield the bow ({{SCP|Ranged|30}}) and arrows and when the bird appears, range it. If the bird doesn't appear or it flies away before you can kill it, keep placing bloated toads to lure the Chompies back.
*Once you kill a Chompy, pluck the carcass and take the [[raw chompy]] back to Rantz. He now wants you to cook it as well. '''In order to progress, you must kill the chompy yourself.''' Purchasing a raw chompy from the [[Grand Exchange]] or another player will not allow you to move forward in the quest.

===Cooking the chompy bird===

'''Clock Tower''' is a quest that takes place in the [[Clock Tower (building)|Ardougne Clock Tower]]. The tower's mechanism has stopped working, and you are asked to retrieve its missing parts from the dungeons.

==Details==
{{Quest details
|start = Talk to [[Brother Kojo]] in the [[Clock Tower (building)|Clock Tower]] south of [[East Ardougne]].
|startmap = 2569,3249
|difficulty = Novice
|description = Help the confused Brother Kojo find the missing cogs and fix his clock tower. Search the dungeon using brawn and brains to correctly place the four cogs.
|length = Very Short
|requirements = The ability to run past level 53 [[Ogre]]s
|items = * [[Bucket of water]] (obtainable during quest) 
** Alternatively, a [[Jug of water]], [[Ice gloves]], or [[Smiths gloves (i)]]
|recommended = * {{SCP|Combat|15|link=yes}}
*[[Weight-reducing clothing]] and [[Stamina potion|stamina]] or [[energy potion]]s
*Fast travel to [[Ardougne]] to start the quest - [[Ardougne cloak]] 1-4 or [[Ardougne Teleport]] or [[Spirit tree]] to [[Battlefield]] or [[fairy ring]] to {{fairycode|djp}} or [[Captain Barnaby]]'s ship from [[Rimmington]] or [[Brimhaven]]
|leagueRegion = <poem>
{{LeagueRegion|Kandarin}} — location requirement
</poem>
}}

==Walkthrough==
===Starting out===
[[File:Clock Tower - Brother Kojo.png|thumb|220px|Talking to [[Brother Kojo]].]]
[[File:Brother Kojo chathead.png|left|frameless]]
Talk to [[Brother Kojo]] at the [[Clock Tower (building)|Clock Tower]] just south-west of the [[Ardougne Zoo]]. He will tell you that the clock is broken and that you need to find four different coloured [[Cogs (Oaknock's Machine)|cogs]] from the dungeon beneath the tower to fix it.

'''Note:''' Players cannot carry more than one cog at a time, regardless of colour. You will need to retrieve each cog individually and fit it in the right place before moving onto the next one.

===Obtaining the blue cog===
[[File:Clock Tower - Ladder.png|thumb|220px|The ladder, just behind the [[camel]] cage.]]
[[File:Blue cog detail.png|left|60px]]
The [[blue cog]] is locked inside of a cell with a [[dungeon rat]]. 

[[File:Clock Tower - Blue cog.png|thumb|220px|The location of the [[blue cog]].]]
Go outside of the Clock Tower and head north-east to where [[Brother Cedric]] is (from the [[Monk's Friend]] [[quest]]) just south of the [[Ardougne Zoo]]. If you forgot a bucket of water, this is where the bucket and well are. You will notice a ladder just south of the [[camel]] cage from the [[Ardougne Zoo]], around the oak tree.

Go down the ladder and follow the long, winding passage until the end, until you get to a wall that you can push. Push the wall to get inside and pick up the blue cog.

Climb up the ladder in this cage and you'll find yourself south of the [[Clock Tower (building)|Clock Tower]].

Head back inside and climb the stairs to the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} and use the blue cog with the blue spindle.

===Obtaining the black cog===
{{Needed|A [[bucket of water]] or [[ice gloves]].}}
[[File:Black cog detail.png|left|60px]]
[[File:Clock Tower - Black cog.png|thumb|220px|The location of the [[black cog]].]]
This is where the [[bucket of water]] or [[ice gloves]] come in handy. Go inside the [[Clock Tower (building)|clock tower]] and climb down the ladder in the middle room. 

Then head through the passage to the north-east until you see four large coloured tiles on the floor. These tiles will indicate which direction the corresponding coloured cogs are.

Then head through the north-eastern door from the tile room and go as far east as you can until you see several level 2 [[Spider carcass|spiders]].

You will see the [[black cog]] surrounded by short walls of fire. 

To pick up the cog, you may either use the bucket of water with the cog or simply wear your ice gloves. This will cool the cog down so that you can pick it up.

After getting the black cog, head back to the ladder where you first entered, '''but don't go up'''. You should see four spindles near the ladder; use the black cog with the black spindle.

===Obtaining the red cog===
{{Needed|recommended=[[Food]] and [[armour]] for low levels}}
[[File:Red cog detail.png|left|60px]]
[[File:Clock Tower - Red cog.png|thumb|220px|The location of the [[red cog]].]]
Head through the south-eastern door, indicated by the red tile and walk down the passageway until you see some [[Ogre]]s.

The [[red cog]] will be on the floor where the Ogres are. Run over and pick it up then return to the ladder where you came from. 

Climb up to the {{FloorNumber|uk=0}} and use the red cog on the red spindle. The spindles are located on a column beside the ground-floor ladder.

===Obtaining the white cog===
[[File:White cog detail.png|left|60px]]
[[File:Clock Tower - White cog.png|thumb|220px|The location of the [[white cog]].]]
Return to the tile room and head through the north-western door, indicated by the white tile and follow the outer passageway until you find some [[rat poison]].

'''Note''': Hop worlds to pick up an extra one if planning to later complete [[Ratcatchers]].

Pick up the poison, then go north-east down the long passageway until you see two levers near the [[dungeon rat]]s. Pull the levers up to open the rat cage. Then head through the two gates and use the poison that you picked up before with the food trough.

The dungeon rats will eat the poisoned food and begin to die. Wait until they've all died, and then you'll find that the gate to the west has become unhinged. Head through the western gate until you find the [[white cog]]. Pick it up and use the ladder nearby to appear outside of the Clock Tower. 

Go inside and climb to the topmost floor. Now, use the white cog with the white spindle on the top floor.

'''Note:''' If you want to keep the cogs as a souvenir, you must reobtain each cog after they have been placed, and before completing the quest. They will not respawn afterwards.

===Finishing up===
Once you've placed all of the cogs on their corresponding spindles, head back to [[Brother Kojo]], and he will reward you.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

==Walkthrough==
This quest is typically among the first to be completed by new players and is intended to encourage exploration of [[Lumbridge]]. However, for non [[Ironmen]] players, it is possible to skip gathering the ingredients yourself by purchasing the items on the [[Grand Exchange]] before speaking to the [[Cook (Lumbridge)|Cook]], allowing for the quest to be completed in seconds.

===A feast for a Duke===
[[File:Cook (Lumbridge) chathead.png|left|frameless]]
Begin the quest by speaking with the Lumbridge [[Cook (Lumbridge)|cook]] found in the kitchen on the {{FloorNumber|uk=0}} of [[Lumbridge Castle]]. He mentions it is [[Duke Horacio]]'s birthday and that he is supposed to bake the Duke a [[cake]]. Unfortunately, however, he has forgotten to buy the ingredients and asks the player to bring him a [[bucket of milk]], an [[egg]], and a [[pot of flour]].

====Bucket and pot====
A [[bucket]] spawns in the cellar of Lumbridge Castle, and a [[pot]] spawns in the kitchen on the centre table. You can also purchase both a bucket and a pot from the [[Lumbridge General Store]] for {{NoCoins|2}} and {{NoCoins|1}} [[coins]], respectively.

====Egg====
{{Map
|align=right
|x=3166
|y=3288
|mtype=pin
|x:3181,y:3288,icon:redPin,desc:Chicken coop
|x:3177,y:3315,icon:bluePin,desc:Dairy cow field
|x:3163,y:3289,icon:yellowPin,desc:Wheat field
|caption={{mapkey
 |title=Ingredient locations
 |line1=...red,text=Chicken coop
 |line2=...blue,text=Dairy cow field
 |line3=...yellow,text=Wheat field
}}
}}
Go east out of [[Lumbridge Castle]] and run north along the path until you reach the [[chicken]] [[coop]] north-west of [[Fred the Farmer|Farmer Fred]]'s house. Go into the coop and pick up an [[egg]].

====Bucket of milk====
With an empty [[bucket]], go north into the [[cow]] pasture. Use the empty bucket on a [[dairy cow]] (distinguishable by its cowbell) to get a [[bucket of milk]]. You can optionally talk to [[Gillie Groats]] for an explanation on how to milk a cow. She can be found across the [[River Lum|river]] next to the dairy cow in the eastern [[Lumbridge cow field]].

The cook will also accept milk that is in a [[bottomless bucket of milk]], taking one bucket worth of milk from it.

====Pot of flour====
With an empty [[pot]], leave the cow pasture and go south-west to the wheat field. Pick some [[grain]], and then enter the [[Mill Lane Mill]], found up the road to the north-east. Climb to the top floor, put the grain in the hopper, then pull the lever and climb back down to the {{FloorNumber|uk=0}}. Finally, use an empty pot on the [[flour bin]] (which is now full of flour) to get a [[pot of flour]]. You can optionally talk to [[Millie Miller]] inside the mill for an explanation on how to make [[pot of flour|flour]].

===Delivery===
After collecting the ingredients, speak to the [[Cook (Lumbridge)|cook]] to deliver them.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

==Walkthrough==
===The crest===
{{Map|x=3281|y=3404|r=4|width=250|height=250|align=right|caption=The quest's starting point|mtype=square}}

To begin, talk with [[Dimintheis]], who lives in south-eastern [[Varrock]], within the fenced off area, in the house just above the [[Fancy Clothes Store|clothes shop]]. Tell him you are a bold adventurer and he will propose an adventure for you; he needs his family crest returned. Ask him where the crest is, and he will explain his three sons took it with them when they rode out to battle many years ago. He hadn't heard from them since, until he recently learned that his son [[Caleb]] was working as a chef beyond the [[White Wolf Mountain]], in [[Catherby]].

===Caleb===
{{Needed|[[Shrimps]], [[bass]], [[salmon]], [[tuna]] and a [[swordfish]] (all cooked).}}

Head to [[Catherby]], where Caleb can be found either inside the building with the sink to the south of the [[Farming shop]], or wandering outside of it. Talk to him and ask if he is Caleb Fitzharmon, and he will tell you he has a 'bit' of the crest. Ask him what happened to the rest of it, and he will explain that he and his brothers broke the crest into three [[Crest part|parts]] after a disagreement about who would become heir to their fathers' lands, and each of them ended up with a piece. Ask if you can have his bit of the crest, and he will agree to give you his piece provided you bring him ingredients for his fish salad. Agree to bring him the ingredients.

:'''Note''': You must ask him what happened to the rest of the crest, or you will be unable to collect the other parts.

Bring him the [[shrimp]], [[salmon]], [[tuna]], [[bass]], and [[swordfish]] (all cooked) and he will give you his piece of the crest.

===Avan===
{{Needed|[[necklace mould]], [[ring mould]], any [[pickaxe]], 2 [[Ruby|cut rubies]]|recommended=Food and armour, fast travel method to Dwarven Mine, Witchaven and Al Kharid.|skills={{SCP|Mining|40}} {{Boostable|yes}} to mine [[perfect gold ore]], {{SCP|Smithing|40}} {{Boostable|yes}} to smelt [[perfect gold bar]], {{SCP|Crafting|40}} {{Boostable|yes}} to craft the [['perfect' necklace]] and [['perfect' ring]]}}

Caleb mentioned that the last he heard from his brother Avan, he was searching for treasure in the desert, and that you might want to ask the traders there about him.

Head to the [[gem trader]] in the north of [[Al Kharid]], found next to the [[gnome glider]] just south of the gate to [[Lumbridge]]. Ask him about Avan Fitzharmon, and he will remember that the man was searching for 'perfect gold'. The gem trader told him to search the sand dunes where [[gold rocks]] can be found. Head to the northern [[Al Kharid Mine]], and a man can be found wandering around just at the entrance to the pit with a yellow [[cape]] on. This is, indeed, [[Avan]], as he'll tell you when you ask him. He's not giving up his piece of the crest though unless you can help him win the affection of a certain lady by getting him a [['perfect' ring|ring]] and [['perfect' necklace|necklace]] made out of perfect gold. Unfortunately, the stuff there in the desert isn't nearly good enough. He'll tell you a [[dwarf]] named [[Boot]] might know something about where to find the gold.

:'''Note:''' The player must speak to Boot before being able to give the jewellery to Avan, even though it is possible to mine and smith perfect jewellery without speaking to him.

{{Map|mapID=6|2984,9810|width=250|height=250|align=right|r=6|mtype=square|caption=[[Boot]] is located towards the far west end of [[Dwarven Mine]].}}

Head to the [[Dwarven Mines]], located just west of the [[Edgeville Monastery]]. Climb down the trapdoor behind the eastern building to enter the mines. Boot can be found south-west from this northern entrance, wandering by the two rock columns - see the map to the right. Tell him you are in search of very high quality gold, and he will direct you to east of [[Ardougne]], underground somewhere. The location you need to visit is the [[Witchaven Shrine|Witchaven Dungeon]] in [[Witchaven]].

:'''Note''': You will need to pass by level 28 [[hobgoblins]], level 53 [[ogres]], and level 122 [[hellhounds]] in this dungeon, though you do not need to kill any of them. The hobgoblins will attack you immediately after entering the dungeon if below 57 [[Combat Level]], and you will need to solve a puzzle while being attacked by ogres (if below 107 combat level). [[Protect from Melee]] will negate all damage, as the monsters only use melee.

Enter the dungeon and head north east along the path. To the north and south are two rooms with [[lever (Family Crest)|lever]]s in and outside of them. You'll have to complete a lever puzzle here to unlock the eastern area which contains the gold rocks and hellhounds:

{{Checklist|
*Go to the northern room and pull the outside lever up.
*Head into the southern room using the eastern door, pull the lever up, then exit via the '''western''' door.
*Go to the northern room and pull the outside lever down, then enter and pull the inner lever up.
*Leave the room and pull the outside lever up again.
*Go back to the southern room through the '''western''' door and pull the lever down, then exit via the '''eastern''' door.
*The hellhound room should now be unlocked.
}}

'''Note''': Once unlocked, you do not need to do the puzzle again to re-enter.

Enter the hellhound room to the east and mine at least two [['perfect' gold ore]] from the gold rocks ({{SCP|Mining|40}}). The hellhounds have a short aggression range - try and zigzag past them to find an open rock to mine. If you draw aggression before you are done mining, there is a [[safespot]] you can use to hide in behind the rock column directly south of the entrance - you can then world hop to lose aggression and try again. Low levelled players may also consider waiting 10 minutes in this safespot, after which the hellhounds will not attack you while mining the southern rocks. The rocks will take some time to respawn, so once you have mined one rock, use another or world hop to reset the rock.

[[File:Family Crest - Witchaven Dungeon levers.png|thumb|The sequence of operating the levers to get perfect gold.]]

Once you have your two 'perfect' gold ore, head to any [[furnace]] with the ore, your [[rubies]], your [[ring mould]], and your [[necklace mould]]. You may consider using the one in [[Al Kharid]], as you will be returning to Avan in the Al Kharid mine afterwards. Smelt the ore into [['perfect' gold bar]]s ({{SCP|Smithing|40}}), then smelt a bar each into a ruby necklace and ruby ring respectively ({{SCP|Crafting|40}}, {{SCP|Smithing|40}}), which will make the [['perfect' ring]] and [['perfect' necklace]] ('''DO NOT SELECT the GOLD necklace and ring!''').

Return to Avan in the Al Kharid Mine, and he will take your jewellery and give you the second piece of the crest in return. He will then tell you how to find the final brother Johnathon.

===Johnathon===
{{Needed|An [[antipoison]] potion, [[runes]] to cast the four Blast spells, combat equipment for the battle with [[Chronozon]].|recommended=Fast travel method to the Jolly Boar Inn, Edgeville and Varrock|skills={{SCP|Magic|59}} {{Boostable|yes}} to cast [[Fire Blast]]}}
[[File:Edgeville Dungeon map.png|thumb|upright|Edgeville Dungeon]]
The last brother is holed up on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} of the Jolly Boar Inn north-east of [[Varrock]] near the edge of the [[Wilderness]]. Bring your [[Antipoison|antipoison potion]], and head up to the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} where he is huddled in the north western room. Talk to him and he will be delirious - he has been bitten by a [[Poison spider|poisonous spider]]. Once he has finished speaking, use the antipoison on him (he'll take the entire potion, but you may bring a lower dosed potion) and he'll be very grateful to be cured.

Johnathon will tell you that he lost the crest while attempting to kill a powerful demon named [[Chronozon]]. If you want it back, you'll have to kill the demon yourself. Johnathon explains that to defeat the demon, you will need to first hit him once with each of the four elemental spells of death.

[[Chronozon]] can be found in the [[Edgeville Dungeon]], by the [[poison spiders]] near the [[Earth obelisk]].

:'''{{Colour|red|Warning}}:''' You will be heading into the [[Wilderness]], where other players may kill you. Only take items you are willing to lose to [[player killers]], and consider using a low population world.

[[File:Chronozon safespot.png|thumb|Chronozon safespot.]]

To defeat Chronozon, you will need to cast [[Wind Blast]], [[Water Blast]], [[Earth Blast]], and [[Fire Blast]] and '''successfully hit him''' once with each (in any order). {{mes|Chronozon weakens....}} will appear in the chat after each individual hit from a blast spell. You do not need to kill him using Magic after he has been weakened, though he has no Magic defence and is weak to [[Water spells]].

Along with enough runes to cast each blast spell several times, bring food, combat equipment and a [[poison cure]] for the poison spiders near Chronozon. Head to [[Edgeville]] and enter the dungeon through the trapdoor in the south eastern corner of the building south of the bank. Head north, then east through the gate past the skeletons, then north through the gate with thugs on the other side. Continue north past the thugs, west past the red spiders and black demons, then south to the [[Obelisk of Earth]].

There is a [[safespot]] one square in front of the eastern standing torch for Magic and Ranged. If you draw aggression of the poison spiders, stand behind the stalagmite to avoid it, then hop worlds. Weaken him with each blast spell, then kill him with any combat style.

:'''Note''': If you take too long to kill him, his weakness will wear off and you'll have to weaken him again.

{{bug|The [[Twinflame staff]]'s double cast feature does not kill him as expected.}}

Chronozon will drop the final crest piece on death, pick it up.

===The crest reassembled===
Now that you have all three crest pieces, put them together to make the [[family crest (item)|Family Crest]] and then make your way back to [[Varrock]]. Give the crest to [[Dimintheis]] who will be very, very pleased to have it back.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

:'''Tip:''' You may choose to talk to Dimintheis again to start the [[Family Pest]] miniquest before imbuing one of the gauntlets, as you will additionally have the chat option to progress the miniquest.

Death Plateau:
{{external|rs=Death Plateau (historical)}}{{otheruses|the quest|the location|Death Plateau (location)}} {{Has quick guide}} {{Infobox Quest |name = Death Plateau |number = 56 |image = [[File:Death Plateau.png|300px]] |release = [[9 August]] [[2004]] |update = Death Plateau Quest |members = Yes |series = [[Quests/Series#Troll|Troll]], #1 |developer = Jonathan S }} '''Death Plateau''' is a short quest wherein you are to help the [[Burthorpe Imperial Guard]] gain access to the [[Death Plateau (location)|Death Plateau]] in order to defeat the hostile [[troll]]s. ==Details== {{Quest details |start = Talk to [[Denulth]] in his tent in [[Burthorpe]]. |startmap = 2896,3528 |difficulty = Novice |length = Short |description = Trolls have come down from the north and are camped on Death Plateau. They are using this base to launch attacks on the principality of Burthorpe! The Imperial Guard is taking heavy losses. They need your help! |members = Yes |items = * 60 [[coins]] (bring 1000 for the gambling dice with Harold part) *10 unnoted [[bread]] *10 unnoted cooked [[trout]] *[[Iron bar]] *[[Asgarnian ale]] (can be found on the bar at the pub in [[Burthorpe]]) |recommended = *[[Premade blurb' sp.]] or [[Blurberry special]] (optional, but strongly recommended, as it trivialises the dice betting segment) *[[Games necklace]] for [[Burthorpe]] teleports or [[Combat bracelet]] for [[Warriors' Guild]] teleports *[[Stamina potion|Stamina]] or [[energy potions]] |ironman = [[File:Ultimate ironman chat badge.png]] Players need 21 empty inventory spaces to deliver items to Tenzing. *A method to obtain an iron bar: **{{SCP|Mining|15}} [[Mining]] and {{SCP|Smithing|15}} [[Smithing]] if smelting [[iron ore]] **Spawn in [[Thurid's Brain Buckets]] on the [[Sunset Coast]] in [[Varlamore]] (requires {{SCP|Quest|[[Children of the Sun]]}}) **Spawn in level 18 [[Wilderness]] north-west of the [[Ferox Enclave]], next to the bears west of the Graveyard of Shadows. Accessible via {{SCP|Minigame|Clan Wars}} [[Minigame Teleport]] **1/42.67 drop from [[dwarf|dwarves]] ({{SCP|Combat|10}}) in the mines under Falador **1/34.42 drop from sorting [[small salvage]] with {{SCP|Sailing|15|link=yes}} |leagueRegion = Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Asgarnia}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Desert}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Fremennik}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Kandarin}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest }} ==Walkthrough== ===Death Plateau=== Head to [[Denulth]], who is located in a tent directly south-east of the [[Warriors' Guild]] in [[Burthorpe]], or south of the [[Burthorpe Games Room]]. He tells you [[troll]]s have taken over the [[Death Plateau (location)|Death Plateau]] and are using it to launch nightly raids. However, they cannot reclaim the camp because the main path is heavily guarded by trolls. It has now become your job to find a different path to the Death Plateau. You also have to open the equipment storage room, which requires a combination code that was lost by the previous night's guard. ===Harold the guard=== {{Needed|[[Asgarnian ale]], 60+ [[coins]], and a [[Blurberry special]] or [[Premade blurb' sp.]] (optional but recommended)}} '''Talk to [[Eohric]]''' on the top floor of [[Burthorpe Castle]]. He will tell you that last night's guard, [[Harold]], is at [[The Toad and Chicken]] pub in [[Burthorpe]]. '''Go to the pub south-east of the castle''', and head upstairs and to the west to find him. '''Try and speak to Harold''', but he doesn't want to talk about the combination. '''Go back and talk to Eohric'''. He will tell you that a beer and gambling may help to make Harold get over his guilt. [[File:Death Plateau - Dice.png|thumb|right|Gambling dice with [[Harold]].]] {{Listen |title = [[Lucky Win (Death Plateau)|Lucky Win]] |align = right |filename = Lucky Win (Death Plateau).ogg |desc = The jingle that plays upon winning against harold.}} {{Listen |title = [[Bad Roll (Death Plateau)|Bad Roll]] |align = right |filename = Bad Roll (Death Plateau).ogg |desc = The jingle that plays upon losing against harold.}} Buy him an [[Asgarnian ale]], or get one from the table downstairs, and try talking to him again. This time, he will tell you he lost the [[combination]] and that he has searched for it everywhere without any success. '''Note:''' ''You can ask Harold if he would like another drink and hand over a [[Blurberry special]] or [[Premade blurb' sp.]], which makes Harold drunk and unable to count. This allows you to automatically win all the dice games as Harold believes you are using all four dice.'' Now, ask him if he wants to gamble. Make sure you have a relatively large stack of coins; you have to continue winning the bets until Harold is out of money, and you may lose a few times. Keep trying to beat him until you get an [[IOU]] (you will only get an IOU betting in amounts between 60 and 1,000 coins). Once you get the IOU, read it to find that the combination code to the storage room is on the back of the [[IOU]]! The [[IOU]] will vanish from your inventory and be replaced with the [[Combination]]. '''Note:''' '''You'll need it at the end but you can get a new IOU (or Combination, depending if you've completed the dialogue from reading the IOU) from Harold if you've lost it. ''' The combination is: {{Cquote2|''Red is north of Blue.
Yellow is south of Purple.
Green is north of Purple.
Blue is west of Yellow.
Purple is east of Red.''}} ===Storage room=== {{Needed|1+ free inventory spaces}} [[File:Death Plateau - Puzzle.png|250px|thumb|right|Combination code to the storage room.]] Head back to the [[Burthorpe Castle|castle]], and you'll see some coloured [[Stone Ball|stone ball]]s on the ground. Pick up the five stones (one of each colour; the yellow ball is just south of the green ball), and place them in this order with the map facing north: *Blue in the bottom left corner. *Yellow in the bottom right corner. *Red in the middle on the left. *Purple in the middle on the right. *Green in the top right corner. '''If you place the balls before reading the IOU/Combination, the door will not open. In this case, pick up one of the balls (Green is closest to door) and replace it after reading the Combination.''' Once you've unlocked the equipment storage room, you can continue on to the next step. ===The new route=== {{Needed|1 free inventory space}} {{Map|mtype=pin|align=right|caption=The map of [[Death Plateau (location)|Death Plateau]]. |2854,3577,title:Saba's Cave,desc: |2820,3555,title:Tenzing the Sherpa,desc: }} Walk out of the [[Burthorpe Castle|castle]] and head north-west, up the path towards [[Death Plateau (location)|Death Plateau]] to find a cave. Go in and talk to [[Saba]]. Ask if he knows of another path to the Death Plateau. The guy has a very rude and grumpy demeanour that may put off anybody, but he hates [[troll]]s as much as those who disturb him, so he will negotiate with you. He proceeds to share with you a secret path from a certain [[Tenzing|Sherpa]]'s house, which leads directly to the Death Plateau. Exit Saba's cave and continue heading west along the path until the path splits into a fork north and south. A wounded soldier marks the dangerous route towards the north. '''{{Colour|red|Warning}}:''' ''If you head north, a warning sign will tell you that Death Plateau is dangerous and you will be attacked by trolls. Do not go this way! Head back south-west.'' Follow the southern path and enter the house; inside you will find the Sherpa [[Tenzing]]. Talk to Tenzing and ask for his help. He will help you in return for 10 [[Loaf of bread|loaves of bread]], and 10 cooked [[trout]]. He will hand you some [[Climbing boots]]. {{Colour|red|Warning:}} If your inventory is full, the climbing boots will not go into your inventory and Tenzing may not sell you another pair. '''Note:''' {{Colour|red|If you have lost your climbing boots}}, continue on with the quest, talk to Dunstan, then talk to Denulth to get the [[certificate]] to accept Dunstan's son into the Imperial troops, then talk to Dunstan again and your character will remark that you have lost the boots. Go back to Tenzing to get another pair. ===Spiked boots=== {{Needed|[[Iron bar]], empty inventory slot and Tenzing's [[climbing boots]]}} Take the [[climbing boots]] to [[Dunstan]] in north-east [[Burthorpe]] (marked by an [[anvil]] on the mini-map, north-east of the castle, you can quickly walk around the castle on the north side) to get them changed into [[spiked boots]]. He tells you that he will make you the boots under one condition: His son should be made into an Imperial Guard. He also requires an [[iron bar]] to make the spiked boots. After talking to Dunstan, head back to the tent where you started the quest, and talk to [[Denulth]], and tell him that you have found a new path. However, it will only be revealed under the condition that the [[Tenzing|Sherpa]] has spiked boots and Dunstan's son be put into the Imperial Guard. Denulth makes an exception and gives you a [[certificate]] to accept Dunstan's son into the Imperial troops. Go back to Dunstan, and speak with him to hand over the iron bar and the certificate to receive a pair of [[spiked boots]]. '''Note:''' If you already have a pair of spiked boots in your bank, Dunstan will not make you another pair and just say "Sorry, I can't do anything with that" when you try to give him an iron bar, he will also hint that you already own a pair. ===Into the mountains=== {{Needed|10 [[Bread|loaves of bread]], 10 [[Trout|cooked trout]], [[combination]], and Tenzing's [[Spiked boots|spiked climbing boots]]}} Go back to [[Tenzing]] and give him his supplies. The bread and trout must be un-[[noted]]! '''Note:''' ''You must give him the 21 items in one go. [[Trout]] can be bought in the [[Warriors' Guild]].'' [[Tenzing]] gives you a [[secret way map|map of the secret area]]. '''You need to check the path before telling [[Denulth]] about it.''' Exit [[Tenzing]]'s house out the side door to his backyard and climb over the [[stile (Death Plateau)|stile]]. Take the path north and then continue following it east. Keep walking until you pass the second [[Mountain Goat]] and the rocks shortcut (don't try to climb the rocks). You may get a popup message saying that you'll be assailed by trolls if you continue while walking along the secret path. Ignore it, as the trolls will only attack if you're on the normal path. Just keep walking east until you get the message that it's safe to tell [[Denulth]] about the secret path. Return to [[Denulth]] with the [[Combination]] and [[Secret way map|secret map]] in your inventory to complete the quest. '''Note:''' ''If the [[Combination]] or the [[Secret way map]] were lost, they can be obtained from [[Harold]] or [[Tenzing]] respectively.'' '''Congratulations, quest complete!''' ==Rewards== {{Quest rewards |name = Death Plateau |image = [[File:Death Plateau reward scroll.png|centre]] |qp = 1 |rewards = *{{SCP|Attack|3,000}} [[Attack]] [[experience]] *[[Steel claws]] *The ability to make [[claws]] *Ability to purchase and wear [[climbing boots]] from [[Tenzing]] }} ==Required for completing== Completion of Death Plateau is required for the following: *[[Troll Stronghold]] ==Transcript== {{Hastranscript|quest}} ==Music== *[[Hermit]] *[[Tremble]] *[[Contest]] ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = |update = |change = Fixed a bug that allowed the rewards for the request to be repeatedly claimed. }} {{Subject changes |date = 8 August 2013 |update = Patch Notes (8 August 2013) |change = Dunstan's dialogue has been adjusted to make it clear if you already have spiked boots in your bank during the Death Plateau quest. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ==Trivia== *[[Tenzing]] is an allusion to the Sherpa {{wp|Tenzing Norgay}}, who, along with the New Zealander {{wp|Sir Edmund Hillary}}, was the first to climb {{wp|Mount Everest}}. *When you open the door to Tenzing's house for the first time, he exclaims 'No milk today! Thank you!' This is probably a reference to the song 'No Milk Today', by the 1960s band, {{wp|Herman's Hermits}}. Coincidentally, the song 'Hermit' is unlocked during the quest. *The idea of a secret path round the back of an invincible army comes from the battle of Thermopylae on which the film ''{{wp|300 (film)|300}}'' was based. *The 3,000 [[Attack]] [[experience]] gained is enough to bring a player from 1 to 16 Attack, which is more than adequate to wield the [[steel claws]] you receive. *If you have a full inventory and are logged out with the boots on the ground they will despawn and you cannot get a new pair. {{Death Plateau}}

==Walkthrough==
===Scrying the future===
{{Needed|3 empty inventory spaces, 1 [[gold coin]].}}
[[File:Demon Slayer - Wally.png|thumb|left|300px|[[Wally]] slaying Delrith.]]
Speak to [[Aris]] in the tent on the western side of [[Varrock Square]]. Pay her one [[coin]] and she will scry the future, seeing a vision of the player wielding an impressive sword fighting a demon named [[Delrith]], who terrorized Varrock over a century prior. Delrith was previously defeated by a hero named [[Wally]]; just your luck, the demon is being summoned again. Ask Aris where you can find the demon, and she will mention that to defeat him you must first find Wally's sword [[Silverlight]].

Ask Aris, ''"So, how did Wally kill Delrith?"'' She will show you the incantation Wally used: write down or screenshot the phrase, as it will be important later on. '''The word order of this spell is randomised for every player.''' After telling you the incantation, she tells you to talk to [[Sir Prysin]] to help.

Go north to [[Varrock Palace]]. [[Sir Prysin]] will be wandering the south-west portion of the {{FloorNumber|uk=0}} of the castle. Talk to him and tell him that Aris sent you. Ask for [[Silverlight]], the weapon needed to kill Delrith. He will tell you that to prevent the weapon from falling into the wrong hands, it was put into a special box that requires three different keys to open it. He has dropped his key in the drain just outside the palace kitchen, and the other two are in the possession of [[Captain Rovin]] and the Wizard [[Traiborn]].
{{Listen
|title = [[Wally the Hero]]
|align = right
|filename = Wally the Hero.ogg
|desc = The jingle that plays while Wally defeats Delrith.}}
{{Clear}}
===Captain Rovin's key===
[[File:Captain Rovin chathead.png|left|frameless]]
[[Captain Rovin]] is located in the north-west corner of the palace on the {{FloorNumber|uk=2}}, up two flights of stairs. Talk to him and tell him that you need the key in order to recover [[Silverlight]] to slay a demon that threatens the city. Mention that Sir Prysin said Captain Rovin would give the key to you, to which he will rant about the King being the only one to tell him what to do. Next, ask him why Sir Prysin gave the key to him in the first place, and he'll state the King made Sir Prysin give him the key so that it wouldn't get lost. After this dialogue, he'll then hand over the key, under the condition that you do not allow Sir Prysin to kill the demon.

[[File:Demon Slayer - Wizard Traiborn's wardrobe.gif|thumb|250px|Wizard Traiborn casts a spell to summon a wardrobe containing his key]]

===Sir Prysin's key===
{{Needed|[[Bucket of water]] or a similar container of water.}}
[[File:Sir Prysin chathead.png|left|frameless]]
On the {{FloorNumber|uk=0}} of the palace, head to the kitchen in the north-east corner of the {{FloorNumber|uk=0}}. If you do not already have a container of water, you can find an empty [[bucket]] up the stairs, in the bedroom to the north-east. With the bucket, return to the kitchen and use it on the sink to obtain a bucket of water.

Next, head outside through kitchen door and look for a [[Drain (Demon Slayer)|drain]] against the wall north of the doorway. '''Use your container of water on the drain. You must do this, or the key will not appear during the next step.''' The key will be washed down the drain, so you must now retrieve it from the [[Varrock Sewers|sewer]] below. Head east, out of the palace, and look for a [[manhole]] located south of the palace's east walls. It is marked by the [[File:Dungeon icon.png]] icon on the [[minimap]]. Once you find it, open the manhole and climb down to enter the sewer.

<!-- This doesn't use the regular map template because it cannot draw text labels; the GeoJSON used as an alternative is somewhat bloated, and therefore placed in mapspace and transcluded here-->{{Map:Demon Slayer key location}}{{clear}}

While in the sewer, go north-west and follow the path highlighted on the map above until you reach a stream. You should see a muddy patch to your left, next to a pile of skeletons. Examine this and you will find a [[Silverlight_key_(Sir_Prysin)|rusty key]].

===Wizard Traiborn's key===
{{Needed|25 unnoted [[bones]]. You can save some time by having all of the bones when you first speak to him. An easy way to get the bones is to kill [[Goblin|goblins]] south of the prison outside of Draynor Village}}
[[File:Wizard Traiborn chathead.png|left|frameless|width=138x138]]
[[Wizard Traiborn]] is located on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} of the [[Wizards' Tower]], which stands on an island south of [[Draynor Village]]. Ask him about the key and at first he won't remember it - but once you ask whether he has 'any keys knocking around', he will recall that he sealed it inside a magical wardrobe, for which he needs 25 regular [[bones]] to open. 

Once all 25 bones have been delivered, Traiborn will perform his ritual and then give you his key. Note that you can deliver the bones in increments, so [[File:Ultimate ironman chat badge.png]] Ultimate Ironmen will not need to clear out their inventory to complete this step.

'''If you die with the key, you will have to pay another 25 bones to re-retrieve it.'''

[[File:Silverlight detail.png|thumb|width=255x255|The mighty sword Silverlight.]]

=== Silverlight ===
Now that you have all three keys, head back to [[Sir Prysin]] in Varrock. Give him the keys, and he will give you [[Silverlight]]. Players can drop Silverlight and ask Sir Prysin for another one for free; after the quest he will charge {{Coins|500}}. Equip the sword, get any [[food]] and [[armour]] you may need for combat, and prepare to fight Delrith.

''If you have forgotten the magical incantation, you can speak with Aris at her tent in Varrock Square to hear it again.''

When you're ready, head south of [[Varrock]], and go east towards the stone circle surrounded by [[dark wizard]]s. A [[cutscene]] will play of [[Delrith]] being summoned by the wizards after you enter the circle.
===Banishing Delrith===
[[File:Demon Slayer - Summoning ritual.png|thumb|220px|The dark wizards attempt to summon Delrith!]]
{{Needed|recommended=[[food]] and [[armour]].}}
[[File:Dark wizard chathead.png|left|frameless]]
[[File:Demon Slayer - Delrith is summoned.png|thumb|220px|Delrith is summoned!]]
{{Listen
|title = [[Delrith (music track)|Delrith]]
|align = right
|filename = Delrith.ogg
|desc = The jingle that plays upon Delriths summoning.}}
The final part takes place in an [[instance]] of the [[Varrock]] [[stone circle]], with Delrith and several [[dark wizard]]s (two level 7 wizards and a level 20 wizard). Level 7 and 20 wizards will be [[aggressive]] to players with lower than 15 or 41 [[combat level]] respectively. Additionally, upon the cutscene finishing for the first time, one of the level 7 wizards will attack regardless of combat level. The level 20 wizard's maximum hit of 6 can threaten players with a low [[Hitpoints]] level, especially if the player has negative [[Magic Defence]] bonus. '''To leave, run to the edge at any time during the fight.'''

Because the fight takes place in a [[single-way combat]] zone, if you are already under attack from a dark wizard, you will need to kill or hide from it before you are able to begin combat with Delrith. It is recommended for lower-level players to approach from the south, and hide from wizards behind the southernmost stone wall until Delrith is nearby. Since the wizards '''do not respawn''' in the instance, it is also possible to kill them first, leave and restock, and then return to face Delrith.

Attack Delrith with Silverlight equipped. Despite his combat level of 27, the Silverlight's weakening effect will reduce Delrith's hitpoints to less than that of a [[cow]]. When he reaches 0 hitpoints, say the magical incantation. If the wrong incantation is said, Delrith regenerates to full health. '''If you cannot remember your personal randomized incantation you can return to Aris and she will repeat it when prompted.''' 

==== Pures and lower levels ====
For those wishing to attack with magic, wielding Silverlight and manually casting spells will also deal damage. Other methods include [[flinch|flinching]] him or using [[Confuse]], [[Curse]], or [[Weaken]] to make him easier to kill with melee. [[Ring of recoil|rings of recoil]] can be used for this fight. <!-- is combat xp normal? -->

If you take too long<!-- how long? --> to finish off [[Delrith]], he will disappear and you will need to leave and re-enter the instance. If Delrith disappears during the dialogue to banish him the quest can still be completed by pressing "continue" until the end.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''
