==Walkthrough==
Before starting, note that while in the desert, you will take around 10 damage from [[desert heat]] if not holding a [[waterskin]]. Every 30-90 seconds, you will use a charge from your waterskin, or take damage if you have no charges left. The interval depends on the [[armour]] worn. As such, it is '''highly recommended''' to equip any [[desert clothing]] before entering the desert, and to also ensure at least 1-2 full [[waterskins]] are kept in your inventory. Waterskins can be refilled by cutting [[Kharidian cactus|cacti]] found around the desert with a [[knife]] or [[slash]] weapon.

===Missing daughter===
[[File:Irena chathead.png|left|frameless]]
[[File:The Tourist Trap - Talking to Irena.png|thumb|220x220px|Talking to Irena.]]
{{Map|3270,3029|zoom=1|width=220|height=220|align=right|mtype=pin|caption=The Mercenary Captain outside the [[Desert Mining Camp]] entrance.}}
Head through the [[Shantay Pass]] south of [[Al Kharid]] and speak to [[Irena]]. A [[shantay pass]] is required to pass through, which can be bought from [[Shantay]] nearby. Alternatively, [[fairy ring]] {{Fairycode|BIQ}} is just north-east of the [[Bedabin Camp]]. Ask Irena what's bothering her, and she'll share that her daughter [[Ana]] has gone missing in the desert. She'll mention some footprints which appear to lead to the [[Desert Mining Camp]]; follow these footprints south until you reach the mercenaries guarding the [[Desert Mining Camp]] gate (west side of the camp), and talk to the [[Mercenary Captain|mercenary captain]].

:'''Note''': After concluding the dialogue, you will immediately enter combat with the captain. See the section below for fight mechanics.

Say ''wow, a real captain!'', then say ''you'd love to work for him'', ask ''if you can do something for him'', and he will ask you to bring him the head of Al Zaba Bhasim, head of the desert bandits. Refuse, then ''accuse him of being unable to fight his own battles''. {{Chat option|1Wow! A real captain!|2I'd love to work for a tough guy like you!|2Can't I do something for a strong Captain like you?|2Sorry Sir, I don't think I can do that.|1It's a funny captain who can't fight his own battles!}}He will agree to a duel, and the guards will gather round. Complete the dialogue when you are ready to fight. Note that if you attack him too early, you will be teleported away, taking damage and losing your water. 

==== Fighting the captain ====
The captain can easily be defeated without taking any damage by using [[Protect from Melee]]. Low-levelled players who cannot use this prayer should bring decent food, [[swordfish]] or better.

It is possible to [[safespot]] the captain by waiting to complete the dialogue until a [[mercenary]] is nearby, then talking to the [[mercenary]] to block the captain's way. A dwarf [[multicannon]] may also be set up west of the gate, just in the edge of the captain's roaming area.

The captain may also be killed entirely with [[rings of recoil]], and the key will still drop. You may also simply stay on the final dialogue ''(The guards gather around to watch the fight'') and wait while a friend kills the captain, then press continue right as the captain dies.

Once the captain attacks you, kill him and take his [[metal key]].

===Getting into the mine===
[[File:Male slave (brown hair) chathead.png|left|frameless]]
'''Before entering the camp''', unequip everything except your desert clothing. Ammunition is allowed. If you have weapons/armour equipped during the camp, you will be put in a cell; to escape, you must bend the bars in the window and climb out, climb the rocks, then the cliff, then the rocks again. During this process you may be sent away from the camp and have your waterskins taken away. Once escaped, you may return to the gate to enter again.

:Alternatively, it is possible to change worlds immediately upon opening the gates to avoid getting caught. This may be easier to perform when using quick-hop keys on the [[RuneLite]] client.

[[File:The Tourist Trap - Trading clothes.png|thumb|220px|Trading clothing with a slave keen to escape.]]

Once inside, enter the northern building and search the table with a [[bowl of water]] on it to receive a [[cell door key]]. This key can be used if you are caught in upcoming sections to escape via the [[Prison door (Desert Mining Camp)|prison door]], which will save you some time. Note that the guards may occasionally confiscate the keys from you. While here, you may also use the [[bowl of water]] to refill your waterskins, although the desert heat will no longer  affect you whilst inside.

Head to the east wall by the rocks and talk to the male slave, who says you look like a new recruit. When you ''tell him you've just arrived'', he mentions he is planning on a escape. ''Tell him that it sounds interesting'', and he will mention there is one missing detail from the plan. Ask ''what's that then'' and he says he can't get his bracelets off. Tell him ''you can try to undo them for him'', and he will mention making a trade. Say ''it's funny you should say that'' and the player will request his slave robes in return for your desert clothing. Keep trying until you break the bracelets off the slave and then agree to the trade. {{Chat option|1I've just arrived.|2Oh yes, that sounds interesting.|1What's that then?|1I can try to undo them for you.|1It's funny you should say that...|1Yeah, okay, let's give it a go.|1}}

:'''Note:''' If a guard is close to you while you attempt to break off the bracelets, they will detain you in the cell and you will need to escape using the key (or through the window, per the earlier note).

=== What lies below ===
{{Map:Tourist Map}}
While in the mine in the following sections, you must have your slave robes equipped at all times. If the guards spot you without the robes,  you will be jailed and forced to mine 15 [[Rock (The Tourist Trap)|rocks]] to be freed (alternatively, you may teleport out). If you are caught, you can logout during the dialogue to avoid being jailed (re-equip the slaves robes on relogging).

Wearing the slave robes, enter the mine and follow the winding path to the winch area. ''Don't talk to the [[rowdy slave]]s, or they attack you.'' At the doors to the winch area, talk to a guard and ask to mine in a new area, and he will request a [[Tenti pineapple|tenti pineapple]]. You will now need to visit the [[Bedabin Camp]] to the west of the [[Desert Mining Camp]]. Either exit the mine the way you came—unequipping your slaves robes ''after'' leaving the mine—or teleport out.

If your gate key was confiscated and you do not have access to a teleport, you can get it back by searching the west table upstairs in the building.

===Pineapples and plans===
{{Map|name=Al Shabim|caption=Location of Al Shabim in the Bedabin Camp.|x=3171|y=3029|width=200|height=200|align=right|r=4|mtype=square}}
{{Needed|skills={{SCP|Smithing|20}} {{Boostable|yes}} to create a [[prototype dart tip]], and {{SCP|Fletching|10}} {{Boostable|yes}} to turn it into a [[prototype dart]]}}
Talk to [[Al Shabim]] in the southern circular tent of the [[Bedabin Camp]]. He will agree to give you the pineapple if you get some [[Technical plans|weapon plans]] for him, and gives you a key.

Return to the Desert Mining Camp (without armour or weapons equipped), go into the northern building, and climb up the ladder to find [[Captain Siad]]. Search the [[bookcase (The Tourist Trap)|south-west bookcase]] to learn he has an interest in sailing, then talk to him again and ''ask to have a chat''. He will insist that you leave; ignore him and tell him he ''seems to have a lot of books'', to which he will agree. Mention that he has an ''interest in sailing'' and he will say it's been a passion of his for some years. Tell him you ''could tell by the cut of his jib'' and he will be flattered and begin rambling, creating a distraction. {{Chat option|1I wanted to have a chat?|5You seem to have a lot of books!|3So, you're interested in sailing?|1I could tell by the cut of your jib.}} While he is distracted, search the chest in his office and steal the blueprints.

Return to [[Al Shabim]] in the [[Bedabin Camp]], who will give you permission to use the [[anvil]] nearby. Bring any skill boosts needed, as well as additional materials, as it is possible to fail both steps. Enter the tent directly north of Al Shabim, near the magic carpets. Use your [[bronze bar]] on the anvil to create a [[prototype dart tip]] ({{SCP|Smithing|20}}), then add the [[feather]]s to make a [[prototype dart]] ({{SCP|Fletching|10}}).  Take the dart and the technical plans back to Al Shabim and he will give you the [[Tenti pineapple|pineapple]] you need.
{{Clear|left}}

===Finding Ana===
[[File:Ana in a barrel detail.png|left|frameless|80px]]
[[File:Tourist Trap - Riding the mine cart.png|thumb|220px|Riding the mine cart. Enjoy the ride!]]
With your slave outfit equipped, enter the mine and give the [[tenti pineapple]] to the guard who wanted it. He will now allow you to enter the winch area. Inside this section, head east until you reach a mine cart, then search a nearby barrel to take one. Once you have one, search the mine cart to get in, and you will ride it to the other side. It is possible to fail and take 1-4 damage by banging your knee or falling off the edge of the minecart.

[[Ana]] can be found down the north-west path, at the very end. After optionally talking to her, use the barrel on her to put her inside, then return to the mine cart. Do not drop the barrel while she is inside, and do not mention sneaking past the guards or the key if you choose to talk to her, or else you will be thrown in jail.

===Free at last===
[[File:Mine cart driver chathead.png|left|frameless]]
[[File:The Tourist Trap - Ana in a barrel in a mine cart.png|thumb|220px|Putting Ana on the cart.]]
Use [[Ana in a barrel]] on the mine cart to send her down the track. When the cart returns, get in. Once you reach the other side, search an empty barrel, and you will retrieve [[Ana in a barrel]] again. Do '''not''' exit the mine yet.

Use [[Ana in a barrel]] on the [[winch bucket]] to the north-west, and a guard will offer to help. Accept his help, then when he suspects that Ana said something, say you were just calling him ''very gregarious'' to throw him off. If this section glitches and the guards are alerted, simply re-log and try again.

[[File:The Tourist Trap - Operating the crane.png|thumb|220px|Operating the crane with Ana in the barrel.]]

Return to the surface while still wearing your slave robes. Operate the [[winch (The Tourist Trap)|winch]] in the south-west corner of the camp, then search the nearby barrel to retrieve Ana. Put her in the wooden [[wooden cart (The Tourist Trap)|cart]] nearby. 

'''{{Colour|Red|Warning}}''': If you click the wrong dialogue options in the next section you will have to redo the majority of this quest! 

Now, you need to talk to the [[mine cart driver]] and say the following dialogue before he will allow you to hide in the cart. {{Chat option|2Nice cart.|2One wagon wheel says to the other, 'I'll see you around'.|1'One good turn deserves another.'|3Fired... no, shot perhaps!|3In for a penny in for a pound.|3Well, you see, it's like this...|1Prison riot in ten minutes, get your cart out of here!|2You can't leave me here, I'll get killed!}}

*''"Nice cart."''
*''"One wagon wheel says to the other, 'I'll see you around'."''
*''"One good turn deserves another."''
*''"Fired... no, shot perhaps!"''
*''"In for a penny in for a pound."''
*''"Well, you see, it's like this..."''
*''"Prison riot in ten minutes, get your cart out of here!"'' (You could also choose to bribe the driver instead for 100 coins)
*''"You can't leave me here, I'll get killed!"''

Once he has agreed to help you, search the cart and choose the option to get on it.

Head back to [[Irena]], and she'll reward you for all your hard work.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

==Introduction==
Desert Treasure is one of ''[[Old School RuneScape]]''{{'}}s most well-known quests, and is commonly completed by [[player killers]] for its reward of the [[Ancient Magicks]]. Due to the difficulty of the quest's bosses, players are '''highly advised''' to read through each section before starting the fights, as each boss has unique fight mechanics that heavily favour certain combat styles, including immunity to specific spells. [[Pures]] wishing to avoid gaining [[Hitpoints]] experience should note that all of the bosses may be defeated with the help of a [[Dwarf multicannon|cannon]], but should be prepared to use 500 or more [[Cannonball|cannonballs]] due to the high amount of combat throughout the quest. See the "notes for pures" section under each boss for more information.

==== Stranger Danger ====
Before starting, note that if you're carrying one or more of the [[Diamonds of Azzanadra]], you may be attacked by a level 95 [[Stranger]] who appears next to you and carries a [[poison]]ed [[dragon dagger]]. This is random and does not happen to everyone, but can happen at any point where the diamonds are in your inventory.

To be safe, players may want to carry a [[teleport]] and [[antipoison]] when moving the diamonds and ensure having some spare [[prayer point]]s until the quest is completed. Players can flee from him when he appears. Simply banking the diamonds will prevent him from appearing further, but players should be warned that he can strike almost immediately after the diamonds are received from their respective bosses. Make sure to close the bank interface, you can still be attacked after banking the diamond if the interface is still open.

[[Ultimate ironmen]] can deposit each diamond into the pyramid as they acquire them so as not to risk attack; see the [[Desert Treasure I#The Ancient Pyramid|Ancient Pyramid section]] below for more information.

==Walkthrough==
{{Map:Kharidian Desert}}
===Enchanting the mirrors===
{{Needed|Two [[Shantay pass (item)|Shantay pass]]es (or another method of entering the [[Kharidian Desert]]), 650 [[coins]], [[blood rune]], [[ashes]], [[bones]], [[charcoal]], 6 [[molten glass]] (noted works), 12 [[magic logs]] (noted works), 6 [[steel bar]]s (noted works)|recommended=[[Waterskin]]s, [[desert clothing]], coins for [[magic carpet]] rides (bring a [[Ring of Charos(a)]] for discounted rides), teleportation methods to the [[Exam Centre]] ([[digsite pendant]], [[Varrock]] teleport) and [[Al Kharid]] ([[ring of dueling]], [[amulet of glory]]).}}

Travel through the [[Shantay Pass]] south of [[Al Kharid]] and then west via flying carpet or by running to the [[Bedabin Camp]]. [[Fairy ring]] code {{Fairycode|BIQ}}, near the [[Kalphite Lair]], is north-east of the camp. Talk to [[Asgarnia Smith]] near the small water pool; he'll give you some [[etchings]] to bring to [[Terry Balando]], the archaeological expert, at the [[Digsite]] [[Exam Centre]].

Go to the Digsite, east of [[Varrock]], and talk to Terry in the Exam Centre, who will take the etchings. Talk to him again to receive the [[translation]] to take back to Asgarnia Smith.

Go back to Asgarnia Smith in the desert. When talking to him, choose the ''Don't read book'' option. Talk to him again and agree to help.

Go south to the [[Bandit Camp (Kharidian Desert)|Bandit Camp]]. ''Before entering the camp, remove any equipment that depicts [[Saradomin]] or [[Zamorak]] imagery, otherwise the bandits will be aggressive''. Talk to the [[Bartender (The Big Heist Lodge)|bartender]] and buy a [[Bandit's brew|drink]] for 650 [[coins]]. Talk to him again to find out about the four [[Diamonds of Azzanadra]]. '''This step must be completed before talking to Eblis otherwise the option to talk with him about the diamonds won't appear.'''

Talk to [[Eblis]] in a nearby building to the east, past the [[general store]]. Ask him about the diamonds and he'll tell you that he needs various items to create some scrying glasses:

Bring Eblis the items required. Make sure to '''use''' the bones on him instead of burying them, noting them will avoid this.

After giving him the items, Eblis will have travelled south-east on top of a hill (shown as a grey circle on the minimap), surrounded by six mirrors. Looking into them will show locations related to the diamonds, though it is not required.

Talk to Eblis again and he'll explain that his spell only makes the mirrors reveal where the diamonds have been at one point in time. Two of the mirrors show other locations entirely; the [[Bedabin Camp]], which you visited, and the [[Ancient Pyramid]] itself, which you need to acquire the diamonds in order to enter.

If using Runelite, disable the 'Easy Unnote' plug-in, or you will not be able to give Eblis noted items.

'''Diamonds can be acquired in any order. The order below is sorted from easiest to hardest.'''

==Smoke diamond==
{{Needed|[[Shantay pass (item)|Shantay pass]]es, [[waterskins]], a [[tinderbox]] ([[Bruma torch]] does not work); a gas mask, face mask, or slayer helmet; two or more [[Energy potion]]s or a [[stamina potion]], [[ice gloves]] or [[water spell]] [[runes]] (staves do not work without [[ice gloves]]), [[prayer potion]]s, a [[weapon]] (only if wearing [[ice gloves]]; otherwise your weapon will be unequipped), [[armour]] (Magic-defence armour or armour with [[Prayer bonus]]), [[food]], and an emergency teleport.}}[[Fareed]] is widely considered the easiest boss of the quest, due to the fact that he uses [[melee]] almost exclusively. Keep the following in mind during this section:

* Those coming directly from the [[ice diamond]] section must restore their [[Firemaking]], as the [[Standing Torch (Smoke Dungeon)|torches]] require at least level 50 Firemaking to light.
* A [[facemask]], [[slayer helmet]], or a [[gas mask]] '''must''' be worn at all times while in the dungeon, or the player will be hit for 20 damage every 12 seconds. While this smoke effect won't kill you (it will never damage you below 1 hitpoint), various monsters can still deal damage, posing a significant risk for low-level players should they accidentally enter combat.
{{Map|name=Smoke Dungeon|x=3310|y=2962|r=4|mtype=square|align=right|caption=The [[Smoke Dungeon]] is located west of [[Pollnivneach]].|width=250|height=250}}

===With gate responsibility===
[[File:Smoke Dungeon map.png|center|thumb|500px|A map of the [[Smoke Dungeon|dungeon]].]]

Take all of the items listed above and travel to the [[Smoke Dungeon]]. The dungeon entrance is marked on the world map; hug the cliffs on the west side of [[Pollnivneach]], and head south to find it. Climb down the well, and if it stops you with a warning about the air inside, just try to climb down again. 

In each of the four corners of the dungeon are [[Standing Torch (Smoke Dungeon)|standing torches]] that you need to light using your [[tinderbox]] ([[Bruma torch]] does not work).  '''The torches will burn out if you take too long;''' if you walk instead of run, the first lamp will have burnt out by the time you reach the [[burnt chest]]. As such, it is recommended to use [[energy potion]]s or [[stamina potion]]s to maintain run energy.

While the torches can be lit in any order, it's recommended to start with the north-eastern torch, as it's the farthest from the chest. From there, the torches can be lit in under two minutes if running to the south-eastern torch second, the north-western torch third, and finishing at the south-west torch, allowing you to quickly run to the chest. 

When all four are lit, go to the centre of the dungeon and open the burnt chest to obtain the [[warm key]]. ''If the key is lost before being used to unlock the gate, it can be reobtained from the chest without needing to relight the torches.''

===Facing Fareed===
Make your way to the east part of the dungeon and use the key on the gate to begin the fight with [[Fareed]].

''If you leave the fight before killing Fareed, you will '''NOT''' need to get the Warm Key again.''[[File:Desert Treasure torch.png|thumb|The torch the player needs to light.]]

====The fight====
[[File:Fighting Fareed.png|thumb|right|A player fighting [[Fareed]].]]

* Despite his simplicity, [[Fareed]] should not be underestimated. His main attack is a melee hit that can deal up to 40 damage (or 36 with ice gloves). [[Protect from Melee]] negates all damage from his melee attack; those with low [[Hitpoints]] who do not have 43 [[Prayer]] should ensure they are not in melee range.
*Fareed also has a [[Magic]] attack, but it can only be cast in melee distance. While it's very uncommon for him to use the attack, it can still hit in the 20s, so [[Armour/Magic armour|Magic defence]] is recommended to supplement melee protection prayers.
*If the player doesn't have [[ice gloves]] equipped, Fareed will repeatedly remove the player's weapon to their [[inventory]]. This makes melee impossible for those without the gloves; combined with his high melee defence, and his ability to hit with magic while in melee range, melee is not recommended when fighting him.
*'''Magic is the most effective attack style''', as Fareed is very weak to [[water spells]]. Mages should note that any other spell type will '''not''' work against him, including [[God spells]] and the [[trident of the seas]] and [[Trident of the Swamp|swamp]]. Players can bypass the need for ice gloves by manually casting spells from their spellbook.
*Range is also fairly effective; although as before, ice gloves are required to wield a bow around him when in melee distance. It may be advisable to use cheap ammunition on Fareed, as any ammunition used besides [[ice arrows]] will drop beneath him as [[ashes]], bypassing the ammo-saving effect of [[Ava's accumulator]] and [[Ava's assembler]].
*[[Bind]], [[snare]], or [[entangle]] can be used to stop him from moving, though moving too far out of range will cause him to despawn. Using the technique of binding him and running away (known as [[kiting]]), players can avoid the need for prayer or ice gloves by preventing him from ever getting in melee distance.
*Fareed can also be trapped and safespotted behind another player. The [[dwarf multicannon]] works in the dungeon.

Upon defeating Fareed, the [[Smoke diamond]] will appear in your inventory. If lost, it will reappear in the chamber on the ground when the player walks through the gate. Fareed will not have to be fought again.

==Shadow diamond==
{{Needed|[[Shantay pass (item)|Shantay pass]]es, [[waterskin]]s, 20—100+ [[lockpick]]s, noted lockpicks and 5 [[coins]] per to exchange at [[Tiles]]|recommended=Teleportation method to [[Rasolo]] ([[skills necklace]] to teleport to the [[Fishing Guild]], [[games necklace]] to [[Barbarian Outpost]], or [[Barbarian Assault]] [[Minigame Teleport]]), teleport method to [[Al Kharid]] ([[amulet of glory]] or [[ring of dueling]]), multiple [[antipoison]], [[super restore]] if using melee, [[food]]. Additional noted supplies may be preferable.}}

Damis is similar to Fareed in that he uses melee and can be easily safespotted. While the fight is fairly straightforward, his section is one of the longest, so keep the following in mind to avoid multiple trips, and ensure a successful fight:

*[[Rasolo]] '''must''' be spoken to before the chest can be [[Lockpick|picked]] open.
*There is a large amount of running for this section, making stamina or restore potions beneficial.
* Contrary to popular belief, Damis is not particularly weak to earth spells.

===Giving a ring===
[[File:Desert Treasure Rasolo.png|thumb|Talking to Rasolo in the location shown by the mirror.]]
Travel west of the [[Fishing Guild]] to the entrance of the [[Tourist Information Centre]]. Just east of the Tourist Information Centre lies a fenced area, with a wandering man named [[Rasolo]] nearby. Talk to Rasolo, asking about the diamonds, and he'll offer to give you a [[ring of visibility]] in exchange for a [[gilded cross]].

[[File:Desert Treasure chest.png|thumb|The chest the player needs to open.]]
Take some [[food]], [[lockpick]]s, and [[antipoison]] to the [[Bandit Camp (Kharidian Desert)|Bandit Camp]]; for ironmen, note that both lockpicks and antipoisons may be pickpocketed from the [[Bandit (Bandit Camp)|Bandits]] in the vicinity. In the southern-most tent in the Bandit Camp is a [[secure chest]], requiring 53 [[Thieving]] to open. Use lockpicks on it until all 3 locks are bypassed, and the chest is opened; then, search the open chest to receive the gilded cross and 150 Thieving [[experience]]. 

This section is straightforward, but many players find this section to be tedious and require many tries. If a player fails to open any of the locks, all of the previous locks are reset, and the player's lockpick will break. Each failed attempt will deal 2—3 damage, as well as have a chance to apply [[poison]] to the player if not protected. For those who find themselves running out of food or lockpicks, the nearby [[Tiles]] will un-note additional supplies 5 coins each, allowing players to bring larger stacks of items.

If the cross is lost, search the chest again to receive a new one; it does not need to be re-picked.

===Defeating Damis===
{{Needed|[[Gilded cross]]|recommended=Combat equipment, [[prayer potion]]s, [[runes]] to cast spells such as [[Entangle]], [[stamina potion]]s, and an emergency teleport.}}

{|
|colspan=2|[[File:Shadow Dungeon map.png|center|thumb|500px|[[Shadow Dungeon]]]]
|-
|1. Entrance east of [[Baxtorian Falls]] with [[ring of visibility]]||G – [[Giant skeleton (Shadow Dungeon)|Giant skeletons]] ''(level 80)''
|-
|2. [[Damis]]||S – [[Shadow hound]]s ''(level 63)''
|}

Return to Rasolo and exchange the gilded cross for the [[ring of visibility]]. Equip the ring, and a ladder will appear to the east of Rasolo in the fenced area. Climb down the ladder, then head east as far as you can, then north as far as you can. Head east again, and go south as far as possible at the first fork. Go east again. After this, take the next turn north, then go east, and you will reach [[Damis]]' cave. Beware that the area where [[Damis]] is encountered is a [[multi-combat area]], filled with [[Giant skeleton (Shadow Dungeon)|giant skeletons]] and [[shadow hound]]s. These monsters solely use melee, so activating [[Protect from Melee]] will negate all damage.

Once Damis' cave is reached, it's time for the fight. If he does not spawn, players can make Damis appear by running around a bit in the final area. You must have the ring of visibility equipped or he will not appear; make sure to '''keep the ring equipped for the entire fight'''. 

'''Note:''' It is possible for Damis to not appear right away. Un-equipping and re-equipping the ring of visibility may help, as well as walking around the arena close to the walls. If he still doesn't appear, hopping worlds should work. 

If you teleport out after defeating him without picking up the diamond, it will remain on the ground and you can come back to pick it up, without having to fight him again. Additionally, players may find it beneficial to kill a shadow hound while in the dungeon, to complete a task for the [[Hard Kandarin Diary]].

====The fight====
[[File:Fighting Damis.png|thumb|A player fights [[Damis]].]]
* Damis has two forms. The first is level 103 which only attacks with [[Melee]], and the second form is level 174 and rapidly drains [[Prayer]] when attacking you. The second form is significantly harder, and has an attack speed of 3, as well as being able to hit up to 28 while draining 5% + 1 of your current Prayer points every [[tick]] (0.6 seconds).
** At 43 prayer, this attack will drain 3 prayer points every tick. Combined with normal rate of prayer drain, this means that players will lose 16 points every three seconds.
** This prayer drain only triggers when Damis is in melee distance; safespotting him allows players to ignore this mechanic completely.
** With Protect from Melee, [[Damis]] is not much more difficult than any other monster, although you'll need to ensure you have enough prayer potions to account for his prayer drain. Make sure to watch your prayer points so that you don't run out.
* The most common way of defeating Damis is with magic. While it is possible to use Melee, his Melee defence is very high, on top of subjecting players to the prayer drain.
* Damis has no elemental weakness;{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1028980496020242432|date=13 August 2018|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/99559|archivedate=28 May 2020|quote=The ice & fire warriors have effects. So do mummies in the pyramid. That's all I could find.}} any spell will suffice. You can use a [[trident of the seas]] for both forms.
* Unless safespotting, you will rely heavily on [[Protect from Melee]], as without it activated, you'll be tanking 2-4 [[Giant skeleton (Shadow Dungeon)|giant skeletons]] and [[shadow hound]]s while trying to kill [[Damis]], all of whom attack accurately with Melee.
* Without Protect from Melee, prepare to take large amounts of damage '''very''' quickly. To simply tank Damis without using prayer potions, it is recommended to have level 65 to 70 melee stats at minimum, a [[divine super combat potion]], and a full inventory of high-healing food ([[Cooked karambwan|karambwan]] or better). Poisoning Damis is also helpful.
* If you leave after defeating his first form, you do not have to fight it again! When you return, you will only have to defeat his second form, allowing players to re-supply if necessary.
* Bringing a [[stamina potion]] and kiting him around the arena will help reduce the burden of using [[prayer potion]]s. Casting [[Snare]]/[[Entangle]] on [[Damis]] and re-casting once he moves can help keep him from ever coming within Melee distance.[[File:Desert treasure safespot.png|thumb|220px|A player uses a [[giant rat]] to [[Safespot]] [[Damis]].]]

====Notes for pures====
* If you plan to use the [[Safespot]], lure his first form there, as otherwise, his second form will just disappear into the shadows.
* The safespot is easy to set up: as soon as Damis spawns, head to the safespot, using the torches to your advantage (Note: this is only a flinch method, not a true safespot)
* Due to the dungeon being multicombat, '''it is recommended''' to use creatures, such as the rat or the [[bat]] found around the north-east safespot of the arena. To do so, simply position yourself behind the animal and attack it with a weak attack or spell, then attack Damis with Magic or Range. Consider bringing a fun weapon such as flowers to draw the creatures' attention without killing it. You may also use the thin tunnel if luring Damis to the torch seems ineffective. If using the tunnel, 43 Prayer and/or high-healing food is recommended as a [[Giant Skeleton]] will continuously spawn in the NE opening.
* You can also poison Damis, and then use the safespotting method to let the poison lower his health; he rarely despawns.
* Cannons can be set up in this area. For those without access to prayer, the south-eastern-most area of the dungeon is just wide enough to fit a cannon, but narrow enough to trap Damis while setting it up.

Once you have defeated Damis in his second form, he will drop the shadow diamond on the ground. Once the diamond is in players' inventories, they can safely teleport out of the dungeon. If the diamond is lost, simply crossing the corridor into the multi-combat zone, the area where Damis spawns, will make the diamond reappear on the ground.

==Blood diamond==
{{Needed|[[Garlic powder]] (created by using your [[pestle and mortar]] with [[garlic]]), [[silver bar]], [[spice]].|recommended=Good food ([[swordfish]] or better), 1-2 [[prayer potion]]s, [[Druid pouch|druid pouches]], and a [[Draynor Village|Draynor]] teleport method.}}

[[Dessous]] is a fairly straightforward boss, but due to his location, forgetting steps can cost a lot of time. Keep the following in mind:

* The pot cannot be made ahead of time,  you need to get instructions from [[Malak]] first.
* Save gearing up until after you get the [[Silver pot (Desert Treasure I)|silver pot]], as you'll need to go to [[Entrana]] to get it blessed, and combat items aren't allowed on the island.
* If you plan on using the [[Shades of Mort'ton (minigame)|Shades of Mort'ton]] [[Minigame Teleport]] and [[Swamp Boaty|the Hollows boat]], make sure to bring 10 coins or a [[Ring of Charos(a)]] for the ride.

===Sweetening the pot===
[[File:Desert Treasure talking to Malak.png|thumb|Malak notices your presence whilst collecting blood tithes.]]
Travel to [[Canifis]] ([[fairy ring]] code {{Fairycode|cks}}), and talk to [[Malak]] in the pub. Tell him that you're looking for a diamond. He'll agree to give it to you if you kill Dessous and gives you a list of items that you'll need to kill him successfully. '''Make sure to ask [[Malak]] how to kill [[Dessous]] before you go to [[Ruantun]] or he won't make the silver pot for you.''' Travel to [[Draynor]], there is [[garlic]] in the cupboard upstairs in [[Morgan]]'s house if you need it. Bring your [[silver bar]] down the trapdoor, west of Morgan's house, to enter [[Draynor Sewers]]. In the sewers, go east, then north and talk to [[Ruantun]]. Ask him to make you a [[Silver pot (Desert Treasure I)|silver pot]]. 

Take the pot to [[Entrana]] (making sure you have no [[weapons]]/[[armour]] on you; there's a deposit box at the ship that can be used to bank before embarking), and head to the church, then use the silver pot on the [[High Priest (Entrana)|High Priest]] to get it blessed. Go back to Canifis, and talk to Malak again and he'll fill the pot with your blood (this will damage you for 5 [[Hitpoints]], but '''cannot''' kill you). Finally, add the [[garlic powder]] to the pot along with some [[spice]] to prepare for the battle. The [[High Priest (Entrana)|High Priest]] will still bless a silver pot filled with blood, though he will be slightly shocked, if the instructions are done out of order.

The examine for the pot should read: ''A blessed silver pot filled with blood, garlic, and spices.'' 

'''If the examine does not say this and you attempt to kill Dessous, he will regenerate to full Hitpoints and you will need to refill the pot.'''
[[File:Graveyard_Map.png|thumb|434x434px|Reaching [[Dessous]] in the [[Morytania Graveyard]].]]

===Dealing with Dessous===
Once the pot is prepared, gear up and go to the [[Morytania Graveyard]] - see [[Dessous]]' page for routes there. Once you arrive, pour the blood on the tomb and Dessous will appear.

====The fight====
*Dessous is a [[Vampyre (monster type)#Tier 1 Vampyres|tier 1 vampyre]], meaning that [[silver weaponry]] is '''not''' required to damage him, though they do gain a 10% damage bonus. The [[Ivandis flail]] and [[blisterwood flail]] give greater bonuses, but Dessous' weakness to [[Stab weapons|stab]] means a stab weapon such as a [[dragon sword]] is a better option if using melee.
*[[Efaritay's aid]] will give regular weapons a 10% damage bonus against Dessous.
*He also has low [[Magic defence]], so the highest max hit spell you can cast will make it possible to kill him quickly.
*Dessous sometimes teleports to you if you use prayer. He may occasionally still do so randomly however. He will not teleport if you are within melee range.
*If you make him teleport more than three times, he'll say he's bored and will leave, causing you to have to start the fight again with a new pot.
** If the chatbox says Dessous has gotten bored and left when his health has been fully depleted, it means you haven't defeated him.
*Dying or leaving the fight earlier will require a new pot to be filled and used on the tomb.
*Dessous has two attacks: a melee attack that is rapid and accurate '''(3-tick speed, hits up to 19)''', and a combination range and magic attack that always hits '''double 5s (totaling to 10)'''. Because of this, it's strongly recommended to use '''[[protect from melee]]''', reducing his max hit to 10 at any given time.
*'''Never let your health drop below 16''', as his double 5s will sometimes lag, stacking up to 15 altogether.
*He '''cannot''' be safespotted through the fence, but it can be used to effectively [[flinch]] him.
*The [[silver pot]] is correctly prepared if the [[Magic]] and [[Ranged]] combo attack only hits a maximum of two 5s and he switches between that attack and melee.
*If you know how to 1-tick alternate your prayers, you can avoid all damage by flicking between Protect from Melee and Protect from Missiles.
[[File:Dessous spawns.gif|thumb|right|Dessous comes out of the grave.]]

====Notes for pures====
* A [[Dwarf multicannon]] can be used to kill Dessous, although it will be fairly inaccurate against him. Be sure to set up the cannon '''before''' opening the coffin; bring at least 75 cannonballs.
* [[Tick eating]] can be used to survive with low HP, but the double 5s make this difficult to do, so keeping HP above 10 is a must. For low HP pures, it's recommended to use foods that boost HP above your current level such as [[Guthix rest]]s (requires [[One Small Favour]]) and [[Saradomin brew]]s. At 10 HP, a brew will boost your HP by 3; you can eat a slice of [[pineapple pizza]] and then drink a brew in the same tick, restoring/boosting your HP to 13 after every hit Dessous makes.

Once Dessous is dead, return to [[Malak]] in [[Canifis]] to claim the [[Blood diamond]], and deposit it in the bank as quickly as possible to avoid being attacked by the Stranger. If you lose the diamond, reclaim it from Malak. You will not have to fight Dessous again.

'''Note:''' If the player wishes to keep the pot or other variants (including copies), the player should drop them before speaking with Malak or reclaiming a lost diamond from him.

==Ice diamond==
{{Needed|A sweet ([[cake]], [[chocolate cake]] (partial cakes work), [[chocolate bar]], [[cooking apple]], or [[pineapple pizza]]), [[Spiked boots]], a way to get to [[Troll child]] ([[Trollheim Teleport]], [[climbing boots]], or [[Ghommal's hilt 1]]+), several [[super restore]], [[menaphite remedy]], [[restore potion]] or [[sunlight moth mix]], or [[sunlight moth]]s, equipment and supplies to kill 5 [[Ice troll]]s and [[Kamil]] (if using magic, runes for [[fire spells]] and be on the [[standard spellbook]]. Kamil is immune to all other spells, including Iban Blast and Flames of Zamorak).|recommended=Several [[prayer potion]]s, good [[food]] ([[lobster]]s or better), and an emergency one-click teleport that doesn't have a Magic requirement, such as the [[Ectophial]] or a [[magic tablet]].}}
[[File:Ice Path map.png|thumb|right|After reaching [[Trollheim]], the [[Ice Path]] is due north-west.]]

[[Kamil]] is the next boss and arguably the hardest boss of the quest. Due to the many factors that come into play during this fight, it's highly recommended to thoroughly read this section before continuing.

* [[Protect from Melee]] is '''highly''' recommended otherwise the [[ice troll]]s and [[Ice Wolf|ice wolves]] on the way to Kamil will deal a lot of damage. The trolls are in single combat, while the wolves are in multicombat.
* It is recommended to restock and restore stats after each step because everything will be heavily drained.
* While not in combat, mainly right after entering the ice cave or hiding behind the boulder after passing the wolves, it's possible to stall the cold effect by activating a prayer that you don't have unlocked yet, and leaving the dialogue box open. This can be good for those who need to reread a section before proceeding.

===Feeding the trolls===
Make your way to [[Trollheim]], and then take the north-western path to the [[Troll child]]. If following the path from [[Burthorpe]], you will need a pair of [[Climbing Boots]] as well as [[Spiked Boots]]. You will need to pass the [[Thrower Troll (Trollheim)|thrower troll]]s; [[Protect from Missiles]] will negate their damage entirely, otherwise [[food]] or another player to tank is required. '''Do not''' enter the path with a boulder in the way; that leads to the [[God Wars Dungeon]]. Go down the previous path, which leads to the Troll child and the entrance to the [[Ice Path]]. It should start to snow as you approach the gate (note that the stat-reducing effects '''only occur once you pass through the Ice Gate''', making this a safe area to wait).

Upon talking to the Troll child, he'll cry and won't speak to you. Use a [[cake]] or [[Troll child#Sweet foods|other sweet]] on him and then speak to him again to learn that his parents are frozen farther up the path. Attempt to enter the Ice Gate, the Troll child will explain why it is frozen. Enter the Ice Gate once more to squeeze through it.

While on the Ice Path, your stats will be drained every few seconds, your run energy will instantly be reduced to 0, and you will take 1 damage every time the cold hits. All of your [[Special attack]] energy will be drained as well, so [[special attack]] [[boosts]] should be done before entering. Restore potions will recover drained stats, and Super restore potions will do the same, as well as restore Prayer points. Otherwise multiple trips can be taken by using a [[ring of dueling]] to teleport to [[Ferox Enclave]] and drink from one of the [[pools of refreshment]] to restore all stats.

Once past the Ice Gate, you have to kill five [[ice troll]]s, regardless of their level. However, the ice trolls with higher levels have lower defensive stats in exchange for higher offensive stats, making them easier to kill if using Protect from Melee. They can hit up to '''25''', so use [[Protect from Melee]] or safespot them with [[Ranged]] or [[Magic]] to be more safe. The [[dwarf multicannon]] works here, but can be inaccurate against the trolls, so be sure to bring several hundred cannonballs. They retreat when safespotted. The five trolls do not have to be killed in succession, you can leave and return without losing progress. After killing five trolls at the gate, the cave will have thawed open, allowing you to enter and proceed to Kamil.

If you forget how many trolls you've killed, you can check your progress by examining the cave or by counting the number of chatbox messages that are: ''"A chunk of ice falls away from the cave entrance..."'', if you haven't logged out, as killing a troll causes that message to appear until you've killed five. '''It is recommended you go back to the bank and restock your supplies before returning.'''

===Killing Kamil===
Enter the cave and follow the [[Ice Path]] until you reach [[Kamil]]. '''This path contains multiple [[Ice wolf|ice wolves]] capable of hitting 16s in multicombat, so protect from melee or a lot of food is a must.''' Another account can be used to tank damage as well. Continue walking and the path will open up and turn to the left, walk until you find a rock, marking the area where you will find Kamil. ''You'll get a message saying "You can feel an evil presence nearby..." when you enter the area.''

====The fight====
*[[Kamil]] uses two attacks, a strong melee attack capable of hitting up to 23, and a magic attack similar to Dessous' combination attack which always hits 5. '''Due to lag it's possible for these to stack to 10, so it's recommended to keep your hitpoints at 12 or above at all times.''' He also consistently freezes you with this attack by using a spell resembling [[Ice Barrage]], especially if outside of melee range. When frozen, you're unable to move or attack for several seconds so you'll only have a few ticks (if any) to get off attacks before being frozen again.
*Hiding behind the rock does '''not''' work anymore, and neither does having another player block Kamil. You cannot cast from behind the rock, and Kamil will teleport if you have another player blocking.
*[[Protect from Melee]] is '''highly''' recommended, otherwise you will deal very little damage due to constant eating.
*When using [[Magic]], '''only''' [[fire spells]] can damage Kamil. Due to the [[temporary skill drain]] it is recommended to use a spell significantly below your base Magic level. Even though stats can be restored, it is much more reliable. [[Fire Bolt]] is a good option, along with [[chaos gauntlets]] and a [[tome of fire]]. Also note, [[Iban Blast]] will '''not''' work against [[Kamil]] as it is not a fire spell.
*Melee combat is not recommended as he will freeze you often.
*While [[Ranged]] is not recommended, using a fast, strong weapon like the [[toxic blowpipe]] may be feasible.

====Notes for pures====
*A [[dwarf multicannon]] can also be used against Kamil, it should be set up two squares north of the rock, allowing them to safely hide from Kamil, but restock it when it runs out of cannonballs. Since the cannon's position will cause it to attack the wolves as well, be sure to bring enough (100+) cannonballs to kill him.
*Low hitpoints pures may find reaching the cave difficult, as there are dozens of trolls in the area, and it's single combat; one way around this is to enter a [[PvP world]] and remove your weapon and attack a friend, keeping them in combat with you and as such avoiding being attacked by the trolls. '''If using this method, do NOT eat until you've made it to the cave, as the delay from combat while eating will cause the trolls to attack you.'''

===The parent trap===
[[File:Desert Treasure freeing ice trolls.png|thumb|right|Thawing the ice troll child's parents.]]
Once Kamil is defeated, you need to free the troll parents. Head west from Kamil, then follow the path as it loops around. If you check the world map (or the map above), you can see the path that you need to take more easily than you can on the minimap or in game. At the end of the spiralling path, you will reach a second, darker, more visually distinct path, the beginning of which is located between two pillars of ice formations.

Put on your [[spiked boots]] and ''Use'' the ice ledge between the two pillars to climb up onto the second path. This is another long, spiralling path of ice which you must follow all the way up to reach the parents. You may slip and fall multiple times, taking some damage as you walk. Using [[super restore]]s to restore your [[Agility]] level will help here. At the top, pass through the ice gate and walk west along the third and final path until you see two large [[ice block]]s containing the troll parents. Attack the ice blocks, which have 10 [[Hitpoints]] each. They can be smashed or attacked, however with low stats it may be difficult to deal damage accurately, so the super restore from Kamil should be used.

If you have 49 [[Prayer]], [[Redemption]] can be used to heal with '''all''' of your remaining Prayer points to stay alive after running out of food as a last resort. It will sustain you if you have more [[prayer potion]]s or super restores.

After freeing the troll parents, they will take you back outside the gate and give you the [[ice diamond]]. If lost, talk to the Troll child to receive another. Kamil will not have to be fought again.

==The Ancient Pyramid==
{{Needed|[[Shantay pass (item)|Shantay pass]]es, [[waterskin]]s, [[blood diamond]], [[ice diamond]], [[smoke diamond]], [[shadow diamond]], coins for [[magic carpet]] rides (bring a [[Ring of Charos(a)]] for discounted rides)|recommended=[[Weight-reducing equipment]] such as [[graceful clothing]] or gear with high crush defence, [[Prayer items|prayer boosting equipment]], 2+ [[prayer potion]]s, 1 [[super antipoison]] (or some [[strange fruit]]), several [[energy potion]]s or 1 [[stamina potion]], [[food]] ([[summer pie]]s recommended), and an emergency teleport, 80,000 [[coins]] if buying [[Ancient Staff]].}}

With all four diamonds in your inventory, go to the [[Ancient Pyramid]] south-east of Eblis (marked "Jaldraocht Pyramid" on the world map). Place each diamond in its respective obelisk on the corners around the base of the pyramid (requires level 50 [[Magic]]). Each obelisk's tip and centre have a colour related to the specific diamond that needs to be placed there. Diamonds will only fit in the correct obelisk and cannot be removed afterwards.

[[File:Ancient Pyramid pillar.png|thumb|right|The pillar absorbs the gem.]]
When all four obelisks are activated, the pyramid will no longer be blocked, and can be entered from the top.

'''Note:''' To keep duplicate diamonds after the quest, drop the duplicates before putting the last diamond into the pyramid's last unpowered obelisk. After this is done, the quest can be safely completed without the diamonds being automatically removed from one's inventory or bank.

===Tomb raider===
[[Desert heat]] is not a problem while inside the pyramid, but most of the interior is dangerous. Level 92 [[scarab swarm]]s occasionally erupt out of the floor while level 103 [[Mummy (Ancient Pyramid)|mummies]] roam about and level 96 [[Mummy (Ancient Pyramid sarcophagus)|mummies]] spontaneously pop out of [[Sarcophagus (Ancient Pyramid)|sarcophagi]]. All monsters use [[Melee]] only, though scarab swarms can [[poison]]. 

Every time a scarab swarm appears or a mummy pops out of a sarcophagus, you will stop moving, and will not be able to move until the animation has finished. It is possible to avoid a scarab swarm entirely by making sure it is behind a mummy. There are also randomly activated traps that will send you back to the entrance of the pyramid. Bring [[weight-reducing clothing]] and plenty of [[super energy potion]]s or [[stamina potion]]s to maintain [[run energy]] or restore it quicker if it depletes. If you get caught by a trap, you will be taken outside to the south side of the pyramid but with no damage done. Do not click directly to the ladder; keep clicking to your goal as this will reduce the chances of getting caught by traps. It is useful to use a [[strange fruit]] while inside the pyramid due to the fact that it recovers 30% run energy and cures any kind of poison you may have gotten while inside the pyramid. Opening the house option interface while running to the ladder will stall the traps, reopen interface when attacked.

''The levels in the pyramid are numbered in the order the player encounters them in the quest. The purple line marks the route.''

====Outside====
Enter the pyramid from its top. The southern entrance leading to the altar can only be used after the quest has been completed.
[[File:Ancient Pyramid outside.png|center|thumb|Diagram of the pyramid's exterior]]

====Level 1====
Run from the entrance ladder to the Level 2 ladder. This level is the smallest in the area, with the fewest mummies.
[[File:Ancient Pyramid level 1.png|center|thumb|Level 1 of the Ancient Pyramid]]

====Level 2====
This level is the second smallest in area, with a few more mummies roaming about. This room might have a few traps.
[[File:Ancient Pyramid level 2.png|center|thumb|Level 2 of the Ancient Pyramid]]

====Level 3====
This level is fairly large in area, with a significant number of mummies. There is a vast amount of traps.
[[File:Ancient Pyramid level 3.png|center|thumb|Level 3 of the Ancient Pyramid]]

====Level 4====
This level is quite large in area, with mummies roaming about everywhere except the altar room. The altar room is separated by a door—do not rely on the minimap to run outside.
[[File:Ancient Pyramid level 4.png|center|thumb|Level 4 of the Ancient Pyramid]]

:''Easy tip to remember which way to start running after each level:'' north, east, south, west.

===Azzanadra===
[[File:Azzanadra is freed.png|thumb|300px|Azzanadra is released from his prison.]]
[[File:Azzanadra (Desert Treasure I) chathead.png|left]]
It is possible for a [[scarab swarm]] to spawn inside the altar room, but this only happens if it was spawning as you were entering the room. If this is the case, trap it between the door and an obstacle that is just in front of the door. Speak to [[Azzanadra]], or spawn him by using the [[Altar (Ancient Pyramid)|altar]]. He has lost track of time and believes that the [[God Wars]] are still going on. He goes on to talk about ancient unknown civilizations like [[Paddewwa]], [[Lassar]], and [[Annakarl]]. He is also surprised to see that he cannot hear [[Zaros]] in his mind anymore.

After talking, Azzanadra finally comes to peace with reality, rewarding the adventurer with the [[Ancient Magicks]] of Zaros for their efforts.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

At quest completion, you will be switched to the [[Ancient Magicks]] spellbook. Make sure you change back to the [[standard spellbook]] before you leave, if you prefer to be on it, by praying at the [[Altar (Ancient Pyramid)|altar]]. You can return here at any time via the back entrance of the pyramid to swap between the two.

'''Notes:''' 
*Praying at the [[Altar (Ancient Pyramid)|altar]] twice after completing the quest will complete a [[Desert Diary|hard task in the Desert area]]. Do this before leaving the area.
*[[Paddewwa Teleport|Teleport to Paddewwa]] to complete a [[Varrock_Diary#Hard|Varrock hard diary]] task. This requires 2 Law Runes, 1 Air Rune, 1 Fire rune, and level 54 [[Magic]].
*After exiting the pyramid, and at any point after the quest, you can speak with Eblis to obtain both an [[ancient staff]] (for 80,000 gp) and an endless supply of [[ancient signet]]s (for free).

==Walkthrough==
===Getting started===
{{Map|name=Doric|x=2952|y=3452|r=4|height=250|width=250|mtype=square|align=right|caption=The quest's start location.}}
[[Doric]] can be found in a small building on the crossroads north of [[Falador]], east of the [[Taverley]] gate, and south of the [[Goblin Village]].

Ask Doric if you could use his [[whetstone]] or [[anvil]]. Doric will tell you he needs some materials in order to manufacture some [[pickaxe]]s. He will hand you a [[bronze pickaxe]]. He wants you to get him:

*6 [[clay]] 
*4 [[copper ore]]s
*2 [[iron ore]]s

(''These cannot be noted'')

These materials must be turned in all at once ''(12 inventory slots)''.

===Obtaining the materials===
''(Skip this part if you already have all of the required materials)''

Where you obtain the ores does not matter, and can for example be obtained from other players or by mining the ores yourself (15 [[Mining]] is required for [[iron ore]]).

The [[Dwarven Mine]] is located near Doric's house, so you can head there. To get there, go east from Doric's house and then north to find a path onto [[Ice Mountain]]. On the mountain, walk south and look for a ladder surrounded by buildings and [[Dwarf|dwarves]]. Climb down the ladder to enter the Dwarven Mine. The [[Iron rocks|iron]], [[Copper rocks|copper]], and [[tin rocks]] are located due south of the entrance. [[Clay rocks]] are located a little further south.

[[Dwarf|Dwarves]] located outside the [[Dwarven Mine]], east of Doric's house, sometimes drop [[iron ore]]. This may help [[Ironmen]] trying to complete this quest before level 15 [[Mining]]. [[Members]] can buy the copper ores and iron ores at [[Ore Seller|the store]] in [[Blast Furnace]]. [[Ironmen]] can also complete the quest before reaching level 15 Mining by [[pickpocketing]] [[H.A.M. Member|H.A.M members]] as they have an uncommon chance to give [[Iron ore]]. Also you can kill for example [[Sand Crab|Sand]] or [[Rock Crab]]s which drop both copper and iron.

Alternatively, instead of mining in the Dwarven Mine, you can use the [[Rimmington mine]] south of Falador, which contains all the required ores right next to each other.

===Finishing up===
When you have all the ores needed, return to [[Doric]] to finish the quest. He will appreciate your help, reward you, and allow you to use his [[anvil]]s whenever you'd like.

==Walkthrough==

===The Champions' Guild and Oziach===
[[File:Guildmaster.png|left|frameless|width=250x250]]
Head to the [[Champions' Guild]] immediately south of the southern gates of [[Varrock]] and ask the [[Guildmaster]] for a quest. He will tell you to visit [[Oziach]], the maker of rune platebodies, who sets the tasks that champions must complete to earn the right to wear one. 

Oziach can be found in the north-west corner of [[Edgeville]], near the [[Wilderness ditch]] and the [[Edgeville Monastery]]. Speak to him, and he will set the player the task of killing the dragon of [[Crandor]].

Return to the Guildmaster, who will recount the tale of [[Elvarg]], the dragon that laid waste to the whole of Crandor, leaving a trio of wizards as the sole survivors. To reach Crandor, the player will need a ship capable of getting through dangerous reefs, a map to show the way, and protection against the dragon's breath.

'''''Important:''' Ask him '''all the follow up questions below'''; each one unlocks a stage of the quest. You will need to return later if you do not.''

Ask him how you can find the route to Crandor, and he will tell you that only one map exists - it was split into three pieces, each held by a wizard.

Ask him where to find each map piece, and he will give you information about each piece, as well as give you a [[Maze key]] (requires free inventory space). 

Ask him where you can find the right ship, and he will suggest looking in Port Sarim. 

Ask him how to protect against the dragon's breath, and he will mention that [[Duke Horacio]] has a special shield which is enchanted against dragon's breath.

===Obtaining the anti-dragon shield===
[[File:Duke Horacio chathead.png|left|frameless]]

Alternatively, you can obtain one for free from [[Duke Horacio]] on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} of [[Lumbridge Castle]]. The [[drop trick]] can be used to obtain several shields, which may be useful if you  die during the dragon fight and need to return, as Elvarg shoots dragonfire immediately upon entering her arena.

Take your nails, planks, [[hammer]], and {{Coins|2000}}, and head to [[Port Sarim]]. ===Preparing for the fight===
{{Needed|[[Anti-dragon shield]], [[combat equipment]] and [[food]]|recommended=Quick escapes, like [[teleport]] [[runes]], [[teleport tablets]] or the [[ectophial]]. [[Antifire potion]]s, and [[Prayer potions]] or [[restore potions]]}}

==== Dragonfire ====

Without the use of [[Dragonfire#Protection|dragonfire protection]], [[Elvarg]]'s [[dragonfire]] can deal up to '''70''' damage at range. Equipping an [[anti-dragon shield]] is '''highly recommended''' to mitigate this at a minimum; [[Protect from Magic]] will also reduce some of the damage.  Members may also drink an [[antifire potion]] or [[super antifire potion]] in combination with the other two methods.

See the below table for the maximum damage Elvarg will deal based on your combination of dragonfire protection used.

{{:Dragonfire/Elvarg}}

Note that every dragonfire attack from Elvarg will also drain 10% of your remaining [[Prayer]], rounded down.

====General preparations====

As well as dragonfire protection, consider taking [[prayer potions]] or [[restore potions]] with you for when Elvarg drains your prayer, if you plan to use it during the battle.

Lower levelled players may find it useful to use [[rings of recoil]] to deal additional damage, as Elvarg's fast hits make it particularly useful in dealing back damage.

The rest of your inventory should be filled with [[food]] - [[lobster]]s (12 HP) should be enough for most players with a [[combat level]] of around 40 and appropriate gear, but [[swordfish]] (14 HP) or higher would be useful.

You may also consider taking a [[teleportation]] method with you, either to escape death or to leave the island after killing her.

'''Note''': While it will allow you to set up a cannon in the area, it will not attack Elvarg.

====Choosing a combat style====
Before fighting Elvarg, you'll need to choose a ''[[Combat triangle|combat style]]'': melee, ranged or magic.

'''Melee'''

This is the preferred style, as Elvarg will not solely use her dragonfire attack but also melee attacks when standing next to her, and the latter are less powerful. You may also consider using [[flinching]] (see the tips section below for more information).

Equip good-quality armour; preferably [[adamant armour]] or better.

Like all [[Dragon (race)|dragons]], Elvarg is weak to [[stab]] attacks; see the page about [[Attack types]]. As such, consider wielding a [[Stab weapons|stab weapon]]: a sword or dagger instead of a scimitar. Adamant or better is recommended. For [[free-to-play]] players, a [[rune sword]] is recommended as it possesses the highest stab bonus in F2P, with its aggressive style the optimum for most players. A  [[rune longsword]], [[rune scimitar]], [[rune battleaxe|battleaxe]] or [[rune mace|mace]] are less effective but may still do decent enough damage.

Elvarg is not immune to [[poison]], so adding [[weapon poison]] would turn the battle even more in your favour; thus a poisoned [[dagger]] would be effective.

'''Ranged'''

Elvarg is also weak against [[Ranged|ranged attacks]], but as you should be using an [[Anti-dragon shield]], you must use a one-handed weapon such as a [[crossbow (weapon)|crossbow]]. This may be trickier for Free-to-play players who only have access to the weakest types and [[bronze bolts]]. For Members this is more viable, and they should use the best crossbow with the best [[bolts]] they can use (preferably poisoned).

Make sure you have [[Auto Retaliate]] on and select the [[Combat Options#Rapid|Rapid]] firing style.

'''Magic'''

While Elvarg, like many other dragons, has somewhat strong defences against magic, she has a 30% [[elemental weakness]] to [[water spells]]. This means that water spells have their accuracy and damage increased by 30% against her. As such, mages should use the strongest water spell they have available.

===Travelling to Crandor & locating Elvarg===
{{Map|2840,3268|align=left|width=220|height=280|zoom=2|caption=The surface of Crandor.}}
[[File:Dragon Slayer - Cabin boy Jenkins fried.png|thumb|right|A reason why dragonfire protection is needed to face Elvarg.]]

Head back to and board your ship to meet up with Ned and Cabin boy Jenkins. Speak with Ned to depart and a cutscene will begin...

After crashing on the southern side of [[Crandor|the island]], make your way to the top of the volcano (the [[dungeon]] marker on your [[minimap]]), avoiding [[aggressive]] [[skeletons]], [[moss giants]], [[hobgoblins]], and [[lesser demons]]. Enter the hole and a short cutscene plays, followed by abruptly finding yourself surrounded by [[Skeleton#Level 25|skeletons (level 25)]]. Down the corridor you'll find large [[Skeleton#Level 45|skeletons (level 45)]], and you'll see Elvarg in the main chamber behind stalagmites and stalactites. 

'''Note''': If you are a [[Member]], you can climb back up the rope to complete a medium task in the [[Karamja Diary]], then climb back down.

'''Note:''' Before fighting Elvarg, there is a wall to the south you can open. Once opened, it will allow you to travel back to Crandor from the [[Karamja Volcano]], by climbing down the rocks on the eastern side of the volcano, then heading north. If you die during the fight, you would otherwise need the materials to repair the boat again (90 steel nails, 3 planks and a hammer). Once you have unlocked this shortcut, trying to repair the ship will result in the message {{Mes|You don't need to mess about with broken ships now that you have found the secret passage from Karamja}}, and you will be unable to use it to return to Crandor. After the quest has been completed, you will be able to return to Crandor via the [[Karamja Volcano]] regardless of whether you opened it during the quest or not.

Now, go back to the main chamber, climb over the low stalagmites, and fight Elvarg (see section below for tips).

===Tips for the fight & potential strategies===
[[File:Dragon Slayer - Fighting Elvarg.png|thumb|left|250px|A player battles against Elvarg, the destroyer of Crandor. In the top-left, the remains of the original adventurer who woke the dragon can be seen.]]

*Make sure that you have your dragonfire protection active before you enter the arena, as Elvarg, unlike other [[Green dragon|green dragons]], can use dragonfire attacks at a distance.

*You may consider standing under Elvarg while eating, as it takes her a moment to move and hit you again.

*If you happen to teleport away during battle, she will take some time before fully healing, and may still be missing health if you can return quickly.

* Aside from teleporting, you can exit the arena whenever you'd like, however re-entering the arena will result in guaranteed dragon fire attack.

* Members who are unable to kill Elvarg in one trip may choose to escape through the shortcut to Karamja and go through the cave entrance to [[Mor Ul Rek]] to get extra food from their bank. If you return quickly, Elvarg will not have enough time to heal. Be sure to keep enough food to survive being hit by monsters on the way.

[[File:Elvarg safespot.png|thumb|right|250px|A player standing in a safespot to heal up, or to use the flinching method.]]

*Elvarg can be [[Flinching|flinched]] using melee attacks. Flinching is a combat tactic that entails attacking an opponent while it is out of combat and going to a [[safespot]] before the monster can retaliate. This can and will still go wrong every now and then, so it is still recommended to bring food and have a decent combat level.

*To flinch her, stand in the south-eastern corner of her cave, in the game square directly next to the north-west corner of the little lava pool. You'll also need to get Elvarg to stand directly left of the skeleton on the ground to the north-west. (See the image for the place to stand.) If you pull this off, she will be unable to hit you; this is a safespot. From there, begin to attack her, and immediately click on the north-west corner (don't click on a rat) of the little lava pool to walk back to the safespot. Wait for Elvarg's health bar to disappear, and repeat the process.

==Trivia==
*Although players must complete this quest in order to wear the [[green d'hide body]], its completion is '''not''' required to equip the [[Blue d'hide body|blue]], [[Red d'hide body|red]] and [[Black d'hide body|black]] dragonhide bodies.
*Dragon Slayer I was the last quest to be released before [[Members|membership]] was introduced to ''[[RuneScape Classic]]''.
*When speaking to Oziach at the start of the quest, he asks you how you found out he sells the rune platebody. If you reply 'I am a master detective,' and have completed the [[Murder Mystery]] quest, your character will exclaim that they even solved the Sinclair murder mystery all by themselves.
*If you have completed the quest, when speaking to Duke Horacio during [[The Lost Tribe]] quest, [[Sigmund]] mentions to him that you are the same adventurer who defeated Elvarg. Otherwise Sigmund will reference [[Rune Mysteries]] instead.
*Attempting to take a [[charter ship]] to Crandor, only available during this quest, they will refuse and tell the player "''Crandor? Are you crazy? No charter ship would take you to that island. You'd need to use your own ship, but even then, you'd need a miracle to find a safe route there!''"
*If the player leaves Crandor before defeating Elvarg,  Ned in Draynor Village will answer the player's question how he got back from Crandor with ''"I got towed back by a passing friendly whale."'' When talking to Klarense again, he'll exclaim: ''"Wow! You sure are lucky! Seems the Lady Lumbridge just washed right up into the dock by herself!"'' Miraculously, the ship is not nearly as damaged as after the crash. Only the initial hole in the hull needs fixing once again, requiring the same materials as before (i.e.,  3 planks, 90 steel nails, and a hammer). Ned is standing on the deck just like before, but Cabin boy Jenkins is nowhere to be seen (obviously, since he died during Elvarg's attack on the ship).
*If you sail to Crandor and then teleport out without opening the secret entrance from Karamja to Crandor, the shortcut will unlock by itself.
*Wearing an Amulet of Ghostspeak and talking with the ghosts in Melzar's Maze reveals them to be citizens of Crandor, reliving their final moments before dying.
*If the player has completed [[Pandemonium]], your character will ask the guildmaster if you can captain your own ship. He will suggest finding someone else to be the captain since you will be dealing with a dragon.

==Walkthrough==
===The stone circle===
[[File:Druidic Ritual - Kaqemeex.png|thumb|220px|Speaking to [[Kaqemeex]].]]
{{Needed|recommended=To save time, bring [[raw rat meat]], [[raw bear meat]], [[raw beef]] and [[raw chicken]]. You can read the subsequent section for advice on gathering these.}}
[[File:Kaqemeex chathead.png|left]]
Head to the stone circle on the hill just north of [[Taverley]], immediately east of the road to [[Burthorpe]]. Talk to [[Kaqemeex]] and tell him you are in search of a quest. He will mention that the stone circle south of [[Varrock]] used to belong to the druids of [[Guthix]], but the [[dark wizards]] have cursed the rocks. They are in need of an adventurer to help purify the circle. He asks you to speak to [[Sanfew]], who is working on a purification ritual.

Sanfew can be found to the south, upstairs in the big octagonal [[Herblore shops|Herblore shop]] marked with a herb. Tell him that you were sent to help, and Sanfew will request [[raw rat meat]], [[raw bear meat]], [[raw beef]] and [[raw chicken]], to be dipped in the [[Cauldron of Thunder]] for the ritual.

===Acquiring the meat===
:''Skip this section if you already have the meat.''
[[File:Raw beef detail.png|left|70px|frameless]]
These meats can all be bought on the [[Grand Exchange]], or purchased at [[Rufus' Meat Emporium]] in [[Canifis]] after the completion of [[Priest in Peril]]. 

If obtaining the meat by killing the animals, [[Lands End]] in [[Great Kourend]] has a [[bear]], [[chicken]] and [[rat]] in close vicinity. ({{Map|type=maplink|x=1499|y=3449|mtype=pin|group=kourend}}) You can reach the area via [[Veos]] in [[Port Sarim]] after the completion of [[X Marks the Spot]]. [[Cow]]s can be found south-west of Veos inside the cow field in northern [[Hosidius]]. ({{Map|type=maplink|x=1767|y=3640|mtype=pin|group=kourend}})

Alternatively, there is the [[bear]] near the building just west of [[Ice Mountain]], the [[chicken]] and [[cow]] at the farm just south-east of [[Falador]], and the [[giant rat]] near the graveyard just north of the church below [[Port Sarim]].

===Enchanting the meat===
[[File:Cauldron of Thunder location.png|frame|left|[[Cauldron of Thunder]] location.]]
[[File:Druidic Ritual - Cauldron of Thunder.png|thumb|220px|Enchanting the meats.]]
{{Needed|[[Raw bear meat]], [[Raw rat meat]], [[Raw chicken]] and [[Raw beef]]|recommended=[[Food]] for low levels}}
The [[Cauldron of Thunder]] is located in [[Taverley Dungeon]]. Head south of [[Taverley]] and down the ladder. Head north, past the level 22 and level 25 [[skeleton]]s until you see a gate to the east, with two level 19 [[Suit of armour|suits of armour]] on either side. Try to open the gate and they will attack you (regardless of combat level). Either kill them, or simply continue to click on the gate until it opens. Enchant the meat by using each piece on the [[Cauldron of Thunder]] inside the room, and you will notice they will turn blue.

Once you have enchanted all four meats, return to [[Sanfew]], who will take them and thank the player for bringing the druids one step closer to reclaiming their stone circle. ==Walkthrough==
===Starting out===
[[File:Drezel chathead.png|left]]
Talk to [[Drezel]] in the basement of the [[Paterdomus Temple]] where you left him at the end of [[Priest in Peril]]. Drezel will give you three [[meat pie]]s and three [[apple pie]]s to take to [[Filliman Tarlock]].

Pass through the [[Holy Barrier]] by Drezel, then cross the nearby bridge. Travel south to the gate permitting access to the [[Mort Myre Swamp]].

===Traversing the swamp===
{{Needed|Ghostspeak amulet|recommended=Additional food for low levels (some may be rotted, see below)}}
{{Map|3441,3337|r=8|mtype=square|align=right|caption=Location of the Grotto Tree.}}
[[File:Nature Spirit - Nature Grotto.png|thumb|220px|The Grotto Tree.]]
While in the swamp the player will lose 3 health every 2 minutes to [[swamp decay]]. Additionally [[ghasts]] will attempt to rot your food, though they may often miss. Without any food in your inventory they will instead deal up to 3 [[typeless]] damage per attack. The [[druid pouch]] obtained later during the quest will protect you from ghasts by consuming charges per attack. Do not worry about the food given by Drezel being rotted as you won't actually end up giving Filliman the food. You may considering banking this food in [[Canifis]] before entering the swamp to avoid it rotting if you have more inexpensive food to use.

You must enter the [[Mort Myre Swamp]] through the gate, or Filliman will not appear. Head south along the west river until you see the grotto tree. Attempt to jump across the [[Bridge (Nature Grotto)|broken bridge]] to the grotto. There is a chance to fail this jump. '''Failing to jump across will cause the player to take between 1 and 7 damage and can be lethal.''' If the jump fails, the player will still swim to the grotto regardless.

Once on the island, the player will be safe from both swamp decay and ghasts. Attempt to enter the grotto via the small black hole with an "Enter" option, and the ghost of [[Filliman Tarlock]] will appear.

Equip your [[amulet of ghostspeak]] to speak to him. He won't believe that he's dead, so take the [[washing bowl]] off the nearby [[bench (Nature Grotto)|bench]] to find a [[mirror]] underneath. Use the mirror on Filliman to convince him. After this, he will tell you to find his [[Journal (Filliman Tarlock)|journal]]. Search the [[Grotto tree]] to get it and give it to him.

Ask him how you can help, and Filliman will mention that the journal details the requirements for him to complete his transformation into a Nature Spirit. He will give you a [[Druidic spell|spell scroll]].

===Blessings===
{{Needed|Druidic spell (given to you by Filliman), a [[Silver sickle]], and your ghost speak amulet|recommended=Additional food to prevent the mushroom from being rotted in this section}}
[[File:Nature Spirit - Drezel's blessing.gif|thumb|170px|[[Drezel]] blesses the player.]]

Return to [[Drezel]] and ask him to bless you. For the next step you will need to use [[Prayer]] points. If you need to recharge them, there is an [[altar]] on the [[Paterdomus Temple]]'s main floor.

Once blessed by Drezel, return to the swamp and look for any [[rotting log]]. Cast the [[druidic spell]] next to it to make a mushroom grow. The [[druidic spell]] will transform into [[a used spell]]; '''do not''' drop it as you will need it later. Pick up the mushroom and show it to [[Filliman]]. If a Ghast turns your mushroom rotten, go back to the grotto to ask for another [[Bloom]] scroll.

:'''Note:''' Multiple spells cards may be obtained from Filliman utilising the [[drop trick]]. This can be used to avoid the need to use prayer in the next section.

[[File:Nature Spirit - Performing the nature spirit ritual.gif|thumb|220px|[[Filliman]] performs the transformation ritual.]]

At Filliman's grotto, '''use''' (don't drop) the mushroom on the [[stone (Nature Spirit)#Brown|light-brown (western) stone]], and the used spell card on the [[stone (Nature Spirit)#Grey|grey stone]]. Summon Filliman again if needed by trying to enter his grotto, '''then, while standing on the [[stone (Nature Spirit)#Orange|orange stone]]''', tell Filliman you think that you have solved the puzzle. Filliman will complete half of his transformation and ask you to come inside the [[Nature Grotto|grotto]].

[[File:Nature spirit - Blessing sickle.gif|thumb|170px|[[Filliman]] blesses the player's silver sickle.]]

Go inside, and search the grotto in the middle of the cave. Filliman will turn into a Nature Spirit, then ask you to get a [[Silver sickle]]. Talk to him again and Filliman will bless the sickle, turning it into a [[Silver sickle (b)]]. After giving you a [[Druid pouch]], he will then ask you to kill three [[ghast]]s.

===Killing the ghasts===
{{Needed|A [[weapon]], [[Ghostspeak amulet]], [[druid pouch]], and [[prayer potions]] for players with low [[Prayer]]}}
[[File:Ghast dying.gif|thumb|120px|The [[ghast]] is freed after it is killed.]]

Go into the swamp with the blessed silver sickle, and operate it to cast [[Bloom]] while standing next to logs, bushes, and twigs. Each cast costs 1-6 [[Prayer points]] and allows you to harvest nearby [[Mort myre pear|pears]], [[Mort myre fungi|fungi]], and [[Mort myre stem|stems]].

Add at least three pears, fungi, or stems to your druid pouch by clicking "Fill" while three of them are in your inventory.

When you use the druid pouch on the level 30 ghasts, they'll become visible, and one charge will be deducted from your druid pouch. Kill three of them (you may use any weapon).

:'''Note:''' If you get a message when using the druid pouch saying "You've not been told how to use this item yet", ensure you've finished the dialogue with Filliman explaining how to use it.

Enter the grotto tree, then search the grotto and speak with the Nature Spirit to complete the quest.

:{{Color|red|Warning:}} Any items dropped before speaking with the Nature Spirit will be lost in the "old" grotto upon completion of the quest. 

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

:'''Tip:''' Before leaving, pray at the [[Altar of nature]] within the Grotto to complete an easy task for the [[Morytania Diary]].

Teleport nearby via [[Ardougne Cloak 1]], [[fairy rings]] code {{fairycode|DJP}}, or [[Fishing Trawler]] [[minigame teleport]] and walking north. He wants you to retrieve a [[child's blanket]] from some thieves found in a secret cave hidden under a ring of stones west of the monastery.
{{Clear|left}}
===Child's blanket===
{{Map|2561,3221|r=4|mtype=square|width=220|height=220|align=right|caption=The stone circle's location.}}
Head west immediately after exiting the [[Ardougne Monastery]]. East of the [[Battlefield|Gnome Battlefield]] and south-west of the [[Clock Tower (building)|Clock Tower]], there is a perfect circle of grey stones. When inside the ring, a ladder will appear.
[[File:Monk's Friend - Stone circle.png|thumb|200px|left|A ladder mysteriously appears.]]
Climb down the ladder into a large dungeon. Take the first path south into the room at the end, where you'll find the [[child's blanket]] on the table guarded by two level 14 [[Thief|thieves]] and a level 26 [[Head Thief]].

Bring the blanket back to [[Omad]]. He will be pleased because he can sleep now. '''Talk to Omad again''', who is now better and ready to organise a child's birthday party: he just needs [[Brother Cedric]] to return with the wine. '''Ask who he is, and then ask where to find him, or you will be unable to complete the following section.''' He will point the player towards the nearby forest.
{{Clear|left}}

[[File:Brother Cedric chathead.png|left]]
{{Map|name=Brother Cedric|x=2614|y=3259|r=3|mtype=square|width=220|height=220|align=right|caption=Brother Cedric's location.}}

You cannot use the well next to Cedric to fill up your jug, but you can use the [[bucket]] on the well, then the [[bucket of water]] on a [[jug]]. There is also a sink south of the monastery. Alternatively, you can kill [[imp]]s near Port Khazard for either a full or empty jug.

Give the jug of water to Cedric to sober him up. Now, he needs [[logs]] or a [[plank]] to repair his cart. Cut a log if needed and talk to Cedric again. '''Only''' regular logs work. If you do not have an axe, there are plank spawns in Port Khazard, south-west of the bank chest.  He can now repair his cart and wants you to go back to Brother Omad to tell him he is coming soon.

Go back to [[Brother Omad]], who will finally start the party.
