==Walkthrough==
===Starting off===
:'''Note:''' If boosting the [[Herblore]] requirement, you will need to boost twice; once before starting the quest, and once before making the [[troll truth potion]].

Speak to [[Sanfew]] on the top floor of the herb shop in [[Taverley]]. Select '''ask general questions''', then ask if he has any more work for you. He will task you to find the secret of the herb [[goutweed]], in order to perform the next part of the purifying ritual on the [[Druid's circle]]. Only the [[troll]]s in the [[Troll Stronghold (location)|Troll Stronghold]] know about goutweed, so Sanfew will suggest you speak to his friend, [[Eadgar]], who lives near there at the top of [[Trollheim]].

===Getting to the Troll Stronghold===
{{Needed|[[Food]], [[armour]] and [[climbing boots]]|recommended=An [[Ardougne teleport (tablet)|Ardougne teletab]], [[prayer potion]]s or [[super restore]]s, and one of a [[slayer Ring]], a [[dramen staff]], a [[Ghommal's hilt]], a [[combat bracelet]], or a [[games necklace]]}}

'''''Note:''''' Failing the obstacles, though uncommon, deals 1-5 damage, depending on your current HP.

Make your way to [[Trollheim]] using any of the routes below.

====God Wars Dungeon route====
The fastest and safest method to get to Trollheim is to teleport near the entrance of the [[God Wars Dungeon]] with one of [[Ghommal's hilt]]s, rewarded from completing [[Combat Achievements]]. The hilt's 'Trollheim' option will place the player near the [[Boulder (God Wars Dungeon)|boulder]]/[[little crack]], at which point they may run south to meet up with the thrower troll portion of the Burthorpe route.

====Burthorpe route====
[[File:Eadgar's Ruse - Quest map.png|thumb|240x240px|Shows the various ways to get to Mad Eadgar's Cave. The red line is the path to take if you do not have level 44 agility. Eadgar is located inside the cave entrance.]]
If using a [[games necklace]] or a [[combat bracelet]] teleport to [[Burthorpe Games Room]] or the [[Warriors' Guild]], respectively, and follow the mountain path out of the north-western corner of [[Burthorpe]]. Go south at the fork in the path to [[Tenzing]]'s house. If you don't already have [[climbing boots]], buy some here from Tenzing for 12 [[coins]]. Wear the climbing boots, and climb over the stile in his back yard, following the path north. At the next junction, climb over the rocks, follow the path, and go west at the next fork climbing over rocks as required. Head north to the Secret Entrance that will place you on the lower level of the [[Troll Stronghold (location)|Troll Stronghold]].

====Rellekka route====
''If using a [[Slayer ring]] or a [[Dramen staff]], you must have [[climbing boots]] already as you won't be able to reach [[Tenzing]] from this path.''

For the [[Slayer ring]] path, teleport to the [[Fremennik Slayer Dungeon]] or use the [[Fairy ring]] with (code {{Fairycode|ajr}}) to teleport outside the Dungeon entrance. Head north-east to a narrow passage and climb over some rocks ([[climbing boots]] required). Head north to the Secret Entrance that will place you on the lower level of the [[Troll Stronghold (location)|Troll Stronghold]].

===Cooking up a plan===
:'''Note:''' If you didn't rescue [[Eadgar]] during the [[Troll Stronghold]] quest, you will need to do so before the following steps, or he will not appear in the cave. You may check the quest log to see whether it says "I've rescued Godric and Mad Eadgar". To rescue him, head to the Stronghold's prison on the bottom level, and pickpocket [[Berry]] the sleeping guard to get the key to his cell. If you are unable to pickpocket him, you may have already freed Eadgar (he will still appear in the cell even after being freed). Unlock the gate to free him.

From the Secret Entrance, head north along the corridor, past the jail cells and sleeping guards and take the stone staircase in the north-east corner. Head south and you'll see four [[Troll Cook]]s here – one of them will be called [[Burntmeat]]. Speak to him, and he will offer to tell you about [[goutweed]] in exchange for a human to cook in his stew.

:'''Tip:''' Consider doing the first section of the [[Troll Romance]] quest while in the area (the three trolls are just to the north-west of the kitchen).

Take the stairs next to Burntmeat and you will be on the upper level of the Stronghold. From here, follow the corridor north until you see the exit on the wall to the east, exit the Stronghold and run south-east to reach the base of [[Trollheim]] on the west side.

At the summit of Trollheim, enter the unmarked cave entrance on the southern side. Speak to Eadgar and the player will inform him of your quest and Burntmeat's request for a human stew. Eadgar has a plan to trick him, but first he needs a parrot.

===The parrot===
{{Needed|[[Climbing boots]], [[vodka]], [[pineapple chunks]], 10 [[grain]], 2 [[logs]], a [[tinderbox]], 5 [[raw chicken]]s, a [[pestle and mortar]], Herblore [[boost]] (if not level 31), and a [[ranarr potion (unf)]]. 10 grain may be picked while obtaining robes from [[Tegid]]|recommended=A [[Slayer ring]] or a [[Dramen staff]] for the fastest access to the troll prison, a [[games necklace]], or a [[combat bracelet]] if not.
A Falador Teleport Tablet if you need to return to Taverley for the dirty clothes}}

Head to the [[Ardougne Zoo]], and talk to [[Parroty Pete]] near the northern [[wolf]] enclosure. Ask him when they added the parrot aviary, and then ask what they like to eat. He will tell you their favourite food is [[pineapple chunks]], and that someone recently replaced their drinking water with [[vodka]] as a prank.

'''Use''' (don't eat) your pineapple chunks on the vodka to make [[alco-chunks]], then use them on the aviary hatch on the west side of the parrot cage. You'll obtain a [[drunk parrot]], with the player telling Parroty Pete that you will take it to the vet.

'''Do not drop''' the parrot or it will fly away. Once you have visited Eadgar with the parrot, you will be able to retrieve it from him if lost.

While in Ardougne, it's also a good idea to pick up your logs, tinderbox, grain, raw chicken, pestle and mortar, and [[unfinished ranarr potion]] from the bank.

Take the parrot to Eadgar. You need to make it look like a human, taste like a human, smell like a human, and talk like a human. (You must do these steps in order; however, you may hand in the items after hiding the parrot.)

:Go back to Eadgar using your route of choice, to talk about the rest of his plan before proceeding to the next step.
:If you pick a Thistle now, you can dry it on a fire on the way back to Eadgar. Scroll down to the [[#Truth serum|truth serum section]] to learn how to acquire a troll thistle.

*'''Talk like a human''' - Go back to the [[Troll Stronghold (location)|Troll Stronghold]], and head north through the corridor, then climb down the stone staircase, and unlock the prison door (no key required), finally climb down the second stone staircase to arrive at the prison cells. Go a bit further west and hide your parrot under the rack just north of the cells. Alternatively, use the [[fairy rings]] (code {{Fairycode|ajr}}) or a [[slayer ring]] to teleport to the [[Fremennik Slayer Dungeon]] and follow the north-east passage to the climbable rocks, then open the secret door to the north and you will be directly south of the jail cells. Then, head north until you get to the stone staircase, and then, head west and hide the parrot under the rack north of the cells.
*:You will come back for the parrot later. Make sure that you check your Quest Log and talk to Eadgar before teleporting away.

*'''Look/Taste like a human''' - Teleport out of Trollheim and get your 10 grain, 2 logs, tinderbox, 5 raw chicken, pestle and mortar, and unfinished ranarr potion.
**Note for Ultimate Ironmen: You can make multiple trips with the items if you do not have the inventory space available to bring them in one trip.
*'''Smell like a human''' - Go to [[Taverley]]. You will see [[Tegid]] washing robes in the lake. Talk to him, and ask for a [[dirty robe]]. Then, threaten him with talking to [[Sanfew]] or chopping down trees to get one. After this, if needed, pick 10 [[grain]] just south of Tegid to bring to [[Eadgar]]. Take all items to Eadgar and he will make the human substitute for you. 
**Consider doing the middle sections of the [[Troll Romance]] quest now to save time running back and forth.

===Truth serum===
{{Needed|recommended=Combat gear and supplies for fighting [[Arrg]] if returning to complete the last part of [[Troll Romance]] quest simultaneously}}

'''Note:''' If you boosted your Herblore to start the quest, a level of 31 is needed to make the troll truth potion.  
[[File:Eadgar's Ruse - Troll thistle.png|thumb|220px|A thistle, hiding amongst the grass.]]
After you've done all of this, [[Eadgar]] will tell you that you need to make a [[troll truth potion]] so that [[Burntmeat]] won't lie to you about [[Goutweed]]. Look near the grass patches around Eadgar's hill until you find a tiny [[Thistle (Trollheim)|thistle]] growing in one of them and pick it for a [[Troll thistle]]. It may take you a while, but keep searching. If unable to find it, one may find it helpful to world hop and check the grass directly north or directly west of the cave. The Thistle's name is yellow when displayed at the top-left of the game window.

Once you've found the troll thistle, make a fire with your extra [[log]] and cook it to get a [[dried thistle]]. If you forgot to bring an extra log and/or tinderbox, there is a fire in the cave between the arena and Trollheim. Then, grind it with a [[pestle and mortar]] to make [[ground thistle]]. Finally, [[Greenman's ale|boost]] your Herblore level (if necessary) and add the ground thistle to your [[unfinished ranarr potion]] to make a [[troll potion]]. (If your character doesn't want to, check your quest journal to re-sync your progress).

Talk to Eadgar again. He will take the potion off of you and tell you that the parrot has had enough by now, so you can get it back from the troll jail. At this point it's recommended that you bank and grab some food for the next part of the quest. Go back to the prison cells in the [[Troll Stronghold (location)|Troll Stronghold]], either through the back door to the jail via [[Fairy rings]], code '''{{Fairycode|ajr}}''' or with the [[Slayer ring]] teleport (bring climbing boots). If you chose not to bank, head back to the stronghold then north through the corridor, then climb down the stone staircase, and unlock the prison door. Finally, climb down the second stone staircase to arrive at the prison cells, search the rack to retrieve the parrot, and then return to Eadgar.

After you give the parrot to [[Eadgar]], he will give you the [[Fake man]]. Go back to the cooks in the stronghold by going south of the entrance and then down the stairs, and give the dummy to [[Burntmeat]]. He'll give you a piece of [[burnt meat]] as a reward (which you can discard as it serves no purpose in the quest). He'll also tell you that the [[Goutweed]] is kept in the storeroom and that you can find the key by searching the Kitchen Drawers.
* Consider doing the first section of the [[Troll Romance]] quest if not already previously started. 

Open and then search the stone drawers in the south-eastern corner of the room to find the [[storeroom key]], then go down the stairs just to the north. Down the hallway is a room with patrolling [[Guard (Goutweed)|guards]]. If one of them sees you, it will throw a rock at you, dealing 0-6 damage, and you will be sent back to the entrance. Protection prayers do not block this damage.

The troll guards walk in cycles of 4, repeating. The easiest way to get a Goutweed is to click the crate with the Goutweed with run on as the two guards closest to the door are about to pass each other. Two of the 4 cycles should succeed using this method, and there is a 4 tile window where you can do this. If you get caught the cycle does not change like with [[Sorceress's Garden]] so you can keep trying. If done correctly this should result in a Goutweed every 2 runs. If you prefer you can just click the crate and try to brute force it, players may expect to obtain somewhere in the vicinity of one Goutweed per 5-10 runs using this method. Since you will be running a lot and being thrown out a lot, it is recommended to bring energy-restoring items.

If you wish to utilise the intended mechanics, the best way is to use the two most eastern guards as an indicator of when to move to the second safespot. To do this turn on your run and wait until one of the two guards rounds the northern corner of the boxes that they rotate around. As soon as this happens run to the second safespot. Note that the darker coloured troll patrolling the small section of boxes must also be avoided. Once in the second safespot simply run to the one of the safespots adjacent to the crate when the guard that comes north and closest to you turns west, and then click on the Goutweed crate.

The next way to do this is to use the safespots, which are dead ends surrounded by three crates. Time your movement and run to the first safespot, then wait for your chance to run to the second. You can use the position of the troll guards as an indication of when to move, as the placements of the guards will repeat after one or two cycles. Wait at the second safespot until you get the chance to run to the Goutweed crate and search it. Be careful not to simply click ''search Goutweed Crate'' as this will get you stuck on the sleeping troll instead of going up to the crate. Make sure you click on the spot adjacent to the crate, and ''then'' click search Goutweed crate. You'll be kicked out after you get one piece of Goutweed. Also, if you plan to do [[Dream Mentor]] or [[Dragon Slayer II]] at any point, it is recommended to get two extra Goutweed as it is a required item in those quests ('''Note:''' You can grab multiple Goutweed if you are quick enough to skip the dialogue and click on the crate).

Give the Goutweed to [[Sanfew]] back in Taverley by clicking on the "ask other question" option NOT the "talk about sanfew serum". This will complete the quest.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

==Walkthrough==
[[File:Elemental Workshop I - Odd looking wall.png|thumb|195x195px|The odd looking wall.]]
[[File:Elemental Workshop I - Fixing bellows.png|thumb|195x195px|A player fixes the bellows.]]
===Bound under lock and key===
Head to [[Seers' Village]] and into the house immediately south-west of the bank, indicated by the quest start icon. Search the [[bookcase (Elemental Workshop I)|bookcase]] on the east wall to receive a [[battered book]]. '''Read it''' to start the quest. 

The book details the discovery of a new ore in the [[Fifth Age]], and the workshop erected to work the new material. After the true power of the unique ore was realised, the workshop was closed and bound under lock and key. The book hints that the secret to entering the workshop lies within it.

After reading it, use a [[knife]] (one spawns in the house north of the church) or [[slash weapon]] on the book to get a [[battered key]], turning it into a [[slashed book]] in the process. '''Do not drop''' the slashed book.

Enter the northern building with the [[anvil]] icon, and use the key on the odd-looking wall with the strange crack. Climb down the stairs you find there to enter the [[Elemental Workshop (location)|workshop]].[[File:Elemental Workshop (location) map.png|thumb|left|200px|A map of the [[Elemental Workshop (location)|dungeon]].]]
[[File:Elemental Workshop I - Filling a stone bowl.png|thumb|195x195px|A player filling a stone bowl with lava.]]
[[File:Elemental Workshop I Location of Leather.png|alt=Located in the north-west section of crates.|thumb|195x195px|The crate containing leather.]]
[[File:Elemental Workshop I Location of Stone Bowl.png|alt=Located in the north eastern part of the central area.|thumb|195x195px|The crate containing a stone bowl.]]

===Restarting===
{{Needed|skills={{SCP|Crafting|20}} {{Boostable|yes}} to fix the [[bellows (Elemental Workshop)|bellows]], {{SCP|Mining|20}} {{Boostable|yes}} to mine an [[elemental rock]]}}
In the northern chamber is an inactive [[Water wheel (Elemental Workshop)|water wheel]], with two water controls to the west and east of it. Turn the east water control and then the west one to change them both to green (this must be done in order, turn the west one back if you turned it first). After this, pull the lever next to the water wheel. The water wheel should now be spinning.

Next you will need to repair the bellows, found in the eastern chamber. If you did not bring leather and a needle, they may be found in a [[Crate (Elemental Workshop I, leather)|crate]] in the north-western part of the central room, and a [[Crate (Elemental Workshop I, needle)|stacked crate]] in the western room respectively.

Fix the bellows with a spool of thread and leather ({{SCP|Crafting|20}}), then pull the lever next to it. The bellows should begin pumping air. 

Head into the western cavern and attempt to mine an elemental rock ({{SCP|Mining|20}}). The rock springs to life, yells, and attacks you. Kill the [[earth elemental]], and pick up the [[elemental ore]] that it drops. The elementals walking around do not count; it must be an elemental awoken by an attempt to mine them.

:'''Tip:''' Kill two more if you want to save time for [[Elemental Workshop II]], or three more if you also want a [[Mind shield]] after completing that quest.

:'''Tip:''' You may choose to kill one of each elemental in the workshop to complete an easy [[Easy Kandarin Diary|Kandarin Diary]] task. You must kill a regular earth elemental for this, not the ones that are mined first.

Finally, head back to the central chamber. Search the [[Boxes (Elemental Workshop)|boxes]] north-east of the hatch to obtain [[a stone bowl]]. Fill it with lava from the lava trough in the southern chamber, then use it on the [[furnace]] to the east in the same chamber. The inside of the furnace should now glow orange.

===A lost art===
{{Needed|skills={{SCP|Smithing|20}} {{Boostable|yes}} to smith [[elemental metal]] and [[elemental shield]]}}
Proceed to use the elemental ore, along with four [[coal]], on the furnace to obtain an [[elemental metal]] ({{SCP|Smithing|20}}). If this does not work, ensure that you used the elemental ore on the furnace rather than the coal, and that both the water wheel and bellows were successfully activated in the previous steps.

With the [[slashed book]] in your inventory, use the elemental metal on the workbench in the centre to make an [[elemental shield]] ({{SCP|Smithing|20}}). If you are unable to craft the shield, destroy the slashed book and obtain a new one from the bookcase.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

:'''Tip''': You may choose to create more shields after the quest, returning with the battered key, slashed book and 4 coal to smelt with the elemental ore. The shield may also be sold on the [[Grand Exchange]] for {{Coins|{{GEP|Elemental shield}}}} gold, costing {{Coins|{{GEP|Coal}}*4}} to create.

==Walkthrough==
{{Map|name=Edmond|2568,3334|r=4|mtype=square|width=220|height=220|align=right|caption=[[Edmond]]'s location.}}
===Infiltrating West Ardougne===
[[File:Edmond chathead.png|left|frameless]]
{{Needed|[[dwellberries]], 4 [[buckets of water]], a [[spade]], a [[rope]], a [[bucket of milk]], [[chocolate dust]], and [[snape grass]].}}
Talk to [[Edmond]] behind his house, next to the wall surrounding [[West Ardougne]] and north of the [[Ardougne Castle]]. He will mention that he has to find his daughter, Elena; ask him what happened to her, and he'll explain that she's a healer who crossed the wall into plague-stricken [[West Ardougne]] three weeks ago, but hasn't been heard from since. Agree to help him with his plan to get into West Ardougne, and he'll tell you to talk to his wife about protection against the plague.

His wife, [[Alrena]], is inside the house or wandering outside. She'll tell you she can make a [[gas mask]] if you get her some [[dwellberries]]. Give them to her and she'll give you a mask. ''After receiving the first mask, spare masks can be found in the cupboard.'' While in the house, pick up the [[picture]] of [[Elena]].

Talk to Edmond again, and he'll tell you his plan to dig under the wall and get into [[West Ardougne]]. First, you'll need to soften the ground: do this by using four [[buckets of water]] on the [[Dug hole|mud patch]] behind his house, between the [[Cabbage (scenery)|cabbages]] and [[Potato (scenery)|potatoes]]. You can refill buckets with the sink inside if needed.

Once the ground is soft, use the [[spade]] on the softened ground. You'll fall under, and Edmond will follow you down. In the sewer, walk south to find a [[pipe (Plague City)|pipe]] blocked by a [[grill (Plague City)|grill]]. After pulling on it to no avail, use a [[rope]] on the pipe, and talk to Edmond to pull the grill off. Put on your gas mask, and climb inside to enter West Ardougne.
{{Map|name=The Rehnison household|2531,3331|r=4|mtype=square|align=right|height=220|width=220|caption=The Rehnison House}}

===Finding Elena===
[[File:Jethick chathead.png|left|frameless]]
{{Needed|Elena's [[picture]].}}
Once inside [[West Ardougne]], talk to [[Jethick]], found just to the east (in the same plaza). Show him [[Elena]]'s picture and he'll tell you to go check the [[The Rehnison household|Rehnison house]], and give you a [[Book (Plague City)|book]] that he borrowed from them. Go north to the grey house sitting right up against the edge of the wall, as shown on the map to the right. They'll let you in when you mention you have the book. Once inside, talk to [[Martha Rehnison]] or [[Ted Rehnison]], then go upstairs and talk to their daughter, [[Milli Rehnison]], who'll tell you more about Elena's disappearance and whereabouts.

After talking to the family, leave the house and head south past the town square, to the house along the southern wall with a large black "X" on the doors. The house will have a stairwell in the middle going down, and is marked with a black box on the map. Attempt to open the doors and you'll be blocked by the [[mourner]]s, who won't let you in because it's been hit hard by the plague. Tell them that you're looking for a kidnapped girl (you need to select the option to ask again or you can't continue), and they'll tell you that you need permission from [[Bravek]] to enter the house.

{{Clear|left}}

===Getting inside===
[[File:Mourner chathead.png|left|frameless]]
[[File:Plague City - Bravek drinks the hangover cure.png|thumb|220px|right|Bravek drinks the cure.]]
{{Needed|[[Hangover cure]] or the ingredients to make it.}}
Go back to the town square and enter the large building on the north side of the [[manhole (West Ardougne)|manhole]]. Ask the [[clerk]] who is through the door, then tell him ''This is urgent though! Someone's been kidnapped!'', and he'll let you inside to see a badly-hungover [[Bravek]].

Talk to Bravek and he'll give you [[a scruffy note]] with a recipe for a [[hangover cure]]. To make it, put the [[chocolate dust]] into the [[bucket of milk]], then add [[snape grass]]'''. Be careful: do not left-click on the chocolate bar or the chocolatey milk, or you will eat/drink them!''' Once made, give the hangover cure to Bravek, and tell him that the mourners won't listen to you. He'll then give you a [[warrant]] granting permission to enter the plague house and search for [[Elena]].

Go to the plague house and try to enter again. The [[mourner]]s will try to stop you, but will be at a loss when given the warrant, giving you a chance to sneak inside. Once inside, search the [[barrel (Plague City)|barrel]] to the west of the staircase to find [[a small key]]. Then, go downstairs to find Elena, unlock the door with the key, and talk to her to release her.

Return to [[Edmond]]'s garden, either by teleporting out, or by climbing down the manhole in the middle of the city and climbing up the [[mud pile (Ardougne Sewers)|mud pile]]. Talk to Edmond to finish the quest.

To start this quest, head to either the dwarf [[Austri]] east of [[White Wolf Mountain]] or the dwarf [[Vestri]] west of the mountain, at the points shown on the map.

:'''Tip:''' The western quest start point is closer to the next part of the quest, so it is recommended if not planning to use fast travel.

Talk with either dwarf, and use the following dialogue options. {{Chat option|1I was wondering what was down those stairs?|2Why not?|3If you were my friend I wouldn't mind it.|1Well, let's be friends!|1And how am I meant to do that?}} Ask what is down the stairs, and he will say you can't use them. Ask why not, and he will ask you how you would like it if he took a shortcut through your home. Tell him if he was your friend you wouldn't mind, and he will say he doesn't know you. Ask to be friends; he wants you to earn his trust first. Ask how you are meant to do that, and he will mention that the dwarves are after a gold artefact, the first prize at the [[Hemenster]] fishing contest. He will give you a [[fishing pass]] to enter in the competition. You must win the competition before the dwarves will allow you to use the shortcut.

===Help from the champion===
{{Needed|A [[spade]]|recommended=armour and food for low level players}}
[[File:Fishing Contest - red vine.png|thumb|Checking the vine.|220px]]
[[File:Grandpa Jack chathead.png|left|frameless|80px]]
If you were to head to the contest, [[Grandpa Jack]] the previous champion would give you advice on how to win; you can skip this however, and gather the required items without needing to speak to him.

If you don't already have [[garlic]], pick up a piece off the table in the house south-west of the [[bank]] in [[Seers' Village]].

With your [[spade]], head to [[McGrubor's Wood]] west of [[Seers' Village]], also accessible by the [[Fairy ring]] {{Fairycode|als}} inside (using the ring will also complete a medium [[Kandarin Diary]] task). If entering from outside, the southern gate is locked and you must squeeze through the railing on the northern side. Beware of aggressive level 44 [[guard dog]]s.

Just west of the fairy ring, you will find a red vine. Check the red vine and collect at least 2 [[red vine worms]].

===Winning the trophy===
{{Needed|A [[fishing pass]], [[fishing rod]], [[garlic]], 5 [[coins]] (10 if no rod), and 1 [[red vine worm]]}}
[[File:Sinister Stranger chathead.png|left|frameless|80px]]
Head to [[Hemenster]], located by the Ranging Guild. If you didn't bring a fishing rod, buy one for 5 [[coins]] from [[Grandpa Jack]] in the house slightly north-east of the town.

Find [[Morris]] at the gate to [[Hemenster]] and show him your [[fishing pass]] and he will let you in.

Put the [[garlic]] into the third pipe from the gate on the south wall of the north [[Hemenster]] building.

Pay [[Bonzo]] the contest fee to start the contest (5 coins). The [[Sinister Stranger]] will complain about a horrible smell and you will change places with him.

[[File:Fishing Contest - Fishing the giant carp.png|thumb|220px|Fishing next to the pipes.]]
Fish at the spot by the pipes using the [[red vine worm]]s. You will catch a [[raw giant carp|giant carp]], a unique type of fish that you can't catch normally, and that will be the prize winning fish.

Speak to [[Bonzo]] again and hand over the [[raw giant carp|giant carp]]. You will be announced the winner of the Fishing Competition.

After winning the contest and obtaining your [[Fishing trophy|trophy]], head back to the quest starting point on either side of the mountain and give the dwarf your trophy.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

==Walkthrough==
===Starting out===
{{Needed|100 [[coins]].}}

[[File:Gertrude chathead.png|left]]
Speak to [[Gertrude]] at her house west of [[Varrock]], south of the [[Cooks' Guild]]. She has lost her cat, [[Fluffs]], and she wants you to look for her. Her two children were the last to see her. If you don't already have a [[seasoned sardine]],  pick up some [[doogle leaves]] to the south.

Head to the [[Varrock Square]] and talk to [[Wilough]] or [[Shilop]]. They will tell you about their secret playground, which is the last place they remember seeing Fluffs. Pay them {{NoCoins|100}} coins to tell you the location, which is the [[Lumber Yard]] found north-east of Varrock.
[[File:Gertrude's Cat - Fluffs.png|thumb|220px|Fluffs, located on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} in the Lumberyard.]]

===The secret playground (Lumber Yard)===
{{Needed|[[Bucket of milk]], and [[seasoned sardine]] '''OR''' [[raw sardine]] and [[doogle leaves]].|recommended=[[Lumberyard teleport]]. An [[axe]] to complete an [[easy Varrock Diary]] task.}}

At the [[Lumber Yard]], climb-over the broken fence on the southern side to enter, then climb up the ladder in the centre of the area. There you will find Gertrude's cat, [[Fluffs]]. Try to pick-up the cat and she will hiss at you, then use a [[bucket of milk]] on her and try to pick her up again. She will still hiss. Use the [[doogle leaves]] on the [[raw sardine]] to make a [[seasoned sardine]] and use it on her. Try to pick her up again and she will be afraid to leave; in the distance you can hear kittens mewing...

{{Map|x:3315,y:3515,title:Crate|x:3298,y:3514,title:Crate|x:3303,y:3506,title:Crate|x:3307,y:3507,title:Crate|x:3305,y:3500,title:Crate|x:3310,y:3499,title:Crate|mtype=pin|icon=greenPin|caption=Locations of all crates where kittens can potentially be found.|align=right

Go down the ladder and search through the nearby [[crate (Gertrude's Cat)|crates]] with the yellow "Mew!" above them. Despite the mews moving around, the location of the kitten remains the same, so keep searching different crates until you find [[Fluffs' kitten]]. '''Click on continue''' and the kitten appears in your inventory. Do '''not''' drop the kitten or it will run away and you will have to find it again.

:'''Note:''' If the kitten didn't appear in your inventory, log out and back in.

Go back up the ladder and use the kitten on Fluffs, and they will both return home.

:'''Tip''': Chop down a nearby [[dying tree]] and convert it to a plank at the [[sawmill operator]] to complete two [[easy Varrock Diary]] tasks.

Return to Gertrude to complete the quest. Wear a [[Ring of Charos(a)]] if you want to choose the colour of your kitten reward.

'''Goblin Diplomacy''' is the 15<sup>th</sup> [[quest]] released in ''RuneScape''. During the quest, the player resolves a long-standing dispute among the [[goblin]]s of [[Goblin Village]].

==Details==
{{Quest details
|description = There's a disturbance in the Goblin Village. Help the goblins solve their dispute so the world doesn't have to worry about rioting goblins. Aim: to help the goblins decide which colour they will wear.
|start = Talk to [[General Bentnoze]] or [[General Wartface]] in [[Goblin Village]].
|startmap = 2957,3512
|difficulty = Novice
|length = Very Short
|items = * 3 sets of [[Goblin mail]] (obtained during the quest)
* 1 [[Blue dye]] (or 2 [[woad leaves]] and 5 coins to obtain a blue dye from [[Aggie]])
** Offer 20 coins to [[Wyson the gardener]] and he will give you two woad leaves
* 1 [[Orange dye]] – created by combining [[red dye]] with [[yellow dye]]
** 1 [[Red dye]] (or 3 [[redberries]] and 5 coins to obtain a red dye from [[Aggie]])
** 1 [[Yellow dye]] (2 [[onion]]s and 5 coins to obtain a yellow dye from [[Aggie]])
|leagueRegion = <poem>
{{LeagueRegion|Asgarnia}} — location requirement
Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Fremennik}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest
</poem>
}}

==Walkthrough==
===Getting started===
Talk to [[General Bentnoze]] or [[General Wartface]] in [[Goblin Village]], in the Kingdom of [[Asgarnia]] (located north of [[Falador]], and east of [[Taverley]]). They will say that the [[goblin]] race is on the brink of civil war over armour colour, and they want their armour to be orange which is different to their normal colour.

===Gathering the required items===
'''''<u>Skip this subsection if you already have the items required.</u>'''''

Ask the generals where you can get orange armour. Eventually, one will answer that you can dye [[Goblin mail]] orange. [[Grubfoot]] will mention he stole yellow dye from a witch in [[Draynor Village]], and mentions you may be able to find it there. One of the generals will mention you can find goblin mail in three different [[Crate (Goblin Village)|crates]] around the village.
Grab the suits of goblin mail from the following crates:
*Behind the generals' hut.
*Inside the western hut in between the small square hut and the generals' hut.
*Up a ladder near the gate to the goblin village.
''Note: DO NOT dye 3 pieces of armour. You only want 1 blue and 1 orange. Leave one plain. If you mistakenly paint an armour you won't get new ones from the crates.''

Alternatively, goblin mail can be obtained as a drop from killing [[goblin]]s. The goblins in [[Goblin Village]] drop red or green goblin mails, which can be dyed, but you will need one uncoloured one from a standard goblin. You can go up the only ladder in the goblin village, up there will be some crates, search them to find a brown goblin mail.

[[Wyson]] the head gardener in [[Falador Park]] will sell you the needed [[woad leaves]]. Ask him if you can buy some. When you do, he'll ask how much you are willing to pay. Say, "<u>About 20 coins</u>," and he'll say you are generous and will give you two woad leaves. This is the cheapest option.

Two [[onion]]s can easily be picked from the field just north of [[Rimmington]], or from the backyard of [[Farmer Fred]]'s farm north of [[Lumbridge]]. One also spawns on the top floor of the [[Lumbridge]] [[general store]], on the table.

Three [[redberries]] can be purchased from [[Wydin's Food Store]] in [[Port Sarim]] for 3 coins each or picked west of [[Varrock]]'s [[South-east Varrock mine|south-east mine]].

===Making the dyes===
'''''<u>Skip this subsection if you already have [[Orange dye]] and [[Blue dye]].</u>'''''

You need to make orange dye and blue dye from the components you gathered in the previous section. Take the supplies to [[Aggie]] in [[Draynor Village]], and have her make one [[yellow dye|yellow]], one [[red dye|red]], and one blue dye. To make orange dye, use the yellow dye and red dye on each other in your inventory. Note: dying Yellow Goblin Mail with red dye makes Red Goblin Mail (and vice versa), so make sure you mix the dyes before using them!

===The generals' verdict===
[[File:Goblin Diplomacy - Grubfoot cutscene.png|thumb|Grubfoot trying the orange goblin mail.]]
Dye one [[Goblin mail]] orange, one blue, and leave the last one unaltered.

Go back to [[Goblin Village]], and give the orange goblin mail to the generals. They will have [[Grubfoot]] try it on, and say they do not like it. They will ask for blue armour. Give them the blue goblin mail. Again, they will have Grubfoot try it on, and again, it is rejected. They now want brown. Give them the plain brown goblin mail. Grubfoot tries it on for the last time. They decide that the original colour, brown, is best after all.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

==Walkthrough==
===Optional Diary Tasks===
{{Needed|[[pickaxe]], [[bracelet of clay]] or 4 [[clay]], [[bird snare]]|recommended=[[Digsite pendant]] or [[Digsite teleport]], a woodcutting axe for another diary task later|skills={{SCP|Thieving|25}} {{Boostable|yes}} to steal a phoenix feather, {{SCP|Hunter|5}} {{Boostable|yes}} to catch a golden warbler}}
This quest takes place in the vicinity of several diary tasks which may be optionally completed. This is recommended as several of the tasks may also save you time during the quest. You may choose to teleport to [[Eagles' Eyrie]] with the [[necklace of passage]], complete the tasks and then head south-east towards the Ruins of [[Uzer]] where the quest takes place.

{{Checklist|
*Steal a [[Phoenix feather]] from the [[Desert Phoenix]] ({{SCP|Thieving|25}}) for both a medium [[Desert Diary]] task and use in the quest itself.
*Mine 5 pieces of [[clay]] for an easy [[Desert Diary]] task (4 of which can be used in the quest itself but require a method such as mining it with a bracelet of clay to turn it into [[soft clay]]).
*Catch a [[Golden warbler|Golden Warbler]] with a [[Bird snare|Bird Snare]] ({{SCP|Hunter|5}}) for an easy [[Desert Diary]] task.
*Fill a [[Waterskin]] with water by cutting a Khardian cactus with a [[knife]] for an easy [[Desert Diary]] task.
}}

{{Map|3422,3162|r=5|mtype=square|align=right|width=220|height=220|caption=The clay mining spot. The desert phoenix can also be found nearby.}}

===Repairing the golem===
{{Needed|4 [[soft clay]] '''or''' a [[bracelet of clay]] and a [[pickaxe]]|recommended=[[Digsite pendant]] or [[Digsite teleport]], a woodcutting axe for a diary task|skills={{SCP|Woodcutting|35}} {{Boostable|yes}} if completing an optional diary task}}

Travel to the Ruins of [[Uzer]]. You can use a [[necklace of passage]] to the [[Eagles' Eyrie]] or [[fairy ring]] {{fairycode|dlq}}.

Talk to the broken clay golem to learn it is in need of repair. Use each piece of [[soft clay]] on it to slowly repair it. If you didn't already, you can mine [[clay]] at the north-western mine with a [[bracelet of clay]]. If you didn't bring a bracelet, there is a [[jug of water]] in the [[Oasis]] to the south of Uzer that may be used on the clay to make soft clay (world hop to respawn it).

Once fully repaired, the golem will explain that he was programmed to destroy a powerful demon, [[Thammaron]], and that he needs assistance to open a portal to defeat it. '''Ask him how to open the portal''',  and he will explain that four statuettes in the temple must be turned to the correct pattern, but he doesn't know it. 

Outside the temple ruins, near the golem, there is a [[Letter (The Golem)|letter]]. Take the letter and read it; it describes how an expedition here was discontinued after the opening of [[The Digsite]] near [[Varrock]].

Head east into the temple by climbing down the stairs behind the golem. Once inside, pick a [[black mushroom]] by the entrance, then pick up the [[strange implement]] in the north-western corner.

:'''Tip:''' Pick a second for [[Shadow of the Storm]], and keep the strange implement for the same quest. If you brought an axe, you may also choose to complete a medium [[Desert Diary]] task here by cutting the [[Teak tree]] ({{SCP|Woodcutting|35}}) behind the ruins, indicated on the minimap with a tree icon.

===The Digsite===
{{Needed|skills={{SCP|Thieving|25}} {{Boostable|yes}} to pickpocket Curator Haig}}
{{Map|name=Elissa|x=3374|y=3434|r=4|mtype=square|align=left|width=240|height=240|caption=The location of Elissa.}}
Head to the north-eastern corner of the [[Digsite]] to find [[Elissa]], the author of the letter. The fastest method of reaching her is a [[digsite pendant]] or [[gnome glider]].

Talk to her about the letter, and she will suggest you look in the [[Exam Centre]] for her late husband's notes, the man whom led the discontinued Uzer expedition.

Head to the [[Exam Centre]] and search the south-eastern most bookshelf to find [[Varmen's notes]]. '''Read them''' before progressing; Varmen describes in detail the discovery of the golems and the great city of [[Uzer]], and mentions taking a statuette from the ruins. Return to Elissa and ask where the statuette went, and she will point you towards the [[Varrock Museum]].

[[File:The Golem - stealing statuette.png|thumb|224px|The player steals the statuette.]]

Go to the [[Varrock Museum]] and ask [[Curator Haig Halen]] on the {{FloorNumber|uk=0}} about a missing statuette. Then, [[pickpocket]] him to get a [[display cabinet key]] ({{SCP|Thieving|25}}).

:'''Note:''' Ensure that you have read the notes and completed all prior dialogue if the dialogue options do not appear.

Unlock Display Case 30 upstairs to steal the [[statuette (The Golem)|statuette]]. It is on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} in the first row, the fourth case after you ascend the stairs.

:'''Note:''' If you lose the statuette, you can use the display cabinet key on the empty display cabinet to receive a new one.

{{Clear|left}}

===Returning to Uzer===
{{Needed|An empty [[vial]], [[pestle and mortar]], [[statuette (The Golem)|statuette]], black mushroom (obtainable in Uzer dungeon), Strange implement, [[papyrus]], [[Phoenix feather]] (obtainable near the clay mines north of [[Uzer]]), [[chisel]] and [[hammer]] (optional, for cutting [[gems]]).}}

[[File:The Golem - desert phoenix.png|thumb|left|210px|The Desert Phoenix, near the clay mine.]]
[[File:The Golem - the alcove.png|thumb|200px|The alcove in the centre where the statuette goes.]]
[[File:The Golem - Thammaron's remains.png|thumb|200px|The dead demon.]]
Ensure you have the required items and return to [[Uzer]]. Enter the dungeon near the golem, then use the statuette on the empty alcove on the wall in the centre. Turn all of the statuettes north to face towards the [[Door (Ruins of Uzer)|double doors]] to unlock the demon's lair. The east statues should face right and the west statues should face left when the player examines them. The statues will lock and the doors will automatically open. Go inside to discover that [[Thammaron]] had succumbed to his wounds long ago after the battle with the golems.

:'''Note:''' You may optionally use a chisel and hammer on the [[Throne (Thammaron's throne room)|throne]] to take 2 cut [[rubies]], 2 [[emeralds]], and 2 [[sapphires]]  for yourself.

Return to the golem to inform him of the demon's death. He does not believe the player - you will need to reprogram him to put his mind to rest.

With an empty vial in your inventory, use your pestle and mortar on the black mushroom to make [[black dye]]. Use the phoenix feather on your ink to make a [[phoenix quill pen]], then use it on your papyrus to write a [[Golem program]].

Use the strange implement on the golem followed by the golem program, and the golem will declare that his task is complete.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

==Walkthrough==
===King Arthur and the Holy Grail===
[[File:King Arthur chathead.png|left]]
Speak to [[King Arthur]] in [[Camelot]], who mentions he is sending out knights on an important quest. Ask him about it, and he will say they have recently learned the [[holy grail (item)|holy grail]] has passed into [[Gielinor]]. He wants you to speak to [[Merlin]] who may know more about where to find it. 

[[Merlin]] can be found on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} of [[Camelot Castle]], north-west of King Arthur up the staircase in the south-east room ('''not''' the south-east tower where you went up the ladder to rescue Merlin in the 'Merlin's Crystal' quest). Merlin will appear once you enter the south-east room. Merlin will suggest that the grail is likely to reside in a holy place like [[Entrana]], and that [[Sir Galahad]] previously quested for the grail and may know more.
{{Clear|left}}

===The old crone's warning===
{{Needed|recommended=Fast travel to Galahad, Draynor Manor, and then Brimhaven for future sections. You will need your combat equipment before the Brimhaven step.}}
[[File:Crone chathead.png|left|frameless]]
Before speaking to Galahad, you must first visit Entrana. Head to [[Port Sarim]] and travel with the [[Monks of Entrana]], depositing any [[weapons]] or [[armour]] via the nearby bank deposit box, as the monks will not allow them on the island.

Speak to the [[High Priest (Entrana)|high priest]] of the church, who says that the grail passed through the island but is no longer here. A [[Crone|strange old crone]] will appear and say that a [[Fisher King]] is in trouble. To help him you must find where the six [[Mysterious statue|stone heads]] around the world point to and blow a [[magic whistle]] there, in order to enter his realm.
{{Clear|left}}

===Galahad's holy table napkin===
[[File:Galahad chathead.png|left|frameless]]
{{Map|name=Galahad|x=2613|y=3477|r=4|mtype=square|caption=[[Galahad]]'s house west of [[McGrubor's Wood]]s and [[Camelot]].|width=220|height=220|align=right}}
Head to [[Galahad]], found in a house west of [[McGrubor's Wood]]. Tell him you're looking for an item from the [[Fisher Realm]], and he will reluctantly give you a [[holy table napkin]], a souvenir he took from the Fisher Realm.

'''Note:''' To complete a task in the easy [[Kandarin Diary]], ask him if he ever gets lonely, and he will give you a cup of tea.

With your napkin, head to the top floor of [[Draynor Manor]] and into the room south of [[Professor Oddenstein]]. You will see a pair of magic whistles on the table. Pick up '''both''', one will be taken from you later. [[Fairy rings|Fairy ring]] {{Fairycode|BJR}} will become accessible later in the quest - if you plan to use it, you will only need one, though taking multiple is still useful in case of mistakes. More than two can be obtained by dropping the whistles outside the room, entering it again, grabbing the two new whistles that spawn, and picking the dropped ones back up.

'''Note''': The whistles have a despawn timer, but will respawn upon re-entering the room.
{{Clear|left}}

===Passing into the Fisher Realm===
[[File:Magic whistle detail.png|left|60px]]
{{Needed|[[Excalibur]], [[magic whistle]], and combat equipment|recommended=[[food]], [[anti-poison]] if under level 41 [[Combat]], fast travel method to Camelot and Goblin Village for future sections, pickaxe for an easy Karamja Diary task ({{SCP|Mining|40}})|skills={{SCP|Attack|20}} {{Boostable|no}} to wield [[Excalibur]]}}{{Map|2742,3234|r=3|mtype=square|caption=The location to blow the magic whistle.|width=220|height=220|align=right}}
Head to [[Brimhaven]], ensuring you have your combat equipment with you. Go west of the town and then up the northern peninsula to the [[North Brimhaven mine|goldmine]], avoiding the [[poisonous]] [[scorpions]] if below [[Combat level]] 41. Look for a guard tower north of where the [[gold rocks]] are.

'''Note:''' To complete an easy [[Karamja Diary]] task, take the rope swing to the western island (with the Giants) and back.

'''Note:''' If you brought a pickaxe, you can complete an easy [[Karamja Diary]] task by mining a piece of gold here with {{SCP|Mining|40}}.

Go under the tower and blow one of the magic whistles, and you will be teleported to the [[Fisher King's Realm]].

===Black Knight Titan===
[[File:Black Knight Titan chathead.png|left|80px|frameless]]
[[File:Holy Grail - Fighting the Black Knight Titan.png|thumb|right|220px|Fighting the [[Black Knight Titan]].]]
The [[Black Knight Titan]] guards the bridge ahead, and you must defeat him before you may continue. You may deal damage to him with other weapons but the '''killing blow must be dealt with [[Excalibur]]''', otherwise he will heal to full health. Using [[melee]] to defeat him is '''highly recommended''', as he has +1000 defence against [[Magic]] and [[Ranged]].

As the Black Knight Titan will not move, it is extremely easy to defeat him through [[flinching]], by hitting him and moving back one square immediately. Unlike most monsters, the player does not have to wait for the Black Knight Titan's health bar to disappear before attacking him again; they can immediately walk back to attack him after moving back one square. If you do take damage, his max hit is up to 15, so beware. Using a [[halberd]] will allow you to defeat him with [[melee]] from range with no chance of taking damage. '''Remember to switch back to Excalibur''' at around 10% hitpoints remaining to avoid accidentally healing him to full. At low levels the knight may take 15 minutes or more to kill due to its 142 hitpoints and high melee defence.

After killing the titan, cross the bridge and then head south along the river until you find a [[Fisherman (Holy Grail)|fisherman]]. Ask him how to get inside the castle, and he will tell you to ring the bell.

Head to [[Fisher Realm#Grail Castle|the castle]] located south-west from the fisherman where you will find a [[grail bell]] on the ground in front of the entrance. Ring it and a [[Grail Maiden]] will invite you inside.

Go up the western staircase and speak to the [[Fisher King]]. Tell him you seek the grail, and he will reply that legend has it a questing knight will restore the Fisher Realm to its former glory and then claim the grail as their prize. Tell the Fisher King he doesn't look well, and he will tell you he fears his life is running short; he wants you to find his son [[Percival]], who is actually a Knight of the Round Table, and bring him to the castle.

{{Color|Red|Warning:}} Complete both dialogues before leaving, or you may have to return and kill the titan again!

Blow your whistle again to be teleported out, or teleport out through other means and return to Camelot.

===Finding Percival===
[[File:Holy Grail - Talking to Sir Percival.png|thumb|right|220px|Finding [[Sir Percival]].]]
{{Needed|Both [[magic whistle]]s, [[magic gold feather]]|recommended=Fast travel to the Fisher Realm and then Camelot, bring antipoison if not using fairy rings and under combat level 41}}
[[File:Sir Percival chathead.png|left|frameless]]
Speak to [[King Arthur]], who will recall [[Percival]] riding off on a quest to recover the golden boots of Arkaneeses a few months back. He will give you a [[magic gold feather]] which is said to point towards the location of the boots.

Blow on the feather, and it will guide you towards [[Goblin Village]], located north of [[Falador]]. Once at the Goblin Village, Open the [[Sacks (Holy Grail)|sacks]] in the east house (do not just prod), and you will find Sir Percival ('''you must have the feather in your inventory'''). Tell him that his father wishes to see him. Percival doesn't know how to get to the castle; if you have a magic whistle in your inventory, you will automatically give it to him when the conversation ends.

[[File:Holy Grail - Taking the Holy grail.png|thumb|left|220px|Take the [[Holy grail (item)|Holy grail]].]]

===Retrieving the Holy Grail===
Head back to the Fisher King's Realm like before (you don't need to fight the [[Black Knight Titan]] this time). You may now also teleport there using [[fairy ring]] {{Fairycode|BJR}}. Return to where the [[Fisher King]] previously was to find that Percival has become the new king.

Head back downstairs, go up the staircase on the east end of the castle, and continue up the ladder. Take the [[Holy grail (item)|holy grail]].

Return to King Arthur in Camelot and the player will inform him that the grail has been retrieved.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

*The player will keep asking The Knights of the Round and Sir Galahad about finding the grail even after they have it in their possession. Only Merlin seems to note that the player has discovered the grail.
*If using a [[chart]], [[watch]], and [[sextant]] to find the Fisher King's realm, you'll find that the stone heads face toward exactly 1'50"N, 9'24"E. However, the location of the Fisher King's realm is several steps north of this, at 2'18"N, 9'24"E.

He will take you underground to show you the roots of the tree, which appear to be dying. He will give you a [[translation book]] and a [[bark sample]] and ask you to take the sample to [[Hazelmere]], the last surviving gnome mage involved in creating the tree. [[Hazelmere]] is found on a small island east of [[Yanille]], upstairs in his house. There are [[jungle spider]]s (level 44) on the way, although they are not [[poison]]ous. Talk to [[Hazelmere]], who will take your [[bark sample]], and after examining it, give you a [[Hazelmere's scroll|message]] written in his language. Return to King Narnode in the [[Grand Tree]], who will ask what the translation is. The correct translation can be deciphered using the [[translation book]] and reads: {{quote|A man came to me with the King's seal.
I gave the man [[Daconia stone|Daconia rocks]].
And Daconia rocks will kill the tree!}} Give him the correct translation from the options offered, selecting none of the above for the first two choices. {{Chat option|1I think so.|5None of the above.|5None of the above.|2A man came to me with the King's seal.|1I gave the man Daconia rocks.|4And Daconia rocks will kill the tree!}} The king will exclaim that someone must have forged his seal to obtain the [[Daconia rock]]s, which were made as a "fail-safe" and are the only thing that can kill the tree. He will direct you to talk to [[Glough]], his head tree guardian. ===Charlie the prisoner=== {{Needed|1,000 [[coins]] (if you haven't helped [[Femi]])|recommended=Fast travel to Tree Gnome Stronghold}} {{Map|x=2477|y=3463|r=3|width=220|height=220|mtype=square|align=right|caption=Glough's house location.}} [[File:Glough chathead.png|left|frameless]] Glough is located in a treehouse south of the [[Grand Tree]], east of the ramp by the hot air balloon. After remarking that humans can't be trusted, he will tell you that he will take care of the problem. Return to [[King Narnode Shareen]], who informs you that [[Glough]] has caught and imprisoned a human found with the [[Daconia rock]]s. [[File:The Grand Tree - Talking to Charlie.png|thumb|left|220px|Talking to Charlie.]] Head to the top floor to speak with [[Charlie (prisoner)|Charlie]] the prisoner. He tells you that Glough paid him to retrieve the rocks from Hazelmere. He doesn't know what Glough is up to, but suggests you search Glough's house for evidence. Go to Glough's house and search the [[cupboard (The Grand Tree)|cupboard]] to find his [[Glough's journal|journal]], which describes how he plans to convince the tree gnomes that humans are naturally evil and must be destroyed. Confront Glough, who calls a guard over to lock you in the cell next to Charlie's. Talk to Charlie, who mentions he delivered a large amount of gold to the [[Shipyard (Karamja)|shipyard]] on [[Karamja]]. He suggests you give the foreman there a visit to covertly see if he knows what Glough is up to, and gives you the password to access it, which is '''Ka-Lu-Min'''. [[King Shareen|The king]] will appear and apologise for Glough imprisoning you. He will tell you that guards are watching the entrances, and tells you to quickly escape on the [[Gnome glider]] on the top floor of the [[Grand Tree]], next to the cells. Talk to the pilot. He will ask you where you want to go and you will ask him to fly you to [[Karamja]]. {{Clear|left}} ===Karamja investigation=== [[File:Foreman chathead.png|80px|left|frameless]] The glider will crash land just west of the [[Shipyard (Karamja)|Shipyard]]. Run east, avoiding the [[aggressive]] level 53 [[jogre]]s, and attempt to open the gate to the Shipyard. A [[shipyard worker]] will stop you; tell him Glough sent you, then give him the password '''Ka-Lu-Min'''. Once inside, find the level 23 [[foreman]] on the southern docks. You may either kill him or talk to him to receive a [[lumber order]]. If you choose to talk to him, tell him Glough sent you, then answer some personal questions about Glough. He will ask how his wife is, select "'''Sadly his wife is no longer with us'''". He will then ask what his favourite dish is, select "'''Worm holes'''". Finally, he will ask for his new girlfriend's name, which is "'''Anita'''". {{Chat option|3Sadly his wife is no longer with us!|2He loves worm holes.|1Anita.}} You need to return to the Grand Tree to show the king the lumber order which is evidence of Glough's invasion plans, but Glough has ordered the guards not to let you in. You can now teleport out of the shipyard and head to the Gnome Stronghold, or leave via the charter ship if you brought coins. If you have completed the [[Tree Gnome Village]] quest, you can sneak in by using a [[spirit tree]], such as the one at the [[Grand Exchange]] or the [[Battlefield]]. Alternatively, talk to [[Femi]] by the gate to the stronghold. Tell her you need to get inside, and she will sneak you in. She will help you for free if you never entered the stronghold through the gate before, or if you chose to help her move boxes the first time you entered. If you chose not to help her when you first entered, she will charge you 1,000 coins. ===Tuzo=== {{Needed|[[Lumber order]]|skills={{SCP|Agility|25}} {{Boostable|yes}} to climb the watchtower}} {{Map|x=2391|y=3511|r=3|width=220|height=220|align=left|caption=Anita's house on the map.|mtype=square}} [[File:The Grand Tree - Using the twigs.png|thumb|220px|Using the twigs on the pillars.]] After you show [[King Shareen|the king]] the [[Lumber order|note]] from the [[foreman]], he still will not believe your accusations, call you as paranoid as [[Glough]], and ask you to leave for your own safety. Speak to [[Charlie]] the prisoner again on the top floor of the [[Grand Tree]], who says he heard Glough mention a chest key that he left at his girlfriend [[Anita]]'s house. In the north-west corner of the stronghold, climb up the most north-western ladder by the tortoise pens to speak to [[Anita]] and she will give you [[Glough's key]] and ask you to return it to him. Go to Glough's house, and use the key to open the chest. Inside, you will find his [[invasion plans]] detailing his plan to seize control of [[Gielinor]]. '''Click continue''' to receive the plans. Ensure you have four free inventory spaces, then take the invasion plans to the king. He will still not believe you, stating that anyone could have made the plans. He will give you four bundles of [[twigs]], which was all his guards could find when searching Glough's house. Return to Glough's house, and climb up the watchtower. This tree is located on the east side of the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} by the chest and requires {{SCP|Agility|25}} to climb. Up in the watchtower, you will find a stone stand and four pillars. Use the twigs with the four pillars to spell out ''TUZO'', starting from the far left. Using the [[Translation book]], this translates to "open." After you have placed the twigs on the four pillars, you will hear gears turning, activating the trap door on this platform, '''but do not go in yet unless you are prepared for the fight.''' {{Clear|left}} ===Encountering the Black demon=== {{Needed|[[Combat]] [[equipment]] and [[food]] to last in a fight against a level 172 [[Black demon (The Grand Tree)|Black demon]]}} [[File:Black demon (The Grand Tree, 1) safespot.png|thumb|250px|right|Safespot 1: The recommended safespot located directly north of the entrance ladder.]] Climb down the trapdoor into the cave below, and [[Glough]] will appear, threatening you with his plans to wipe out humans. '''Complete the conversation''' without interacting with anything else, or you will have to re-enter and repeat it. A level 172 [[Black demon (The Grand Tree)|black demon]] will appear down the tunnel and immediately attack you. It can be fought with any combat style, but can be [[safespotted]] with [[Ranged]], [[Magic]] or a [[halberd]]. To safespot, immediately move one tile to the north and then east (adjacent to the ladder, see the picture). [[Magic]] is recommended, as the demon has a negative magic defence bonus. Use [[water spells]] if available to you as it has a 40% [[Elemental weakness|weakness]] to water spells. :'''Note:''' If the demon is not killed within 10 minutes, it will '''disappear''' and the battle needs to be '''restarted'''. To do so, walk through the tunnel and leave through the ladder next to [[King Narnode Shareen]], and re-enter Glough's trapdoor. :'''Note for 10HP pures:''' With [[Bind]], it is possible to kill the demon with a cannon with at least 120 cannonballs. When the scene begins, use Bind on the demon immediately and set up the cannon just 2-3 spaces west of the ladder you used to enter. If you die during setup the cannon will remain. You will know the cannon is in the right area if you can reload it from the ladder safespot. If the cannon aggros a rat during the fight without killing it, the cannon may stop firing, and you will need to take aggro from the demon by moving forward and back, or lure the rat away. ===The adamant king=== [[File:Daconia rock detail.png|left|70px]] After defeating the demon, Glough will flee into the tunnel behind him. Walk along the passage until you find [[King Shareen]] standing by a ladder. Talk to him and tell him that Glough sent a demon to attack you. Not believing you, he will finally send a guard to scout for Glough, finding him hiding amongst the stones. The king apologises, and asks you to locate the last [[Daconia rock]]. Ensure you have one free inventory space, then search the [[Root (The Grand Tree)|roots]] all around the area until you find the Daconia rock. It may be in any of the roots, so keep going until you have found the rock. '''Click continue''' once you find it or it won't appear in your inventory. If you somehow lose the rock, it'll spawn in the root where you first found it. Talk to King Shareen again for your reward for saving the Grand Tree. '''Ernest the Chicken''' is a [[free-to-play]] [[quest]] where players must discover what happened to the missing [[Ernest]], who went into [[Draynor Manor]] to ask for directions and never returned.

It was one of the first quests developed and the first quest released after RuneScape's initial launch.

==Walkthrough==
===Ernest the missing===
[[File:Veronica chathead.png|left]]
Talk to [[Veronica]] standing just outside the courtyard of the [[Draynor Manor]]. She wants you to find her fiancé, [[Ernest]], who had gone to the manor an hour ago for directions and has not come back yet.

Enter the manor and climb up the staircase in the centre room. Then climb up the spiral stairs immediately west to find [[Professor Oddenstein]]. He will explain that Ernest was turned into a chicken when he was helping on an experiment with his 'pouletmorph' machine. However, to change him back, the professor needs parts that were stolen and hidden by the poltergeists in the manor.

You need to help him find a [[pressure gauge]], a [[rubber tube]], and an [[oil can]] in any order.

===Pressure gauge===
[[File:Pressure gauge detail.png|left|80px]]
To get the pressure gauge, [[fish food]] and [[poison (item)|poison]] are required. Fish food is in a blue box, one is found on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} in the room directly south of the main staircase. Poison is in a green bottle, one is found on the {{FloorNumber|uk=0}} in the small north-western room south of the kitchen.

Use the poison on the fish food to create [[poisoned fish food]]. Go to the south-eastern room (of the {{FloorNumber|uk=0}}), '''grab the spade''' next to the door leading outside (respawn every 48s), if you do not already have one to get the rubber tube. Leave the manor by exiting the door in the south-eastern room, go to the south-western corner of the manor grounds to the fountain. '''Use''' the poisoned fish food on the fountain to kill the piranhas then search the fountain to get the pressure gauge.

===Rubber tube===
[[File:Ernest the Chicken - Rubber tube.png|thumb|220px|The rubber tube and the skeleton.]]
[[File:Rubber tube detail.png|left|80px]]
On the west side of the grounds look for a [[compost heap]], north of the [[belladonna]] [[special patch]] near a patch of [[cabbage (Draynor Manor)|cabbage]]s. Search the compost heap, requiring a [[spade]] and you will get a [[Key (Ernest the Chicken)|key]]. Go back into the manor through the front door then go through the door to the room behind the stairs containing the [[aggressive]] [[skeleton]] and take the [[rubber tube]]. The skeleton will attack you, so if you are a low level it is recommended to get the tube and leave as quickly as possible.
{{Clear|left}}
===Oil can===
[[File:Oil can detail.png|left|80px]]
Go to the western room on the {{FloorNumber|uk=0}}, search the [[Bookcase (Draynor Manor)|bookcase]] on the western side on the wall to gain access to a secret room. Go down the ladder into the basement where there will be doors and levers around you. It is '''not''' possible to use [[Telekinetic Grab]] to pick up the oil can.

'''Note:''' The levers can be reset by leaving the room and returning.

Follow the steps given below to obtain the oil can:
[[File:Ernest the Chicken - Oil can map.png|300px|right]]
{{Checklist|
*Pull levers B then A down.
*Enter door 1.
*Pull lever D down.
*Enter doors 2, then 3.
*Pull levers B, then A up.
*Enter doors 3, 4, and 5.
*Pull levers E, then F down.
*Enter doors 6 and 7.
*Pull lever C down.
*Enter doors 7 and 6.
*Pull lever E up.
*Enter doors 6, 8, and 3.
*Go through door 9 and grab the [[oil can]].
}}
===Transmogrification===
[[File:Chicken (Ernest).png|left|80px]]
Leave the basement and leave the secret room by pulling the lever on the eastern wall.

Finally, go back to the top floor and talk to [[Professor Oddenstein]]. Give him the items, he will fix his machine which turns [[Ernest]] back into a human.
:'''Note:''' You are still required to leave the manor through the back doors.

{{Clear}}
'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

'''Haunted Mine''' is a quest that explores the depths of a maze-like mine located south of [[Mort Myre swamp]] rumoured to contain powerful crystals infused with Saradomin's power. It is similar in terms of gameplay to [[Underground Pass]], relying mainly on the player's own aptitude for exploration and aiming to instil an eerie atmosphere throughout.

Whilst the quest is standalone, it does reveal some backstory related to [[Morytania]] and [[Lord Drakan]].

==Walkthrough==
===Preparation===
{{Map|3440,3232|mtype=square|r=6|align=right|caption=The [[Abandoned Mine]] is located south-west of [[Mort Myre Swamp]].}}
To begin the quest, players need to head to the [[Abandoned Mine]], which can be found in the south-westernmost part of [[Morytania]], south of the swamps and west of [[Mort'ton]] and [[Burgh de Rott]]. To reach the abandoned mine players will either have to have started [[Nature Spirit]] or have access to fast travel to Mort'ton or Barrows.

There is a [[low fence]] shortcut from [[Burgh de Rott]] which requires {{SCP|Agility|25}} and partial completion of [[In Aid of the Myreque]], which will save time not running through the swamp to the north of the mine.

{{Color|red|Warning}}: The boss fight is very difficult even for higher combat levels, as you will take a lot of damage regardless of armour. The only nearby bank is the [[Burgh de Rott]] bank unlocked through [[In Aid of the Myreque]], and returning to the boss fight room will require you to redo some steps of the quest, so it is recommended to bring all of your combat gear and supplies for the boss at the start of the quest. Read ahead to the [[Haunted Mine#Treus's wrath|boss fight]] section for tips.

'''Note''': If travelling through the swamp to reach the mine, don't forget your filled [[druid pouch]].

===The mysteries of Mort Ridge===
[[File:Zealot chathead.png|left]]
[[File:Haunted Mine - Zealot.png|thumb|The [[zealot]] tells you about the mine and its contents.]]
In the area between the mine and the swamp, a Saradominist [[zealot]] is walking around. Speak to him and he will demand to know your allegiance. Select any response other than Zamorak, and ask him what he is doing. He will explain that he is on a quest to reclaim the Haunted Mines in the name of Saradomin, and that the legendary [[Salve amulet]], since lost, was carved from the crystals that grow in the lower levels of the mine. The mines are haunted by the condemned soul of [[Treus Dayth]], a Zamorakian mage whose soul was bound by Zamorak to the mines to prevent those crystals from ever being reached again. The zealot hopes to reach these crystals to recreate the [[Salve amulet]].

Ask about other entrances into the mine, and the zealot will confirm that a second entrance may exist, and that he has come into possession of a key granting access to the lower levels of the mine. [[Pickpocket]] him to get [[Zealot's key|his key]] (drops on the floor with full inventory). Follow the cart track to the south (avoiding the the [[feral vampyre]]s) and climb over the mine cart blocking the way, then enter the cart tunnel.

'''Note''': If you don't have {{SCP|Agility|15}}, you cannot climb over the cart - instead, go to the west side of the mountain and enter the southern entrance.

===Into the depths===
{{main|Abandoned Mine}}

You find yourself in a dark cave with many bats, big and small, and many pickaxes and corpses strewn about. There are some hazards to be aware of throughout the mine:

* Some skeletons are dormant; the ones called [[corpse]]s in yellow letters will spring to life and become [[skeletal miner]]s when you approach
* Some pickaxes may become [[Possessed pickaxe|possessed]] and attack you when you attempt to pick them up
* Creepy [[haze]]s are spooky but generally harmless (although they can sometimes turn into aggressive [[ghost]]s when adjacent to them)
* [[Mine cart (Abandoned Mine)|Mine cart]]s moving of their own accord will damage you if you get in their way

Your task is to make your way to the depths of the caves and find the Salve crystal. Follow the cart track to the west and exit the cave on the western side (ignore the ladder). Once outside, enter the southern entrance (the same one used if you didn't climb over the cart).

Climb down the ladder at the end of the blocked path. Head east and climb down the next ladder.

Follow the path to the cart track running north to south. '''Wait until the moving cart has headed south''', then follow it and wait in the western alcove to the south. When the cart passes north, run south to the ladder and climb down.

===Getting a light===
[[File:Abandoned Mine - Level 4 map.png|thumb|left|A map of the fourth level.]]
