[[File:Glowing fungi.png|thumb|left|A cluster of fungi in a stagnant pool.]]

After climbing down the ladder '''(12)''', you will arrive next to a stagnant pool to the west with [[glowing fungus]] growing '''(X)'''. Pick one; this is to be your light source in the lowest level of the cave (no other light source will work). There is a lift to the east, but you cannot descend in it now - it leads to a flooded area which would extinguish any other light source. You will need to find a way to transport the fungi to the lift without carrying it, as it will crumble to [[ashes]] if taken outside.

{{Colour|red|Warning:}} '''Do not''' take the fungi outside of the cave and also '''do not drop it''', as both actions will cause it to crumble to [[ashes]]. Random events that teleport the player will also destroy the fungi.

====All aboard!====
Head north-west along the track until you reach a searchable mine cart. Place the fungus in the cart '''(T)'''. Head north and then west to the [[Points settings]] '''(P)''' panel, which operates the cart system.

'''Note''': In the alcove immediately south of the panel is an [[Iron pickaxe]]. If you didn't bring a pickaxe but you plan to do the hard [[Morytania Diary]] task during the quest, you can pick this one up without it becoming possessed. Beware of the [[skeletal miner]] corpse becoming reanimated however.


Open the panel, and it will show a map of all the cart tracks on this level as well as ten junctions that can each be in two positions. Pressing the start button sets the cart system in motion. The objective is to get the cart from the start position on the left to the ladder in the top right corner (north-west). 

The map also shows two groups of levers controlling the junctions. The cart will follow the ''crimson (lighter red)'' route at any junction when approaching from the tail direction of the corresponding arrow. Pulling the respective lever exchanges the crimson and burgundy arrows at the junction. The initial configuration will be different for each player, but the solution remains the same (see the image below).

The levers A through E are south-east of the control panel (location '''(Q)''' on the map above), whereas F through J are north, around the corner (location '''(R)'''). Beware of skeletal miners lying in ambush at both stations. The levers F, G and H are inaccessible, meaning those junctions are fixed.

When approaching a junction from the arrow head's direction, its orientation (i.e., colour) does not matter ''as long as it is a straight path''. In order to round a corner and not plunge into a wall or the water, the direction taken by the cart must be marked by a crimson arrow.

<gallery widths="300">
Haunted Mine - Levers A-E.png|Levers A-E.
Haunted Mine - Levers I-K.png|Levers F-K. (The blocked levers F, G & H are unmarked in this picture.)
Haunted Mine - Track map.png|The mine cart route solution.
</gallery>

Operate all the levers in accordance with the rules above and then check the control panel to make sure that the route on your map directs the mine cart to the ladder. Operate the mine cart by pressing the start button and the map will show the path of the mine cart.

Depending on the contents and route of the cart, four outcomes are possible. They are indicated both by the second half of the short cutscene, and a game message or player dialogue:
* {{mes|Oh dear, the mine cart seems to have sunk.}} - The cart sinks into the water. Any fungus in the cart will be destroyed.
* {{mes|How useful, it's come right back to where it started.}} - The cart returns to the start. Any fungus in the cart will still be in the cart.
* '''Player:''' I wonder if that cart is anywhere useful now? - The cart successfully makes it to the other side. The fungus will now be on the other side.
* ''(No message)'' - The cart successfully makes it to the other side. There was no fungus in the cart before sending it.

If the cart sinks, the [[glowing fungus]] is removed from the cart. In that case, pick another glowing fungus and put it in the cart '''(T)'''. Operate the appropriate levers to fix the problem and hit the red button again.

When the mine cart reaches the correct end point, you will remark that it may have ended up somewhere useful. If your character doesn't make a comment about the location of the cart, put another mushroom in and send the cart off again.

====Retrieving the fungus====
You will now have to reach the ladder yourself to retrieve the fungus. First, retrace your steps to the very top of the mine. Go back up the ladder '''(12)''' near the [[Glowing fungus|glowing fungi]] pool. Walk north along the track, avoiding the cart. Take the first path to the east and climb up the ladder at the end of the path. Go west and up the ladder, then exit the cave to the west. You should end up next to the [[River Salve]].

Enter the northern cave. Climb down the first ladder immediately to the east and head north-east through the cave. Climb down the northern ladder to the next level. Head to the north-west corner of the cave and climb down the ladder.

Search the nearby cart and take the glowing fungus that was put in earlier. If there is no fungus in the cart, you will need to repeat the previous process.

'''Note:''' If you die during the boss fight, you will need to get another glowing fungus and send it through the mine cart again, but you will not need to set the levers again as they will remain the same.

===Waterlogged===
{{Needed|Zealot's key, combat equipment and plenty of high-healing [[food]]|recommended=[[stamina potion]], 1-2 [[prayer potions]], one click teleport to escape if needed (e.g [[ectophial]])}}
[[File:Abandoned Mine flooded chamber.png|thumb|200px|Taking a swim from the lift.]]

Do '''not''' take the mine cart track leading south. Instead, climb back up with the fungus in your possession. Head all the way east past the ladder going up and then south past a moving cart. Climb down the ladder to end up in a side cave east of the flooded tracks. Head south down the corridor. Pick up the [[chisel]] from the spawn on top of a crate if you did not bring one. 

In this area there is a water-powered lift going further down but it is not operational. To use it, head around the large pipe and use the [[zealot's key]] on the valve to activate the water flow from the nearby basin. '''Run''' quickly back to the lift and head down, before a [[mischievous ghost]] can shut off the valve. If the ghost beats you, simply turn the valve again and retry.

'''Note''': If you die during the following boss fight, you will not need to use the valve again, and the key is no longer required for access.

[[File:Abandoned Mine - Level 5 map.png|thumb|Abandoned Mine Level 5]]

The lift will drop you into a pool of water, but the cave will be properly lit with the [[glowing fungus]]. From the flooded chamber, walk south onto the track (beware of possessed pickaxes) and '''follow the east track'''. Climb down the stairs ('''14''') and go west into a large chamber with [[loading crane]]s and [[Mine cart (Abandoned Mine)|mine cart]]s. This room is where the boss fight will take place. 

'''Do not take the [[Crystal-mine key|innocent-looking key]] until you are completely ready to begin!'''

'''Note''': If you want to return to the upper levels, simply return to the lift, click on it and you will automatically swim towards it.

===Treus's wrath===
:'''Note:''' ''Read this part fully before entering the fight if you're not experienced with the fight! Especially if you're low [[combat]]! This boss fight is difficult and should not be taken lightly. High-healing food is recommended. The surrounding environment is more dangerous than the actual [[Treus Dayth|boss]] itself.''
[[File:Haunted Mine - Crystal-mine key.png|thumb|220px|The crystal mine key appears suspiciously easy to take.]]
[[File:Treus Dayth chathead.png|left]]
To start the fight, try to pick up the [[Crystal-mine key|innocent-looking key]]. It will float away and return. Click the chatbox to continue the dialogue and the ghost of [[Treus Dayth]] (combat level 95), the erstwhile guardian of the Salve crystals, will appear and start to attack you.

During the fight Treus will use his ghostly powers to turn invisible, and move through obstacles about the room. He cannot be attacked while invisible, and you will need to chase him around the room until he reappears. His location is at any time indicated by a flashing yellow arrow on the minimap. As the fight progresses he will disappear at a faster rate.

There are four methods that Treus uses to damage you:
*''Mine Cart'' - When the player steps on a cart track, a mine cart will be sent tumbling after them. This can hit up to 9 typeless damage every [[game tick]], which can equal to '''36 damage every 2 seconds''' if the player is unlucky. This is the most dangerous attack. This attack can be easily avoided by running across the tracks instead as the cart will only move when the player is in its target range.
*''Crane'' - The possessed cranes will attack the player if the player moves to a square directly adjacent to it, dealing up to 10 typeless damage. This is the second most dangerous attack out of the three.
*''Pickaxes'' - If the player is not near any other obstacle, the player will be attacked by projectile pickaxes. These hit up to 15 damage each. The [[Protect from Missiles]] prayer only provides '''33%''' protection from this attack, reducing it to a max of 10. Pickaxes are the second least dangerous attack.
*''Melee'' - If the player is standing next to Treus Dayth, he may rarely use a melee attack that deals up to 8 damage. This is the least used attack and also the least dangerous.

====Strategy====
As [[Treus]] moves around the room, you will need to chase him across the tracks without staying on them, and while avoiding standing too close to the cranes. Treus will throw pickaxes at you, so you should pray [[Protect from Missiles]] while running around, using [[stamina potions]] to keep your run energy, and restoring your hitpoints with food while he is invisible. Note that you can also leave via the eastern door at any time and use that as a safe zone to regenerate your health, run energy and prayer if necessary - the boss will have the same amount of health when you re-enter. The boss will eventually reset back to a key if the fight lasts too long.

If Treus moves between the north-western and north-eastern side of the room, you may run back and forth along the northern-most cart track where you only have to dodge one cart. If he moves south, try to hug the cavern walls to avoid the cranes as you approach him.

[[Magic]] is the easiest choice against this boss due to its low [[Magic defence]]; it is also weak to [[Wind spells]] and [[Crumble Undead]]. If you have access to an [[Iban's staff]] (requiring 50 [[Attack]], [[Magic]], and completion of [[Underground Pass]]) it may be more effective, as it hits accurately (especially against this boss) and very high.  Note however that most of your attacks will take place in close to melee range, as the obstacles in the room will block you from attacking the boss at range. You can kill the boss with any [[combat style]] if you have a stronger option due to your combat stats or gear. If using magic, consider bringing along an additional set of defensive armour to switch to while running after the boss to reduce the damage of his [[Ranged]] attack. When he reappears you can switch back to your offensive Magic gear.

As you have limited opportunities to hit him, using a high hitting special attack like the [[dragon dagger]] as a secondary can be useful. Its [[special attack]] hits twice in one go, but this boss will only receive one of those hits before he moves away to a new spot and before you even get to him the second attack from the dagger will automatically hit him. If using melee as your primary attack style, bring the highest-hitting [[melee weapon]] you can use, such as a [[2h sword]] or [[halberd]].

Interestingly, Treus Dayth's attack speed while not teleporting is '''dramatically''' lowered to a 30-tick cycle if he is successfully [[poisoned]]. He is, however, immune to poison damage. You may consider using a [[trident of the swamp]] to apply venom.

'''Note''': It is '''not''' possible to freeze the ghost from moving using Magic or the Zamorak Godsword special attack.

'''Note''': If you die, items will appear inside a grave for 15 minutes. You will need to get another glowing fungus to return. The boss will respawn once you take the key again. If you fail to retrieve your grave in time your items will be at [[Death's Office]].

[[File:Haunted Mine - Fighting Treus Dayth.png|thumb|Fighting [[Treus Dayth]].]]

===Salvation at last===
{{Needed|skills={{SCP|Crafting|35}} {{Boostable|yes}} to obtain the salve shard from a crystal}}
[[File:Haunted Mine - Crystal mine.png|thumb|220px|The long sought-after Salve crystals.]]
After defeating [[Treus Dayth]], the machinery will stop attacking you. Pick up the innocent-looking key, which no longer resists and is, in fact, the [[crystal-mine key]]. Now, head back east through the door and climb up the stairs back to Level 5. Walk all the way west until you reach another staircase ('''15''') and head down.

The crystal-mine key opens the large door to a room with several [[crystal outcrop]]s in the south-east corner. Use a [[chisel]] to cut a piece from the crystal outcrop ({{SCP|Crafting|35}}). If you forgot your chisel, go back up the lift and pick up the chisel from on top of the crate. You will obtain a [[salve shard]] that can be crafted into a new amulet. Be sure to cut extras for backup!

'''Note''': Mining a mithril ore from the veins on the wall within this room will complete a task in the hard [[Morytania Diary]].

A nearby cart tunnel leads right back to the entrance of the mine and can henceforth be used as a shortcut.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

'''Hazeel Cult''' is a novice quest that was released on [[15 August]] [[2002]]. The quest introduces [[Hazeel]], a [[Zamorak]]ian [[Mahjarrat]] that has been put into a state of torpor, and his followers who want to revive him in time for the next [[Ritual of Rejuvenation]].

This quest is notable in that it has two sides, a "good" one and an "evil" one, sharing this trait with [[Temple of Ikov]]. In the "good" side, the player foils the cultists; in the "evil" side, the player joins the cult and assists them in resurrecting Hazeel.

==Walkthrough==
===Hazeel thieves===
[[File:Ceril Carnillean chathead.png|left|frameless]]
Head to the house in the south-western corner of [[East Ardougne]] and speak to [[Ceril Carnillean]], who will start ranting about thieving cultists. Ask him what's wrong, and he'll explain that some cultists have stolen a suit of armour. You will offer to help get the armour back, and Ceril will point you in the direction of a cave to the south of the city. Head east of the [[Clock Tower (building)|clock tower]], and enter the cave.
{{Clear|left}}

===Picking a side===
[[File:Clivet chathead.png|left|frameless|80px]]
At this stage you will have a choice between two sides in this quest: helping Ceril get his family armour back and foiling the plan to revive [[Hazeel]], or helping Hazeel's followers murder a Carnillean and resurrect their master.

The reward is almost the same for either side. Siding with Ceril rewards 5 additional [[coins]], and gives you the option to obtain [[Carnillean armour]], a weak armour with lower defensive bonuses than an [[iron platebody]]. This side is quicker, but requires killing [[Alomone]], which is not recommended for very low-level players.  Siding with Hazeel will reward the [[Hazeel's mark]], which is a purely cosmetic reward. 

Rewards may only be obtained during or upon completion of the quest, and can '''never''' be reclaimed afterward. Your choice will also have a minor effect on the events of the quest [[Secrets of the North]]. If siding with Ceril, read the following section; if siding with Hazeel, [[Hazeel Cult#Siding with Hazeel|click here to skip to the section below]].

===Siding with Ceril===
{{Map:Hazeel Cult}}
{{Needed|Weapon, armour and food}}
[[File:Butler Jones chathead.png|left|frameless]]
If you've chosen to side with Ceril, talk to [[Clivet]] in the cave to learn about [[Hazeel]], an ancient and powerful follower of Zamorak who was killed by an ancestor of Ceril. He will ask for your help in reviving Hazeel. '''Refuse'''.

Clivet will sail away on a raft, saying that you'll never be able to find him. Go back upstairs, find the [[sewer valve]]s, and turn them in the proper direction.
{{Clear|left}}
{{Checklist|
*'''Valve 1''' - North of the cave. Turn it <u>'''left'''</u>.
*'''Valve 2''' - West of Valve 1, southern end of the bridge by the Carnilleans' house. Turn it <u>'''right'''</u>.
*'''Valve 3''' - North-east of Valve 2, across the bridge. Turn it <u>'''right'''</u>.
*'''Valve 4''' - Other side of the river from Valve 3; cross the bridge again and head east towards the zoo's penguin cage. Turn it <u>'''right'''</u>.
*'''Valve 5''' - South-east of Valve 4, past the monk. Turn it <u>'''right'''</u>.
}}
After you've turned all five, go back into the cave. Board the raft, then head to the southernmost room and talk to [[Alomone]]. He will let it slip that Ceril's butler is part of the cult, before attacking you. Kill him, then open the chest in the room to get the [[Carnillean armour]].

'''Note''': You can use the [[drop trick]] if you want your own armour.

Board the raft again in order to return to the sewer entrance. Back at the Carnilleans' house, talk to [[Ceril Carnillean]], who will take the armour from you and give you 5 coins. After the player accuses the butler, he will refuse to believe you.

'''You'll see a quest reward screen, but you haven't received the real reward yet!'''

{{Listen|filename=Oh Dear!.ogg|align=right|title=[[Oh Dear!|Congratulations! Quest complete!]]|desc=Or not...}}
[[File:Hazeel Cult partial completion reward scroll.png|frame|centre|The first (fake) "reward". Continue the next step to claim your real reward.]]

Search the [[cupboard (Hazeel Cult)|cupboard]] on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} and you will find the Mark of Hazeel and a bottle of poison. Show these to Ceril. He will fire Butler Jones and give you the ''real'' quest reward.

===Siding with Hazeel===
{{Map:Hazeel Cult}}
[[File:Hazeel chathead.png|left|frameless]]
If you've chosen to side with [[Hazeel]], make sure you have a free inventory slot and then talk to [[Clivet]] to learn about [[Hazeel]]. He will explain that Hazeel is an ancient and powerful follower of Zamorak who was killed by an ancestor of Ceril. He will ask for your help in reviving Hazeel. '''Accept.'''

He wants you to prove your loyalty by killing Ceril. Ask him how, and he will give you some poison and instruct you to pour it in Ceril's food.

Head to the basement of Ceril's house, and use the bottle of poison on the range. Then, go upstairs and talk to Ceril Carnillean to learn that you've accidentally killed Scruffy the family dog instead; his son gave the meal to him.

Talk to Clivet again, and he will have heard about the accident, but takes it as proof of your loyalty regardless.  He'll give you [[Hazeel's mark]], then tell you to meet with their leader [[Alomone]] in their hideout. To get to the hideout, you need to find five [[Sewer valve]]s and turn them the proper direction.
{{Checklist|
*'''Valve 1''' - North of the cave. Turn it <u>'''left'''</u>.
*'''Valve 2''' - West of Valve 1, southern end of the bridge by the Carnilleans' house. Turn it <u>'''right'''</u>.
*'''Valve 3''' - North-east of Valve 2, across the bridge. Turn it <u>'''right'''</u>.
*'''Valve 4''' - Other side of the river from Valve 3; cross the bridge again and head east towards the zoo's penguin cage. Turn it <u>'''right'''</u>.
*'''Valve 5''' - South-east of Valve 4, past the monk. Turn it <u>'''right'''</u>.
}}
[[File:Hazeel Cult - Hazeel revived.gif|thumb|200px|Hazeel emerges from his coffin.]]

Go back to the cave and board the raft. Once you're in the main hideout, talk to [[Alomone]]. He wants you to help the Carnillean's butler, an undercover cultist, retrieve a [[Hazeel scroll| magical scroll of restoration]] that is hidden in the Carnilleans' house.

Talk to [[Butler Jones]] in the house, who believes the scroll is hidden where even the family won't find it. Search the [[crate (Hazeel Cult)|crate]] in the basement for a [[Chest key (Hazeel Cult)|chest key]] (make sure to finish the dialogue to get the key in your inventory). Go up the ladder, then up the stairs and knock on the wall in the east room, on the northern side, then finally go up the ladder. Use the key on the chest to get the scroll. Return to Alomone to start Hazeel's resurrection.{{Clear}}

==Walkthrough==
===The greatest heroes of the land===
[[File:Achietties chathead.png|left]]
[[File:Heroes' Quest start.png|thumb|Speaking to the heroine Achietties.]]
Talk to [[Achietties]] outside the [[Heroes' Guild]] just south of [[Burthorpe]] about joining the guild. If you meet the requirements, she will acknowledge your questing prowess and set you the entry tasks. She will tell you that in order to get in you need to give her three items: a [[fire feather]] from an [[Entrana firebird]], a cooked [[lava eel]], and a [[Thieves' armband|Master Thieves' Armband]].

For the armband, she suggests you probably have 'relevant contacts' yourself with whom to enquire about it. To obtain the feather she only offers the most helpful advice that Entranan firebirds tend to live on [[Entrana]]. To get the eel, she advises you to talk to someone who knows a lot about fishing.

The items may be obtained in any order, but must be given to Achietties simultaneously.

===Master Thieves' armband===
{{Map|2771,3194|mtype=rectangle|rectX=24|rectY=12|caption=The location of Scarface Pete's mansion in Brimhaven.|align=right|width=250|height=250}}
To earn the armband, you will have to contact your old gang associates from the [[Shield of Arrav]] quest, as indicated by the quest journal. For this part of the quest, you will need the help of a player of the opposite gang. Players that have completed the quest may go back and help others. For finding a quest partner, the [[Grouping]] interface is useful. You can also usually find a partner on the [[chat-channel]] 'Osrs Soa' during peak hours.

:'''Note:''' For this part of the quest you '''do not''' need to meet the skill requirements. This means you can complete this part of the quest in order to help a friend complete their entire quest; see [[Heroes' Quest#Trivia|Trivia]] for more details. You can even help a friend if you have already completed the quest yourself.
:'''Note:''' Traded Pete's candlesticks will not be accepted if the presenter did not kill Grip. As such, do not get scammed into buying or taking free candlesticks unless you are a Phoenix Gang member and can kill Grip. Black Arm gang members can never kill Grip so they should not accept traded candlesticks under any circumstances. Likewise, a [[miscellaneous key]] without a Black Arm member to lure Grip is useless. Do not get scammed into buying miscellaneous keys.

=== Black Arm Gang member ===
[[File:Katrine chathead.png|left]]
{{Needed|A [[black full helm]], a [[black platebody]] and [[black platelegs]]}}

Go to Varrock and talk to [[Katrine]] who is inside the [[Black Arm Gang Headquarters]], which is situated in the south-west of the city. She tells you that you need to do something amazing in order to attain the rank of master thief. She explains some of the most coveted items for thieves are in [[Brimhaven]]. The leader of the pirates there is one [[Scarface Pete]]. She will tell you that you have to steal his very valuable [[Pete's candlestick|candlesticks]] and that his security is very good.

You have to visit the Black Arm members in their hideout in the alleyway of Palm Street. The gang's password is "''four leafed{{sic}} clover".''

=====The Hideout on Palm Street=====
Go to Brimhaven and find the gang office, which is the building along the fence, east of the two inns and south of the [[Brimhaven Agility Arena|Agility Arena]]. Give [[Grubor]] the password "four leaved clover" at the door, and inside speak to [[Trobert]], the leader of the Black Arms in Brimhaven. Trobert explains one of the only keys to Pete's treasure room is carried by his head guard [[Grip]], who was taking on a new deputy called [[Hartigen]], a deserter of the [[Kinshra|Black Knights]] seeking employment in Brimhaven. The Black Arms have waylaid Hartigen and stolen his identification papers. Volunteer to impersonate Hartigen. He will give you the [[Id papers]], which you will need to get into Scarface Pete's mansion, and tell you to introduce yourself to its guards.

Speak to [[Garv]], who is the guard patrolling along the southern wall of the large building on Brimhaven's western side. He will not believe you are Hartigen, stating that the Black Knight dressed differently. Equip a full set of [[black armour]]: full helm, platebody and platelegs. Garv will then allow you to go inside tells you to speak to Grip.

=====Getting a Grip on the key=====
[[File:Talking to Grip.png|thumb|250x250px|Grip explaining your duties.]]
Once inside, talk to [[Grip]]. He explains you will be working various guard duties, and that the important keys are in Grip's jacket. Ask him "So what do my duties involve?" and then "Anything I can do now?" and he will give you a [[Miscellaneous key]].

:'''Note:''' If you have already done the quest and have the Miscellaneous key in your bank, he will not give you a new one.

Grip won't allow you to enter the treasure room and you can't kill him without drawing attention to yourself. This means you will need an accomplice. Leave the building and trade the key to your [[Phoenix Gang]] partner.

=====Handling the candlesticks=====
[[File:Heroes'_Quest_-_Attacking_Grip.png|thumb|250x250px|A player attacking [[Grip]].]]
Back inside, head into the north-eastern room from the entrance. Wait for your partner to get to the room behind the eastern wall, behind the arrowslit; then, search the [[cupboard (Heroes' Quest)|cupboard]]. A [[pirate guard]] will say that Grip really doesn't like his drinks cabinet being touched, but open it anyway. Grip will then come into the room, telling you to get your hands off his drinks. Make sure the door is open. Grip can become stuck on the guards in the room, so you may need to wait or kill some guards to create space or else Grip may be blocked and leave the room. If this happens, just search the cupboard again. It's common for Grip to not come in the room all the way or retreat after being hit, so closing the door after he enters helps.

Your Phoenix Gang partner will then kill Grip through the slit from the hidden room. Once he dies, pick up [[Grip's keyring]]. 

Using the key, go to the treasure room (the {{FloorNumber|uk=0}} room with coins on the floor next to the staircase in the north-west corner) and open the north chest in the first room to receive two candlesticks. '''Give one candlestick to your Phoenix Gang partner.'''

Go back to Varrock and talk to Katrine. She will give you the [[Thieves' armband]].

:'''Note:''' The door to the treasure room will not open and give you a message if you attempt to open it with Grip's keyring without having obtained a miscellaneous key at least once.
:'''Note:''' The chest containing Pete's candlesticks (position to the north) will be empty if you have a candlestick in your inventory or bank. If you have a traded one in the bank, you will need to discard it then come back to search this chest as you will not be able to turn in a traded candlestick to Katrine at any time.
:'''Note:''' Be sure to pick up the candlesticks yourself; otherwise, Katrine will say you weren't the one to retrieve the candlestick and you will have to go back to do it all over again.
:'''Note:''' Grip's Keyring is unique to the player you are doing the quest with. If you complete the quest and are retrieving candlesticks for a different player and still have Grip's Keyring, drop it and ask him for a new one.

=== Phoenix Gang member ===
{{Needed|A [[Ranged weapons|ranged weapon]] and [[ammo]] ([[brutal arrows]] will not work) or [[runes]] for [[Magic]]}}
[[File:Straven chathead.png|left]]
Go to [[Varrock]] and speak to [[Straven]] at the hideout. Enquire about becoming a master thief. He will explain that some eager gang members are trying to steal the valuable candlesticks of [[Scarface Pete]], the pirate leader of [[Brimhaven]]. He gives you the password ''gherkin'' to tell [[Alfonse the waiter|Alfonse]], a gang member posing as a waiter in [[The Shrimp and Parrot]] inn.

Get a [[bow]] and [[arrows]], or magic gear if using magic, before heading to [[Brimhaven]].

=====The side entrance=====
Go to the Shrimp and Parrot restaurant in Brimhaven. Once you are there, talk to Alfonse the waiter and ask about gherkins. He will wink and redirect you to [[Charlie the cook]] in the back room. Give him the password as well and tell him you are after Pete's candlesticks. Charlie the cook will tell you that the restaurant was set up as part of the heist. There is a secret wall-door that opens into [[Mr. Olbors]]'s garden that you are able to push to open. Across the garden is an old side entrance into the mansion that has since been blocked. However, the Phoenixes are unable to get hold of the key to that door. The pushable wall is in the kitchen, in the same room as where Charlie is. Beware of Mr. Olbors's [[guard dog]]s.

'''Get a [[miscellaneous key]] from your [[Black Arm Gang]] partner.''' Head into Olbors's garden and enter the mansion's eastern door. Once inside, use the miscellaneous key on the northern door. This brings you in a cramped room with an arrowslit into a room with a cupboard. Shoot through the hole in the wall at [[Grip]] and kill him with [[Ranged]] or [[Magic]]. Your partner will have to lure him inside the room by rummaging through his drinks cabinet. It's common for Grip to not come in the room all the way or retreat out of the room after being hit. Have your Black Arm Gang partner close the door once he enters.  Grip will drop the key for your Black Arm Gang partner.

'''Your Black Arm Gang partner will get two [[Pete's candlestick|candlesticks]] and should trade you one of them.'''

:'''Note:''' You must actually kill Grip! If you don't, Straven will ''NOT'' accept your candlestick. Don't buy it or the key off other players as shortcut; you can't kill Grip alone.

Go back to Varrock and give the candlestick to Straven to get the [[Thieves' armband]].

===Entrana firebird feather===
{{Needed|[[Ice gloves]], or a [[pickaxe]] and combat equipment if you do not already own a pair|recommended=[[Energy potion|Energy]]/[[stamina potion]]s if obtaining [[ice gloves]]|skills={{SCP|Mining|50}} {{Boostable|yes}} if obtaining [[ice gloves]]}}

If you want, speak to a [[monk]] in the Entranan church about the firebird. He does not think they exist but redirects you to the head monk, who is more knowledgeable. The [[High Priest (Entrana)|High Priest]] tells you that the bird lives somewhere on Entrana, and that you will need some cold gloves to pick up its feather.

The [[firebird]] lives on the northern half of [[Entrana]]. It is very weak and easy to kill. However, its [[fire feather]] is too hot to pick up; you require something cold in order to do so. In order to pick up the [[fire feather]], you'll need [[ice gloves]]. They are dropped by the level 111 [[Ice Queen]] located underneath [[White Wolf Mountain]]. If you do not own ice gloves, see the section below.

Once you have a pair of ice gloves, bank your weapons and armour, but keep the gloves. Head to [[Entrana]] and kill the firebird near the [[Law Altar]]. Make sure to have the ice gloves equipped before picking up the feather.

You can also grab a fishing rod from the house beside the fishing platform on the south east corner of the island if you need a spare to use for making the oily fishing rod. 

====Ice Spy with my Little Eye====
[[File:Heroes'_Quest_-_Rockslide.png|thumb|250x250px|Compass pointing north; location of the rockslide to get into the lair.]]

If you do not already own [[Ice gloves]], go to White Wolf Mountain (east of [[Catherby]], west of [[Taverley]]), to the [[rock slide]] on the north side. It can be found just north-west of the [[gnome glider]]. Otherwise, enter the mountain at the southern entrance and walk or run north until you come to the rock slide.

Use a [[pickaxe]] on the rock slide ({{SCP|Mining|50}}) and go through it . Once you are through, you will be near level 57 [[ice warrior]]s and three ladders.

[[File:Heroes'_Quest_-_Ice_Queen's_Lair_route.png|thumb|220x220px|left|A map of the [[Ice Queen's Lair]].]]

At the end of the room resides the [[Ice Queen]], kill her and she will drop the ice gloves. If you stand behind the throne, you can avoid the ice warriors and can still attack the Ice Queen if positioned right. Once you have the gloves, exit using the same route back or teleport out.

===Cooked lava eel===
{{Needed|A [[fishing rod]], [[fishing bait]], [[harralander potion (unf)]] (or a [[harralander]] and [[vial of water]]), other items depending on chosen location (see below)|skills={{SCP|Herblore|25}} {{Boostable|yes}} to make [[blamish oil]], {{SCP|Fishing|53}} {{Boostable|yes}} to catch a [[raw lava eel]], and {{SCP|Cooking|53}} {{Boostable|yes}} to cook it}}
[[File:Heroes' Quest Gerrant.png|thumb|250px|Speaking to the fishing expert about catching a lava eel.]]
Go to [[Port Sarim]] and talk to [[Gerrant]] at the [[fishing shop]]. He will tell you that catching a lava eel requires a lava-proof fishing line, which can be created by coating an ordinary [[fishing rod]] with [[blamish oil]]. Gerrant will give you a free bottle of [[blamish snail slime]], which is added to a [[harralander potion (unf)]] to make the blamish oil. Buy a fishing rod and some bait from him if you haven't got any yet.

After making the blamish oil, right-click on it to use it on a normal [[fishing rod]] to get an [[oily fishing rod]].

There are '''four possible locations''' where you can catch [[Raw lava eel|lava eels]]:
* [[Taverley Dungeon]] is a safe option, but requires the player to to take a long and winding path if they do not have at least level 70 [[Agility]] to use the shortcut.
* The [[Lava Maze]] (level 40-45 [[Wilderness]]) may alternatively be chosen as catching a lava eel there is a hard [[Wilderness Diary]] task. As with all Wilderness activities, there is a risk of being killed by other players.
* The [[Charred Dungeon]] requires level 60 [[Sailing]] to access. The route is shorter and more straightforward than Taverley Dungeon, but players will need to spend time sailing there.
* The [[Wyrmscraig Cavern]] requires level 62 Sailing and the completion of [[Fallen From Grace]] to access. A [[slayer ring]] will take the player directly to the caverns, and may be the fastest option for players that have already completed the quest.

====Taverley Dungeon====
{{Needed|[[Dusty key]] (can be obtained in the dungeon) or {{SCP|Agility|70}}|recommended=[[Dragonfire]] protection such as an [[anti-dragon shield]], [[stamina potion|stamina]] or [[energy potion]]s, [[food]] or prayer points for [[Protect from Melee]] if low-levelled}}
[[File:Heroes'_Quest_-_Taverley_Dungeon_route.png|thumb|250px|Routes to the lava eels and dusty key.]]
Make your way to [[Taverley]] and enter the dungeon to the south of the town. Some options include the [[balloon transport system]], [[Falador Teleport]] and going west over the {{SCP|Agility|5}} [[shortcut]], or using [[Teleport to House]] if it is in Taverley.

'''If you have 70 Agility''' (which can be boosted), enter the pipe after putting on your dragonfire protection and run south. The [[fishing spot]] is near some [[baby blue dragon]]s, which generally do not attack you from the position.

'''If you don't have 70 Agility''', follow the magenta path on the image to the right. Walk through the dungeon and use the [[dusty key]] on the door between the [[lesser demon]]s and [[blue dragon]]s. If you have 63 Agility, you can save a bit of time by squeezing through loose railings to go straight to the lesser demon area.

If you don't have the dusty key, go past the bridge, continue south-west past the [[hill giant]]s, and you will enter the [[Black Knights' Base]]. Go to the east into a jail, kill the [[jailer]] and then pick up his key. Use it on the jail cell holding [[Velrak the explorer]]. Ask him if there are any good places to explore to get the dusty key. Head back north past the hill giants and follow the magenta path to the fishing spot. Use the key on the door between the lesser demons and blue dragons. The fishing spot is near some baby blue dragons; from here, catch a lava eel.

====Islands====
{{Needed|A [[boat]]|skills={{SCP|Sailing|60}} {{Boostable|no}} or {{SCP|Sailing|62}} {{Boostable|no}}|recommended=[[Dragonfire]] protection such as an [[anti-dragon shield]], [[stamina potion|stamina]] or [[energy potion]]s, [[food]] or prayer points for [[Protect from Melee]] if low-levelled}}
There are two [[Sailing]] islands that have [[fishing spot (lava eel)|lava eel fishing spots]]. Going to these locations may be ideal for those who don't have 70 [[Agility]] and don't want to spend time getting the dusty key, or don't want to risk entering the Wilderness. 

[[Charred Island]], which requires a Sailing level of 60, has a fishing spot in the [[Charred Dungeon]]. There is no teleport to this island, so you must sail there. To reach the fishing spot, you must run past dragons, nechryael, and lava strykewyrms, so bringing [[dragonfire]] protection and some food is recommended.

[[Wyrmscraig]], which requires a Sailing level of 62, has a fishing spot in the [[Wyrmscraig Cavern]]. After completing the quest [[Fallen From Grace]], you can quickly teleport to the cavern by using a [[slayer ring]], or to the island itself with a [[necklace of passage]]. Reaching the fishing spot only requires briefly running past some unaggressive [[wyrm]]s, making it safer than navigating the Charred Dungeon.

====Lava Maze====
{{Needed|A [[knife]] or a [[slash weapon]] (all tiers of [[Wilderness sword]] will always succeed)|recommended=Burning amulet}}
{{Map|name=Lava Maze|3070,3853|zoom=1|align=right|height=180|width=280|caption=A map of the Lava Maze.}}

'''{{Colour|Red|Warning}}:''' The [[Lava Maze]] is located in level 40-45 [[Wilderness]], meaning that many [[player killer]]s will be within the level range to attack you. Do not bring any items you are not willing to lose.

There are several methods to get to the Lava Maze:
*Teleporting there directly using the [[burning amulet]]. This is the quickest way.
*Casting the [[Ghorrock Teleport]] spell (or [[Ghorrock teleport|tablet]]) in the [[Ancient Magicks]] spellbook. This requires completing the quest [[Desert Treasure I]].
*Take the [[Wilderness Obelisk]]s to the destination at level 35 or level 44 Wilderness. This may take several attempts. The obelisks can be quickly accessed by taking the [[Minigame Teleport]] to [[Ferox Enclave]].
** Beware of the [[Chaos Fanatic]] if arriving from the Ghorrock Teleport of level 44 Wilderness Obelisk.
*Take a waka canoe from [[Edgeville]] or any other [[Canoe Station#River Lum|River Lum Canoe Station]] to the [[Wilderness Pond]]. This requires 57 [[Woodcutting]]. Then walk west to arrive near the entrance.

Upon arriving at the entrance, use your knife or slash weapon to cut the web and proceed through the maze until you see the fishing icon on your minimap. The fishing spot is relatively near the entrance.

If you die with your oily fishing rod, you will probably lose it and have to make a new one. If Gerrant does not give you another bottle of [[blamish snail slime]]<!--requires testing-->, you can also get it by killing a [[Myre blamish snail]] and grinding its meat with a [[pestle and mortar]] with an empty [[sample bottle]] in your inventory. The sample bottle can be obtained from [[Fidelio]] in the [[Canifis General Store]].

[[File:Catching a lava eel.png|thumb|220px|Fishing in the lava.]]

Once you catch a [[raw lava eel]] ({{SCP|Fishing|53}}), cook it over a [[fire]] or a [[range]] ({{SCP|Cooking|53}}).

:'''Note:''' Lava eels do not burn when cooked (or, indeed, when swimming in lava). Do not worry about obtaining multiple eels if you are worried about burning one.

===Quest end===
Go back to the [[Heroes' Guild]], talk to [[Achietties]] outside and give her the three collected items.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

==Trivia==
*If you have completed the quest and are a part of the [[Black Arm Gang]], you have the ability to help others who have not completed the quest and are members of the [[Phoenix Gang]]. First, you can enter the mansion without your full [[black armour]] and ask [[Grip]] for another [[miscellaneous key]] for your partner - to get another key, first ask him what your duties involve before asking "what can I do now?". Open the cabinet and allow Grip to walk into the room. Shut the door and trap him and the Phoenix Gang member '''must''' kill Grip. This will update their quest journal for the Heroes' Quest.
*Members of the Phoenix Gang who have already completed the quest also have the ability to help others who have not, and are members of the Black Arm Gang. Either use the miscellaneous key received while completing the quest initially, or get a new one from the Black Arm Gang member. Return through [[The Shrimp and Parrot]] restaurant to the kitchen, and then through the secret panel. Head past the [[guard dog]]s again and into mansion. Use the miscellaneous key on the door, and kill Grip once the Black Arm Gang member has lured him into position.
*After [[Grip]] is killed and before he respawns if the player searches the cupboard they will find [[Whisky]].
*Attempting to drink the blamish oil results in the player saying "You know... I'd really rather not."
*Heroes' Quest was the first quest to have other quests specifically required to be completed, although [[Black Knights' Fortress]] and [[Dragon Slayer I]] had quest point requirements first.
*Other than Crafting, Magic, and Prayer, Heroes' Quest gives experience rewards to all skills that were in the game at the time of its release.

==Walkthrough==
===Hetty the witch===
Talk to [[Hetty]] in her house in south-east [[Rimmington]], and tell her you want to know more about the black arts. She will tell you she is making a potion and needs four ingredients that she wants you to get: a [[rat's tail]], a piece of [[Burnt food|burnt meat]], an [[eye of newt]], and an [[onion]].

===Rat's tail===
Kill a level 1 [[rat]] (they can be found in the [[Brian's Archery Supplies|archery shop]] west of [[Hetty]]'s house) to obtain a rat's tail. '''Note: You can only obtain a rat's tail if you have started the quest! Giant rats will NOT drop a rat's tail.'''

===Burnt meat===
'''- You can skip this point if you have already obtained [[Burnt meat]].'''

Kill a [[giant rat]] just north of the chapel graveyard south-east of [[Rimmington]], or kill a [[cow]] in the cow pen just south of Falador, and cook the meat. Meat can be used on the fireplace in Hetty's own house. If you didn't manage to burn the meat, use the [[cooked meat]] on the fire or range to purposely burn it. (A player-lit fire will also work.) You can also buy raw meat from [[Wydin]] at the food store in Port Sarim.

[[File:Witch's Potion - Hetty's Cauldron.png|thumb|right|Hetty's cauldron]]
===Eye of newt===
'''- You can skip this point if you have already obtained an [[Eye of newt]].'''

You can buy an [[eye of newt]] from the [[Betty's Magic Emporium|magic shop]] in [[Port Sarim]] for 3 [[coins]]. The magic shop is labelled with a fire rune symbol on the map.

===Onion===
'''- You can skip this point if you have already obtained an [[onion]].'''

[[Onion]]s can be found in a field directly north of [[Rimmington]] and east of [[Melzar's Maze]], or in the backyard of [[Fred the Farmer]]'s farmhouse west of the sheep pen in [[Lumbridge]].

===Finishing up===
When you have all these items, talk to [[Hetty]]. She'll put them in her cauldron and tell you to drink from it. Drink from the cauldron to complete the quest and gain your reward.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

==Walkthrough==
===Lighthouse trouble===
{{Needed|60 [[steel nails]], a [[hammer]], and 2 [[plank]]s|recommended=Fast travel method to the Barbarian Outpost and back|skills={{SCP|Agility|35}} {{Boostable|yes}} to enter the pipe inside the [[Barbarian Outpost Agility Course|agility course]]}}
[[File:Larrissa chathead.png|left]]
Head to the [[Lighthouse]], located north of [[Barbarian Outpost]], reachable via the [[Basalt rock|basalt platforms]]. If travelling from the outpost, you can obtain the required planks from the north-east end along the fence. Bring [[food]] as the platforms have a high failure rate even with decent agility, and a max hit of 10. Alternatively, [[fairy ring]] {{fairycode|alp}} will take you right by the lighthouse.

Speak to [[Larrissa]], who will tell the player that her boyfriend lives in the lighthouse. She is worried about him, as the light has gone out and the door is now mysteriously locked. Ask how you can help; she is stranded here, as a storm destroyed the bridge to the east, and she wants you to repair it. She also requests you retrieve a spare key to the lighthouse from her cousin at the [[Barbarian Outpost]].

[[File:Horror from the Deep bridge.png|thumb|Repairing the bridge.|220px]]

Some distance east of Larrissa is a broken bridge that connects to the mainland. With a [[hammer]] and 60 [[steel nails]] in your inventory, use a [[plank]] on the side of the bridge you are on, then click to jump to the other side to use a [[plank]] there as well. Depending on your agility level, you may take slight damage from the leap. Once the bridge is fixed, you will be able to cross without failure, despite the bridge not looking any different. 

Check your quest log to make sure it says that you've fixed the bridge, then head to the [[Barbarian Outpost]]. Speak to [[Gunnjorn]], found inside the [[Agility]] course, through the pipe ({{SCP|Agility|35}}). Tell him Larrissa is in trouble and needs her spare key back, and he will give you the [[lighthouse key]].

===Fixing the Lightomatic Deluxe 500===
{{Needed|A [[tinderbox]], [[molten glass]], and [[swamp tar]]}}
 [[File:Lighting mechanism (broken).png|left|100px]]
Return to Larrissa. She asks you to go inside the lighthouse and find out what happened to [[Jossik]]. Enter the building; you will appear in an [[instance]] with Larrissa inside. The furniture is smashed and there are blood splatters and claw marks on the floor and walls. She asks you to repair the light mechanism to prevent any shipwrecks. She does not know how to, but says Jossik probably had some manuals lying around.

By searching the bookcase on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}}, you may find the [[manual|lighthouse manual]], Jossik's [[Journal (Horror from the Deep)|journal]], and his [[diary (Horror from the Deep)|uncle's diary]]. Reading these  is not required to progress the quest. If you choose to read them, the manual will describe how to maintain the [[Lightomatic]] Deluxe 500, with a troubleshooting FAQ section at the end of the book. The journal describes how Jossik became the lighthouse keeper after his uncle disappeared, and soon began to hear voices. It ends with Jossik's decision to investigate the strange noises coming from the basement. In his diary [[Silas]] discusses the monstrous [[dagannoth]] in-between incoherent ramblings, as well as his construction of a metal door in the basement. He mentions that to unlock the door, 'the key' is fire, air, water, and earth runes, as well as weapons.

Head to the {{FloorNumber|uk=2}} and use some [[molten glass]] and [[swamp tar]] on the lighting mechanism in order to fix it, then light the tar with a [[tinderbox]]. Return to Larrissa, who requests that you do everything to find Jossik.

===The door is the key===
{{Needed|One of each elemental [[runes|rune]], 1 [[arrow]], and 1 [[sword]]}}
[[File:Horror from the Deep - The strange door.png|left|120px]]
Go down the iron ladder into the basement to find the door mentioned in Jossik's journal. You appear in a kind of sea cavern, with further passage blocked by the [[strange wall (Lighthouse)|metal door]]. It has a monstrous face in its centre surrounded by six icons: the four runes, a sword and an arrow.

Use all of your basic elemental [[runes]] on the door ([[Fire rune|fire]], [[Water rune|water]], [[Earth rune|earth]], and [[Air rune|air]]). You may bring a full stack of each, as the door will only use one rune. Use your [[sword]] on the door (any type), and then an [[arrow]] (any type except [[ogre arrows|ogre]] and [[training arrows|training]]). Bolts will not work. '''You do not get these back!'''

===Horrors from the deep===
{{Needed|Combat equipment}}

Once you have used all of the items on the door, it will unlock. Ensure you have your combat equipment with you, and go through the eastern part of the door and down the ladder. Be prepared to fight both a [[dagannoth]] and the [[dagannoth mother]], then talk to [[Jossik]] sitting injured by the ladder, who says he was trapped down here by creatures that attacked him. When the player suggests they should return upstairs to find help, a level 100 [[dagannoth]] emerges from the sea and attacks!
[[File:Horror from the Deep first dagannoth.png|thumb|Safespotting the first dagannoth.|200px]]
The [[Dagannoth (Horror from the Deep)|dagannoth]] only attacks with melee and can be killed with any combat style. You can utilise a [[safespot]] by standing in the southern corner of the pond to the west.

After defeating it, Jossik says that was not the creature that had attacked him but one of its babies. A cutscene follows in which a larger dagannoth appears from the waters, revealing itself to be the much stronger [[dagannoth mother]]. She attacks with both ranged and melee, and changes colour every 18 seconds through a fixed cycle, indicated through a chat message {{Mes|The Dagannoth changes to blue...}} as well as visually. Her six colours correspond to the four elemental spell types, ranged, and melee. For as long as she remains that colour, she can only be damaged through use of that particular attack style.

The same safespot used for the regular dagannoth is not as effective here, as she may eventually attack you. You can use the stalagmites in the south-east corner of the room to [[flinch]] with a melee weapon, using [[Protect from Missiles]] to avoid her ranged attack when using the other combat styles. By default, the mother will use ranged at a distance and melee up close, but may detect [[Prayer]] changes and automatically use the opposite attack type.

You can defeat the [[Dagannoth mother]] without using all of the combat styles, and may choose to simply wait in a [[safespot]] (or up the ladder) while she is the wrong colour. You could also use these pauses to heal. As she has a weakness to [[earth spells]] and only level 1 [[Magic]], this is the most effective source of damage.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/636095399070158848|date=25 August 2015|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/107525|archivedate=26 May 2020|quote=NPCs' magic defence is calculated off their Magic level, not their Defence level, and his is negligible.}} [[Ranged]] is the second most effective, and she has a higher resistance to [[melee]].

'''Note''': The [[Twinflame staff]] is not recommended, as it will remain on [[Earth spells]] as the mother's weakness, even if she has changed colour.

{{Color|red|Warning:}} Any dropped items will be unobtainable after defeating the boss. You may still loot your items if you die before killing her.

Defeating the [[Dagannoth mother]] will automatically complete the quest, and you will receive a [[rusty casket]]. The casket can be obtained from [[Jossik]] upstairs if you had a full inventory.

==Walkthrough==
===Captain Redbeard===
{{Needed|60 [[coins]].}}
[[File:Redbeard Frank chathead.png|left|frameless|100px]]
Talk to [[Redbeard Frank]] located in front of the northernmost dock in [[Port Sarim]]. Tell him you are in search of treasure, and he will ask you to bring him some [[Karamjan rum]] before he'll tell you where to find some.

Walk south on the docks to see three sailors (NOT the [[Monk of Entrana|Monks of Entrana]]). Talk to any one of these sailors to board the ship to [[Karamja]] for 30 [[coins]] (free using the [[Ring of Charos(a)]]).
{{Clear}}
===Rum smuggling===
{{Needed|30 [[coins]].}}
{{Map|name=Pirate's Treasure crate|x=2939|y=3149|r=1|mtype=pin|align=right|caption=Location of the crate used to hide the rum.|width=200|height=200}}
[[File:Zembo chathead.png|left|frameless]]
When you arrive in Karamja, follow the path to the west and enter the [[Karamja Wines, Spirits, and Beers|bar]]. Trade with [[Zembo]] and buy one [[Karamjan rum]].

'''Do not leave the island''' with the rum - it will be confiscated by the [[Customs officer|officers]] as [[Asgarnia]] has banned the import of intoxicating spirits. The bottle will also break if you teleport or accept a [[random event]] where you would be temporarily teleported.

You will need to find a method to smuggle the rum off the island. First, pick 10 [[banana]]s from the plantation to the north. Then talk to [[Luthas]] in his hut to the east of the plantation and ask him for a job, and he will hire you as his worker.

Outside the south east corner of his hut is a [[Crate (Pirate's Treasure)|crate]]. Use the rum on it to hide it in the crate, then "Fill Crate" on it to fill it with bananas.

'''Note''': If you get a message saying "Why would I want to do that?" make sure you have asked for employment first.

Talk to Luthas again and he will pay you 30 coins for loading the crate. Ask him where the crate goes, and he will tell you they go to [[Wydin]], who owns the food store in [[Port Sarim]]. Travel back to Port Sarim at the customs officer to the east for 30 coins (free with [[Ring of Charos(a)]]).

===Retrieving the rum===
{{Map|name=Chest|x=3219|y=3396|plane=1|mtype=pin|align=right|caption=Location of Hector's chest.|width=200|height=200}}
{{Needed|recommended=a teleport to [[Varrock Teleport|Varrock]] and [[Falador Teleport|Falador]].}}
[[File:Wydin chathead.png|left]]
Once you are in Port Sarim, make a quick stop at [[Gerrant's Fishy Business|the fishing shop]] just to the west. Hanging on the back wall is a [[white apron]]. Take it and wear it.

Talk to [[Wydin]] at his [[Wydin's Food Store|food store]] directly south of the fishing shop, and ask him for a job. He will agree as long as you are wearing your [[white apron]]. Enter the back room and search the [[Crate (Food Store, banana)|crate]] with a [[banana]] on top of it. You will find the rum. '''Do not teleport with it in your inventory (including random events).''' Head back to [[Redbeard Frank]] and give him the drink.

Frank will give you a [[Chest key (Pirate's Treasure)|key]] to the chest found upstairs in [[Varrock|Varrock's]] [[Blue Moon Inn]], owned by the now deceased [[One-Eyed Hector]]. Travel to [[Varrock]] and head to the [[Blue Moon Inn]] located just north of the city's southern gate. Go upstairs and find the chest in the room at the end of the hall. Use the key on the chest to find a [[pirate message]]. It will give you a clue to the treasure's location. '''Be sure to read the clue'''.

===Buried treasure===
{{Needed|[[Spade]], [[pirate message]]|recommended=A [[weapon]].}}
[[File:Gardener chathead.png|left]]
[[File:Pirate's Treasure - Buried treasure location.png|thumb|200px|Location of the buried treasure.]]
Travel to Falador Park, located in the north of Falador. If you don't yet have a spade, grab one from the estate agency just south-west of the park. Find the statue of [[Saradomin]] in the middle of the park, and notice where it's pointing. Note the configuration of the dirt, which vaguely makes an X. Stand in the middle of the dirt "X" and dig.
An angry level-4 [[gardener]] will appear out of nowhere and attack you. You will be unable to dig again until you either kill him, or run out of the park to despawn him. Dig again in the same spot to get a casket and complete the quest.

==Walkthrough==
===A mighty hero===
Speak to [[Lucien]] in the [[Flying Horse Inn]] in the north-western corner of [[East Ardougne]]. He wants you to retrieve the [[Staff of Armadyl]] from the deserted [[Temple of Ikov (dungeon)|Temple of Ikov]]. Ask him why he can't get it himself, and he will explain that the guardians of the staff have set up a magical barrier that he is unable to overcome, and give you the [[Pendant of Lucien]], which is required to enter the Chamber of Fear within the dungeon. He wants you to bring the staff to him in his house in [[Edgeville]] once you have found it.

===The Temple of Ikov===
{{Needed|Pendant of Lucien, 20 limpwurt roots, Yew bow or higher '''or''' throwing weapon, light source and knife (only if collecting the boots of lightness)|recommended=Ava's Accumulator, Ranged Armour and [[Protect from Magic]] for ranged style combat}}

In the following section, you will need to briefly reduce your weight to -1kg or less. The easiest method is to use the [[boots of lightness]] found within the dungeon, but any [[weight-reducing clothing]] will work. 

You may wish to bank the limpwurt roots/combat gear and do the dungeon in two trips. You may alternatively bring all of the gear required to complete the quest in one trip, provided you are '''willing to temporarily drop your items''' on the ground and pick them back up again after completing the weightless section (only takes a few seconds).

The temple is located directly south of the [[Ranging Guild]] and west of the [[Sorcerer's Tower]]. Climb down the ladder to enter the [[Temple of Ikov (dungeon)|dungeon]].

===The Boots of Lightness===
[[File:Temple of Ikov - Bridge.png|thumb|220px|The unsteady bridge.]]

If you have not yet collected your boots of lightness and are using it as your weight reducing method, from the entrance run to the west until you come to a set of stairs. You will need your light source with you to descend. Slash the web, pick up '''and equip''' the [[Boots of Lightness]], then return upstairs.

===The Unsteady Bridge===
Head through the northern gate of the room while wearing the pendant. Without wearing the pendant, you will stop and receive the message {{mes|As you reach to open the door a great terror overcomes you!}}

Here you will find an unsteady bridge over lava. To successfully cross this bridge, '''your weight needs to be -1kg or less,''' '''{{Colour|red|or you will fail and take 20 damage!}}'''

If you brought extra items, drop them now until your weight displays -2kg to be safe (you will need to pick up a lever weighing 0.056kg). '''Keep your pendant equipped, or you will be unable to retrieve your items if you messed up the weight and fall!'''

Walk across the bridge and take the [[Lever (Temple of Ikov)|lever]] on the other side.

:'''Note''': If you fell, you made a mistake with the weight and must walk to the south and take the ladder. You will appear just south of [[Hemenster]], walk east to return to the Temple of Ikov.

Pick up any dropped items, then head back to the initial room and place the lever on the lever bracket on the wall south-west of the entrance ladder. '''Pull the lever''' to open the southern room. If you forget to pull the lever and leave the area, it will need to be reobtained.

===The Ice Chamber===

After pulling the lever, the southern gate will be unlocked. Enter it and follow the path to the ice chamber filled with level-61 [[ice spider]]s.

You need to gather enough [[ice arrows]] in this room to battle the [[Fire Warrior of Lesarkus]]. If you've chosen to use throwing weapons, you only need to find at least 1 ice arrow. If using a bow, at least 20 arrows are recommended for low levels, though you can get by with much less if you have a high Ranged level and an [[Ava's device]]. 

To gather [[ice arrows]], you must search the 6 [[Closed chest (Temple of Ikov)|chests]] in this room. Only one will contain arrows at a time. Each time you loot a chest with arrows, you'll obtain 1-5 arrows, and a chest is randomly selected as the next spawn for the arrows. '''After obtaining arrows from a chest, search it again''' as it's possible for it to be randomly selected in succession.

===Fire Warrior of Lesarkus===
{{Needed|skills={{SCP|Thieving|42}} {{Boostable|yes}} to disable a trap}}
[[File:Temple of Ikov - Fire Warrior of Lesarkus.png|thumb|right|Duelling the [[Fire Warrior of Lesarkus]].]]

When you have enough ice arrows, return to the entrance and again enter the north door with the [[Pendant of Lucien]] equipped. 

:'''Tip:''' You may choose to unequip the pendant after entering if you want to utilise the [[neck slot]] for the following combat section.

Continue north until you see a small alcove with a [[Lever (trap, Temple of Ikov)|lever]] in it. Right-click the lever to ''Search for traps'' ({{SCP|Thieving|42}}), then pull it. '''{{Color|red|If you don't search the lever first, you will fall into a pit of spikes and take 20 damage.}}'''

The door at the end of the western passage will now be unlocked. Open it to enter a room with a summoning mark in the middle of it. Attempt to open the door to the north, and you'll be stopped by the [[Fire Warrior of Lesarkus]].

To continue you must defeat the Fire Warrior. He is intended to only take damage from ice arrows, however using throwing weapons with at least 1 ice arrow equipped will circumvent this without using up the arrows. After interrupting you, he will not attack until you either attack him first or talk to him. He uses solely magic, so [[Protect from Magic]] comes in handy. Using [[Ava's accumulator]] will assist you in not running out of arrows, though you can also pick up fallen arrows during the fight. If you take too long to defeat him or walk too far from the room, he will disappear and you will need to start the fight over.

:'''Note''': If you use the wrong weapon or run out of ice arrows, he will stop the fight and boast that your weapons do nothing, but will not regenerate health if you resume the fight.

After defeating him, proceed through the north door. You'll find [[Winelda]] the witch standing near a stream of lava. She will teleport you across if you hand her 20 unnoted limpwurt roots, '''all given at once'''.

:'''Note''': In case you have to re-enter the room, you do not need to fight the Fire Warrior again or bring the witch more limpwurt roots.

Pass the skeletons until you reach a room behind a brick wall. ''Push'' the wall to enter it.

:'''Tip:''' Before entering consider picking up the [[shiny key]] found past the level 82 [[Lesser demon]]s further along the corridor, which will allow you to access a shortcut to [[McGrubor's Wood]] through a ladder next to the skeletons. This may be useful if you want to return to fight the monsters in this part of the dungeon after the quest.

===Picking a side===
At this stage you must decide whether to take the staff for Lucien, resulting in combat with a level 43 [[Guardian of Armadyl]], or whether to side with the [[Guardians of Armadyl]], who will ask you to defeat a level 14 [[Lucien]]. Your choice will have a minor impact on the [[While Guthix Sleeps]] quest dialogue. If you choose to side with Lucien and want to obtain the [[Pendant of Armadyl]] again after the quest (used as protection for the [[God Wars Dungeon]]), you will need to kill the guardians rather than talk to them. Otherwise, the rewards remain the same for both paths.

===Side with the Guardians of Armadyl===
[[File:Temple of Ikov - Lucien mind trick.gif|thumb|upright|200px|Lucien will use a mind trick on players who aren't wearing the pendant of Armadyl.]]
{{Color|red|Warning:}} If you don't unequip your pendant or choose the wrong dialogue option, the guardian will attack you.

Unequip your [[Pendant of Lucien]] and talk to the Guardian. Tell them that you seek the [[Staff of Armadyl]] for [[Lucien]], then explain that Lucien offered a grand reward for it. The Guardian will offer to cleanse you to save your soul as a result of working for that 'spawn of evil'. Tell them it's time for "your yearly bath", and they will cleanse you with holy water. They will explain that Lucien is an undead necromancer that raised an army of the undead against Varrock a generation ago. Offer to help defeat him, and they will give you the [[Armadyl pendant]], which must be worn to defeat him. {{Chat option|1I seek the Staff of Armadyl.|1Lucien will give me a grand reward for it!|3You're right, it's time for my yearly bath.|1Ok! I'll help!}}

Head towards Lucien's house which is between [[Edgeville]] and the [[Grand Exchange]]. Defeat him (level 14) while wearing the Armadyl pendant.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

===Side with Lucien===
[[File:Temple of Ikov - Staff of Armadyl.png|thumb|left|200px|The [[Staff of Armadyl]] lying on a table.]]
You may ignore the conversation with the Guardians. Try to take the [[Staff of Armadyl]] on the table in the north-west room. You will be attacked by a [[Guardian of Armadyl]] (Level 43). Defeat them, and take the staff.

Head towards Lucien's house which is between [[Edgeville]] and the [[Grand Exchange]]. Hand him the staff to complete your quest.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

==Walkthrough==
===Mizgog's little helper===
Make your way to the [[Wizards' Tower]], south of [[Draynor Village]] and over a long stone bridge. Climb the stairs, and go up to the {{FloorNumber|uk=2}}. Talk to [[Wizard Mizgog]] and ask him questions to find out that he needs your help. He will tell you that [[Wizard Grayzag]]'s [[imp]]s have stolen his beads and he wants you to get them back for him. He needs you to collect:
*A [[black bead]] - {{Coins|{{GEP|Black bead}}}}
*A [[yellow bead]] - {{Coins|{{GEP|Yellow bead}}}}
*A [[red bead]] - {{Coins|{{GEP|Red bead}}}}
*A [[white bead]] - {{Coins|{{GEP|White bead}}}}

''Note: You can collect the beads in advance without starting the quest to save additional trips to the Wizards' Tower.

===Obtaining beads===
Beads are only obtained as a 5/128 drop from [[imps]], buying them through the [[Grand Exchange]], or trading with other players. Because of the relatively low drop rate, many players may choose to buy beads on the Grand Exchange to avoid the hassle of killing imps (for a total cost of {{Coins|{{GEP|Red bead|1}} + {{GEP|Black bead|1}} + {{GEP|Yellow bead|1}} + {{GEP|White bead|1}}}}).

If looking to collect the beads as a drop, imps commonly spawn throughout [[Gielinor]], and you might consider collecting them passively over time when encountering them. Alternatively, you can use some of the following hotspots where many spawn at a time:
*East of the [[Ardougne Monastery]]
*On top of the [[Karamja Volcano]] (be aware of level 14 [[scorpion]]s in this area)
*Southern entrance to [[Falador]]
*In a basement in [[Kastori]] (4 spawns in a 6x8 room, negates the inconvenience of teleporting imps)

Every 30–120 seconds there is a 25% chance for an imp to disappear into a puff of smoke and teleport a short distance away. Using [[Magic]] or [[Ranged]] is recommended to reduce downtime when killing them.

===Finishing up===
Once you have all four beads, return to Wizard Mizgog and give them to him to finish the quest. He won't accept them one at a time, so Ultimate Ironmen should plan to get the whole thing done at once.

===The first exam===

Talk to an [[Examiner]] and ask her about taking an exam, and she will give you an unstamped letter to take to [[Curator Haig Halen]] in the [[Varrock Museum]], located in the east of the city. Talk to him and he will use his seal on the letter, authorising you to take part in the exam. If you don't have a [[cup of tea]], you can obtain one now from the Varrock [[tea stall]].

Speak to an Examiner again who will test you. Answer anything, the answers do not matter as they are all wrong. When you fail, the examiner suggests you ask the other students for help.

===The study group===
{{Needed|A [[cup of tea]]}}
There are three students in the [[Digsite]] who can help you with the exam answers, but they each have a lost item they want retrieved first. To save time, gather these items before visting the students.

===Teddy===
[[File:Student (Teddy) chathead.png|left|frameless]]
Head north of the Exam centre until you come upon two wooden walkways. Follow the eastern walkway to the top of the small hill and search the easternmost [[Bush (The Dig Site)|bush]] by the [[Large urn|large blue urn]] to find the missing [[teddy bear]]. 
{{Clear|left}}
===Special cup===
[[File:Student (Special cup) chathead.png|left|frameless]]
Enter the tent at the end of the walkway and pick up the [[panning tray]] from the table. Use the [[cup of tea]] on the nearby [[panning guide]] and he will thank you and allow you to pan in the river to the east. Using the [[panning point]]s, pan in the river until you get the [[special cup]]. You may also receive an [[uncut opal]], keep it for later in the quest.
{{Clear|left}}

===Animal skull===
{{Needed|skills={{SCP|Thieving|25}} {{Boostable|yes}} to pickpocket a [[Digsite workman]]}}
[[File:Student (Animal skull) chathead.png|left|frameless]]

"Steal-from" nearby [[Digsite workman|Digsite workmen]] until {{Mes|You steal an animal skull}} appears. If you obtain a [[specimen brush]] whilst stealing from the workmen, keep it as you'll need it later in the quest.

{{Clear|left}}

===Learning the answers===
Once you have all three lost items, return them to each student (you will need to talk to each person twice).

The [[Student#Animal skull|first student]] who lost the animal skull has blonde hair and is wearing a green shirt, north of the tent.

Further north-east is the [[Student#Special cup|second student]] who lost his special cup, wearing an orange shirt, with short black hair and darker skin.

The [[Student#Teddy|female student]] who lost their teddy bear is further north-west, wearing all purple with blonde hair.

===Retaking the exams===
{{Needed|An [[uncut opal|opal]] (cut or uncut).}}

'''Note''': If the correct answer is not present in the selection given, you must have missed talking to a student. Check the quest log to find out which one, speak to them, and then try again.
====Level 1====
[[File:The Dig Site - Level 1 certificate.png|thumb|right|220px|The first certificate.]]
After helping out all three students, return to the [[Exam Centre]] and speak to an Examiner. Speak to her to retake the exam. To pass it, use the answers that the students gave you:
#Can you tell me what Earth Sciences is? - '''The study of the earth, its contents and history.'''
#Can you tell me which people are allowed to use the digsite? - '''All that have passed the appropriate Earth Sciences exam.'''
#Can you tell me the proper safety points when working on a digsite? - '''Gloves and boots to be worn at all times; proper tools must be used.'''

If done correctly, players will receive a [[Level 1 certificate]] and a [[trowel]].

====Level 2====
To pass the level 2 test, speak to the three students again to get the answers and return to the Examiner. The questions and answers are:
#Can you tell me how we transport samples? - '''Samples taken in rough form; kept only in sealed containers.'''
#What is the proper way to handle finds? - '''Finds must be carefully handled, and gloves worn.'''
#Can you tell me the proper use for a rock pick? - '''Always handle with care; strike cleanly on its cleaving point.'''

Upon passing, players receive a [[Level 2 certificate]].

====Level 3====
To pass the level 3 test, you need to speak to the three students again to obtain the answers. '''However''', the female student will ask for an [[uncut opal]] or [[opal]] this time. If you still need one, pan in the river until you obtain it. Talk to her twice, she will first request the opal, then give it to her in the second conversation. Return to the examiner and take the last test:

#Can you tell me how we prepare samples? - '''Samples cleaned, and carried only in specimen jars.'''
#What is the proper way to use a specimen brush? - '''Brush carefully and slowly using short strokes.'''
#Can you describe the technique for handling bones? - '''Handle bones very carefully and keep them away from other samples.'''

Upon passing, players receive a [[Level 3 certificate]] and permission to dig in all levels. You may choose to keep the certificate to later exchange with the [[Museum Curator]] for a [[chocolate cake]] or [[fruit blast]], which may be used for other quests like [[Desert Treasure I]] and [[Recipe for Disaster]].

===Ancient discovery===
{{Needed|A [[trowel]], a [[specimen brush]], and a [[specimen jar]].|skills={{SCP|Thieving|25}} {{Boostable|yes}} to pickpocket a [[Digsite workman]]}}
[[File:Ancient talisman detail.png|left|85px]]
Grab a [[specimen jar]] from the [[cupboard (specimen jar)|cupboard]] on the south wall inside the [[Exam Centre]]. If there is no search option, speak to [[Terry Balando]] about the tools first. Head back to the Digsite and pickpocket a [[Digsite workman]] ({{SCP|Thieving|25}}) until you get a [[specimen brush]] if you didn't get one earlier.

Head to a dig site marked by a level 3 sign, either the south-westernmost dig site or the northernmost dig site (see map above). Use your [[trowel]] on the soil until you find an [[ancient talisman]]. '''This often takes many tries and can easily take several minutes to find.''' {{Mes|You find a strange talisman}} will appear in a dialogue box when found.

Bring the talisman to [[Terry Balando]] in the Exam Centre, who identifies it as a talisman of [[Zaros]], a pagan god little is known of. As a reward he will allow you to use the private dig shafts, giving you an [[invitation letter]] to show a [[Digsite workman]] as proof.
{{Clear|left}}

There are two [[Winch|winches]] in the [[Digsite]] (see map above). Use your [[Invitation letter]] on a [[Digsite workman]] ('''not''' the 'Dig site workman' which lacks a pickpocket option) that's working near a winch, and then use a [[rope]] on the west winch to gain access to the sublevels of the Digsite.

Climb down the rope by operating the winch ({{SCP|Agility|10}}). Grab an [[arcenia root]] just north of the rope, then head south-east where there are bricks blocking the way. "Search" the bricks, and the player will muse about asking someone to help move them.

Return to the surface and head towards the north-east winch. Use another rope and go down, there you will find [[Doug Deeping]]. Speak to him and ask him how you can move a large pile of rocks. He will give you a [[chest key (Digsite)|chest key]].

===An explosive compound===
{{Needed|skills={{SCP|Herblore|10}} {{Boostable|yes}} to create a [[chemical compound]]}}
[[File:Chemical compound detail.png|left|frameless|50px]] 

There is a [[book on chemicals]] found in the bookshelves of the [[Exam Centre]] detailing the creation of an explosive compound that you will need to use to clear the bricks, but you do not need to read it to progress in the quest.

Use the [[chest key (Digsite)|chest key]] on the [[chest (Chemical powder)|chest]] in the tent where you got your [[panning tray]] to get [[chemical powder]]. Use your [[trowel]] on the centre barrel just west of the tent to open it, then use a [[vial]] on it to fill it with an [[unidentified liquid]]. '''{{Color|red|Do not drop it}} or you will take 25 non-fatal damage and must re-retrieve the ingredients.'''

If you didn't bring [[charcoal]], you may search the [[specimen tray]] north of the tent with a [[specimen jar]] in your inventory until you find some.

{{Checklist|
*Use the [[chemical powder]] on [[Terry Balando]] in the [[Exam Centre]] to learn that it's [[ammonium nitrate]], then '''use''' ({{Color|red|do not empty/drop}}) the [[unidentified liquid]] on him to learn that it's [[nitroglycerin]].
*Use the ammonium nitrate on the nitroglycerin to make [[mixed chemicals]] ({{SCP|Herblore|6}}).
*Grind your charcoal with a [[pestle and mortar]] to get [[ground charcoal]].
*Use the ground charcoal on the mixed chemicals ({{SCP|Herblore|8}}).
*Use the arcenia root on the mixed chemicals to create a [[chemical compound]]  ({{SCP|Herblore|10}}).
}}

{{Color|red|Warning:}} If you drop the [[chemical compound]] now, you will take 65 non-fatal damage.

[[File:The Dig Site - Senntisten.png|thumb|220px|left|The Zarosian altar found after blowing up the rocks.]]
Once you have the chemical compound, go down the western winch to use the [[chemical compound]] on the bricks (not the rocks), and then use a [[tinderbox]] on the bricks. Your character will run away as the bricks explode, clearing the path. Pick up the [[Stone tablet (The Dig Site)|stone tablet]] in the room, avoiding the level 22 [[Skeleton]]s if below 45 [[Combat Level]]. 

Bring the tablet to Terry Balando, who remarks that the tablet shows that the followers of Saradomin must have tried to cover up the evidence of the [[Zaros]] altar when building [[Varrock]]. He gives you two [[gold bars]] as a reward.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''
