===Chapter 2===
[[File:Monkey Madness I - Jail map.png|thumb|230px|The layout of the jail.]]
'''"In which our hero finds themselves engaging in severe quantities of monkey business."'''

====First Contact====
[[File:Aberab chathead.png|left|frameless]]
Once on the Atoll, start going west, sticking to the southern coastline until you reach a [[mahogany]] tree. From here, run north, avoiding the poisonous [[snake]]s, [[scorpion]]s, and [[Jungle spider (Ape Atoll)|jungle spider]]s. If you have the level to use it, activate [[Protect from Missiles]] as you travel north, as a volley of poisoned arrows will start pelting you as you come closer to the Ape Atoll gate. Once you get close enough to the entrance, you will be knocked out and placed in a prison.

After waking up, you will find yourself in a cell guarded by [[Trefaji]] and [[Aberab]], two gorilla guards. Speak to [[Lumo]], one of the captured 10th Squad members, and then prepare to make your escape.

==== Prison Break ====
{{Map:Monkey Mapness}}Throughout this section and any time you are re-jailed, you will need to stay one square away from the northern cell wall (near the patrolling guards' path) if the guards are in front of it. If you're in their range, they will punch you for 10-20 damage. The guards follow a path, which is as follows: one of the guards will patrol the area twice, walking the length of the prison each time, and then leave to rotate shifts. Use the time that the guard moves '''away''' from your [[Jail Door (Ape Atoll)|jail door]] to pick the lock. Once out, as the patrolling guard is walking out to switch with the one on standby, '''walk behind him to reach the exit.''' Be prepared to make several attempts.

After successfully making it out of the building, travel north of the jail and then east to find [[Karam]], an assassin and member of the 10th Squad. Karam can be found in the bushes near the crafting shop ([[File:Crafting shop icon.png]]); he is mostly translucent and he can be difficult to spot, so look carefully. After finding him, speak with him to learn about the gnome mage [[Zooknock]].

Refer to the map to the right for relevant locations during the quest. Be wary of all '''yellow''' dots, as they represent poisonous enemies (scorpions, snakes, and spiders), as well as aggressive monkey archers. When you are in the grass, the [[monkey archer]]s do not fire, but it's still a good idea to activate [[Protect from Missiles]] as a precaution.

Once you're ready, travel south, past the large door, while staying in the tall jungle grass. Past the door, go around the castle anti-clockwise until you're at the southern end, and from here, run south-east, until you are between a white building and the castle. To the east of that building is [[Garkor]], the Sergeant of the 10th Squad. Speak with him, and make sure to get all the way through the dialogue to the point where he tells you to go meet [[Zooknock]] in person.

==== Supply Crates ====
[[File:Monkey dentures detail.png|left|frameless|width=65x65]]Sprint west through the grass with Protect from Missiles on. Continue west (south of the buildings) in the grass until you reach the doorway to your north, marked on the map image above. Walk through the door to enter an enclosed area with a sleeping monkey guard, a [[Crate (banana)|banana crate]], and a [[Crate (monkey dentures)|dentures crate]].

When inside this house, '''stay on the dark brown ground along the walls''', or you'll risk being sent back to jail. The spiders inside are poisonous, but their poison only hits 1 damage, so it might be helpful to save your anti-poisons for later in the quest. There are bananas in the south-western crates next to the ladder if the player needs a source of food. 

From the entrance, head east and then north, and search the [[Crate (monkey dentures)|stacked crates]] towards the middle of the room to acquire [[monkey dentures]]. The sleeping guard is a non-threat so long as you don't talk to him; otherwise, he will call for guards. 

After you have the dentures, search the [[Crate_(Temple_of_Marimbo_Dungeon_entrance)|south-easternmost crate]] and a prompt will appear, asking if you're ready to enter the area below. You will take 32.9% of your current hitpoints as fall damage if you drop down into the cavern when entering, so heal up if necessary before attempting it to avoid dying to the poisonous spiders. Your [[Agility]] level has a chance to negate this damage, so a [[summer pie]] or other Agility boost may help avoid fall damage during this section.

Once inside the cavern, travel to the '''north-west''' part of the area and search the [[Crate (m'amulet mould)|crates]] to acquire the [[m'amulet mould]]. At this point, if you need to resupply, you can exit the city by going to the south-east corner of [[Marim]], running past the guards and the gravedigger, and climbing up the ladder. After climbing up, jump off the bridge, and go back to the boat to [[Crash Island]]. You can also teleport out.{{clear}}[[File:Monkey Madness I - M'amulet mould location.png|thumb|230px|The location of the M'amulet moulds.]]

====The Light at the End of the Tunnel====
{{Needed|the [[monkey dentures]], the [[m'amulet mould]], and a [[gold bar]]|recommended=1-2 [[antipoison]] potions, 4+ [[energy potion|energy]], or [[Stamina potion|stamina potions]] (or other energy-restoring items such as the [[Explorer's ring 1|explorer's ring]]), 4+ [[prayer potion]]s, some [[food]], a [[plank]] (not necessary if traversing the traps correctly, but can be obtained during the quest anyway), and a [[one-click teleport]]}}

''Note: [[Strange fruit]] are handy for this section as they also cure poison. You will spend about 220% total run energy to traverse to the end of the tunnel at minimum weight, with no energy conserving mechanics; bring enough energy restore to accommodate.'' 

It is '''highly recommended''' to teleport out and bank at this point. This section involves running past dozens of accurate [[Monkey Zombie|monkey zombies]] and [[Skeleton (Ape Atoll)|gorilla skeletons]] which can hit up to 7 and 12 respectively, all while inside a long and tight multicombat tunnel. [[File:ironman chat badge.png]] [[Ironmen]] or other accounts who don't have access to [[energy potion|energy]] or [[prayer potions]] are advised to use other [[Prayer items|prayer-boosting items]], in order to reduce prayer drain. ====Amulet of Monkeyspeak====
{{Needed|the [[enchanted bar]], the [[m'amulet mould]], a [[ball of wool]], [[monkey corpse]] OR regular [[monkey bones]], and five free inventory slots for the bananas|recommended=1-2 [[antipoison]] potions, a one-click teleport, and some food.}}

'''''Note''': If you are going to do [[Recipe for Disaster]], bring a ranged or magic weapon to kill a monkey guard and archer to save time later. Low level Ironmen can use rune spear (kp) from Tai Bwo Wannai Trio if the healing is too much to handle.''
[[File:Zombie monkey (item) detail.png|left|frameless|width=85x85]]
After restocking, return to [[Ape Atoll]] and continue north-west until you are placed in the jail cell again. Escape the cell as before, then travel east towards the temple.

You must now descend through the [[trapdoor (Temple of Marimbo)|trapdoor]] to the east in the temple (see map). Activate [[Protect from Melee]] before entering the temple to block attacks from the powerful [[monkey guards]]. 

Most of the guards can simply be run through, but the ones with beards near the trapdoor will act as walls, trapping you if they surround you. The easiest method to get past the bearded gorillas is to go upstairs, and then climb down the ladder on the east side to get close to the trapdoor. If you choose to walk to the ladder directly, make sure to wait until the guards walk away; players can hide in the north-east corner of the temple until there is enough room to descend. If you're surrounded by guards and can't move, teleport out immediately; if you're trapped near the ladder, go up the stairs and hop worlds. Note that the ladder near the trap door can only be climbed up from the EAST side.
[[File:Wall of flame.png|thumb|width=429x429|The wall of flame.]]
Go down the trapdoor while still praying against melee. Ignore the [[monkey zombie]]s (or kill one and pick up the bones if you want to do [[Recipe for Disaster]] later), and swiftly use the [[enchanted bar]] on the nearby [[wall of flame]]s to make an unstrung [[M'speak amulet (unstrung)|monkey amulet]]. Either travel back up the ladder or find a [[safespot]] to get away from the foes, and use the [[ball of wool]] with the unstrung amulet to create the full [[m'speak amulet]]. Be aware that if you ascend the ladder, you will be attacked and can be trapped as before, so ensure Protect from Melee is active.

====A Monkey's Uncle====
[[File:Monkey talisman detail.png|left|frameless|width=85x85]]
Head to the building west of the jail, making sure to sneak through the grass. You'll see a banana garden that has a [[Monkey Child]] in it, which is being patrolled by [[The Monkey's Aunt]]. The aunt follows a predetermined path, which loops around the wooden house by the garden; do not enter the garden when the monkey's aunt is present, or she will call for guards to arrest you. Note that if you're caught, you can sometimes escape without being arrested by quickly climbing up the ladder in the building nearby before the monkeys reach you. Do not speak to [[The Monkey's Uncle]] upstairs, as he will also call the guards. You can use the abandoned building next to the banana garden to quickly access the garden, as it has a connecting corridor out of sight.

Wait for the aunt to walk away, then speak to the monkey child, and tell him that you are his uncle. After he reveals that he is supposed to collect 20 [[bananas]], search and pick five bananas from the nearby trees. The monkey cannot count, so you do not necessarily need 20, as long as you give him at least 5. Give him the bananas, then wait for a few moments in the corridor, and return to the monkey child when the aunt is away. Ask the child to lend you his [[monkey talisman]].

=====Multiple talismans=====
You can obtain more than one talisman without dropping your current ones, so be sure to get an additional talisman for each [[greegree]] you want (four in total are needed for all quests; see below). You will need to speak to the monkey child again for each one, telling him you have lost the talisman, which will cause him to cry. Waiting for the aunt to pass by the child again will make the monkey child have another talisman available; Alternatively, you can switch worlds to potentially make the process go faster. If you talk to the child again before the aunt has passed by, you will get the message "The monkey child is too busy crying..."

Note that after you make your first greegree, talismans can be purchased from [[Tutab's Magical Market]] for 1000 [[coins]]. Tutab will not open his shop unless you are in monkey form.

Each of these requires one talisman, for a total of four talismans plus their respective monkey bones if making all talismans in one go. ==== Making the greegrees ====
Once you have all of the required bones (or monkey corpse) and talismans, you must run through the tunnels again, bringing your items to Zooknock. Travel through the tunnel for a second time, and when you reach the end, '''use''' the [[monkey talisman]] and all monkey bones (or corpses) on [[Zooknock]].

After a brief delay and conversation, you will get a greegree corresponding to the bones you used on him. To make another greegree, you have to first talk to him again and ask him if he can make another. '''If you cancel the conversation accidentally, ask how to make the monkey talisman and it will resume.''' If for some reason this doesn't work, try the [[drop trick]] with your previous greegrees, and go through the dialogue again. After all desired greegrees are made, bank or stock up as needed, and return to [[Ape Atoll]].

===Chapter 3===
'''"In which our hero finds themself contending with life as a monkey."'''

{{Needed|[[Karamjan monkey greegree]], [[m'speak amulet]], 1 free inventory space, and a method of reaching [[Ardougne]]}}
[[File:Awowogei chathead.png|left|frameless]]
In this chapter, you will be required to speak with [[Awowogei|King Awowogei]] and retrieve a monkey from the [[Ardougne Zoo]]. If you need to bank or in order to be more efficient, '''you can skip to retrieving the monkey in Ardougne''' (section "Monkey See, Monkey Zoo" below), and then speak with Awowogei when you return to Ape Atoll (steps 1-3).

1- Wield the [[monkey greegree]] to become a monkey. In this form, you will not be approached or attacked by any of the monkeys or wildlife on the island, and you cannot engage in combat. As a Karamjan monkey, return to [[Garkor]] and speak with him. If you are transformed into a different kind of monkey, he'll tell you to change and come back. After you finish talking, with the m'speak amulet equipped, talk to the [[Elder Guard]] near Garkor. The guard will tell you to speak with [[Kruk]].

2- From the guard, run west until you pass the main gate into [[Marim]] and have reached the Western shore of Ape Atoll (do not exit the gate). Head slightly south and follow the ground path up the western hill, then climb up the bamboo ladder at the top and cross the bamboo bridge. Climb down the ladder on the east side and speak to Kruk. After the conversation ends, he will conveniently take you back to [[King Awowogei]].

3- Speak to Awowogei and offer an alliance, and he will ask you to rescue a monkey from the [[Ardougne Zoo]]. Teleport out and make your way to Ardougne.[[File:Monkey Madness I - G.L.O. and Awowogei.png|thumb|300x300px|Caranock, Waydar and King Awowogei plotting.]]

====Monkey See, Monkey Zoo====
Once in [[Ardougne]], ensure you have an empty inventory space and then head to the south-west corner and enter the zoo. Wield the [[greegree]] inside the zoo area to become a monkey, and then speak to the [[Monkey minder]], who will place you in the cage. Speak with a [[Monkey (Monkey Madness I)|monkey]] (the only one with a "Talk" option), and it'll hop into your inventory; then, unequip the greegree and speak to the Monkey minder again. He will be confused and let you out.

You will now need to travel '''by foot''' to the [[Gnome Stronghold]]. You cannot use any form of teleportation (including [[random events]], spirit trees and fairy rings), as doing so will remove the monkey from your inventory, requiring you to re-obtain it from the zoo. The [[canoe system]] will work, however.

Once in the [[Gnome Stronghold]], talk to [[Daero]] on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} to travel back to Ape Atoll as usual.

:''Extra: Your new monkey friend will supply you with some humorous dialogue, and examining him will get you poked. If you have any [[bananas]] in your inventory, he will most likely eat them. There is also a 1/256 chance that he will give you a [[clue scroll (medium)]] if you use bananas on him directly. These can be obtained conveniently from the trees in the [[Monkey Child]]'s garden or [[Solihib's Food Stall]]. Note that you must go through the entire dialogue. Only one clue may be obtained per player{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/707250010379952128|date=9 March 2016|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/101498|archivedate=30 May 2020|quote=1/256, and it's once only per player.}}.''

Once on Ape Atoll, equip your greegree and amulet to speak with Awowogei again. ''(If you have spoken before, simply speak to the Elder Guard to be let in; if not, refer to the section above).'' The monkey will automatically leave your backpack after speaking to Awowogei, and the king will consider an alliance.

Speak with Garkor to begin Chapter 4.

===Chapter 4, "The Final Battle"===
{{Needed|[[Greegree]], food, an antipoison, and [[combat equipment]] to defeat a level 195 [[Jungle Demon]]}}
[[File:Garkor chathead.png|left|frameless]]
Speak with Garkor one more time (as a human or monkey) to receive a [[10th squad sigil]]. '''''Do not equip it until you are ready for the final battle'''''. Make sure to hold onto the sigil, as if you lose it, Garkor will send you to [[Waymottin]] at the end of [[Zooknock]]'s tunnel to reclaim it.[[File:Monkey Madness I - Jungle Demon fight.png|thumb|350px|The 10th squad and the player fight the demon.]]

Bank in preparation for the [[Jungle Demon]] fight, and ensure you have full [[prayer points]] and health. When you are ready to fight, wear the sigil, and you will be promptly teleported to the Jungle Demon's arena.

'''note:'''
* You can wear the sigil, to start the fight, from anywhere in RuneScape; no need to return to Ape Atoll.
* Although you "wear" the sigil, it stays in your inventory and doesn't unequip your neck-slot equipment.
* Activate Protect from Magic '''''before''''' teleporting, and drink any necessary [[potions]].
* Switch to your weapon/unequip your greegree before teleporting. '''You will lose your greegree''' if you have it equipped and your inventory is full when you teleport.

Upon landing in the arena, you'll be confronted by a level 195 Jungle Demon which can hit up to 32 with both magic and melee. Protection prayers reduce all damage to zero; as such, if the player stands out of melee range, the fight can be completed by simply leaving on Protect from Magic and attacking the demon with Magic or Ranged. Note that the demon's melee attack can hit you even if you're two squares away, similar to a halberd; ensure you're three or more squares away to avoid it. Additionally, '''standing still''' once you are teleported to the arena will keep a distance between you and the Demon, who will not move until you do, although it will still attack you with Magic.

The 10th Squad gnomes will be nearby to assist with the fight, but '''you must deal the final blow to the demon yourself.''' If the gnomes deal the final strike, he will heal around 20 percent of his health (anywhere from 12%-25%); when the demon reaches 1 hitpoint, there will be a period where the gnomes stop attacking, so use this window to deal the final blow yourself.

The demon is weakest to Ranged, although Magic is fairly effective. Players should focus on their combat style with the highest damage. Note that the [[dwarf multicannon]] is effective against the demon, allowing [[pure]] accounts to kill him without gaining any [[Hitpoints]] experience; additionally, despite being from the jungle, he is not immune to poison. Melee is not recommended, but players looking to use melee combat will benefit from using rings of recoil, as the demon's melee attacks hit very accurately.
There is a [[safespot]] in the arena, across a bridge on the outside edge. When you run to the safespot, he will make his way to the bridge, but won't be able to fit over it. You may run further down the outside edge to stop him from attacking at all, allowing you to wait for the 10th Squad to weaken him, then returning to the bridge to deal the final blow.

If you die during the fight, the sigil can be reclaimed from Death's Office. No need to run through the Ape Atoll Dungeon.

Escape the island however you like, either through the main gates as a monkey, with any form of teleport, or by jumping off the bridge in the south-east part of the city, and go back to the [[Gnome Stronghold]].

==Trivia==
*[[Lumo]], [[Bunkdo]], and [[Carado]] will make a random comment each time the player is captured and thrown back into jail, with special dialogue upon being caught 10, 15, 20, 50, and 100 times. Additionally, the player will receive a [[stuffed monkey]] as a reward when being caught for the 100th time.
*If you talk to [[Zeke]], the scimitar seller of [[Al Kharid]], and ask him for a [[Dragon scimitar]], he will respond by saying, "The banana-brained nitwits who make them would never sell any to me. Seriously, you'll be a monkey's uncle before you hold a Dragon Scimitar," referencing when you pretend to be a monkey's uncle to obtain the [[monkey talisman]].
*If you have started [[Fairytale II - Cure a Queen]], completing this quest and receiving Daero's training unlocks a new [[fairy ring]] location in the [[Ape Atoll Agility Course|Ape Atoll agility course]]. This small area has two exits, one requires a [[ninja greegree]], as well as 48 [[Agility]] to continue through the remainder of the agility course. The other is a much slower route and crosses the nearby gorge by climbing the tower and crossing the rope bridge.
*If you wear a [[M'speak amulet]] and listen to the [[enchanted bar]], it says "I'm stuck in this horrible gold bar!"
*The chapter cards and cutscenes in this quest are references to the adventure game series ''{{Wp|Monkey Island}}''.
*Upon first talking to [[Awowogei]], [[Uwogo]] says to "never trust a northern monkey". This is about the friendly rivalry between the north and the south within the UK (Northern Monkeys, Southern Fairies).
*You can pick up the Karamjan monkey King Awowogei requests after bringing him to the island. If a player picks up the monkey delivered to King Awowogei after bringing him to the king, travels to Karamja by foot, and drops the monkey, the player will receive their level in Thieving experience multiplied by two.
*[[Karam]] seems to be a reference to Kalam Mekhar (a character from Steven Erikson's {{Wp|Malazan Book of the Fallen}}) and the 10th squad in general could be a reference to the Bridgeburners 9th squad from the same series.
*This entire quest was created by one intern at Jagex during a summer internship.
*If you give a monkey talisman back to the monkey child, he will be grateful and hug you.

==Walkthrough==
{{Map|align=right|zoom=2|x=3482|y=3278|mtype=pin|width=250|height=250|caption=Where to start the quest.}}
:'''Note:''' The only nearby bank is unlocked during [[In Aid of the Myreque]]. It is recommended to bring all required items with you on your first visit to Mort'ton.
===Starting the quest===
[[File:Diary (Shades of Mort'ton) detail.png|left|70px]]
Head to the most south-western house in Mort'ton and search the shelf on the wall to find a [[Diary (Shades of Mort'ton)|book]]. '''You should also search the [[smashed table (Mort'ton)|smashed table]], as it contains two [[Tarromin]] and [[Rogue's purse]].''' The Tarromin will allow you to create additional potions later on, and you may save the Rogue's purse if you plan to do [[Zogre Flesh Eaters]]. This building also contains a vial spawn in case you didn't bring vials of water with you. You can fill the vials in the sink in the easternmost building.

===Serum 207 and killing shades===
{{Needed|1000+ [[coins]], 2 [[tarromin potion (unf)]] (or 2 [[tarromin]] and 2 [[vials of water]]), 2 [[ashes]], [[food]], [[armour]], and a [[weapon]]|skills={{SCP|Herblore|15}} {{Boostable|yes}} to create [[Serum 207]]}}
[[File:Serum 207 (4) detail.png|left|70px]]
Reading the book will now allow you to create [[Serum 207]], a potion which may be used on the afflicted in town to '''temporarily''' interact with them. If you don't already have a [[tarromin potion (unf)]], use [[tarromin]] on a [[vial of water]] ({{SCP|Herblore|12}}). Use [[ashes]] on the unfinished potion to create the Serum (also complete your second potion) ({{SCP|Herblore|15}}).

:'''Note''': Serum 207 can be bought on the [[Grand Exchange]], but you must make at least one yourself for the purpose of this quest.

[[File:Razmire General Store..png|thumb|250px]]

Use the Serum on [[Razmire Keelgan]] in the [[general store]]. Ask him what all these shadowy creatures are, and he will tell you they are restless spirits of the dead. He asks you to kill 5 [[Loar Shade]]s (the level 40 green shadows) and collect their [[Loar remains|remains]] so that he may do some experiments on them.

:'''Note''': The kills will only count after Razmire has asked you to kill them, and you must collect the remains via killing them.

{{mes|That's all five Shades!}} will appear in the chat when you are done. Return to Razmire and use the Serum 207 on Razmire again, and he will take two of the shade remains from you. He then mentions that [[Ulsquire Shauncy]] might also be interested in seeing some shade remains.

Before heading to Ulsquire, open the general store through Razmire and buy some [[olive oil]]. Then ask him to open the builders store, and buy 1-2 [[timber beam]], 1-2 [[limestone brick]], and 10-20 [[swamp paste]].

:'''Note''': The supplies may be much more expensive on World 377 (the official Shades of Mor'ton minigame world) due to players buying them up, so consider switching worlds temporarily before buying them.

Ulsquire can be found in the house right next to Razmire to the south-east. Give him a dose of Serum 207, and then one of your [[shade remains]]. Talk to him again, and ask what he found out from the remains. Ulsquire believes that the tormented spirits should be put to rest, and jokes about rebuilding the nearby [[Flamtaer|temple]] and experimenting with the sacred flame. Next, ask him what he can tell you about the temple. He will suggest that to rebuild it, you will need the items you have just bought from Razmire. {{Chat option|1What did you find out about the remains?|2What can you tell me about that temple?}}

:'''Note''': Make sure you complete the dialogue options with Ulsquire, or interacting with the temple will result in the message {{Mes|You're not quite sure how to fix this}}.

===Repairing the Temple===
{{Main|Shades of Mort'ton (minigame)}}
{{needed|[[Hammer]] or [[Flamtaer hammer]], [[food]], [[armour]], [[Weapons|weapon]], [[tinderbox]], [[logs]] or [[axe]], [[loar remains]], [[olive oil]], and 1+ [[Serum 207|doses of Serum 207]] (2+ recommended). Building materials: multiples of [[limestone brick]], [[timber beam]], 5 [[swamp paste]]|recommended=1-2 [[Flamtaer bracelet]]s are recommended|skills={{SCP|Crafting|20}} {{Boostable|yes}} to repair the temple walls, {{SCP|Herblore|15}} {{Boostable|yes}} if choosing to create [[serum 208]]}}
 [[File:Flaming Fire altar.png|left|70px]]
[[File:Flamtaer.png|thumb|250px|The Flamtaer temple when fully repaired with the fire altar lit.]]
Now, you must help rebuild the temple located on a small island north-east of the general store, in order to create the sacred oil needed for a pyre funeral.

This section of the quest serves as a short introduction to the Shades of Mort'ton [[Shades of Mort'ton (minigame)|minigame]]. It is possible to complete this solo if using several [[Flamtaer bracelet]]'s along with the [[Flamtaer hammer]], but you may consider using the official World 377 dedicated to this minigame to find other players also rebuilding the temple, as this will make the process '''significantly faster'''.

In this minigame, players work together to rebuild the temple while under attack from [[Loar Shade]]s. To complete this quest, rebuild the walls around the temple using your hammer and build materials ({{SCP|Crafting|20}}). The [[Flamtaer hammer]] and [[Flamtaer bracelet]] make this process approximately 75% faster (the bracelet degrades after 80 uses). Once fully rebuilt, ignite the flame and then use the [[olive oil]] on it to create [[sacred oil]], provided you have at least 10% Sanctity. Sanctity is earned by your contribution towards repairing or reinforcing the walls, or by killing [[Loar Shades]] (only recommended for high combat levels).

:'''Note''': Once you have your sacred oil, it is optional but '''highly recommended''' to use your remaining [[Serum 207]] on the flame with at least 20% Sanctity, to create [[Serum 208]] ({{SCP|Herblore|15}}). This will permanently cure [[Razmire]] and [[Ulsquire]], making them permanently available for dialogue and trade. It may also be used on other [[afflicted]] citizens for a small [[Serum_208#Cure_rewards|reward]].

===Burning a Shade===
[[File:Shades of Mort'ton - Burning shade remains.gif|thumb|right|250px||The Shade spirit is now free!]]
{{Needed|[[Sacred oil]], [[logs]] or [[axe]], [[loar remains]], [[tinderbox]]|skills={{SCP|Firemaking|5}} {{Boostable|yes}} to use pyre logs on the funeral pyre}}

If you do not yet have logs, cut down a nearby [[dead tree]]. Use your sacred oil on the [[logs]] to receive a [[pyre logs|pyre log]]. Then, head over to one of the funeral pyres, which are the brown patches on the map west of the General Store. Use the pyre logs on the funeral pyre, followed by the [[Loar remains]]. Light this and you will see a spirit rise from the pyre. ({{SCP|Firemaking|5}})

Collect your reward from the stone pillar next to the pyre and head back to Ulsquire. Speak with him to prompt the end of the quest (use a serum if he has reverted to being afflicted).

'''Murder Mystery''' is a quest that investigates the murder of [[Lord Sinclair]]. The culprit is random for each player, so some investigation must be done to determine the murderer. However, there are plenty of clues to be found around the [[Sinclair Mansion]].

==Details==
{{Quest details
|start = Talk to any [[Guard (Sinclair Mansion)|guard]] around the [[Sinclair Mansion]], north  of [[Seers' Village]] and [[Camelot]].
|startmap = 2741,3562
|difficulty = Novice
|description = Old man Sinclair has been found dead in his mansion! Unfortunately, the local authorities are having some trouble figuring out who's the guilty party. Maybe the unbiased eye of a passing adventurer will be of help.
|length = Short
|items = * [[Pot]] or [[Pot of flour]]
|recommended = * 16 empty [[inventory]] spaces
* [[Weight-reducing clothing]]
|leagueRegion = <poem>
Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Kandarin}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest
</poem>
}}

==Walkthrough==
Murder Mystery is one of the more unique [[quests]] because the outcome of the quest is random, so there is a reasonable amount of detective work you have to do on your own. However, there are plenty of clues to be found as to who the culprit is.

===Starting out===
{{Map|x=2741|y=3562|r=4|mtype=square|width=250|height=250|align=right|caption=The quest's start point.}}
Head to the [[Sinclair Mansion]] located north to [[Camelot|camelot castle]]. [[Fairy ring]] {{Fairycode|cjr}} is nearby.

Talk to the [[Guard (Sinclair Mansion)|guard]] to activate the quest. Then, enter the house and search the murder scene, which is on the east side of the {{FloorNumber|uk=0}}. There are three things you need to do in this room.

# Inside will be a [[pungent pot]] on a table, which you should pick up.
# There is the [[criminal's dagger]] on the floor, which you should collect.
# Investigate the smashed window to find the [[criminal's thread]].

Go around to the various bedrooms belonging to the suspects to find six silver items, all contained within barrels in each room. (There are four rooms upstairs and two on the {{FloorNumber|uk=0}}.) Look for:

*[[Anna]]'s [[silver necklace]]
*[[Bob (Sinclair)|Bob]]'s [[silver cup]]
*[[Carol]]'s [[silver bottle]]
*[[David (Murder Mystery)|David]]'s [[silver book]]
*[[Elizabeth (Murder Mystery)|Elizabeth]]'s [[silver needle]]
*[[Frank]]'s [[silver pot (Murder Mystery)|silver pot]]

Now, it's time to get your first piece of evidence. Go to the main entrance of the mansion, and go north-east until you reach the [[Sinclair Guard dog|guard dog]] enclosure. Investigate the sturdy wooden gate for more information.

Next, go to the gardener's shed (the small house on the ground level, west side of the outside of the mansion) and investigate the sacks to find [[flypaper]]. Take seven of these.

Go to the kitchen in the north-west corner of the mansion, and fill your empty [[pot]] with flour. Use it on the criminal's dagger; then, use the dagger on a piece of flypaper to get an [[unknown print]]. Dust each silver item with more flour, and use the flypaper to lift fingerprints from the items; then, compare them to the print of the criminal's dagger you found at the crime scene by using the flypaper pieces on the first flypaper print you got from the dagger.

Once you've got a match, all the silver items are no longer needed and can be safely dropped, except for your proof.

You'll need more than just that for a conviction, though. Go to the entrance of the mansion, and talk to [[Gossip]], and ask him who he thinks is responsible.

[[File:Murder Mystery - Poison Salesman.png|thumb|250px|Talking to the Poison Salesman]]

Next, you need to gather info about the poison. There's a [[Poison Salesman|poison salesman]], who sells it inside of the pub west of the [[bank]] in [[Seers' Village]]. Ask him to whom he sold the poison, and he'll tell you that everyone at the mansion bought some.

Go back to the house and ask the person who had the fingerprints on the criminal's dagger to find out what the poison was used on. Search the item they mention, detailed here:

*Anna - [[Sinclair family compost heap]]
*Bob - [[Sinclair family beehive]] in cow pen
*Carol - [[Sinclair mansion drain]], west of the front door
*David - [[Spiders' nest]], upstairs between the two rooms with three beds each in them
*Elizabeth - [[Sinclair family fountain]]
*Frank - [[Sinclair family crest]], east of the front door

You'll find that the subject was lying and didn't use their poison on what they had said they did.

:'''Note:''' If you wish to keep the silver necklace as a souvenir, drop it before talking to the guard (banking will not work).

Go back and talk to a guard and tell him you know who did it. Use the fingerprints of the person that did it on the unknown fingerprint. Show him the fingerprints, tell him about the poison, and show him the thread from the windowsill, since its colour will be a match to an article of the culprit's clothing. Case closed!

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

[[File:Father Aereck chathead.png|left|frameless]]
Talk to [[Father Aereck]], found in the [[Lumbridge]] chapel just east of [[Bob's Brilliant Axes]]. Tell him you are looking for a quest, and he will ask you to get rid of a [[Restless ghost|ghost]] haunting the graveyard. He suggests you start by talking to [[Father Urhney]], an expert on ghosts.

Go south of the castle, and into the [[Lumbridge Swamp]]. Head west through the swamp until you come upon a small house by the coast and talk to the irate [[Father Urhney]] inside. After you mention [[Father Aereck]]'s request, he gives you an [[amulet of ghostspeak]], which allows you to communicate with the ghost. '''It is highly recommended to keep the amulet for future quests. It is possible to drop the amulet on the ground, and speak to Father Urhney again to obtain duplicate amulets.''' Once you have the amulet in your [[inventory]], teleport or run back to Lumbridge, and make your way to the graveyard located beside the chapel.
{{Clear}}

===Freeing the ghost===
[[File:The Restless Ghost - Battle.png|thumb|250px|Fighting the skeleton in the [[Wizards' Tower]].]]
[[File:Restless ghost chathead.png|left|frameless]]
In a small building in the south-east corner of the graveyard is a [[Coffin (The Restless Ghost)|marble coffin]]. Wearing your [[amulet of ghostspeak]], search the coffin, and a [[Restless ghost|ghost]] will dramatically emerge. Talk to him, and he tells you he is missing his skull. Head to the [[Wizards' Tower]] located on an island south of [[Draynor Village]], and climb down the ladder in the room directly next to the entrance. Across the room, you will find an altar, which you will need to search to obtain the [[ghost's skull]]. '''A [[Skeleton (The Restless Ghost)|skeleton]] will appear and attack you.''' You do not need to fight the skeleton and can simply leave the room. Make sure you have the [[Ghost's skull|skull]] in your inventory.

Run or teleport back to [[Lumbridge]] to speak with the [[restless ghost]]. He wants you to put the skull in his coffin. Use the skull on the coffin, and you will see the ghost's spirit disappear into the river.

'''Priest in Peril''' is the [[quest]] that unlocks access to the region of [[Morytania]]. At the command of [[King Roald]], you must head to the temple of [[Paterdomus]] to aid the monk [[Drezel]] with recovering the temple.

==Details==
{{Quest details
|description = Recently contact has been lost with the temple to Saradomin on Misthalins' Eastern border. [[King Roald]] would be very interested to know what has caused this lack of communication, and seeks an adventurer willing to report back to him on the situation.
|start = Talk to [[King Roald]] in the [[Varrock Palace]].
|startmap = 3221,3473
|difficulty = Novice
|length = Short
|members = Yes
|items = * 50 unnoted [[rune essence]] or [[pure essence]] (can be mined by talking to [[Aubury]] in [[Varrock]], after completing [[Rune Mysteries]]. All 50 essence do not have to be of the same type) (does not needed to be handed in all at once; multiple trips can be made.)
* [[Bucket]] (obtainable during the quest from Varrock general store for 2 coins)
|recommended = * {{SCP|Combat|15|link=yes}}
* [[Essence pouch]]es - optional, but helps to carry more essence.
* [[Food]] (recommended for low levels)
* 3 [[Varrock teleport]]s
* [[Stamina potion]]s or [[Super energy|(super)]] [[energy potion]]s
|kills = * [[Temple guardian]] dog ''(level 30) - can be safespotted or flinched, immune to [[Magic]]
* [[Monk of Zamorak (Paterdomus)|Monk of Zamorak]] ''(level 30) - can be safespotted or flinched''
|leagueRegion = <poem>
Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Varlamore}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest
</poem>
}}

==Walkthrough==
===The Paterdomus priest===
{{map|3410,3494|zoom=3|align=right|caption=Location of the Temple and Dungeon Entrance to the north.}}
{{Needed|[[Combat equipment]]|recommended=[[Varrock teleport]]}}
Talk to [[King Roald]] in the south-easternmost room of the [[Varrock Palace]] near the main entrance, and ask him for a quest. He will ask the player if they are aware of the [[Paterdomus Temple]], which guards [[Misthalin]] from the only passage into the deadly vampyre-infested lands of [[Morytania]]. After the player responds that they've heard of it, the King will tell them that it has been some days since he heard from [[Drezel]], the priest who lives there. He wants the player to check in on them.

[[File:Paterdomus Temple.png|thumb|220px|The entrance to the temple.]]
The [[Paterdomus Temple|temple]] is located north-east of [[Varrock]]. After exiting Varrock through the eastern entrance, head north along the path, continuing past the [[Earth Altar]] through the gate to the east. Follow the path all the way to the temple, then attempt to open the door. A mysterious voice will ask who you are and what you want. Tell them King Roald sent you to check on Drezel. After some panicked muttering, a second voice will introduce themselves as Drevil, before clarifying that they meant Drezel. They will then ask for a favour; a horrible big dog-like thing has moved into the mausoleum outside, and they want the player to get rid of it.

===The dungeon===
[[File:Temple_Guardian_safespot.png|thumb|left|220px|Safespotting the Temple Guardian.]]

Climb down the trapdoor north of the temple, then kill the unaggressive level 30 [[temple guardian]], which may be [[safespotted]] with ranged, or [[flinched]] using melee. You cannot use [[Magic]]. To trap the guardian, simply move one square east after coming down the ladder, and drag the dog over by using ranged attacks, or by attacking with melee and then running back to the same square.

:'''Note:''' If using [[rings of recoil]], 1 damage must be dealt by the player for the kill to register.

===Returning to King Roald===
Return to King Roald in the [[Varrock Palace]]. After telling him you killed the dog in the mausoleum, King Roald becomes enraged, and explains that the [[Temple guardian|dog]] was protecting the mausoleum from sabotage, and that the whole of [[Misthalin]] is now at risk. He instructs you to go back and fix it right away.

Before returning, if you don't yet have a bucket, go up the nearby stairs and grab one from the bedroom in the north eastern corner. Alternatively you can buy one from the general store to the south of the palace.

===Back to the temple===
{{Needed|50 Unnoted [[Rune essence|rune]] or [[pure essence]], an empty [[bucket]], [[combat]] [[equipment]] and 1 free [[inventory]] space|recommended=[[Essence pouch]]es and [[Varrock teleport]]s}}
[[File:Monk_of_zamorak_safespot.png|thumb|left|220px|Safespotting the Monk of Zamorak.]]
Return to the temple and enter it. Kill the '''hooded''' level 30 [[Monk of Zamorak (Paterdomus)|Monk of Zamorak]] to get a [[golden key]]. Only the level 30 monk will drop the key. The monk attacks with magic, and can be trapped in-between the pews by standing south of the pew, to be safespotted with ranged or magic. They can also be flinched with the same method.

:'''Note:''' If using [[rings of recoil]], 1 damage must be dealt by the player to receive the key.

After receiving the key, climb up the stairs in the north-east corner of the room, then climb up the ladder of the south west corner of the room to reach the top floor. Talk to [[Drezel]] through the bars. He will explain that Zamorakians have attacked the temple, intending to desecrate the blessings placed upon the holy River Salve by the [[Seven Priestly Warriors]] and leave Misthalin defenceless against the vampyres of Morytania. Ask what to do, and he will explain that you need to find the key to unlock his cell and a way to deal with the vampyre trapped in the nearby coffin. As a descendant of one of the Seven Priestly Warriors who blessed the river, it may be awoken by the familiar scent of his blood. If you choose to speak to him again, he will suggest that the Zamorakians may have hidden the right key somewhere, as the golden key you retrieved does not fit the gate.

Next, go back down the trap door into the mausoleum. With the golden key in the inventory, the player can now unlock the gate to the south. Through the gate is a room with seven [[monument]]s and a [[Well (Paterdomus)|well]]. Study the monuments until you find the one that holds an [[iron key]], then use the golden key on it to swap the two. After obtaining the iron key, use your empty [[bucket]] on the nearby well to fill it with [[murky water]].

:'''Note''': The other monuments hold golden items which may be obtained once as souvenirs by swapping them with the regular versions. The items that may be swapped are a [[pot]], [[feather]], [[candle]], [[tinderbox]], [[needle]], and [[hammer]]. This can no longer be done after Drezel moves to the mausoleum in the following steps.'''

[[File:Priest in Peril - Blessing the coffin.png|thumb|250px|The player pours the bucket of blessed water on the coffin, trapping the vampyre within.]]
Return to the top floor of the temple, and use the iron key on the cell door. Enter the cell and talk to [[Drezel]], who will bless the murky water for you. Use the [[blessed water]] on the [[Coffin (Priest in Peril)|coffin]] just outside of the cell to seal the vampyre within it. Talk to [[Drezel]] again and he will ask the player to meet him in the mausoleum, in order to help revert the damage that the Zamorakians have done.

Return to the dungeon and proceed through the gate located in the north-east corner of the monument room. Speak to [[Drezel]], who will tell the player that the Zamorakians have used a potion to pollute the River Salve. While he focuses on reinforcing the barrier between Morytania and Misthalin, he wants the player to help soak up the evil magic that the potion has released into the river. To do this, he needs 50 '''unnoted''' rune essence.

If you need to, you can give him a mixture of both [[rune essence|rune]] and [[pure essence]]. Players with essence pouches can bring all 50 essence in a single trip if desired. If you don't have an [[essence pouch]], make multiple trips as needed.

After bringing him all of the rune essence, he will thank the player and give them a [[Wolfbane]] dagger, explaining that it has been passed down through his family for generations and is imbued with the power of [[Saradomin]].

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

:'''Note:''' To unlock access to [[Morytania]], you must ask Drezel if you can now pass through the barrier, and wait until he has blessed you.

{{Checklist|

===Planning a rescue===
{{Needed|3 [[balls of wool]], [[rope]] (unless buying from [[Ned]]), 2 [[onion]]s '''or''' [[yellow dye]], 1 [[redberries]], [[pot of flour]], [[ashes]], a [[bucket of water]] or [[jug of water]], [[soft clay]], a [[bronze bar]], 3 normal beers, a [[pink skirt]], and 30 [[coins]] (unless teleporting)}}
[[File:Chancellor Hassan chathead.png|left|frameless]]
{{Map|name=Leela|x=3113|y=3262|plane=0|r=3|mtype=square|caption=Leela's location just east of Draynor Village.|align=right|width=250|height=250}}

Osman will explain that Prince Ali, heir to the Emir of Al Kharid, has been taken by a group of bandits to the abandoned jail just east of [[Draynor Village]]. He wants you to talk to his daughter [[Leela]], who will help you attempt a rescue.

[[Leela]] can be found strolling east of [[Draynor Village]] just south of the wheat field. Talk to Leela and ask her about the key and disguise, and she will explain what you will need to pull off the escape.

To the west of Leela is [[Ned]]'s house. Ask him to make you a wig from the [[balls of wool]]. If you haven't brought a rope, you can buy one from his shop for 18 [[coins]] (15 through dialogue). Once you have the rope and wig, talk to [[Aggie]] in the house just west of Ned's, and ask her to make you some [[Paste|paste]]. She will use your [[redberries]], [[ashes]], [[flour]] and [[water]] to make the paste. If you did not bring yellow dye, you can ask her to make it for you in exchange for 2 [[onion]]s and five coins. Use the dye on the wig to dye it yellow.

[[File:Draynor jail front.png|thumb|left|200px|Guards patrolling the Draynor jail.]]

Head inside the jail directly east of [[Draynor]], avoiding the aggressive level 26 [[jail guard]]s. They will ignore you if your combat level is 53 or higher. Once inside, speak to [[Lady Keli]] and tell her she's famous, then ask her about her latest plan, then praise her skill. Ask her how she knows someone won't try to free him, and she'll mention the key. Ask her if you can see the key and then if you can touch the key for a short amount of time. You will make a [[key print]] of the key using the [[soft clay]]. {{Chat option|1Heard of you? You're famous in Gielinor!|1What is your latest plan then?|2How do you know someone won't try to free him?|1Could I see the key please?|1Could I touch the key for a moment please?}}

Once you have the key print, head to any furnace to smelt the [[Bronze key (Prince Ali Rescue|bronze key]] using the key print and your [[bronze bar]]. The closest is in [[Lumbridge]]. [[Members]] may use a [[Amulet of glory]] to teleport to the [[Edgeville furnace]], and then to teleport to [[Draynor Village]] for the next section.
{{Clear|left}}

===Saving the Prince===
{{Needed|3 [[beer]]s, [[rope]], a [[pink skirt]], a [[wig]] (dyed yellow), and [[paste]]}}
[[File:Prince Ali chathead.png|left|frameless]]
Talk to [[Leela]], who will tell you to talk to [[Joe (jail)|Joe]] the guard to find a weakness before breaking the prince out.

'''Note''': If she doesn't tell you to talk to the guard, you may have forgotten to dye the wig yellow.

Talk to Joe and offer him a drink of all three beers, until he is drunk. Use the rope on [[Lady Keli]], the key on the cell door, then talk to [[Prince Ali]] and he will use the [[wig]] and [[pink skirt]] as a disguise and escape.

Return to [[Hassan]] in the Al Kharid palace to claim your reward.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

:'''Tip:''' [[Members]] may talk to [[Osman]] outside the palace after the quest to unlock the [[Minigame Teleport]] to the [[Sorceress's Garden]].

Regicide: {{External|rs|dw}} {{Has quick guide}} {{Infobox Quest |name = Regicide |number = 59 |image = [[File:Regicide.png|300px]] |release = [[20 September]] [[2004]] |update = Plague City Part 4 Released |members = Yes |series = [[Quests/Series#Elf|Elf]], #4 |developer = {{RSL|Mod Dylan|Dylan C}} }} '''Regicide''' is the fourth quest in the [[Elf quest series]], where [[King Lathas]] sends the player to [[Tirannwn]] to kill his brother, [[King Tyras]], and end his tyranny. ==Details== {{Quest details |start = Talk to [[King Lathas]] on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} of [[Ardougne Castle]]. |startmap = 2577,3293,plane:1 |difficulty = Experienced |description = Continuing the Plague City series, the Regicide Quest takes you beyond the 'Well of Voyage' to a new realm. Once there, you will see that everything is not as serene as it first appears. |length = Long |requirements = * Completion of the following quests: ** [[Underground Pass]] *** [[Biohazard]] **** [[Plague City]] * {{SCP|Crafting|10|link=yes}} {{Boostable|no}} {{Questreqstart|}} * {{SCP|Agility|56|link=yes}} {{Boostable|yes}} {{Questreqstart|no}} * The ability to defeat a level 110 [[Tyras guard]] (can be [[safespotted]]) |items = * 6-9 [[coal]] in the bank (although at least 25 is recommended; you may bring the coal noted to save you a bank trip) * [[Bow]] and some [[arrows]] (or [[fire arrows|lit fire arrows]] if you already have some.) * 2 [[rope]]s (3 in case you fail) * [[Spade]] * [[Limestone]] (or a [[pickaxe]] and {{SCP|Mining|10+|link=yes}}). Note that [[limestone brick]]s will '''not''' work. * [[Tinderbox]] * [[Strip of cloth]] (made on a [[loom]] with 4 [[balls of wool]]; '''not''' a [[bolt of cloth]] - you can use the [[loom]] at the [[Iorwerth Camp]] or at the [[Falador]] farm) * [[Pestle and mortar]] * [[Gloves]], the list on [[Quicklime]] shows all gloves that work. * [[Pot]] (obtainable during quest) * [[Cooked rabbit]] (obtainable during quest) or [[roast rabbit]] |recommended = * {{SCP|Combat|60|link=yes}} * Some [[antidote++]] or [[antipoison]]s * [[Stamina potion]]s and [[weight-reducing gear]] (such as [[Boots of Lightness]] or the [[Graceful outfit]]) * At least 3 [[Summer pie]]s to boost [[Agility]] for several obstacles, and to recover health from the traps * [[Ranged]], [[Magic]] or a [[Halberd]] to safespot the [[Tyras Guard]] * [[Coins]] to buy food in the [[Underground Pass (dungeon)|Underground Pass]] * Any [[axe]] to cook the raw rabbit anywhere * Fast travel to Rimmington such as [[Rimmington teleport]] tablets, [[Teleport to House]] if your house is in Rimmington, [[Ring of the elements]], [[Falador teleport]], or [[Explorer's Ring 2]] or higher. * Fast travel to the Underground Pass ([[West Ardougne teleport]] or travel from East Ardougne) * OPTIONAL: Your [[Iban's staff]] or [[Iban's staff (u)|its upgraded counterpart]] in order to recharge it for free by using it on the [[Well_(Paladin_badges)|well]] during the [[Underground Pass (dungeon)|Underground Pass]] section |kills = * [[Tyras guard]] ''(level 110)'' ''Safespottable'' |leagueRegion = Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Tirannwn}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest }} ==Walkthrough== :'''Note:''' When doing this quest, players should make sure that they have everything required before continuing. '''The coal, pot, strip of cloth, pestle and mortar, limestone, and gloves do not need to be brought to [[Tirannwn]]. Players will use these items after returning to Ardougne prior to the second trip back.''' If players reach Tirannwn and realise that they have forgotten something, it is a ''very'' long journey back from the [[bank]]. ===Starting out === You may be approached by the [[King's Messenger]], but this is not required. Talk to [[King Lathas]]. He will tell you to go through the [[Underground Pass (dungeon)|Underground Pass]] again to the western darklands. Once there, you are to meet some scouts of his. '''You must speak to King Lathas''' and be informed of your new mission before going through the Underground Pass; otherwise, you will be unable to pass the [[dense forest]] on the other side of it. The quest log will indicate the quest is started by showing a description of what must be done rather than the requirements. ===First trip=== :'''Note:''' There are '''no''' accessible [[banks]] beyond the Underground Pass. {{Needed|[[Arrows]] that can be made into [[fire arrows]], a [[bow]] that can shoot them, a [[rope]], a [[spade]], gear and items to kill a level 110 enemy that uses melee, and at least 2-3 [[Agility]] [[boosts]] (such as 1-2 [[Summer pie]]s) if you are below level 56 Agility.|recommended=An [[axe]] or [[coins]] to buy food, tinderbox (to cook food), a form of [[antipoison]] (4 doses should be enough), [[weight-reducing clothing]], and a [[pickaxe]] if mining the [[limestone]] before it is required, though it can be obtained in the [[Limestone Mine]] instead. Armour is not required when using a safespot or [[Protect from Melee]]. [[Prayer potion]]s or a [[Falador shield]] may be used if using Prayer.}} See the [[Underground Pass (dungeon)|separate guide]] for how to get through the pass. If you have just enough [[agility potion]]s to complete the required elf traps, do not waste them here as it takes another voyage through the pass to get back to the elf lands. Once you are at [[Iban]]'s temple (where you encounter him during Underground Pass), go in and talk to [[Koftik]] if you require food. Simply climb down the [[Well of Voyage]] and go out of the cave. ===Isafdar === Welcome to Tirannwn! Go into the forest just a little bit and wait for an elf named [[Idris]] to spawn and start a dialogue with you. '''This may take a little while. If he spawns but does not talk to you, hop worlds and try again'''. He will question why you are here, but he is slain by [[Essyllt]] and [[Morvran]] before he has the chance to finish. They will tell you to talk to [[Lord Iorwerth]], who can be found at the camp in the north-west corner of the forest. Before proceeding with the quest, here is a detailed map of [[Tirannwn]]: [[File:Isafdar map.png|600px|centre]] As you navigate the forest, you will encounter four different obstacles: *[[Dense forest]]: You will learn how to navigate this obstacle after speaking to an [[Elf Tracker]] later in the quest. 56 [[Agility]] is required to push through the dense forest, though this is not required to return back to the starting point of this obstacle (e.g., returning from [[Tyras Camp]] to the forest). This obstacle cannot be failed. '''Note:''' Players under level 56 Agility can use the fact that most dense forests only have an Agility requirement one way through the forest. It is advised to attempt passing through the forest before taking a bite or sip from your boosting item. *[[Leaves (trap)|Leaf trap]]: This obstacle is a pitfall that appears as a circle of leaves on the ground. '''Click "Jump Over" on the side of the trap that is closest to where you are standing.''' If you ignore or fail the trap, you will fall through the leaves and lose 15 [[HP]]. *[[Tripwire]]: You will see two rocks connected by a thin wire with four small crossbows pointing at them. Right click between the rocks to step over the tripwire. If you ignore or fail the trap, you will lose 10 [[HP]] and be [[poison]]ed, starting at 2 HP. *[[Sticks (trap)|Stick trap]]: This obstacle appears as some sticks on the ground. Click "Pass" on the obstacle. If you ignore or fail the trap, you will lose 8 [[HP]]. If you stand in front of the trap by exactly one square, and repeatedly 'spam'-click the trap until your character moves over, you will negate any damage and never fail this trap, no matter your Agility level. If you stop clicking for just one tick, your character will attempt to walk, and may fail and take damage! So make sure to keep clicking until your characters moves automatically. === Getting through the forest=== Make your way to the [[Iorwerth Camp|Elf Camp]] in the north-west corner. See the map above for reference. Along the way you can kill and cook [[Rabbit|rabbits]] for food if needed. *From the [[Underground Pass (dungeon)|Underground Pass]] exit, go west and take the south split in the path to avoid the stick trap. * Keep going west until you see a leaf trap (pitfall) to the south. Jump over it. *Keep going south until you reach two small pools of water. Go west and cross the stick trap. *Go up the north-west path and jump over the leaf trap. Keep going north and cross the log balance (Level 45 Agility is required) to reach the camp. At the camp, speak with [[Lord Iorwerth]]. He will tell you to talk to his tracker after you tell him that [[King Lathas]] sent you. Go back down the path you took to reach the camp, but go south when you reach the stick trap. The [[Elf Tracker]] is at a small camp just north of the [[Poison Waste]]. He will not believe what you say since you are a human, so return to [[Lord Iorwerth]] to get a [[crystal pendant]]. Note that if you wish to keep the pendant as a souvenir, it '''must''' be [[drop trick]]ed every time you talk to Lord Iorwerth from now on, as well as when completing the quest by talking to [[King Lathas]] - otherwise it will be removed from your inventory or bank. Talk to the tracker again with the pendant in your possession. He will tell you to find the [[Tyras Camp]]. [[File:Tyras guard safespot.png|thumb|220px|A safespot is available to fight the Tyras guard.]] Click "Follow" on the footprints leading into the dense forest to the west. You will receive a message telling you that you are unable to follow the footprints. Return to the tracker and tell him. You will now be able to climb through dense forest if you have 56 [[Agility]]. Climb through the dense forest just west of the tracker and a level 110 [[Tyras guard]] will attack you, equipped with a [[steel halberd]]. Despite having a halberd, he does not have a 2-square attack range. You can use the mushrooms as a safespot or use [[Protect from Melee]] to make the fight easier ([[Prayer flicking]] is an option as he has a slow attack speed). If you take too long in killing him, he will despawn, and you will have to try to summon him again, or kill the guard by the entrance to the Tyras camp instead. This alternative guard does not despawn, but he does in fact have a 2-square attack range, and his safe spot is more difficult. Lure him to the clump of rocks directly north-east of the dense forest, trap him in the small hollow, and walk east out of his range. He will try to back away from you when you attack from outside his range, but will be caught in the rocks on his west and south. After you have killed one of these guards, proceed to the Tyras Camp, stepping over the tripwire to the north-west if you killed the first guard. Climb through the dense forest to the north and then go west. You will find [[Tyras Camp]] past the dense forest that is south of the [[catapult]]. If you killed the second guard, he may respawn if you do not enter the dense forest quickly enough but he will not attack you after you have killed him. Talk to [[General Hining]]. He will tell you that you can't see King Tyras. You can buy bread from the general store if you are low on food, but leave one space available for the [[Big Book of Bangs]], which will be given by Lord Iorwerth upon returning to him. Go back to the Elf Tracker, then talk to [[Lord Iorwerth]] '''(remember to drop the [[crystal pendant]] before talking to Iowerth if you are keeping it)'''. ===Getting the materials=== [[Lord Iorwerth]] will give you the [[Big Book of Bangs]]. '''Don't drop this book''' - you need it when in [[Rimmington]] later. Talk to Lord Iorwerth and ask him about all the items. In order to build the explosive, you will need a [[barrel of coal tar]], [[sulphur]], and [[limestone]]. Here is how to gather the materials: [[File:Regicide - Coal tar location.png|thumb|217x217px|The location to obtain the coal tar.]] #Take at least three [[barrel]]s from the Iorwerth camp because you can lose your coal tar when attempting to make the [[barrel of naphtha]]. Another barrel of naphtha will be required for the [[Mourning's End Part I]] quest, so extra barrels now will save time later. Two barrel spawns can be found in the north-east tent. Go back to the [[Elf Tracker]]. Go to the poison waste swamp south of the tracker and fill all your barrels with coal tar. See the image for where to obtain it. The target tile looks no different from the neighbouring grey swamp tiles, but has a "Take Coal Tar" option when hovered over. #Gather some of the [[sulphur]] from beside the poison waste swamp. You will only need one unless you lose the bomb. #If you wish to mine [[limestone]] in the forest, go east of the Iorwerth camp and through the dense forest, and north-east past the gates of [[Prifddinas]]. Find some [[limestone rock]]s and mine one piece of limestone. However, if low on inventory space, it may be more convenient to buy, or mine the limestone later at the [[Limestone Mine]] by the [[Odd Old Man]]. Make '''sure''' you have the [[Big Book of Bangs]], '''at least one [[barrel of coal tar]]''', and some [[sulphur]]. After this, it is safe to teleport out of Isafdar. ===Making the barrel of naphtha=== :'''Note:''' If you are planning to do [[Mourning's End Part I]], you may make an extra [[barrel of naphtha]] (''not'' a completed [[Barrel Bomb]]) and keep it in the bank. {{Needed|The [[Big Book of Bangs]], the [[barrel of coal tar|barrels of coal tar]] and at least 6-9 [[coal]] per barrel. Noted coal can be unnoted at [[Phials]] for 5 coins per coal or use the [[Corsair Cove]] bank.}} Go to [[East Ardougne]] and speak with [[Elena]], who will tell you to see the [[Chemist]] in [[Rimmington]]. Talk to the Chemist about the quest, and he will give you permission to use the distiller. Now, use a barrel of coal tar on the large distiller outside.[[File:Regicide_-_Distilling_naphtha.png|thumb|220x220px|The interface when making a barrel of naphtha.]] The barrel is only used to access the machine; as long as you leave the window open and have enough coal you can still do the distilling. All you need to do here is to get the green bar filled. You can configure the machine ''before'' using any coal. The valves can be clicked on their left side or their right side to control what side they go to. The idea of using this distiller is to keep pressure stable on its green area (this is the first segment that the needle reaches, the following one being red) and keep the heat on the green area (tips below) as long as possible while adding coal, but there is tolerance for mistakes. The pressure valve has 3 positions: Closed, controlled, and released (the last one resets pressure to 0, remember you need some pressure to make the naphtha), it is initially closed (handle on the left side). The tar regulator has 3 positions as well: Closed, intake, and afterburner, it is also initially closed and once you put it to intake (handle at the top) pressure will start going up. Let the pressure go up to the green area, but pay attention to the heat level. ''Add coal as needed, optimally to maintain the heat gauge in the green zone, but it could be played more safely by keeping it well below overheating.'' '''A very easy way to do this is:''' # Start by using the barrel of coal tar on the Fractionalising still. # Turn the valve on the right all the way to the third tick (all the way to the right). #Wait for the pressure gauge to land in the green zone. #Quickly turn the valve on the left to the second tick (in the middle) to halt the pressure in the green zone. If it landed in the red zone, you could turn the valve right to relieve some pressure, then back to the middle. #'''The valves never need to be touched again, and the pressure gauge can be ignored.''' # Add 2 coal, and then 1 additional coal whenever the heat gauge falls too low (below, or counterclockwise from, the green zone). '''Don't spam click the "add coal" button. If you add too much at once, it is likely to overheat''' and you will have to restart, but this does not make you lose your barrel of coal tar. Simply add more coal to start the process again. Optimally, the process is fast and may only likely use 6-9 coal. The bar on the bottom should start turning green. When it is full, stop adding coal and close the window to replace your empty barrel with a [[barrel of naphtha]]. To prevent confusion, note that the barrel of naphtha in your inventory looks almost identical to an empty barrel. ===Making the bomb=== *Limestone can be bought on the Grand Exchange, or can be mined on the path to [[Paterdomus]], north-east of [[Varrock]]. If you have completed [[Shades of Mort'ton]] you can buy cheap limestone from [[Razmire Keelgan|Razmire]] and you can get there quickly with [[Minigame Teleport]]. '''With gloves equipped''', use your [[limestone]] on a [[furnace]] to get [[quicklime]], then grind your quicklime with a [[pestle and mortar]] while carrying a [[pot]] to get a [[pot of quicklime]] (gloves are needed to prevent damage from handling the quicklime). You may choose to use the furnace in the [[Underground Pass (dungeon)]] to save time as you will be passing by it in the next segment. Just remember to bring all the ingredients listed below. *Grind the [[sulphur]] with a pestle and mortar to create [[ground sulphur]]. *Use four [[balls of wool]] on a [[loom]] to make a [[strip of cloth]]. (There is a loom in the [[Iorwerth Camp]], and another in the farm near [[Falador]].) *Mix the ground sulphur and pot of quicklime into your [[barrel of naphtha]]. *Use the strip of cloth on it to complete the [[barrel bomb]]. ===Regicide=== {{Needed|[[Spade]], [[bow]], [[arrows]], 2-3 [[rope]]s, a [[cooked rabbit]] (more easily obtainable if you bring an axe), [[tinderbox]] (even if you already have a cooked rabbit), [[barrel bomb]], [[agility potion]]s or [[Summer pie]]s (if boosting).|recommended=[[food]], [[antipoison]], [[axe]] (to cook a rabbit anywhere), an [[Ardougne teleport]], [[Stamina potion]]s and [[weight-reducing gear]] (such as [[Boots of Lightness]] or the [[Graceful outfit]]).}} [[File:Regicide_-_Regicide.png|thumb|220x220px|The barrel bomb destroys King Tyras' [[Burning tent (Regicide)|tent]].]]Now that you have the [[barrel bomb]], go all the way through the [[Underground Pass (dungeon)|Underground Pass]] one last time. The coal, gloves, pestle and mortar, pickaxe, and combat gear no longer need to be brought. Kill a [[rabbit]] and cook it on any fire. If you did not bring an [[axe]], there are lit fires in the [[Iorwerth Camp|Elven Camp]], as well as in [[Zul-Andra]] south of Tyras Camp. Then, go to the catapult outside the [[Tyras Camp]]. Talk to the guard, and give him some rabbit meat to distract him. Then, use the bomb on the catapult - you will need your tinderbox for this. (If you forgot your tinderbox, you can buy one from the General Store in the camp). You will see a cutscene of your character loading the barrel onto the catapult and launching it at [[King Tyras]]' camp, where it [[Burning tent (Regicide)|explodes on his tent]]. Go back to [[Lord Iorwerth]]. He will give you [[Iorwerths message|a letter]] to take to [[King Lathas]] and then give you access to the overground pass of [[Arandar]]. Teleport out, and go to [[Ardougne Castle]]. On the way, you will be approached by an elf named [[Arianwyn]] who will break the magic seal on the letter and tell you to read it. You will learn that King Tyras wasn't the main antagonist in the quest and that his brother King Lathas is actually the one serving the [[Dark Lord]]. Return the letter to King Lathas to complete the quest. '''Remember to drop the [[crystal pendant]] before talking to King Lathas if you want to keep it'''. '''Congratulations, quest complete!''' ==Rewards== {{Quest rewards |name=Regicide|image=[[File:Regicide reward scroll.png|centre]]|qp=3|rewards=*{{SCP|Agility|13,750|link=yes}} experience *15,000 [[coins]] *Access to the elven kingdom of [[Tirannwn]] and the overpass of [[Arandar]] *Ability to wield the [[Dragon halberd]] (with level 60 [[Attack]] and 30 [[Strength]]) *The ability to charter a [[Charter ship|ship]] to [[Port Tyras]] or dock a boat there with 66 [[Sailing]] *The ability to use [[Iorwerth camp teleport]] scrolls *The ability to use [[Zul-Andra teleport]] scrolls *The ability to use the {{Fairycode|BJS}} [[Fairy ring]] *The ability to attempt [[the Gwenith Glide]], a [[Barracuda Trial]] }} ==Required for completing== Completion of Regicide is required for the following: {{legend|orangered|caption=Romeo}} {{legend|lawngreen|caption=Juliet '''(upper floor)'''}} {{legend|yellow|caption=Father Lawrence}} {{legend|steelblue|caption=Apothecary}} {{legend|magenta|caption=Cadava berries}} }} ===Starting out=== [[File:Romeo chathead.png|left]] [[Romeo]] can be found in or near [[Varrock Square]]. Speak to him, and he'll ramble about his love for [[Juliet]]. Ask him if you can help, and he'll ask you to talk to her in her mansion. ===Speaking to Juliet=== [[File:Juliet chathead.png|left]] Go and talk to Juliet, located on the upper floor balcony of the [[Leptoc mansion|mansion]] directly west of the [[Varrock west bank]], just outside the western walls of Varrock. If you cannot find Romeo, he may have wandered inside the [[general store]] located south of the square. ===Father Lawrence=== After delivering the letter to Romeo, he will despair upon learning that Juliet's father opposes their marriage. He suggests going to [[Father Lawrence]] for help, who is located in the [[Varrock church]] north-east of the square. After speaking to Father Lawrence, he will suggest that you fake Juliet's death by giving her a [[cadava potion]] to appear dead, so that Romeo can later collect her from the crypt. He will ask you to go to the [[Apothecary]] who will be able to make one for you. ===The potion=== '''''Note:''' You can save some time by having the cadava berries required for the potion in your inventory before speaking to the apothecary. Consider also picking one extra for the quest [[Making Friends with My Arm]]. [[Ironman]] players are recommended to grab some [[redberries]] at the same time as the [[cadava berries]], for use in later quests.'' [[File:Apothecary chathead.png|left|frameless]] The Apothecary can be found in south-western Varrock located west of the [[Varrock Swordshop]], in a building with a purple potion icon. Speak to him about the quest (selecting 'Talk about something else' first) and he will ask you to bring him some [[cadava berries]] to finish the potion. Cadava berries can be picked from several bushes just west of the [[South-east Varrock mine|south-east Varrock mine]]. Return to the Apothecary with the berries and he will give you the [[cadava potion]]. '''Be careful not to drink the potion yourself''', as this will cause the player to black out for a short amount of time. [[File:Romeo & Juliet - Crypt.png|thumb|Romeo and Juliet in the crypt.]]Now, head back to Juliet, and give her the potion. You will now see a cutscene of her "dying", though she really falls into a coma. {{Listen |title = [[Cadava Potion (Romeo & Juliet)|Cadava Potion]] |align = right |filename = Cadava Potion (Romeo & Juliet).ogg |desc = The jingle that plays while Juliet drinks the potion.}} ===To the crypt=== Go back to Romeo, and tell him that he must rescue Juliet from the [[Varrock crypt|crypt]]. He needs someone to accompany him, which ends up being you. You will now see another cutscene of you entering the crypt with Romeo. When he sees Juliet's cousin, [[Phillipa]], he forgets all about Juliet and falls in love with her. {{Listen |title = [[Romeo Falls in Love (Romeo & Juliet)|Romeo Falls in Love]] |align = right |filename = Romeo Falls in Love (Romeo & Juliet).ogg |desc = The jingle that plays when romeo falls in love again.}} '''Congratulations, quest complete!''' ==Rewards== {{Quest rewards|name=Romeo & Juliet|image=[[File:Romeo & Juliet reward scroll.png|centre]]|qp=5|rewards=}} ==Required for completing== Completion of Romeo & Juliet is required for the following: *[[Making Friends with My Arm]] *[[Defender of Varrock]] ==Transcript== {{hastranscript|quest}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 14 January 2026 |update = New Player Improvements Round 2 |change = The quest's journal entry was updated to make it more intuitive. }} {{Subject changes |date = 14 May 2020 |update = Bounty Hunter Feedback Changes |change = All of the free-to-play quest journals have been updated to be more informative. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ==Trivia== *Multiple [[cadava potion]]s can be obtained by dropping the one that's in your inventory and asking for another, though this item has no use outside of the quest. *If you talk to Draul Leptoc, Juliet's father, while carrying the [[cadava potion]], he'll notice it and mention it in his dialogue. *If you talk to Juliet again after the quest, she will seem fed up with Romeo. If you speak to Romeo, he will still be mistaken about Juliet's "death," and will pine after Phillipa. *'Draul Leptoc' is an anagram of 'Lord Capulet', Juliet's father in the original ''Romeo and Juliet''. *Romeo & Juliet was removed from ''RuneScape 3'' on 21 September 2010 and replaced with {{RSL|Gunnar's Ground}}. {{Romeo & Juliet}}
