==Walkthrough==
===Starting out===
Speak to [[Vanstrom Klause]], the man sat down in the north-east corner of the [[Hair of the Dog]] tavern in [[Canifis]]. He wants you to deliver some weapons to [[the Myreque]], a group of rebels fighting against the [[vampyres]] that rule over Morytania. If you agree to help Vanstrom, he will also tell you about a boatman in [[Mort'ton]] who is rumoured to be able to show you the Myreque hideout.

===Convincing Cyreg Paddlehorn===
{{Map|align=right|name=Cyreg Paddlehorn|x=3519|y=3284|r=3|mtype=square|caption=Cyreg's location, east of Mort'ton.|width=250|height=250}}
{{Needed|[[Druid pouch]] (must have 5 charges), [[Silver sickle (b)|blessed silver sickle]] (if refilling the pouch), 6  [[plank|normal plank]]s, a [[hammer]], 225 [[steel nails]], [[combat gear]] (for level 97 [[Skeleton Hellhound]]), 10 [[coins]] or [[Ring of Charos(a)]], [[steel longsword]], 2 [[steel sword]]s, [[steel mace]], [[steel warhammer]], [[steel dagger]] (all the steel weapons must be held in your [[inventory]] at the same time). You will also need the planks, unless you have completed the [[Shades of Mort'ton]] quest and opened the general store}}

Go to [[Mort'ton]]. You can walk on foot, but beware that the ghasts on the way will drain charges from your [[Druid pouch]] - you may consider taking six [[Mort myre fungus]] in your inventory so you can refill the pouch when you arrive. If you've unlocked [[Fairy ring|fairy rings]] and have at least 50 [[Agility]], you may skip the Mort Myre Swamp using the fairy ring west of Canifis and entering {{fairycode|bip}}, then using the agility shortcut to arrive south of the swamp.

Find [[Cyreg Paddlehorn]]. He is located on the eastern edge of Mort'ton, near his boat at the bridge leading to the Barrows. Attempt to persuade him to bring you to [[the Myreque]]. Cyreg will be very secretive about how to find them though, so you will have to choose the correct sequence of responses to make him feel guilty in order for him to allow you to use his boat. The steel weapons must all be in the inventory to continue dialogue. Choose the following responses in this order:
#''Well, I guess they'll just die without weapons... (2)''
#''Resourceful enough to get their own steel weapons? (2)''
#''If you don't tell me, their deaths are on your head! (3)''
#''What kind of man are you to say that you don't care? (3)''

He will decline to take you himself, but will allow you to rent his boat provided you prove that you have some defence against the ghasts. He will also request 3 planks to fix his boat and 3 to fix a bridge. The player will show him the [[druid pouch]] with at least five charges. Give him the planks and he will give you directions to the hideout. Finally board the boat to travel to [[The Hollows]]; A [[Ring of Charos(a)]] may be used to avoid paying the 10 gold to rent the boat.

'''Note''': Do not repair the bridge in the next section before you've followed the prior steps, or you will need to do so again.

===Myreque===
[[File:In Search of the Myreque - Bridge repair.png|thumb|250px|Repairing the rope bridge.]]
{{Map|3509,3448|align=right|width=250|height=250|mtype=square|r=3|caption=Location of the doors leading into the Myreque's hideout.}}
Once you land at [[The Hollows]], go north, avoiding the [[ghast]]s, until you see a strange tree. Climb up to see a damaged [[Rope bridge (The Hollows)|rope bridge]]. Mend the bridge as you walk along, which requires 75 [[steel nails]] per [[plank]] (225 steel nails total) and three [[plank]]s, and then climb down the other side of the bridge.

Go north to the strange-looking hollow tree and talk to [[Curpile Fyod]] out front. Tell him you've brought the weapons for [[the Myreque]] and then answer some questions for him to prove that you are indeed telling the truth. 
Here are the answers to the possible questions:
{| class="wikitable"
!Question
!Answer
|-
|'' Name the only female member of the Myreque.''||Sani Piliu
|-
|''Who is the leader of the Myreque in Mort Myre?''||Veliaf Hurtz
|-
|''What is the name of the boatman who helps the Myreque?''||Cyreg Paddlehorn
|-
|''Which member of the Myreque was originally a scholar?''||Polmafi Ferdygris
|-
|''Who is the youngest member of the Myreque?''||Ivan Strom
|-
|''What vampyre family rules over Morytania?''||Drakan
|}

'''Note''': If you fail to answer the questions correctly, you will be knocked unconscious and wake up at the boat again, but luckily the bridge will still be intact and your druid pouch will not need the full five charges to re-board the boat.

When you have correctly answered the guard's questions, circle around his tree to the north, and the set of doors in the earth there will be unlocked. Enter and proceed to follow the path to the north west. Halfway up there is an eastern alcove. In the south eastern corner there is a hidden cave entrance - click on the wall to enter (you can rotate your camera to see the entrance).

First speak to [[Veliaf Hurtz|Veliaf]], and he will ask you to introduce yourself to the other five members. Initiate a conversation with each member - it isn't necessary to actually ask any questions of them to continue the quest, just say, "I'll be back later", and then talk to another one.

'''Note''': Combat with the [[Skeleton Hellhound]] will begin immediately after you talk to Veliaf, read the next section to read tips on the fight.

Go back and talk to Veliaf again about the weapons, and he will accept them. However...

===Vanstrom Klause===
As you give the weapons, a [[cutscene]] ensues where a strange mist envelopes the room, and Veliaf realises that it is a [[vampyre]]. The mist shifts, revealing [[Vanstrom Klause]], the stranger you were trying to help. He transforms into his vampyre form and kills [[Sani Piliu]] and [[Harold Evans]] with Blood Burst. After performing the murders, Vanstrom disappears, before summoning a level 97 [[Skeleton Hellhound]], his "little gift" to finish off the remaining members. In order to regain [[the Myreque]]'s trust after having lured Vanstrom to them, you must kill the hellhound.
[[File:In Search of the Myreque - Skeleton Hellhound safespot.png|thumb|The safespot for killing the hellhound with magic attacks.]]
After the cutscene ends, the hellhound will immediately attack you. There is a [[safespot]] in the upper eastern corner of the room on the south side of the chair. Using [[Magic]] is recommended as the hellhound has no Magic defence and is weak to [[Earth spells]]. The hellhound only has 55 [[Hitpoints]], but hits fairly hard; lower levels should bring [[food]]. If you have access to [[Protect from Melee]], the fight will be much easier.

'''Note''': You may leave the chamber during the fight, which will cause the hellhound to respawn close to the entrance once you re-enter. Dying in the chamber will cause your gravestone to appear outside of the room. Returning to the area via the boat will not require you to have a druid pouch, and the bridge will not need repairing. Note that if you die, you cannot return via [[fairy ring]] {{fairycode|dls}} until the quest is completed.

After defeating the hellhound, talk to Veliaf Hurtz who'll say he needs to speak to his superior in order to instate you into the Myreque; you can also ask him more questions about the Myreque and Vanstrom. Finally, ask him how to leave the hideout; he tells you about a secret passage to [[Canifis]]. 

====The Myreque shortcut====
{{Main|Myreque Hideout}}
[[File:The Hollows map.png|frame|centre|The dungeon underneath [[Hair of the Dog]] Inn houses the [[Myreque Hideout|Myreque's hideout]].]]
{{Map|3495,3464|align=right|width=250|height=250|mtype=square|r=3|caption=The Myreque shortcut can be accessed via the trapdoor behind the Canifis pub.}}
Leave the chamber, and search the wall at the end of the tunnel; it will open. Now, climb up the ladder.

'''Note:''' Exiting through the trap door is a requirement of the quest. Exiting through any other method will require travelling here again to complete the quest.

You will surface south of the tavern. The nearby trapdoor leads back to the cave, which you can use as an alternate route back to [[Mort'ton]] in the future.

Proceed back into the tavern and seek out [[Vanstrom Klause]], only to find that Vanstrom isn't there but only a [[Stranger (In Search of the Myreque)|Stranger]]. Speak to him to complete the quest.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

Talk to [[Duke Horacio]] on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} of [[Lumbridge Castle]], and ask if he has any quests to give out. He will explain that although he himself has no tasks for the player, he did find a strange talisman. Curious about its origin, he will give you an [[air talisman]] and ask you to bring it to the arch mage of the [[Wizards' Tower]].

:'''Tip''': Multiple [[Air talisman|air talismans]] can be obtained by using the [[drop trick]] at [[Duke Horacio]]. This may be useful for early runecraft training methods. For details, see [[Money making guide/Collecting air talismans|this guide]].''

Go to the Wizards' Tower found south of [[Draynor Village]], and descend the ladder into the basement to talk to [[Archmage Sedridor]]. He will take your air talisman and give you a [[research package]] to deliver to [[Aubury]] in [[Varrock]].

He will also offer the player a cup of tea, which will completely restore [[energy|run energy]] if accepted.

==Walkthrough==
===Scattered scorpions===
{{Map|name=Sorcerer's Tower|x=2702|y=3405|zoom=2|align=right|caption=The location of the Sorcerer's Tower.|width=200|height=200}}
[[File:Thormac chathead.png|left|frameless|80px]]
Talk to [[Thormac]] on the top floor of the [[Sorcerer's Tower]], just south-east of the [[Ranging Guild]] and south of [[Seers' Village]]. He'll tell you that his rare [[Kharid Scorpion]]s have escaped and are currently running loose. He'll give you a [[Scorpion cage]] to catch the scorpions with and suggest you go talk to the Seers that live just to the north.

Speak with any Seer in Seers' Village. He will tell you that the first scorpion is in a secret room with nasty spiders nearby. This is the [[Taverley Dungeon]].

:'''Note''': The secret room is '''only''' accessible once you have spoken to the seer about the location of the first scorpion. Once that is done, you can now catch the three scorpions in any order and may skip talking to the Seer again to find their locations.
{{Clear|left}}

[[File:Kharid Scorpion.png|left|frameless|80px]]
{{Map|2877,9796|name=Kharid Scorpion|width=250|height=250|r=3|mtype=square|mapID=20|caption=The location of the first scorpion, in the [[Taverley Dungeon]].|align=right}}
'''Note''': In the following section, low levelled players are '''highly recommended''' to use an [[anti-dragon shield]] when passing the [[blue dragon]]s, as their dragonfire can inflict up to 50 damage, which the shield reduces by roughly 80%. If used in combination with an [[antifire potion]], the player will gain full immunity. If you have not started [[Dragon Slayer I]] to obtain the shield, read the following sections for a more difficult strategy to avoid the dragonfire. The blue dragons may also be skipped if you have 80 [[Agility]].

Make your way to the [[Taverley Dungeon]]. Once inside, you can skip the following steps if you have 70+ [[Agility]], by either using the [[shortcut]] to the [[blue dragon]]s (70 Agility) or the [[shortcut]] directly to the [[poison spider]]s (80 Agility).

If you cannot use the shortcuts, a [[dusty key]] is required to enter the section of the dungeon that the scorpion is located in. If you do not already have one, follow the track towards the [[Black Knights' Base]] and kill the [[jailer]] located in the eastern area of the base, who will drop a [[jail key]]. Use the jail key on the door of the cell containing [[Velrak the explorer]]. Speak to him; ask if there are any good places to explore, and when he asks you if you want to go further into the dungeon, say yes and he will give you a dusty key. Head to the blue dragons area.

Walk south of the blue dragons, west to pass the [[black demon]]s, and north to the [[poison spider]]s. To the south of the two coffins, there's a small room with a false wall that you can search to open (see the map). If you are unable to open the door, you probably did not speak with the seer about the first scorpion.

Use the [[scorpion cage]] on the small scorpion inside this room to catch it ''(if you try to pick it up, it will sting you for 3 [[Hitpoints]] of damage)''.

'''Strategy without [[anti-dragon shield]]:''' When running past the blue dragons, ensure a [[baby blue dragon]] is fighting you at all times (they do not breathe dragonfire). The dungeon is single-combat, so the more dangerous blue dragons will not attack you while you are in combat. Avoid standing too close to adult dragons, and hop from baby to baby and draw their aggression when passing through. This strategy is not recommended for [[hardcore ironman|hardcore ironmen]] who are not confident they know what they are doing.

{{Map|3058,3488|name=Kharid Scorpion|plane=1|caption=The location of the second scorpion.|width=200|height=200|r=3|mtype=square|align=left}}

===The second scorpion===
{{Needed|skills={{SCP|Prayer|31}} {{Boostable|no}} to enter the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} of the [[Edgeville Monastery]]}}
The second scorpion is on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} of the [[Edgeville Monastery]]. To enter the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} you'll need to speak with [[Abbot Langley]] to join their guild ({{SCP|Prayer|31}}). You do not have to do this again if you have already done it.

Climb the south-east ladder in the Monastery. The scorpion will be either right at the top of the ladder, or in the bedroom directly north of the ladder. Use your cage on it to catch it.

===The third scorpion===
{{Map|2553,3570|name=Kharid Scorpion|caption=The location of the third scorpion.|width=200|height=200|r=3|mtype=square|align=right}}

The third scorpion is in the [[Barbarian Outpost Agility Course]] (requires completion of [[Alfred Grimhand's Barcrawl]]), found in the north eastern gated building. The scorpion will be wandering just inside the entrance. Use your cage on it to catch it.

Finally, bring the full [[scorpion cage]] to [[Thormac]].

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

==Walkthrough==
===The Fishing Platform===
{{Needed|swamp paste|recommended=small fishing net for a medium [[Ardougne Diary]] task}}
[[File:Caroline chathead.png|left|frameless]]
[[File:Sea Slug - Patching up the boat.png|thumb|200px|Starting the quest.]]
Talk to [[Caroline]] on the coast north of the town of [[Witchaven]], east of [[Ardougne]]. She will tell you her husband [[Kent]] took her son [[Kennith]] to the [[Fishing Platform]] a week ago, and she hasn't heard from them since; other families have not heard from the fishermen there either. She wants you to talk to [[Holgart]], who has a boat that can take you to the platform to investigate.

Talk to [[Holgart]], and he will tell you his ship is in need of repairs. He will ask for [[swamp paste]] ('''not swamp tar''') to fix it up. Once you give him it, Holgart will appear in a cut scene fixing the boat. Talk to him again to go to the Fishing Platform.

===Investigate===
[[File:Bailey chathead.png|left|frameless]]
[[File:Sea Slug - Speaking with bailey.png|thumb|200px|Talking to Bailey.]]
When you arrive, you will notice the odd behaviour of everyone as they all seem to be in a zombie-like trance. Avoid interacting with the [[sea slug (race)|sea slug]]s; they will deal 3 damage if picked up.

'''Note:''' If you brought a [[small fishing net]], you can catch a fish here to complete a task for the medium [[Ardougne Diary]].

Look around and find [[Bailey]] inside a small room in the south-west corner of the platform. Talk to him, he will tell you about the odd happenings and the hauling up of the sea slugs. Pick up the [[broken glass]] on the floor for later in the quest.

===Helping Kennith===
{{Needed|skills={{SCP|Firemaking|30}} to use [[dry sticks]] to light the [[unlit torch]]}}
[[File:Sea Slug - Drying damp sticks.png|thumb|left|130px|Using the glass to dry the sticks.]]
[[File:Sea Slug - Rescuing Kennith.png|thumb|200px|Using the crane to save Kennith.]]
Pick up some [[damp sticks]] close to the ladder in the north-east corner of the platform, then climb up the ladder. Upstairs, in a room on the west side, past the crane, you will find [[Kennith]]. He will tell you that his father tried to leave days ago, but the fishermen stopped him from doing so. He will ask you to find his father, [[Kent]] and help him.

Go back to [[Holgart]] and talk to him. He will take you to a deserted island, where you will find Kennith's father stranded. Talk to Kent and he will tell you his story. Then ask Holgart to take you back to the platform. Talk to [[Bailey]] to find out the slugs' weakness - they are afraid of heat. He will give you an [[unlit torch]], which he cannot light himself as it is too damp. Use the [[broken glass]] on the [[damp sticks]], which are found near the ladder to [[Dry sticks|dry them]], then rub them together to '''light the torch''' ({{SCP|Firemaking|30}}). If you do not light it now, you will be damaged by a fisherman when going upstairs.

Climb up the ladder again (on the north-east of the platform), go into the room, and talk to [[Kennith]]. From outside the room, kick the [[badly repaired wall]] to make an opening, then use your lit torch on any fisherman or sea slugs nearby and then talk to Kennith again. Rotate the [[crane (Sea Slug)|crane]] to save him, shown in a cut scene. Talk to [[Holgart]] to return to shore. Finish the quest by talking to [[Caroline]].

== Introduction ==
Like [[Cook's Assistant]], this quest is designed to help players explore the starting area of [[Lumbridge]]. New players are encouraged to follow the steps below to explore different parts of the town; however, collecting and spinning the wool are optional, as the balls of wool are tradeable between players and sold in stores. The fastest way to complete the quest is to simply buy 20 balls of wool from the [[Grand Exchange]] and then give them to Fred.{{Map|x=3189|y=3274|r=4|mtype=square|caption=Fred the Farmer's location.|align=right|width=250|height=250}}
==Walkthrough==
[[File:Fred the Farmer chathead.png|left|frameless|width=100x100]]
Speak to [[Fred the Farmer]] at his sheep farm, found slightly north of the [[Lumbridge Castle]]. Ask about a quest, and he will task you with bringing him 20 [[balls of wool]].  

===Obtaining the wool===
{{Needed|recommended=21 free inventory spaces (24 if doing Prince Ali Rescue)}}
[[File:Lumbridge Sheep chathead.png|left|frameless]]
If you did not bring [[shears]], Fred will give you some. Enter the fenced area connected to the east side of the house where the [[sheep]] are.
[[File:Sheep Shearer - Spinning wheel.png|thumb|The [[spinning wheel]] on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} of [[Lumbridge Castle]].]]

'''Note''': Players planning to do the [[free-to-play]] quest [[Prince Ali Rescue]] are advised to shear and spin at least three more [[ball of wool|balls of wool]].

Shear the sheep, either by selecting the "shear" option on the sheep, or right-clicking the shears and selecting "use," then clicking the sheep. After shearing them, the skinny looking sheep will grow back their wool after one minute. If they run away while shearing, just keep trying.

Avoid the [[rams]], which look like regular sheep with horns. They cannot be sheared, and it is easy to accidentally attack them. The pen also contains "[[Sheep (penguins)|The Thing]]", which Fred warned the player about. This is actually two penguins in disguise as a sheep, and attempting to shear it will cause the penguins to squeak and run away from you. It can be identified as the only sheep with the "Talk to" option, and poses no danger during the quest. "The Thing" is later encountered during the [[Cold War]] quest.

Low-level players may consider setting their [[Settings#Controls|attack options]] to "Hidden" for the duration of this quest to avoid entering combat with them by accident.

[[File:Sheep Shearer - Abnormal sheep.png|thumb|The two [[penguin]]s disguised as a [[sheep]].]]

=== Spinning the wool ===
Once you have 20 pieces of [[wool]], they must be spun into balls of wool. Go to the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} of the [[Lumbridge Castle]], and find the bedroom on the south end of the castle. Inside is a [[spinning wheel]]; click on the wheel with the wool in your [[inventory]] to spin your wool into balls. When they are all spun, go back to Fred the Farmer to finish the quest. If you do not have the space to carry all 20 pieces of wool, you can make smaller deliveries until you reach the required total. Note that Fred will not accept [[Banknote|noted]] balls of wool.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

'''Sheep Herder''' is a novice quest associated with the [[Elf quest series]]. It begins with the revelation that some sheep have been infected with plague. The target of the quest is to herd the sick sheep, kill them and dispose of their remains to prevent the plague from spreading to the town. Herding the sheep can prove challenging, since they are not very cooperative.

==Details==

|leagueRegion = <poem>
{{LeagueRegion|Kandarin}} — location requirement
Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Tirannwn}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest
</poem>
}}

==Walkthrough==
===A threat to public health and safety===
{{Needed|100 [[coins]]}}
{{Map|x=2617|y=3299|r=3|mtype=square|align=right|caption=The quest's start point.|width=250|height=250}}

Speak to [[Councillor Halgrive]] located in [[East Ardougne]] in the graveyard directly south of the church.

He is concerned about [[Sick-looking sheep|plagued sheep]] located near East Ardougne that escaped from a local farm, causing a threat to the health and safety for the public. He is looking for someone to herd the sheep, kill them quickly and cleanly, and dispose the remains in a special [[incinerator (Sheep Herder)|incinerator]] set up by [[Farmer Brumty]].

Agree to help do the job. He will happily thank you and mention you need a [[plague suit]] while herding the sheep. He will tell you to pick up the plague suit from [[Doctor Orbon]] and hand you some poisoned [[sheep feed]].

Head inside the church and talk to Doctor Orbon. After explaining you need protective clothing to dispose the escaped infected sheep, he will sell his last suit for 100 [[coins]] so he can afford a replacement for himself. Agree to pay for the suit, and you should receive a plague jacket and plague trousers. Pray with missing [[Prayer points]] at the [[altar]] to complete an easy task in the [[Ardougne diary]].

===Herding the sheep===
{{Needed|[[Plague jacket]], [[plague trousers]]}}
{{Map|align=right|mtype=pin|caption=Location of the sheep.
|2609,3389,title:Location of the yellow sheep,icon:yellowPin,desc:
|2620,3368,title:Location of the green sheep,icon:greenPin,desc:
|2608,3346,title:Location of the red sheep,icon:redPin,desc:
|2569,3383,title:Location of the blue sheep,icon:bluePin,desc:
}}
Head to the fenced in enclosure located north-west of the north bank in [[East Ardougne]]. With your [[plague suit]] equipped, enter the gate on the west side of the enclosure. Head towards the incinerator where you will find a [[cattleprod]] lying on the ground a few steps south of the incinerator. Pick it up. 

Leave the fenced in enclosure using the west gate. You can begin to dispose of the sheep by equipping the cattleprod and using it to direct the sheep into the fenced in enclosure using the west gate. The sheep will be prodded in the direction of which you are facing. The sheep can return back to their initial locations if you wait too long to prod. '''You only need one of each colour (in any order)''', and you can finish one sheep at a time.

Note: You can have a friend join you and body block the sheep, preventing them from going farther than desired and also prevent them from going back to their original location. 

*Red sheep are located north of the north bank in East Ardougne.
*Green sheep are north-east of the red sheep, directly north of a fenced in area with chopped and fallen trees.
*Blue sheep are located north-west of the fenced in enclosure with the incinerator, nearby a small camp with [[Warrior (Thieving)|warriors]]. Do not go too far, as there are also aggressive level 42 [[moss giant]]s nearby.
*Yellow sheep are located south of the [[Fishing Guild]].

Note: If a sheep goes '''''BAAAAA!''''' (uppercase letters), it will be prodded in the direction you direct them towards. If a sheep goes '''''Baa''''', it will return to its initial location. When directing them to the fenced in pen with the incinerator located, it is better to spam click the sheep so that it does not walk back. If the sheep gets stuck against a corner or wall, prod them again, this will cause them to move towards an open tile. Make sure you prod the sheep one last time to get it IN the pen when you are close.
[[File:Sheep Herder - Sheep.png|thumb|All four sheep in the pen.]]

===Killing the plagued sheep===
{{Needed|[[Plague jacket]], [[plague trousers]], [[Sheep feed|poisoned sheep food]]}}

Once you have directed them to the gate of the incinerator, the sheep will automatically go inside the gate. Use the [[Sheep feed|poisoned sheep food]] to kill each sheep. Collect their bones and use them on the incinerator to burn the remains.

Return to [[Councillor Halgrive]] and tell him you disposed of the four sheep. He will reimburse you the 100 [[coins]] you spent for the protective clothing in addition to 3,000 coins as recognition of your service.

'''Congratulations! Quest completed!'''

:'''Note''': If you have already completed [[The Giant Dwarf]], skip the following step and go straight to [[Thurgo]]; otherwise you must talk to Reldo before you may continue.

Talk to Reldo in the [[Varrock Palace]] library, the northernmost room on the ground floor. Ask him what he knows about Imcando dwarves, and he will point you towards [[Mudskipper Point]], just south of [[Port Sarim]].

:'''Note:''' If you still need ingredients for the [[redberry pie]] required in the following section, you can take the [[pie dish]] from the kitchen to the east now, then pick [[redberries]] by the [[South-east Varrock mine]].
 
{{Map|name=Thurgo|x=3001|y=3144|r=2|mtype=square|align=right|caption=The location of Thurgo, an Imcando dwarf.|width=200|height=200}}

===Thurgo the Imcando dwarf===
{{Needed|[[Redberry pie]]|recommended=Fast travel method to Falador}}
[[File:Thurgo chathead.png|left|frameless|80px]]
Head south of [[Port Sarim]] to find [[Thurgo]] on the west side of a hill, in his hut with the anvil. Ask him if he would like some [[redberry pie]], and he will take some and eat it. Ask if he can make a special sword, and he requests that you bring him a picture of the lost sword as a reference.
{{Clear|left}}
===Acquiring the picture===
[[File:Portrait detail.png|left|100px|frameless]]
Return to the Squire in the Falador Castle courtyard again, and he will mention that a [[portrait]] of Sir Vyvin's father includes the sword.

'''Note:''' You must have spoken to the squire before you may obtain the portrait.

From the courtyard of the [[White Knights' Castle]] in [[Falador]], go east through three doors, and then up the ladder. Go west through the door and then further west through the open doorway, then up the staircase. Sir Vyvin's room will be directly to the south. 

You need to obtain the portrait by searching the [[Cupboard (The Knight's Sword)|cupboard]] inside his room, but Sir Vyvin will stop you if he is inside the room and looking towards the player. Open the door to his room and wait for him to walk out, or hop worlds until you find one where he is outside the room, then take the portrait from the cupboard.

===Mining the blurite===
{{Needed|A [[pickaxe]], the portrait, 2 [[iron bar]]s (4 if making extra sword)|recommended=Food and plate armour (slash resistant) for low levels, fast travel method to Mudskipper Point and Falador|skills={{SCP|Mining|10}} to mine [[blurite ore]]}}
[[File:Asgarnia_Ice_Dungeon_safespot.png|thumb|left|220px|Safespot by the cave entrance sign.]]
[[File:Asgarnian_Ice_Dungeon.png|thumb|right|240px|The Asgarnia Ice Dungeon.]]
Return to [[Thurgo]] and give him the portrait. He now knows a [[blurite sword]] is what he needs to make, and you must obtain the [[blurite ore]] for it. This ore is only found in the [[Asgarnia Ice Dungeon]], located on the hill to the north east. '''All enemies in the dungeon are [[aggressive]], so get ready to run past them'''. Head down the ladder on the hill, run north through the dungeon until you reach the pirates, then head east down the first corridor and enter the large icy room, which contains several bright blue rocks to mine for the ore. At the south-eastern end of the icy room, there is an entrance to the [[skeletal wyvern]]s section of the cave. Standing directly in front of this entrance is a [[safespot]], which you may wait in until it is safe to mine the nearby rocks.

'''Note''': Mine 1-2 extra if you are planning to complete the easy [[Falador Diary]] and/or want your own [[blurite sword]].
{{Clear}}

===Creating the sword===
{{Needed|2 [[iron bar]]s (4 if making extra sword), [[blurite ore]] (2 if making extra sword)|recommended=an additional [[redberry pie]] if doing [[The Giant Dwarf]]}}
[[File:Blurite sword detail.png|left|80px|frameless]]
Return to [[Thurgo]] with your [[blurite ore]]s and your iron bars and he will make you a sword. If you want a sword for yourself, drop it and ask Thurgo for a replacement, then pick up the second sword again.

'''Note''': [[Members]] planning on doing [[The Giant Dwarf]] soon after this quest are recommended to give Thurgo an additional [[redberry pie]] now to avoid a return trip during that quest.

Go back to the [[Squire]] and he will take one of your blurite swords.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

'''Tai Bwo Wannai Trio''' is a [[quest]] that follows where [[Jungle Potion]] left off. The chief of [[Tai Bwo Wannai]] requests your help in reuniting his sons, requiring you to seek each of the three out and help them in a specific task. One requires aid in defeating [[the Shaikahan]], another seeks the knowledge to catch [[Karambwan]], and the third seeks some unusual foodstuffs before he'll return to the village. Completing their individual tasks requires coordinating between the sons. Upon completing said tasks, the sons return to Tai Bwo Wannai.

==Walkthrough==
{{Map:Tai Bwo Wannai Geo}}<!-- This map does not use the regular template as it cannot draw text labels; the GeoJSON used as an alternative is rather bloated, and is therefore placed in mapspace and transcluded here-->
===Introduction (visiting Timfraku)===
{{Needed|A [[knife]], [[Karamjan rum]] (or 30 coins), and a [[banana]].|recommended=[[Amulet of glory]], [[Antipoison]]}}

Teleport to the [[Musa Point]] banana plantation with your [[amulet of glory]] and pick a banana if you do not already have one. Then, go south to the [[Karamja Wines, Spirits, and Beers|Karamja Spirits Bar]] and purchase [[Karamjan rum|Karamja Rum]]. Slice the [[banana]] using your knife (or a spear) and add the [[sliced banana]] to your rum, making sure not to accidentally eat the sliced banana. Make sure you combine the sliced banana with the rum '''before''' you leave the island, or the rum will break. The rum combined with sliced banana will be necessary in a later part of the quest.

After obtaining the Karamjan rum, travel south to [[Tai Bwo Wannai]] (fairy ring {{Fairycode|CKR}}) and talk with [[Timfraku]] upstairs in the north-west house with a quest [[icon]] above it. Talk with him, and say that [[Trufitus]] sent you. Talk to him again, and when he thanks you for what you have done so far, pick the option "So far??" and he will ask you to gather his sons, [[Tamayu]], [[Tiadeche]], and [[Tinsay]], in the village. {{Colour|Red|Warning}}: The [[Tribesmen]] in and around Tai Bwo Wannai are aggressive to players level 64 and under and deal very high poison damage, easily killing unprepared low-level players. The general store north of Tai Bwo Wannai sells [[antipoison]]s if you forgot to bring some.

:'''''Optional:''''' To avoid accidentally banking/losing the [[Karamjan rum (sliced banana)]], you can visit Tinsay at [[Cairn Isle]] (near fairy ring {{Fairycode|CKR}}) and give it to him. This will fulfil the first of three requests he makes later on.
{{clear|right}}
===Tamayu===
{{Needed|A [[small fishing net]], a [[pestle and mortar]] or 6 gold, an [[Agility potion|Agility potion(4)]] and one of any of the following spears: [[iron spear]], [[steel spear]], [[mithril spear]], [[adamant spear]], [[rune spear]], or [[dragon spear]]. Tamayu will accept any spear given to him, but only the ones listed will work for completing the quest|recommended=[[Logs]] (or an axe to chop them), a [[tinderbox]], and a [[raw karambwan]] (one is obtainable later in the quest), [[Brimhaven teleport|Brimhaven Teleport]].|skills={{SCP|Fishing|5}} {{Boostable|yes}} to catch [[raw karambwanji]]}}

[[File:Meeting Tamayu.png|thumb|Tamayu must slay the Shaikahan before he returns to the village.]]
You can find [[Tamayu]] south-east of Tai Bwo Wannai Village at the mine. He will return to Tai Bwo Wannai only once he has killed [[The Shaikahan]]. Talk to him twice; ask him when he will succeed and offer to join him on his next hunt. During a [[cutscene]] Tamayu will fail to defeat The Shaikahan. He will claim that he is overpowered by its strength, regenerating health, and agility.

'''Do not give your [[spear]] to Tamayu yet. You must poison the spear with karambwan paste, obtained later in the quest, before giving it to Tamayu.''' Go to the [[Holy Lake]] south-west of Tamayu and net-fish for at least 22 [[raw karambwanji]] ({{SCP|Fishing|5}}). (It's recommended to have a few spares or keep the net for later if your [[Cooking]] level is low.) (They are different from [[Karambwan]] and stack like other forms of bait.) If you still need logs, there are some trees that can be cut to the south-west of this pond near the Hunter icon on the minimap.

Now travel north. If you don't have a [[Pestle and mortar]], you can buy one at [[Jiminua's Jungle Store]] (general store icon) north-west of the village. Then continue and talk to [[Lubufu]] (near the POH portal, [[Brimhaven teleport|Brimhaven Teleport]] is useful here) by the fishing [[icon]] on the south-eastern shore of [[Brimhaven]].

[[File:Tai Bwo Wannai Trio Lubufu.png|thumb|Lubufu teaching you the secrets to catching karambwan.]]
Select to "Talk about him..." and ask him how old he is. Then offer to help him collect bait, and then say that he sounds like he could do with the help. He will then tell you to catch 20 karambwanji. Give him the karambwanji and ask him what he uses to catch karambwan, followed by what he does with them, and he will ask you if you want to become his apprentice (you will need to select all options, not just the two listed here). He will then give you a [[karambwan vessel]] and the information that it must be filled with karambwanji as bait. '''You can now catch [[raw karambwan]] with 65 fishing, you will also receive 1500 [[Fishing]] experience'''. If your character goes idle after a couple seconds of fishing, you need to fish at the fishing spots next to Tiadeche in the north east of Karamja. It is recommended you collect more vessels at this stage, one for [[Tiadeche]], one for [[Tinsay]] and one for yourself. You can obtain more by dropping the one in your inventory and then asking [[Lubufu]] for another.

Once you have obtained as many as you wish use a [[raw karambwanji]] on one of these vessels.

See below on how to complete the Tamayu part of this quest.
[[File:Tai Bwo Wannai Trio - Tiadeche catches a karambwan.png|thumb|Tiadeche catches a karambwan.]]

===Tiadeche===
{{Needed|A [[Karambwan vessel]], and a [[Raw karambwanji]]. Logs and Tinderbox, and a [[Ranged]] or [[Magic]] method to kill a [[Monkey]] if you want to save time.}}

Next, go to the north-east corner of the Karamja jungle (fairy ring {{Fairycode|DKP}}) to seek out [[Tiadeche]]. Once found, talk to him. He says he will go back to Tai Bwo Wannai after you teach him how to catch [[Karambwan]]. Give him your '''full''' [[Karambwan vessel]] '''(use your karambwanji on the vessel first, then use the full vessel on Tiadeche)''' and he will subsequently give you a [[Raw karambwan]]. He will also ask you to bring a Karambwan vessel to his brother [[Tinsay]] to request that he study the vessel's design, so the tribe can craft additional vessels. (He will not give you the vessel back; you will have to go get another from Lubufu if you did not already obtain additional vessels earlier.)

While you are here you can grab the nearby [[Seaweed]] that spawns on the beach as you will need it later on.

Once you have the raw karambwan, cook it to obtain a [[poison karambwan]]. If you are an Ironman and burn the [[Karambwan]], you will need to catch another (requires 65 [[Fishing]]). Consider using the [[Hosidius Kitchen]] or some other [[Cooking#Temporary boosts|Cooking boosts]] to minimise the risk of burning it.

Use the [[pestle and mortar]] on the [[Poison karambwan]] to produce [[Karambwan paste]]. Then, use the paste on the [[spear]] to create a karambwan poisoned spear. If you eat the [[Poison karambwan]] you will take up to 5 damage, so right-click on it and select the "use" option, or simply use the pestle and mortar to avoid doing so.

Now, head back to [[Tamayu]] by running south. If you didn't purchase the [[Jogre bones]], kill a [[Jogre]] on the way and pick up the bones. If you don't have a spear, you can continue killing jogres until they drop an [[iron spear]]. Cross the agility shortcut, then run west to the mine.

[[File:Tai Bwo Wannai Trio - The Shaikahan.png|thumb|Tamayu fights the Shaikahan.]]
{{Listen
|title = [[Tamayu Slays the Shaikahan (Tai Bwo Wannai Trio)|Tamayu Slays the Shaikahan]]
|align = right
|filename = Tamayu Slays the Shaikahan (Tai Bwo Wannai Trio).ogg
|desc = The jingle that plays when Tamayu defeats the Shaikahan.}}
Once you have returned to Tamayu, use the newly poisoned spear and your [[Agility potion|Agility potion(4)]] on him (being careful not to drink the potion). While it can be given over multiple potions, he needs 4 doses total. You can now join Tamayu on his hunt and a short [[cutscene]] will play showing Tamayu being successful on his hunt. Once he has slain [[The Shaikahan]] he will promise to return to the village once you've talked with his brothers and father.

To save some time helping [[Tinsay]], kill a nearby [[monkey]] (with [[Ranged]] or [[Magic]], or with a [[halberd]] from one square away) and use its [[Monkey corpse|corpse]] on [[Tamayu]]. He will ask you if you'd like him to skin it, returning the [[monkey bones]] and [[Monkey skin|skin]] (you only need to save the skin).

===Tinsay===
{{Needed|skills={{SCP|Agility|15}} {{Boostable|yes}} to climb the [[rock slide (Cairn Isle)|rock slide]] to [[Cairn Isle]]}}
Now head to [[Cairn Isle]] in order to talk to [[Tinsay]]. He is located up the rockslide ({{SCP|Agility|15}}) and across the bridge. He'll tell you that he's trying to repair the [[Tribal Statue]] in the village. He has lost his sanity recently due to some sort of accident with a [[Jogre]]. He asks for three special local items.

====Banana rum (if not done beforehand)====
{{Needed|A [[banana]], [[Karamjan rum]], and a [[knife]]. Note that the knife is not strictly required. A slashing weapon seems to work as well.}}

The first thing he'll ask you to get him is a bottle of banana-flavoured rum. Head to [[Musa Point]], and buy a bottle of [[Karamjan rum]] from the liquor store there. Then, go into the [[general store]], take the banana and knife off the table and use the knife with the banana to slice it. Add these [[Sliced banana|slices]] to the rum and give it to Tinsay (be careful not to eat the slices).

Do not use a whole banana on the rum without slicing it. It will create a joke item, [[Karamjan rum (banana)]]. If done so you will need to get another bottle of [[Karamjan rum]] to try again.

====Seaweed sandwich====
{{Needed|[[Seaweed]], and a [[monkey skin]]  or a [[Ranged]] or [[Magic]] method to kill a monkey.}}

Next Tinsay wants you to bring him a [[Seaweed sandwich]]. If you do not already have the items cross back over the bridge to collect [[Seaweed]] from the beach and equip your [[Ranged]] or [[Magic]] gear (or a halberd) in order to kill a [[Monkey]]. Collect the [[Monkey corpse]] and take it back to [[Tamayu]] to be skinned and be given [[Monkey skin]].

Once you have both items use them on each other to create a [[Seaweed sandwich]] to give to [[Tinsay]].

Like before, do not use a [[monkey corpse]] on the [[seaweed]] before taking the monkey to Tamayu for skinning. This will create another joke item, [[Stuffed monkey]], and you will need to give the stuffed monkey to Tamayu to revert it back to its base components.

After you make the seaweed sandwich, use one of the [[karambwan vessel]]s on Tinsay to receive the [[Crafting manual]] for [[Tiadeche]]. He won't accept it until you make the sandwich.

====Marinated jogre bones====
{{Needed|[[Jogre bones]], a [[raw karambwanji]], a [[pestle and mortar]]. Recommended: [[logs]], and a [[tinderbox]] (for cooking the pasty jogre bones).}}
{{Listen
|title = [[Tinsay Satisfied (Tai Bwo Wannai Trio)|Tinsay Satisfied]]
|align = right
|filename = Tinsay Satisfied (Tai Bwo Wannai Trio).ogg
|desc = The jingle that plays upon Tinsay agreeing to return to Tai Bwo Wannai.}}
{{Listen
|title = [[Tiadeche Thankful (Tai Bwo Wannai Trio)|Tiadeche Thankful]]
|align = right
|filename = Tiadeche Thankful (Tai Bwo Wannai Trio).ogg
|desc = The jingle that plays upon Tiadeche agreeing to return to Tai Bwo Wannai..}}
You now need to get some burnt jogre bones marinated in karambwanji sauce. '''Be careful not to bury the bones!''' The bones can be accidentally buried at any step in this process.

# Use the jogre bones on a '''tinderbox''' to burn them. It will take a couple of seconds for them to finish burning, after which you can pick them up. If your [[Firemaking]] level is below level 30, you will not be able to burn the jogre bones with a tinderbox. Instead, you will have to burn them in a '''[[furnace]]'''. Alternatively, cast '''[[Superheat Item]]''' on the jogre bones.
# Grind a [[raw karambwanji]] with your [[pestle and mortar]].
# Use the [[Karambwanji paste|paste]] on the [[Burnt jogre bones|burnt bones]] to get [[pasty jogre bones]].
# Cook the pasty jogre bones on a [[range]] or [[fire]] to marinate them, and give the [[marinated j' bones]] to Tinsay. Note: These bones should be green in colour. If you cooked the bones wrong, they will be white instead.

Like before, do not use the karambwanji paste on the jogre bones before burning the jogre bones. This will create another joke item, useless [[marinated j' bones]] (which will be white, not green). You will have to get new jogre bones and karambwanji paste.

Now that you've helped Tinsay, he will regain his sanity and agree to return to Tai Bwo Wannai. Before leaving, give a spare [[karambwan vessel]] to Tinsay and receive the [[Crafting manual]]. 

Return to Tiadeche with the [[Crafting manual]], and they will both return to Tai Bwo Wannai.


===Wrapping up===
After you're done with all three brothers, talk to [[Timfraku]] up the ladder in the north-west house of [[Tai Bwo Wannai]] again to complete the quest. 

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

'''Note''': You must talk to each of the three brothers in their houses along the southern fence of the village to receive the additional experience rewards.

==Details==
{{Quest details
|start = Talk to [[Kangai Mau]] at [[The Shrimp and Parrot]] restaurant in [[Brimhaven]].
|startmap = 2791,3182
|difficulty = Intermediate

==Walkthrough==
===Stolen totem===
[[File:Tribal Totem - Kangai.png|thumb|220px|Kangai in the Shrimp and Parrot shop.]]
[[File:Kangai Mau chathead.png|left]]
Talk to [[Kangai Mau]] in [[Brimhaven]], in the [[the Shrimp and Parrot|Shrimp and Parrot]] food shop. Tell him you are in search of adventure, and he will say that he needs someone to go on a mission to [[Ardougne]]. Lord Handelmort has stolen the [[Rantuki tribe]] tribal totem for his private museum, and he wants you to get it back.
{{Clear|left}}
===Rerouting a magical delivery===
[[File:GPDT employee chathead.png|left|80px|frameless]]
[[File:Tribal Totem - GPDT.png|thumb|220px|right|G.P.D.T.]]
If you were to head to Lord Handelmort's mansion in [[Ardougne]], you would find that the door is locked. You need to find a method to get past the front door.

Instead, head to the [[Gielinor Parcel Delivery Team|GPDT depot]], just west of the [[Ardougne]] docks and just south of the eastern [[bank]]. Investigate the [[crate (Tribal Totem)#Double|north-eastern crate]] to find an [[address label]], addressed to Lord Handelmort. South of this crate is another crate, intended for delivery to the [[Wizards' Tower]]. This crate contains a teleport block, [[Wizard Cromperty]]'s new invention. Use the [[address label]] on this crate to mark it for delivery to the mansion instead.

Ask a nearby [[GPDT employee]] when the crate will be delivered, and he will agree to deliver it now.

===Sneaky teleportation===
{{Needed|skills={{SCP|Thieving|21}} {{Boostable|yes}} to disable a trap in the following section}}
[[File:Wizard Cromperty chathead.png|left|80px|frameless]]
Talk to [[Wizard Cromperty]], found in the house north-east of the [[Ardougne market]]. '''Do not use the right-click 'Teleport' option,''' or you will be sent to the [[Rune essence mine]]. Ask him what he has invented, and he will tell you about his new teleportation block. Ask to be teleported, then confirm that it sounds good when he says you will end up by the teleportation block. You will find yourself inside Handelmort's mansion.
{{Clear|left}}

===Retrieving the totem===
[[File:Totem detail.png|left|frameless|80px]]
[[File:Tribal Totem - Chest.png|thumb|200px|The chest that contains the Totem.]]
Go west through two doors. The second door is locked; the password is Lord Handelmort's middle name, which is '''K U R T'''. You would have found this out by reading the [[Guide book]] in the Estate Agent's house, after some clues from [[Horacio]] the gardener, but this was not necessary to progress the quest.

Enter the code using the left and right arrows (K=10 right, U=6 left, R=9 left, T=7 left). When the password is set, click enter to unlock the door. 

:'''Note:''' If the password K U R T does not work and it states "This combination is incorrect", try entering the letters very slowly and only clicking the right arrow, as the game may not register the letters if clicking too quickly.

The [[stairs (Tribal Totem)|stairs]] are booby trapped; '''Do not use the "climb-up" option first!''' Instead, '''investigate''' the stairs ({{SCP|Thieving|21}}), then climb up. If {{Mes|You don't find anything interesting}} appears, you don't have the required level.

:'''Note''': If you trigger the trap, you will end up in the [[Ardougne Sewers]]. Go south-west and climb up the ladder, then return to Cromperty for another teleport. You will not need to enter the door code again.

Exit the southern door onto the balcony and enter the room to the east. Open the chest and search it to find the tribal totem.

:'''Note''': You can use the [[drop trick]] if you want more totems as a souvenir.

Return the [[totem]] to Kangai Mau in [[Brimhaven]]. He will give you 5 [[swordfish]] as thanks.

==Walkthrough==
===Protecting the Spirit Tree===
{{Map:Tree Gnome Village path}}
[[File:King Bolren chathead.png|left|frameless]]
Head to the centre of the [[Gnome Maze|Tree Gnome Maze]] (see the map to the right for the path through the maze). The maze is located south-east of [[East Ardougne]] and north of [[Yanille]]. Talk to [[King Bolren]], who will say that three orbs have been stolen by Khazard troops. Agree to help him, and you will be escorted by Elkoy out of the maze.
{{Clear|left}}
===The three trackers===
{{Needed|6 normal logs.}}
[[File:Commander Montai chathead.png|left|frameless]]
{{Map
|align=right
|width=250
|height=250
|x=2511
|y=3250
|mtype=square
|zoom=2
|caption=Tracker gnome locations.
|x:2504,y:3263,r:3,desc:Tracker gnome 1
|x:2524,y:3257,r:3,desc:Tracker gnome 2
|x:2492,y:3231,r:3,desc:Tracker gnome 3
}}

North to the [[Gnome maze|maze]] you will find a [[battlefield]]. Find [[Commander Montai]] and speak with him, he is wearing red clothing. He will ask for you to bring him 6 [[logs]] to repair their defences. After giving him the logs, talk to [[Commander Montai]] again, and he'll tell you that three trackers that have been sent out to retrieve coordinates to fire the [[ballista (Tree Gnome Village)|ballista]] have not returned. He asks you to find them.

You can find all three tracker gnomes at the buildings north to the [[battlefield]]. (look at the picture to the right to see the locations)
{{Clear|left}}
*The first tracker is behind or on the side of the biggest building in the north-west.
*The second tracker is in the north-east building in a Khazard Prison Cell.
*The third tracker is roaming outside the south-west corner of the stronghold.

The first two trackers will give you the coordinates you need, which you'll automatically commit to memory. The third tracker, however, has been driven mad as a result of the chaos. Though most of what he says is garbage, he will give you a hint as to the number you need. You may have to do a bit of guesswork, though. For instance, ''"Less than my hands"'' would equal 1, where ''"More than my head less than my fingers"'' could be 2, ''"More than we but less than our feet"'' is 3, and lastly, ''"My legs and your legs"'' is 4. (It should not be any other possible number so try and remember what the third tracker said.)

Head back to the [[Ballista (Tree Gnome Village)|ballista]] (not the [[Catapult (Battlefield)|catapult]], which is next to Montai), which is located in the south-west corner of the battlefield, here you want to choose the coordinate given from the third gnome tracker. If you miss, just try again until you get it.

===Retrieving the first orb===
{{Needed|recommended=[[Food]] and [[armour]] for low levels}}
[[File:Orb of Protection detail.png|left|80px]]
[[File:Tree Gnome Village - Crumbled wall.png|thumb|250px|The crumbled wall you can climb over.]]
Once you get a hit, talk to [[Commander Montai]] once again then walk north to the stronghold (building where Gnome Tracker 1 was) and climb over the crumbled wall. 

'''Note:''' There is a stall after climbing the crumbled wall where you are attacked without being able to heal; as a low-levelled player, this may be dangerous.

Once you climb the wall you will be attacked by a level 48 [[Khazard commander]]; he has low [[Hitpoints]] (22) and should not be troublesome for most mid-levelled players (can be [[safespot]]ted behind northern broken chair). You can skip defeating the commander if you wish and proceed to the western room and climb up the ladder.

When you climb the [[ladder]] you will once again be attacked by a level 48 [[Khazard commander]], kill him or head to the chest and  find the [[orb of protection]]. When you have the orb, run back down the ladder and out of the nearby door.

Return to the north-west maze entrance and talk to [[Elkoy]], he will offer to lead you through the maze, accept his offer.

Talk to [[King Bolren]] in the centre of the maze and he will inform you that the other two [[orbs of protection]] have been stolen by the [[Khazard warlord|Khazard Warlord]].

===Retrieving the last two orbs===
{{Needed|Combat equipment to defeat a level 112}}
[[File:Khazard warlord chathead.png|left|frameless]]
'''Note:''' The orbs will only be dropped by the Warlord after you've spoken to the King.

{{Map|name=Khazard warlord|2455,3301|r=4|mtype=square|caption=The location of the Khazard warlord.|align=right|width=220|height=220}}

Exit the village and start heading north past the stronghold where you found the first orb. When you hit the wall to [[West Ardougne]], follow it to the west past the wolves and then to the north until you see two [[Khazard trooper|Khazard troopers]] and the level 112  [[Khazard warlord]]. The warlord will be unaggressive until you talk with him, at which point he will challenge you to a fight and attack.

Kill him to retrieve the other two orbs. Players with [[Rune armour]] and at least a [[rune scimitar]] should have little trouble fighting him if they have a small amount of decent quality [[food]] ([[lobster]] or better), though the warlord has a rather large HP of 170.

[[File:Tree Gnome Village - Warlord safespot.png|thumb|left|220px|A player safespotting the Khazard warlord.]]

Lower levelled players may consider using Magic or Ranged to [[safespot]] him. After initiating the fight, head west until the warlord de-aggros near the larger dead tree. Move a little south and attack the warlord with Ranged or Magic while outside his aggro range. This will force the warlord to walk backwards at an angle and get caught against the West Ardougne wall and the northern large dead tree. If done correctly, players can attack the warlord safely as long as they keep distant enough as to not aggro the warlord again. If you fail to get the warlord stuck, you can also simply run away from him whenever he gets close, only attacking him while he is wandering back.

'''Note''': He may despawn if you take too long to kill him using this method.

He may also be [[flinched]] using melee by repeatedly stepping in and out of his walking range. One good spot is beside the large skull to the south. He does not despawn when flinched.

After killing him, pick up the [[orbs of protection]]. Go back to King Bolren and hand over the orbs to him. A cutscene ensues, where the gnomes are seen celebrating and holding a ceremony in which the orbs are returned to their places on the sacred spirit tree.

[[File:Tree Gnome Village - Orbs restored.gif|thumb|left|180px|King Bolren returns the orbs to the spirit tree.]]

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

==Walkthrough==
{{Needed|skills={{SCP|Agility|15}} {{Boostable|yes}} to climb rocks with your [[climbing boots]]}}
[[File:Troll Stronghold - Troll Country.png|thumb|This is the route to the Stronghold.]]
Bring all the items needed before starting the quest as there is no nearby bank once you take the shortcut behind [[Tenzing]]'s house.

Start this quest by speaking with [[Denulth]] in [[Burthorpe]] located south-east of the [[Warriors' Guild]] in the tent (South of the Burthorpe teleport from the [[games necklace]]). Tell him that you will help him out and find [[Godric]]. After talking to Denulth, follow the path north-west, then going south-west when you reach the [[injured soldier]], and reach Tenzing's house. Tenzing sells [[climbing boots]] for 12 [[coins]] each if you don't have them. Climb over the stile behind the house to begin the journey up the mountain. Follow the path until you see some rocks to the north. Put your boots on and climb over them ({{SCP|Agility|15}}). Then, go east and enter the arena. You will have to climb rocks twice more before reaching the arena.

===Dad===
A huge troll called [[Dad]] will prevent passage until you defeat him. At level 101 and using a tree to hit with [[Melee]], he can hit up to 27 and send players flying, temporarily [[Stun (status)|stunning]] them. Dad can be [[safespotted]] by standing next to the western gate, or standing where the audience is, and attacking with either [[Ranged]] or [[Magic]] (using a [[halberd]] is a good Melee alternative). Note that Dad has high [[Defence]] stats against Ranged and Magic, so it may take a little bit before you kill him. It is much easier to damage Dad using magic, compared to range. 

When Dad is low on health, he will ask you to spare his life. Spare him and walk past to the gate north of the arena. Be careful as he may try to hit you still if you are in range. '''Note:''' If you don't spare his life, you can still continue the quest.

===Advancing towards the stronghold===
Enter the cave north of the arena, and go past the level 69 and 71 [[mountain troll]]s. Beyond this is [[Trollheim]]. There are level 68 [[thrower troll]]s who will range players here as they walk past the northern part of the mountain. You can avoid them entirely by taking a shortcut by climbing up the rocks, starting from the eastern region of the mountain and ending at the western side. Some of the shortcuts require 41, 43, 44, or 47 [[Agility]]. If you do not have at least 44 Agility, run around the mountain and activate [[Protect from Missiles]] around the northern bend to avoid taking too much damage from the trolls to get to the western portion. (Avoid the north-west portion going towards the [[God Wars Dungeon]].)

Go west of Trollheim and north past several mountain trolls. Enter inside the [[Troll Stronghold (location)|Stronghold]].

===Inside the stronghold===
[[File:Troll general safespot.png|thumb|220px|Safespot for the Troll General.]]
Inside are some more level 69 and 71 [[mountain troll]]s. From the entrance, walk south until you see a door on the west wall. Enter and walk north, passing the non-aggressive troll, [[Kob]]. You will see several '''aggressive''' [[troll generals]] (level 113). They wield huge granite knives and mauls, which can hit up to 38. Kill one to get a [[prison key (Troll Stronghold)|prison key]]. Use [[Protect from Melee]] or [[safespot]] them with [[Ranged]] or [[Magic]]. The southern-most general can be safespotted easily by standing on either side of the desk in his room, or by standing next to the ladder and luring him out into the corridor. Like [[Dad]], it may take a while if killing with Ranged or Magic as they have a high [[Defence]] against both.

===Prison break===
[[File:Berry and Twig safespots.png|thumb|220px|Safespots for Berry and Twig.]]
Once you have the key, go back south, down the stairs arriving in [[Burntmeat]]'s Kitchen, and then go to the very north end of the [[Troll Stronghold (location)|Stronghold]]. Enter the locked door with the prison key, and climb down again to reach a jail. Head west and south, and you'll see two sleeping prison guards called [[Berry]] and [[Twig]]. Both are level 71. If you have level 30 [[Thieving]], pickpocket both to get [[Cell key 1]] and [[Cell key 2]]. Beware, if you fail to pickpocket one, they will still attack you! If not, kill them for the keys. You can [[safespot]] both trolls by standing inside one of the vacant cells. Free both [[Eadgar]] and [[Godric]] with the keys; then, exit the prison by going south to the secret exit.

===Finishing up===
Head south-east and climb over the rocks; you can use the [[minigame teleport]] or use a [[games necklace]] to return to [[Burthorpe]]. Go to the north-east corner of the city, and talk to [[Dunstan]] (look for the [[Smithing]] icon) for your reward.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

The mountain map on the right shows a number of relevant locations for the Troll Romance quest:

In the remainder of the walkthrough, the map numbers will be referenced in the relevant parts of the text. 

*Consider starting [[Eadgar's Ruse]] before heading to [[Troll Stronghold (location)|Troll Stronghold]] to save time running back and forth.

===Ug's woes===
[[File:Ug chathead.png|left]]
[[File:Troll Romance Ug.png|thumb|Ug, crying his heart out.]]

Speak to [[Ug]], a weeping troll  found inside the [[Troll Stronghold (location)|stronghold]]. To get to the stronghold in this manner, use the [[Trollheim Teleport]] '''or''' walk to the western entrance in the mountains. From the teleport location ('''1''' on the map), go to the south-west path. Walk past some [[troll]]s, and take a ramp on the north-western side of that area ('''5''' on the map). After entering the stronghold, use the stairs at the northern side of the corridor. Once down, take the southern corridor. At the end of the corridor, go through the door leading west. Ug is in the southern part of the room.

If using slayer rings ('''2''' on the map), or the fairy ring ('''3''' on the map) walk from the teleport location north-east to the shortcut ('''4''' on the map; requires [[climbing boots]] to use) and enter the stronghold. Follow the corridor north and use the stairs in the north-eastern corner. Once up the stairs travel south down the corridor, go through the door leading west. Ug is in the southern portion of the west room. 

'''Talk to [[Ug]]''' to learn that he is very much in love with [[Aga]], who, unfortunately, loves [[Arrg]], a much stronger troll than is Ug. Offer your help; Ug will gladly accept it, promising he maybe won't eat you. 

'''You should talk to [[Aga]]''', who is in the room north of Ug, accompanied by the fearsome Arrg.

If you want, compliment Aga about her being big and hairy, then enquire about her love life. She is a very romantic troll: whilst Arrg is big and strong, she does not know whether he loves her. He promised to bring her a rare and beautiful [[Trollweiss]] flower, but has not done so yet. She has never heard of Ug. 

'''Talk to an angry [[Arrg]]''' to discover that he does not seem to be very much in love with Aga ('she good cook and wash but talk too many') and has many girlfriends. He also has no knowledge of the Trollweiss location, only promising Aga the flower to shut her up. 

'''Go talk to [[Ug]] again''' to tell him Aga's desire for a Trollweiss flower. He concludes he stands no chance, for no such flower has been found for years, nor will you be able to find one. He says that one who has lived their whole life in the mountains would know where to find [[Trollweiss]], giving you an idea.

===Mystery of the flower===
{{Needed|[[Maple logs|maple]] or [[yew logs]], [[iron bar]], [[rope]], [[cake tin]], [[swamp tar]], [[bucket of wax]]}}
[[File:Troll Romance Tenzing.png|thumb|Tenzing describes the location of the flower.]]

A person that is knowledgeable about the mountains is [[Tenzing]] the sherpa. He lives on the path from [[Burthorpe]] to the [[Troll Stronghold (location)|stronghold]] ('''7''' on the map). Use the [[games necklace]] or [[grouping]] interface to teleport to Burthorpe. From the teleport location, go west and then north-west up the path. At the [[Soldier (Death Plateau)|wounded soldier]], go south-west on the winding mountain path to Tenzing's hut ('''7''' on the map).

[[Tenzing]] explains that [[Trollweiss]] used to grow everywhere but has been disappearing lately. It definitely remains in the [[ice troll]] area, but that is very dangerous and impossible to reach. You would have to reach a certain plateau at the bottom of a slope that has been snowed over. He mentions that a [[sled]] may be useful for getting to that plateau, although you would not be able to get back up. [[Dunstan]] knows more about making a sled, as he has often helped Tenzing with his boots.

[[Dunstan]] is the [[Burthorpe]] smith, whose house is north-east of the [[Burthorpe Castle]] ('''8''' on the map). Talk to him and ask for a sled. He says you are too old to be playing in the snow, but you explain that you need to reach a particular location on [[Trollweiss Mountain]]. He will agree to help you as you have often helped his family. After some thinking, he requests that you bring him the following materials: [[Maple logs|maple]] or [[yew logs]], an [[iron bar]] and a coil of [[rope]]. If you want, ask him about [[Godric|his son]], who has been training with the Imperial Guard and promoted to the rank of sergeant.

Bring him the materials. Dunstan fashions you a sled but it still has to be waxed in order to smoothen and protect the wood. He says you can mix some [[swamp tar]] with wax in a [[cake tin]] to achieve the desired effect. You can get tar from the [[Lumbridge Swamp]] and suggests the wax is found near [[bees]]. Get some swamp tar and a [[bucket of wax]]. The latter can be obtained from the [[beehives]] south of [[Camelot]]. (An empty bucket spawns nearby.) You require [[insect repellent]], found in the house north of [[Catherby]] bank, in order to do so.

With an empty [[cake tin]] in your inventory, use the [[swamp tar]] on the [[bucket of wax]] to get [[wax]] (in the cake tin). Note that it has to be done in that order. Use the wax on the sled to make a waxed sled, making it possible to ride it. The next task is to go up [[Trollweiss Mountain]], past the ice trolls' realm.

===Fetching the flowers===
{{Needed|[[Sled]] (waxed)|recommended=Food, energy potions, prayer potions.|skills={{SCP|Agility|28}} {{Boostable|yes}} to descend the slope}}

Return to [[Trollheim]] using the [[Trollheim Teleport]] spell, via [[Fairy rings]] (code {{Fairycode|ajr}}), the [[Slayer ring]], or make the long walk. Exit the Trollheim maze on the north-western side and take the narrow path leading north, then west, then north again to a dungeon entrance just past the ice gates and the [[troll child]].

The dungeon entrance is shown on the minimap as a red exclamation mark; it faces east and is labelled '''9''' on the map. Do '''not''' enter the ice gate east of the child.

It will be snowing around the area of the cave. '''Do not spend too much time standing in the snowing area as all your stats will slowly decrease by 1.'''

Enter this cave and walk through it to the north-western corner. Beware of the [[Ice troll|ice trolls]] which have a strong [[melee]] attack. In the north-western corner is the exit (marked red on the minimap): a narrow crevasse. It's hard to see. It's the little alcove just before the very end. There are no trolls near the crevasse inside the cave, so you can wait here to rest as needed.

[[File:Trollweiss mountain.png|thumb|An undisturbed patch of rare Trollweiss flowers.]]

When outside, walk south past the [[Ice wolf|ice wolves]] to an opening in the rocks at which point you can walk no longer. Click the slope once to ride the sled ({{SCP|Agility|28}}) due south to crash into a rock just east of the flower patch. You'll see the circular area with a red dot and a central rock; unequip the sled and walk in. (Be careful not to sled down the second slope further south, or else you will have to climb the entire mountain again.) 

'''If you teleport away while using the sled and you have full inventory, you will lose it and have to get a new one!'''

Pick the [[rare flowers]]. Teleport out to prepare for the final battle, or if you brought combat items, you can return to [[Ug]] by riding the sled down the rest of the mountain, going through the tunnel coming out on Rellekka's side and running back to the shortcut ('''4''' on the map). This requires [[climbing boots]].

===Facing Arrg's wrath===
{{Needed|[[Trollweiss]], equipment and supplies for fighting Arrg}}

'''Note:''' The fight with Arrg is not a safe death for [[Ironman Mode#Hardcore|Hardcore Ironmen]].

Return to [[Ug]] and give him the Trollweiss. (You are not able to talk to him if you have the flower in your hand.) Ug will be very glad to receive the flowers, but he is afraid of [[Arrg]], so he cannot give [[Aga]] the Trollweiss directly. The only option is to battle Arrg.

[[File:Fighting Arrg.png|thumb|Duelling Arrg to the death!]]

Go to the room north of [[Ug]] where [[Arrg]] is still around. Prepare for battle before talking to him. Arrg has the same combat level and similar stats as [[Troll General]]s. He primarily uses a moderately inaccurate, but very strong melee attack with a max hit of 38. However, he also uses a slightly weaker but '''significantly''' more accurate Ranged attack that hits up to 30 damage. Both attacks can occasionally hit through protection prayers. If fighting him up close, it is recommended to use [[Protect from Melee]] as he does not change his attack styles based on protection prayers.

Talk to Arrg and defend Aga's honour. You will challenge him to a duel, but not in front of the lady. The two of you are transported into the [[Troll arena]] ('''10''' on the map).

===Fighting Arrg===
Arrg attacks immediately after the teleport, so be prepared. '''Note that you will automatically retaliate.''' Arrg has a strong [[melee]] attack and can hit through [[protection prayers]]. He can also throw rocks, so make sure to keep food on hand. He is level 113 and does not have very high defence or hitpoints.

[[File:Troll Romance - Arrg safespot.png|thumb|left|250px|The safespot for fighting Arrg.]]

There are multiple safespots for Arrg. For the first, run to the centre of the raised land at the north-west of the arena with [[Protect from Melee]] activated, waiting for Arrg to catch up. Once he is on the raised land, run to the west gate and he should get stuck against the mountain wall.

The second safespot is at the northern end of the arena, lure Arrg to the gate and then simply run onto the raised ground to the west and he will get stuck on the end.

Arrg should be killed as quickly as possible, as he will disappear after a few minutes, reappearing at the spot where Ug is.

:'''Note:''' The spectator trolls '''cannot''' be used as obstacles for safespotting as Arrg will walk through them.

If you die during the fight, you may return to the arena to fight him again. Note that he will follow the player around, but will not attack first, making safespotting easier. If you don't have a spare pair of climbing boots, don't forget to bring 12 coins to Tenzing to buy a new pair to allow you to return.

[[File:Second Arrg safespot.png|thumb|Second safespot for Arrg.]]

Defeat Arrg; he will dramatically shout his name and fall to the ground. Victorious, return to Ug. Head west out of the arena until you reach the secret entrance ('''4''' on the map). Otherwise, return via Trollheim. (Arrg will have lost his macho attitude and cringe before you.)

Tell Ug about the demise of Arrg. Since you are very strong and nice, he gives you some 'pretty rocks' in thanks. Rather unfortunately, he is still too scared to talk to Aga, upon which you call him useless and compare him to your toothless grandmother. This will convince him to finally win over the lady troll. She will eat the flower and become his girlfriend, making him weep tears of joy.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

==Trivia==
* When threatened Arrg says "This concept of love confuses and infuriates us!". This is a quote from Omicronian Leader Lrrr in the ''{{Wp|Futurama}}'' episode "{{Wp|Love and Rocket}}".
* When speaking to Tenzing about the location of the Trollweiss he mentions global warming (i.e. climate change), referring to the area being inaccessible due to a lot of snow.
* When picking up the Trollweiss flower with no available inventory space your character will say in dialogue "I know it's only a flower, but I haven't got enough space..."
* When speaking to Dunstan about the sled, he ends with "Thank you, come again." This is a reference to Apu from ''{{Wp|The Simpsons}}''.
* The game tells you "That's probably not a good idea..." when attempting to use Trollweiss on Aga.
* Trollweiss is a reference to the Edelweiss flower found in the European Alps.
